Amendement van het lid Arib c.s. waarmee wordt voorkomen dat een noodzakelijke structurele ramingsbijstelling bij de fractiekostenregeling ten koste gaat van de controlerende en wetgevende taak van de

Shifts budget compensation from the Interior Ministry to the House of Representatives budget so that a structural adjustment to the faction-cost scheme does not reduce parliament's legislative and control capacity.
This amendment aims to prevent a necessary structural budget adjustment to the faction-cost scheme from coming at the expense of the States General's control and legislative task.

Shifts funding from the Ministry of Interior to cover a structural shortfall in the parliamentary faction funding scheme, so that parliament's control and legislative work are not cut.
so that this adjustment does not come at the expense of the current Chamber budget and thus of the legislative and supervisory task of the House of Representatives, compensation is provided

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ortega-Martijn c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 29 om de informatievoorziening op Locatie Werk en Inkomen te waarborgen, o.a. met het oog op het belang van Wajongers
Shifts EUR 1 million within the labour participation budget to ensure information provision and support at Work and Income Locations for new client groups such as Wajongers during reorganisation.
This amendment adds EUR 1,000,000 to article 47, operational objective 2, for information provision at Work and Income Locations.
Dit amendement voegt aan artikel 47, operationele doelstelling 2, € 1 000 000 toe ten behoeve van informatievoorziening op Locaties Werk en Inkomen.
Amendement van het lid Ortega-Martijn c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 19 om de informatievoorziening op Locaties Wrk en Inkomen te waarborgen o.a. met het oog op belang van Wajongers
Moves 1 million euro within the social affairs budget (article 47) to fund information provision at Work and Income locations for new client groups such as Wajongers.
This amendment adds 1,000,000 euro to article 47, operational objective 2, for information provision at Work and Income locations.
Dit amendement voegt aan artikel 47, operationele doelstelling 2, € 1 000 000 toe ten behoeve van informatievoorziening op Locaties Werk en Inkomen.
Motie Madlener en Vermeij over betaalbare vrije kavels in de Randstad
Asks the government to promote more free building plots for homes, especially in the Randstad, with affordability for middle incomes in mind.
requests the government to promote an increase in the number of free plots for homes, especially in the Randstad
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat het aantal vrije kavels voor woningen, vooral in de Randstad, toeneemt
Motie Vermeij c.s. over robuuste financiering voor herstructurering van verouderde bedrijventerreinen
Asks the government to propose robust financing for restructuring old business parks, with provinces, municipalities and businesses contributing, and a cross-subsidy method from new sites.
requests the government to soon come with a proposal for robust financing for restructuring outdated business parks
verzoekt de regering op korte termijn te komen met een voorstel voor een robuuste financiering voor herstructurering van verouderde bedrijfsterreinen
Motie vermeij c.s. over het expliciet opnemen van schoolpleinen in het Activiteitenbesluit
Asks the government to explicitly include school playgrounds in the Activiteitenbesluit noise rules.
requests the government to explicitly include school playgrounds in the Activiteitenbesluit
verzoekt de regering schoolpleinen expliciet in het Activiteitenbesluit op te nemen
Motie Vermeij c.s. over technische oplossingen ter vermindering van radarverstoring
Asks the government to seek technical solutions to reduce radar interference so that more high-rise buildings and wind turbines are possible.
instructs the government to look for technical solutions to reduce radar interference
draagt de regering op te zoeken naar technische oplossingen ter vermindering van radarverstoring
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over binnenstedelijk bouwen niet ten koste laten gaan van binnenstedelijk groen
Asks the government to encourage municipalities to limit urban infill harm to inner-city green space and favour higher building.
requests the government to encourage municipalities to minimise harm to inner-city green from inner-city building targets
verzoekt de regering bij gemeenten te bevorderen dat zij de doelstellingen binnenstedelijk bouwen zo min mogelijk ten koste laten gaan van binnenstedelijk groen
Motie Van Heugten c.s. over een handreiking om onderzoeksplichten te stroomlijnen
Asks the government, with municipalities, water boards and provinces, to produce within six months a practical guide streamlining environmental investigation duties for zoning plans.
requests the government, in cooperation with municipalities, water boards and provinces, to draw up within half a year a practical guide
verzoekt de regering om in samenwerking met gemeenten, waterschappen en provincies binnen een halfjaar een praktische handreiking op te stellen
Motie Van Heugten en Vermeij over een ruimtelijk plan voor een Olympische hoofdstructuur
Asks the government to draft a spatial plan for an Olympic main structure once feasibility research gives a positive result.
requests the government, once said research yields a positive result, to make a spatial plan for an Olympic main structure
verzoekt de regering om zodra genoemd onderzoek een positief resultaat oplevert, een ruimtelijk plan te maken voor een Olympische Hoofdstructuur
Motie Spies c.s. over afspraken met de branche over stille banden
Asks the government to agree with the tyre industry that silent tyres become the standard.
requests the government to reach agreements with the industry that lead to silent tyres becoming standard
verzoekt de regering in overleg met de branche te komen tot afspraken die ertoe leiden dat stille banden standaard worden
Motie Ortega-Martijn en Vermeij over onafhankelijk informatie kunnen inwinnen door werkzoekenden
Asks the government to promote that jobseekers can obtain independent information on work and income at Locaties Werk en Inkomen.
requests the government to promote that jobseekers at the Work and Income Locations can obtain independent information on work and income
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat op de Locaties Werk en Inkomen werkzoekenden onafhankelijke informatie op het terrein van werk en inkomen kunnen inwinnen
Motie Van Gent c.s. over hanteren van dezelfde naam door alle Locaties Werk en Inkomen
Asks the government to promote that all Locaties Werk en Inkomen use the same name.
requests the government to promote that the Locaties Werk en Inkomen all use the same name
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat de Locaties Werk en Inkomen alle dezelfde naam gaan hanteren
Motie Ortega-Martijn c.s. over waarborgen van specialistische kennis voor Wajong'ers
Asks the government to ensure specialist knowledge for Wajong beneficiaries remains available at Locaties Werk en Inkomen.
requests the government to ensure that specialist knowledge for Wajong beneficiaries is retained at Locaties Werk en Inkomen
verzoekt de regering te waarborgen dat specialistische kennis voor Wajong’ers op Locaties Werk en Inkomen behouden blijft
Motie Van Hijum c.s. over de schaal van regionale samenwerking en de aanwijzing van bovenlokale dienstverlening
Motion asking the government to inform the Chamber by mid-2009 on the scale of regional cooperation and designation of supra-local employment services.
requests the government, after consultation with municipalities and UWV, to inform the Chamber before 1 July 2009 about the scale of regional cooperation
verzoekt de regering om na overleg met gemeenten en UWV, de Kamer voor 1 juli 2009 te informeren over de schaal van de regionale samenwerking
Motie Vermeij c.s. over samenspraak over beleidsplannen voor het regionale arbeidsmarktbeleid
Motion asking the government to promote that regional labour market plans be drawn up with social partners and education institutions and reported to the House.
requests the government to actively promote that regional labour market policy plans are drawn up in consultation with social partners
verzoekt de regering actief te bevorderen dat de beleidsplannen voor het regionale arbeidsmarktbeleid worden opgesteld in samenspraak met sociale partners
Motie Vermeij en Van Gent over een handreiking voor de cliëntenparticipatie in de LWI
Asks the government to ask the Raad voor Werk en Inkomen to draft a guide for client participation in the LWI.
requests the government to ask the Raad voor Werk en Inkomen to develop a guide
verzoekt de regering de Raad voor Werk en Inkomen te vragen om een handreiking uit te werken
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over de onafhankelijke positie van de Raad voor Werk en Inkomen
Amends the bill so the Raad voor werk en inkomen keeps its independent position and must hold periodic consultation with the UWV.
With this amendment the independent position of the Raad voor Werk en Inkomen remains guaranteed.
Met dit amendement blijft de onafhankelijke positie van de Raad voor Werk en Inkomen gegarandeerd.
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over het waarborgen van de toegankelijkheid en bereikbaarheid van de LWI’s voor cliënten
Requires that work and income offices (LWI) maintain sufficiently accessible locations for clients.
take care of maintaining sufficiently accessible work and income locations
dragen zorg voor de instandhouding van voldoende bereikbare locaties werk en inkomen
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over verplicht karakter delegatiebepaling over de locaties werk en inkomen ten aanzien van de uitwerking van de dienstverlening
Makes the delegation for regulating service at work and income locations mandatory via a general administrative order, including regional spread and client participation rules.
By or pursuant to a general administrative order, rules are set on the service provided at all work and income locations
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld over de dienstverlening die op alle locaties werk en inkomen tenminste plaatsheeft
Amendement van het lid Vermeij c.s. over het ongewijzigd laten van de reikwijdte van het huidige takenpakket van de RWI
Amendment keeping the current task scope of the Raad voor werk en inkomen unchanged, so it can still consult the cabinet on national labour-market problems.
With this amendment the scope of the RWI's current set of tasks remains unchanged.
Met dit amendement blijft de reikwijdte van het huidige takenpakket van de RWI ongewijzigd.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het bericht dat ‘verzekeraars WAO- en WIA-verzekeringen niet door laten lopen tot de AOW-leeftijd’

MP Vermeij asked whether insurers should extend WAO/WIA private supplementary policies to the new AOW age, so people are not cut on UWV benefits between 65 and that age, and what came of talks with the insurers' association and Achmea. The State Secretary answered that statutory benefits must be paid and no cuts are signalled, that private supplementary products are insurers' own responsibility, that insurers have adjusted statutory products and are working on the supplementary ones, and that UWV does not count these private benefits as income.
There can be no question of people being cut on a statutory benefit whose entitlement has been established by UWV.
Er kan geen sprake van zijn van dat mensen gekort worden op een wettelijke uitkering waarvan het recht (door UWV) is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Vermeij over de afwijzing als Gamze Gül en de uitnodiging als Hanneke bij Pathé Arnhem

MPs Marcouch and Vermeij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Pathé Arnhem rejecting Gamze Gül but inviting 'Hanneke' with identical application materials. The minister confirmed the facts as reported, said discrimination is unacceptable but that judging individual cases is for the ADV, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or courts, and described the Inspectie SZW's existing discrimination-team role and industry initiatives such as the Charter Diversiteit.
Given this division of competences, it is not for me to pass a substantive judgement on this or to hold Pathé to account for it.
Het is gelet op deze bevoegdheidsverdeling niet aan mij om hierover een inhoudelijk oordeel over te vellen dan wel Pathé hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het bericht "Verschil renterisico pensioenfondsen België en Nederland"

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report showing Dutch pension liabilities are more interest-rate sensitive than Belgian ones, and whether pension funds are moving to Belgium because of the supervisory framework. The government answered that the frameworks must be compared as a whole, explained why it chose not to include employer sponsor guarantees, and said cross-border pension activity is very limited, with no plan to change the framework beyond awaiting the IORP revision.
The different frameworks must therefore be viewed as a whole and cannot be compared on a single element in isolation.
De verschillende kaders moeten daarom in den brede worden bezien en kunnen niet op één element los vergeleken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Vermeij over het bericht ‘Aantal pensioenfondsen zakt onder driehonderd’

MPs Lodders and Vermeij asked the State Secretary about the reported drop of Dutch pension funds below 300, the causes of consolidation (especially among industry-wide funds) and what will be done to help industry funds merge. The State Secretary explained the long-term consolidation driven by social developments and efficiency concerns, and said a concept bill on merging mandatory industry funds with temporary segregated assets would be sent to parliament.
The cabinet endorses the importance of scale enlargement aimed at reducing administration costs for small and medium-sized pension funds
Het kabinet onderschrijft het belang van schaalvergroting met als doel het verlagen van de uitvoeringskosten voor kleine en middelgrote pensioenfondsen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over de gemeente Haarlem en Tilburg die op basis van payrolling mensen in dienst nemen

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked about municipalities such as Haarlem and Tilburg hiring staff via payrolling for structural work and whether the government will act. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own employment policy, that social partners are already examining the issue, and that the central government sees no need for further action; payrolling rose slightly among municipalities and has ended in central government.
Municipalities are themselves competent and responsible, within the framework of general legislation and collective agreements, for their employment conditions policy and business operations.
Gemeenten zijn namelijk zelf bevoegd en verantwoordelijk binnen de kaders van algemene wetgeving en cao's voor hun arbeidsvoorwaardenbeleid en bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘Zzp’er te karig voor pensioen’

Two Labour MPs asked the State Secretary about a report showing over a million self-employed people saving too little for retirement, and about policy options such as an opt-out pension scheme and debt reduction support. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing fiscal measures and a pending SER study, said an opt-out system is a possibility for a future cabinet to decide, and referred debt support to municipalities.
It is up to a future cabinet to make decisions on this.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om beslissingen hierover te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over het arrest van de Hoge Raad dat payrolling synoniem staat voor uitzendwerk

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Supreme Court ruling that payrolling falls under the temporary-agency rules and whether this will lead to more insecure contracts. The minister confirmed awareness, said the rules apply to triangular relations and that legislative change is needed but will not come in this cabinet period, deferring to a future coalition agreement.
However, a legislative amendment will not be achievable within this cabinet period.
Een wetswijziging zal echter niet meer in deze kabinetsperiode verwezenlijkt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over flexwerkers die aanzienlijk minder verdienen dan collega’s in vaste dienst

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about CBS findings that flex workers earn much less than permanent staff, and whether this violates equal pay. The minister acknowledged the gap, noted that controlling only for hours and tenure leaves differences, said equal pay for equal work is legally required but that courts, not the minister, judge violations, and said the Wwz reforms will be evaluated in 2018 and 2020.
Whether the above legal provisions are being violated, I cannot assess on the basis of the outcomes of this research.
Of in strijd wordt gehandeld met bovengenoemde wettelijke bepalingen kan ik aan de hand van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Recourt over oudere werknemers die de dupe zijn bij een doorstart na faillissement

MPs Vermeij and Recourt asked whether older employees are disadvantaged in going-concern takeovers after bankruptcy and whether the Work and Security Act affects this, and whether curators should weigh employees' interests. The minister answered that employers may select staff but may not discriminate on age, that a comparative study on employee positions in insolvency was sent to parliament, and that consultation with stakeholders on curators' role for employees will follow.
No figures are available on how many and which employees are taken on by the acquiring party in a going-concern takeover after bankruptcy.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over hoeveel en welke werknemers bij een doorstart na faillissement in dienst treden bij de overnemende partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over verzekeraars die polissen niet verlengen tot aan de nieuwe AOW-gerechtigde leeftijd

An MP asked the State Secretary about insurers refusing to extend disability policies to the new AOW retirement age, a case of a 51-year-old fully disabled since 2014, and about a widow facing a months-long income gap before her AOW starts. The State Secretary said the case was not known to her, that insurers are not obliged to offer extensions after a 2015 KiFiD ruling, that she sees no plans for further action, and that the AOW bridging scheme is adequate.
I have no intention of taking additional action in this regard.
Ik heb in dit kader geen voornemen om hierin aanvullend actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Vermeij over het bericht ‘Een op de zeven Hagenaars heeft schulden’

MPs Yücel and Vermeij asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that one in seven residents of The Hague has debts, and about debt relief, financial education and the role of various institutions. The State Secretary acknowledged the economic hardship, pointed to signs of recovery and existing support measures, said the Debt Relief Act is being evaluated with results due by 1 July, and described financial education initiatives and ongoing consultations.
I will send your House the results, including a government response, by 1 July this year.
Ik zal uw Kamer de resultaten inclusief een reactie van het kabinet, uiterlijk 1 juli dit jaar toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij, Pieter Heerma en Van Weyenberg over schoonmakers in de hotelbranche die zwaar onderbetaald worden door middel van stukloon

MPs asked whether the government knew of and would act on reports that hotel cleaners are underpaid through piece-rate pay, and whether the Inspectorate had checked the hotel sector and whether government contracts with implicated hotel chains would end. The minister said the Inspectorate checked hotel cleaning in 2015 (94 cases opened, 16 violations found in closed cases), that government contracts run through intermediaries under generic social conditions with possible stricter clauses in future, and that cleaning in hotels remains under the Inspectorate's focus.
In 2015 the Inspectorate SZW carried out inspections of cleaning in the hotel sector.
In 2015 heeft de Inspectie SZW controles uitgevoerd naar schoonmaak in de hotelbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het bericht ‘Europese stresstest bevestigt kwetsbaarheden pensioenfondsen’

MP Vermeij asked the State Secretary about an EIOPA stress test showing Dutch pension funds are vulnerable: low buffers, high risk profiles, the rate sensitivity of the FTK, and options for relief in the low-rate environment. The State Secretary largely defended the FTK, promised a May update on funds' financial position and risk profile, and said DNB and AFM are scrutinising funds' communication to members.
Yes. In May I will send you an update on the financial position of pension funds, including an assessment by the cabinet.
Ja. In mei zal ik u een update sturen van de financiële positie van de pensioenfondsen, inclusief een appreciatie van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Mei Li Vos over universiteiten en hogescholen die de Wet werk en zekerheid ontduiken met knutselcontracten

MPs asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences use combined permanent-plus-temporary 'knutselcontracten' to evade the Wwz and whether this breaches the cao, and what the government will do. The minister says the cao and Wwz have already curbed such contracts, that cao compliance is for the parties and courts, and that the government agrees permanent contracts should be the norm, while noting some combinations will remain legitimate.
It is not for us to judge whether these contracts comply with the provisions of the cao, but for the cao parties themselves and ultimately the courts.
Het is niet aan ons om te oordelen of deze contracten in overeenstemming zijn met de bepalingen uit de genoemde cao maar aan cao-partijen zelf en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Monasch over het faillissement van Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport en Steve Madden

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport and Steve Madden, and whether the government would help preserve jobs and engage the retail sector. The minister said the ministry is actively involved behind the scenes, that sales of much of the Macintosh group are advanced, and that retail partners are exploring acceleration of the Retailagenda and transition support for workers.
My ministry has been involved in the bankruptcy process since late December and takes an active stance behind the scenes.
Mijn ministerie is sinds eind december betrokken bij het faillissementsproces en neemt achter de schermen een actieve houding aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de Duitse arbeidsmarkt die geen schade leidt door de invoering van het minimumloon

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the absence of employment damage from Germany's minimum wage, introduced in 2015, should inform the review of the Dutch minimum wage law, and whether a comparison with the Dutch labour market will be made. The minister answers that early effects appear limited, notes that employment effects can show with delay, and commits to considering German outcomes in the review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij, Kerstens en Nijboer over de oud -eigenaar Sun Capital die mogelijk betrokken is bij een doorstart van V&D

MPs Vermeij, Kerstens and Nijboer asked about former owner Sun Capital's possible role in a V&D going-concern restart after bankruptcy, and whether bankruptcy was misused against staff and creditors. Minister Asscher answered that the court and curators are responsible, that the curators' report will show Sun Capital's role, and that research into works council positions in takeovers will be completed before summer.
It is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the company.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Oosenbrug en Vermeij over de relatie tussen het UWV en IBM

MPs Oosenbrug and Vermeij asked about the relationship between UWV and IBM, including reported failures of the werk.nl platform, whether UWV considered switching vendors, and whether open standards would give UWV more freedom in choosing suppliers. Minister Asscher answered that UWV is broadly satisfied with IBM, that switching vendors was considered but rejected for cost and continuity reasons, that open standards help but do not by themselves determine switching ease, and listed planned open-standards measures.
UWV decided to continue the cooperation with IBM and other involved suppliers.
UWV heeft besloten de samenwerking met IBM en andere betrokken leveranciers te continueren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Tanamal over de vondst van werkgevers om de transitievergoeding te omzeilen

Two PvdA MPs asked Minister Asscher about a court ruling in which an employee sought dissolution of the contract after two years of incapacity and a UWV wage sanction, and about how wage continuation works in dormant employment and what counts as seriously culpable conduct by employers under the Wwz. The minister confirmed the ruling, explained the two-year wage obligation and the sanction mechanism, pointed to case law examples, and declined to endorse the court's finding that the employer was not seriously culpable, noting that appeal remains possible.
I do not endorse this judgment.
Ik treed niet in dit oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Vermeij over het weigeren van een stageplaats vanwege de seksuele geaardheid

MPs Yücel and Vermeij asked the ministers about a reported refusal of an internship because of sexual orientation, and about government support and diversity policy. The minister condemns discrimination, points to the existing action plan on labour-market discrimination, existing complaint channels (College voor de Rechten van de Mens, local anti-discrimination services) and the diversity charter, without assessing the specific case.
The assessment of whether discrimination occurred in this specific case is for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or the judge.
De beoordeling of in deze specifieke casus sprake is van discriminatie is aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens (College) of de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over jongeren die na het afstuderen geen baan kunnen vinden en onderbetaald aan de slag gaan

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether graduates are being underpaid through internships and work placements that amount to regular employment, and whether enforcement against such misuse is adequate. The minister answered that genuine internships need no pay but work without a learning focus must pay at least the minimum wage, that the Inspectie SZW has opened 12 investigations since December 2014 with two fines issued, and that a letter on handling reports from FNV Jong's complaint point will follow before 1 April.
The misuse of work placements has the attention of the Inspectie SZW.
Het misbruik van werkervaringplekken heeft de aandacht van de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de representativiteit van beroepspensioenfondsen

MP Vermeij asked the State Secretary whether the 55% self-employed threshold for mandatory occupational pension schemes should be waived to protect employees in sectors like veterinarians and physiotherapists, and for a lasting solution. The State Secretary answered that employees will not be excluded from the mandatory scheme solely for failing the threshold, that representativeness will still be assessed separately for each group, and that she will seek a durable solution in consultation with the sector and social partners.

I find it undesirable that, as a result of changed labour market circumstances, employees could be placed outside the occupational pension scheme solely because the scheme fails the requirement of at least 55% self-employed members.

Ik vind het ongewenst dat als gevolg van veranderde omstandigheden op de arbeidsmarkt beroepsgenoten in loondienst alleen wegens het niet voldoen aan het verhoudingsvereiste van minimaal 55% zelfstandige beroepsgenoten, buiten de werking van de beroepspensioenregeling geplaatst zouden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Van Dekken over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten die bij de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) werken twee weken onbetaald thuis moeten blijven

PvdA MPs Vermeij and Van Dekken asked whether DUO temporary agency workers were being sent home unpaid for two weeks, and whether this was acceptable. The minister denied that workers were sent home unpaid, explaining that agency staff were rostered only where needed and that many took leave, while committing to gradually reduce flexible staffing under a union agreement.
Sending home employees without a permanent contract is not the case.
Van naar huis sturen van medewerkers zonder vast contract is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Tanamal over de nieuwe vondst van werkgevers om de transitievergoeding te omzeilen

MPs Vermeij and Tanamal asked the minister whether employers keep sick workers on unpaid employment to avoid the transition payment, how widespread this is, its effect on reintegration and WIA benefits, and what measures the government will take. The minister said there is no sign of frequent use, that keeping employment for other reasons is legitimate, and that existing rules (court-ordered dissolution with a transition payment for serious fault) are sufficient without new measures.
I believe this is sufficient and that no additional measures are needed.
Ik meen dat hiermee kan worden volstaan en er geen aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over het artikel «Pension Funds Can Only Guess at Private Equity’s Cost»

MPs Nijboer and Vermeij asked the Finance Minister and the Social Affairs State Secretary about pension fund private equity costs, including whether fees and profit-sharing are lawful and whether pension funds can see their costs. The government answered that fee levels are negotiated contractually, that it cannot assess whether the costs are lawful, that existing reporting rules are sufficient for now, and that it will push for more cost transparency internationally through the AIFMD evaluation.

It is not clear to the cabinet what the pension funds named in the article agreed with the private equity funds concerning the allocation, level and reporting of the various costs, and how this relates to the costs actually charged.

Het is voor het kabinet niet inzichtelijk wat de onderzochte pensioenfondsen die in het artikel worden genoemd met de betreffende private equityfondsen hebben afgesproken over de allocatie, hoogte en rapportage van de verschillende kosten en hoe dit zich verhoudt tot de daadwerkelijk in rekening gebrachte kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het stopzetten van het uitbetalen van een aanvulling op het pensioen door het Algemeen Burgerlijk Pensioenfonds (ABP)

An MP asks why ABP stopped paying a pension supplement linked to AOW partner allowance, how it worked, how members were informed, and whether ABP communicated too late. The State Secretary explains the supplement's rules and communication, says the late notice is regrettable, and reports ABP has reversed the decision and will inform affected members personally.

As I indicated on 24 February in answering oral questions from MP Krol (50PLUS) on this subject, I find it very regrettable for those involved that they were informed at a late stage about the discontinuation of the supplementary scheme.

Zoals ik op 24 februari jl. in de beantwoording van de mondelinge vragen van het lid Krol (50PLUS) over dit onderwerp heb aangegeven, vind ik het erg vervelend voor de betrokkenen dat zij op een laat moment zijn geïnformeerd over het stopzetten van de aanvullende regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over pensioenopbouw door IB-ondernemers bij een beroepspensioenregeling

Two MPs asked why self-employed income-tax payers in mandatory occupational pension schemes are assessed on profit from three years earlier, and what relief exists for someone who became partly disabled, so that their pension premium more than doubled. The government answered that a reference year (t-3) gives time to fix the maximum pensionable income, that special rules apply for illness, disability and starters, that it is always allowed to use a lower amount, and that pension funds and social partners decide on premium-free continuation and discretion.
It is always fiscally permitted to assume a lower amount than the maximum that may be taken into account as pensionable income.
Het is fiscaal altijd toegestaan om van een lager bedrag uit te gaan dan het bedrag dat ten hoogste als pensioengevend loon in aanmerking mag worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kerstens en Vermeij over de app Helpling voor de schoonmaakmarkt

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked whether the Helpling app, which matches households with cleaners, falls under the domestic-services regulation and how workers' minimum wage, sick pay, liability and collective agreements are protected. Minister Asscher said courts decide employment status case by case, referred the tax aspect to the Tax Administration, and saw no reason to consult the Labour Foundation.
It is for the court to give a legal characterisation of an employment relationship in individual cases.
Het is aan de rechter om in individuele gevallen een juridische duiding aan een arbeidsrelatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over een advertentie van BDU Media waarin zij ‘werkervaringsplekken’ als verwerkend redacteur aanbieden

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a BDU Media advert offering unpaid-or-low-paid 'work experience' editor posts at 350 euro, questioning whether such posts must pay the statutory minimum wage. The minister explained the stage versus employment distinction, said the advert lacked learning structure, and pointed to the Inspectorate SZW for enforcement and complaints.
The Inspectorate SZW is charged with supervising compliance with the Minimum Wage and Minimum Holiday Allowance Act.
De Inspectie SZW is belast met het toezicht op de naleving van de Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over “de afkoop van kleine pensioenen"

An MP asked whether the government had agreed with pension bodies to postpone payment of small pension buy-outs and whether the fiscal timing and the continued-work requirement could be relaxed. The government said the discussed solution proved unworkable under tax rules, but an adopted amendment now allows postponing the buy-out to the first day of the month after reaching the AOW age without the continued-work requirement.
This was also reported in the letter of 2 July about the buy-out of a small pension.
Dit is ook gemeld in de brief van 2 juli jl. over de afkoop van een klein pensioen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over “de pensioenuitkering en afkoop klein pensioen op verjaardag”

MP Vermeij asked whether the tax authority requires pensions to start only on the pensioner's birthday from 1 January 2015, and how this squares with the government's July 2014 letter on buying out small pensions. The state secretary replied that tax rules have not changed on pension start dates, that the timing of payouts is for pension providers, and that an amendment Vermeij co-sponsored now lets small-pension buyouts be deferred to the first day of the month after the AOW age.
This is not new as of 1 January 2015; the changes to the Witteveen scheme on that date change nothing about the pension start date or the pension target age.
Dit is niet nieuw per 1 januari 2015; de wijzigingen van het Witteveenkader per die datum veranderen niets aan de pensioeningangsdatum of de pensioenrichtleeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Jan Vos over het in surseance verkerende staalbedrijf Nedstaal

MPs Vermeij and Jan Vos asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether they would engage with Nedstaal, a steel company in suspension of payments, about a scaled-down restart, press for preserving regional jobs, and ensure UWV takes extra action for dismissed workers. The minister reports ongoing contact with management, the curator and the municipality, a takeover by Andus Group preserving 200 of 280 jobs, and a regional steering group with UWV and sector support for the 80 workers losing their jobs.
Together with the sector it is being examined whether support can be offered to Nedstaal's employees from the sector plan and what that support would consist of.
Samen met de sector wordt onderzocht of er ondersteuning geboden kan worden aan de werknemers van Nedstaal vanuit het sectorplan en waaruit deze ondersteuning bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over het kwijtraken van pensioen bij bijstand in Enschede

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the state secretary about Enschede's plan to require early cashing-in of occupational pension before claiming social assistance, and whether the Wet werk en bijstand permits this. The secretary called the plan undesirable, noted Enschede has withdrawn it, and promised a proposal to prevent municipalities forcing early pension withdrawal, plus a call to municipalities in the next letter.
Social assistance recipients should not be forced by municipalities to take their second-pillar pension early within the framework of assistance.
Bijstandsgerechtigden zouden – in het kader van de bijstand – niet door gemeenten verplicht moeten worden om hun 2 e pijler pensioen vervroegd in te laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Vermeij over het bericht dat er banen verdwijnen voor mbo-niveau 2 en 3 leerlingen

MPs Jadnanansing and Vermeij asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about a news report that 500,000 MBO level 2 and 3 jobs would disappear permanently, and how education and labour market links would be ensured. The minister rejected the claim as poorly supported, acknowledged technological and globalisation pressure on middle-skilled jobs, and pointed to labour market information, the study guide, the macro-efficiency bill and a planned career-route experiment as responses.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de afkoop van kleine pensioenen

An MP asked whether the pension start date for small pensions, and their buy-out, could be shifted to the prevailing AOW age, and whether the government would discuss pension rule changes with social partners. The government answered that no legal obstacles exist, that the working-on requirement was waived by a 2012 policy decision, and that social partners are already adjusting pension rules.
There are no legal obstacles to setting this pension start date in the collective pension scheme at or after the prevailing AOW age.
Er zijn geen wettelijke belemmeringen om deze in de collectieve pensioenregeling te bepalen pensioeningangsdatum te stellen op of na de geldende AOW-leeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de Belgiëroute voor pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the state secretary about the risks of moving Dutch occupational pensions to Belgian cross-border pension funds (OFPs), covering supervision, member influence, solidarity rules, funding and taxation. The government answered that Dutch law and DNB/AFM supervision still apply, that Dutch members have limited direct influence over Belgian OFP documents, and that employer guarantees and funding rules remain unclear and depend on the Belgian supervisor.
It is of great importance that they pay close attention to the consequences thereof.
Het is van groot belang dat zij goed letten op de gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over verlenging van de VUT-uitkering

Two PvdA MPs asked whether extending VUT early-retirement benefits to bridge the rise in the AOW pension age would trigger immediate taxation, and whether the Tax Authority's pension knowledge group's view was government policy. The state secretary answered that extension past age 65 would lose the transitional regime and trigger the VUT levy, that the knowledge group's advice is not policy, and that spreading existing entitlements over a longer period will be tolerated under conditions via a policy decision.
Policy in the formal sense is determined exclusively by me.
Beleid in formele zin wordt uitsluitend door mij vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over mogelijke fouten in loonstrookjes als gevolg van de samenloop WUL en AOW leeftijdsverhoging

Two MPs asked whether the 2013 AOW age increase combined with the new wage definition (WUL) caused errors in pensioners' payslips, whether the SVB communicated adequately, and whether taxpayers need to file returns. The government denied a systematic error, explained how tax credits are split between AOW and pension income, pointed to Belastingdienst information, and declined to extend the early WUL evaluation to pension-fund and SVB implementation.
At present, given the answers above, I see no reason to also include the implementation and communication by pension funds and the SVB in that evaluation.
Ik zie op dit moment – gezien de hierboven gegeven antwoorden – geen reden ook de uitvoering en communicatie door pensioenfondsen en SVB in die evaluatie te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Vermeij en Albert de Vries (over de planontwikkeling van een recreatiepark nabij Fort Benoorden Spaarndam)

MPs Vermeij and De Vries asked the ministers about plans for bungalows at Fort Benoorden Spaarndam within the World Heritage Stelling van Amsterdam, and whether the national government should be involved. The minister said the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had studied the plans and found no harm to the World Heritage value, that the province is the lead on the project and can request advice from the College van Rijksadviseurs which the government would support, and that the alternative plan from a heritage foundation is a matter for the province.
A request from the province of Noord-Holland I will support and submit to the college.
Een verzoek van de provincie Noord-Holland zal ik steunen en voorleggen aan het college.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over het nieuwe voorstel van de Europese Commissie voor een financiële transactiebelasting

MPs Nijboer and Vermeij asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the Commission's new financial transaction tax proposal, including its effect on Dutch pension funds, extraterritorial reach, a de minimis exemption, next steps, and compensation for non-participating states. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the Netherlands will not join the enhanced cooperation yet because pension funds are still taxed, that the impact cannot yet be reliably calculated, and that compensation is not provided but will be raised in negotiations.
Therefore the Netherlands will for now not join the enhanced cooperation.
Nederland zal daarom op dit moment niet toetreden tot de nauwere samenwerking.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over beleggingen van het ABP in Hospira

An MP asked whether the government, as employer and sector representative, could influence ABP pension fund investments in Hospira, a supplier of drugs used in US executions, and what it would do about human-rights concerns. The government replied that the fund's board is responsible for investment policy, that the state has no direct influence over the privatised fund, and that ABP is engaging Hospira, which has imposed distributor restrictions.
ABP is a privatised pension fund. This means the government/cabinet exercises no direct influence over it.
Het ABP is een geprivatiseerd pensioenfonds. Dat betekent dat de overheid/het kabinet daar geen directe invloed op uitoefent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Hamer over misbruik van ziekte door werkgevers

Two MPs asked the minister about reports that employers misuse sick leave to cut wage costs or push out staff, including keeping recovered workers registered as partially sick, limited access to occupational doctors, and oversight of medical information. The minister disapproves of registering fully recovered workers as sick, points to occupational doctors' advice and UWV or court routes for disputes, and says no cases are known of UWV dismissals of workers already back at work.
I do not approve of a worker who has fully resumed the agreed work after a period of sickness remaining administratively registered as partially incapacitated for one or a few percent.

Ik keur het niet goed dat een werknemer die na een ziekteperiode de bedongen arbeid volledig heeft hervat, administratief voor één of enkele procenten als arbeidsongeschikt geregistreerd blijft staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over "de kwetsbare positie van jongeren op de werkvloer

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the minister whether young workers are more often victims of workplace accidents and whether flexible employment explains this, and asked what extra attention is given. The minister disputes the claim using the TNO Monitor showing no higher accident risk for young workers, notes existing youth-focused safety measures and campaigns, and reports no clear link between flexible contracts and accidents.
I do not reach the same conclusion.
Ik kom niet tot dezelfde conclusie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over de uitspraken van eurocommissaris Semeta over een financiële sectorbelasting en de positie van pensioenfondsen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Commissioner Semeta's statements that a new financial transaction tax would not exempt pension funds conflict with the Dutch coalition conditions for joining enhanced cooperation on the tax. The minister replied that the Commission proposal does not meet the coalition conditions, so the Netherlands will not join for now, and that it will keep lobbying in the Ecofin Council and inform parliament via a BNC fiche.
This proposal does not meet the conditions of the coalition agreement.
Dit voorstel voldoet niet aan de voorwaarden van het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Vermeij over kosten bij pensioenopbouw

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Lane, Clark & Peacock study finding that 17% of pension premiums go to costs, and about the variation in costs between funds, the scope for cost reduction, and transparency. The State Secretary answered that transparency is important, that the 17% figure is not a meaningful measure because costs are better related to managed assets, that Dutch funds' costs are low internationally, and that a legal cost cap is not feasible.
The 17% figure does not say much about the costs incurred by pension funds.
Het percentage van 17% zegt niet veel over de gemaakte kosten van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over "de onregelmatigheden binnen het pensioenfonds van het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)"

MPs Groot and Vermeij asked the minister whether supervision of the CBR pension fund failed given irregularities found by an Integis investigation, and what measures and remedies apply. The minister answered that the investigation concerned a separate toeslagfonds (supplementary fund) outside prudential pension supervision at the time, that current rules prohibit such standalone funds, and that correction of irregularities is for the employer and works council to resolve.
No conclusions can therefore be drawn from this investigation about supervision of the CBR pension fund.
Er kunnen aan dit onderzoek dan ook geen conclusies worden verbonden over het toezicht op het pensioenfonds van het CBR.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over de overgangsregeling bij de versnelde verhoging van de AOW-leeftijd

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about the transitional arrangement accompanying the accelerated AOW pension age increase, covering who falls under it, benefit continuation, numbers affected, costs and whether it extends beyond 2013. The minister answered that a phased increase, an advance-payment scheme, a referral to social assistance, and retention of the partner allowance for a small group will apply, with details and cost estimates deferred to a forthcoming bill.
For a further elaboration of the transitional facilities and an estimate of the costs of the provisions, I refer you to the bill
Voor een nadere uitwerking van de overgangsfaciliteiten en een raming van de kosten van de voorzieningen verwijs ik graag naar het wetsvoorstel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Hamer over de onduidelijkheid tussen de vitaliteitsparagraaf in het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma en die paragraaf in het Stabiliteitsprogramma

MPs Vermeij and Hamer asked why the vitality package's mobility bonuses appear in the National Reform Programme but are cut back in the Stability Programme, and which work bonuses are ended. Minister Kamp answered that the programmes were aligned as far as possible, that the mobility budget is frozen rather than abolished, and that the work bonuses for workers and employers are ended as part of the budget agreement.
The final version of the National Reform Programme submitted to your House on 27 April was aligned as far as possible with the commitments in the Stability Programme.
De definitieve versie van het Nationale Hervormingsprogramma dat op 27 april aan uw Kamer is aangeboden, is zo veel mogelijk afgestemd op de afspraken uit het Stabiliteitsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het handhaven door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) van gunstiger rekenrente pensioenen

Labour MP Vermeij asks the minister whether DNB's decision to keep using a more favourable pension discount rate, pending the new financial assessment framework, conflicts with DNB's earlier stated criteria and implies political interference or undermines planned pension cuts. The minister answers that DNB acts on its legal powers in exceptional market conditions, that the intention to continue averaging aims at sector stability rather than anticipating politics, and that the planned cuts will be reviewed after the end-2012 funding ratio is known.

By stating its intention to continue averaging until it is clear what the consequences of the main lines of the new financial assessment framework for pension funds are, DNB aims to contribute to calm and clarity for the sector.

Door de intentie uit te spreken om rentemiddeling te continueren, totdat duidelijk is wat de gevolgen zijn van de hoofdlijnen van het nieuwe financiële toetsingskader voor pensioenfondsen, beoogt DNB bij te dragen aan rust en duidelijkheid voor de sector.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over pensioenproblematiek bij het bedrijf Georgia Pacific

An MP asked the minister about pension problems for Georgia Pacific workers after acquirer SCA declined to take over the Celtona pension fund, including consequences for retirees and whether minister would talk to SCA. The minister answered that the acquirer need not take over the fund, that accrued rights will be insured or the fund continued, that current workers join SCA's scheme on normal terms, and that he will not engage SCA because pension negotiations are for social partners.
No, I will not engage with SCA. Pension negotiations are a matter for the social partners.
Nee, ik zal niet met SCA in gesprek gaan. Onderhandelingen over pensioenen zijn een aangelegenheid van sociale partners.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over de bewering van FNV Bondgenoten dat automatisch leeftijdsontslag van de baan is

Rep. Vermeij asked the minister whether CAO clauses forcing dismissal on the first of the month in which a worker turns 65 are void under the Gelijke Behandeling op grond van Leeftijd wet, and what the consequences, number of CAOs and workers, and notification would be. The minister said the constitutionality judgement lies with the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling or courts, that cao partners bear primary responsibility, that 36 CAOs covering about 1.88 million workers contain such clauses, and that sociale partners would inform parties after any ruling.
It is not for me to judge the objective justification, but for the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling or the judge.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de objectieve rechtvaardiging, maar aan de Commissie Gelijke Behandeling of de rechter.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over het uitblijven van pensioenbetaling door Aegon

An MP asked the minister whether Aegon's failure to pay 1,086 pension recipients on time was unacceptable, what measures could be taken, and whether an apology and same-day emergency payments should be required. The minister replied that the payment delays were caused by a system change, that Aegon has since paid the affected months, and that supervision and any assessment of the response rest with De Nederlandsche Bank as supervisor.
An assessment of the adequacy of that is for De Nederlandsche Bank as supervisor.
Een beoordeling van de toereikendheid daarvan is aan De Nederlandsche Bank als toezichthouder.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij en Van der Veen over diabetes op het werk

MPs Vermeij and Van der Veen asked about a study showing employers are unprepared for diabetes among workers and about the role of occupational physicians and policy to support early recognition. The state secretary answered that the picture is not uniform, pointed to a Gezond Bedrijf action plan and a ZonMw diabetes-and-work guideline, and gave no new binding measures.
In the action plan Gezond Bedrijf I also devote attention to workers with a chronic condition, such as diabetes.
In het actieplan Gezond Bedrijf besteed ik ook aandacht aan werkenden met een chronische aandoening, zoals diabetes.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over onduidelijke regels over samenwonen in de AOW

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about inconsistent SVB guidance and unclear rules on what counts as living together for the AOW pension, including the criteria for a shared household, the need for logbooks, and whether clear uniform rules will be made. The minister said assessment is case-by-case under the housing and care criteria and case law, that SVB guidance is meant to be uniform, and that no central rules will be set, while noting appeal is open.
The overall determination of objective individual circumstances and weighing of all relevant factors in the individual case cannot by its nature be captured in central rules of general character.

Het geheel van de vaststelling van de objectieve, individuele omstandigheden en de weging van alle relevante factoren in het individuele geval kan naar zijn aard niet in centrale regels met een algemeen karakter worden vervat.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over de correctie van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) op de rentecurve januari 2012

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB's January 2012 correction to the pension discount curve, including its effect on coverage ratios, funds facing cuts, and whether monthly or three-monthly averaging applies. The minister answered that the correction raised average coverage by about 4 percentage points, does not affect recovery plans or cut numbers, and that DNB will decide monthly whether to adjust the curve.
It has been agreed that DNB determines each month whether market conditions give reason to adjust the interest rate term structure.
Er is afgesproken dat DNB per maand bepaalt of de marktomstandigheden reden geven tot aanpassing van de rentetermijnstructuur.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ferrier (CDA) en Dikkers en Vermeij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het feit dat het ABP betrokken is bij land

MPs from CDA and PvdA asked why the ABP pension fund's EUR 47 million investment in the Global Solidarity Forest Fund in Mozambique was linked to alleged land grabbing, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary said the ABP is a privatised fund at arm's length from the cabinet, that the relevant ministries would raise the matter in the employers' council and accountability body, and that pension transparency rules are planned.
ABP is a privatised fund and, like other pension funds in the Netherlands, is therefore at arm's length from the cabinet.
ABP is een geprivatiseerd fonds en staat daarmee net als andere pensioenfondsen in Nederland op afstand van het kabinet.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij (PvdA) en Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over vutters die dankzij faillissement bedrijf geen uitkering ontvangen (ingezonden 13 september 2011).

MPs Vermeij and Ulenbelt asked the minister how ex-workers of bankrupt Boekelo Decor who lost early-retirement (VUT) benefits can be protected, and whether the buyer or the German parent can be held liable. The minister answered that VUT schemes are the responsibility of social partners, that the buyer generally does not inherit the bankrupt firm's debts, that the German parent is a separate legal entity not party to the collective agreement, and that creditors must file claims with the curator.
This is a matter of private law.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over pensioentekort voor werknemers in de sociale werkplaats (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

The MP asks the minister whether a pension deficit of about EUR 350 million at the Werk en (re)Integratie pension fund for sheltered-workshop employees can be confirmed, and what measures will ensure low-income workers build adequate pension. The state secretary declines to confirm the figure, stresses that supplementary pensions are the responsibility of social partners, rules out a ministry top-up, and points to the AOW increase and the social partners' task.
Supplementary pensions are a responsibility of the social partners.
Aanvullende pensioenen zijn een verantwoordelijkheid van de sociale partners.

Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een geconstateerde lacune in de inkomensvoorziening voor oudere werklozen met een ondernemersverleden (ingezonden 29 april 2011)

An MP asked the minister whether older former self-employed workers who return briefly to employment and then lose their job fall through gaps between the IOW, IOAW and IOAZ income schemes, and whether a hardship clause or a legislative fix is planned. The state secretary replied that the WWB safety net covers such cases, that the schemes' conditions are deliberate, and that municipalities can partly exempt pension capital, so no regulatory change is needed.

Given the availability of the WWB, and the possibilities for municipalities to (partly) exempt pension assets when implementing the WWB in appropriate cases and thus apply tailored measures, there is no reason to amend the regulations.

Gezien de beschikbaarheid van de WWB, én de mogelijkheden voor gemeenten om bij de uitvoering van de WWB in voorkomende gevallen pensioenvermogen (deels) vrij te laten en zo maatwerk toe te passen, is er geen aanleiding voor aanpassing van de regelgeving.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de latere uitbetaling van uitkeringen in juni door UWV (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the later June payment of WAO, WAZ, WIA and Wajong benefits by UWV, which may cause anxiety among financially vulnerable recipients, is necessary and whether the measure will be withdrawn. The minister answered that no measures are planned, that recipients are informed in advance and can request an advance payment, and that far fewer people have contacted UWV than expected.
I see no reasons for measures on my part.
Ik zie geen redenen voor maatregelen van mijn kant.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Huizing (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), De Jong (PVV), Ulenbelt (SP) en Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Financiën over het oproep

MPs asked the state secretary about employers, including Connexxion as self-insurer, summoning former employees with WGA 35-80% disability for medical reassessments, and about the rights, procedures and re-integration duties involved. The state secretary answered that assessment of incapacity is reserved to the UWV, that self-insuring employers may request reassessment but cannot set the percentage themselves, and that he sees no reason for new rules or talks with Connexxion.
The UWV or the self-insuring employer have the possibility to summon a WGA beneficiary.
Het UWV of de eigenrisicodrager hebben de mogelijkheid om een WGA-gerechtigde op te roepen.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onderbetaling van ambassadepersoneel (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Vermeij asked whether the Moroccan embassy underpays locally hired staff with Dutch passports and what steps the government will take. The minister said embassies must respect Dutch labour law, that Dutch inspectorates lack legal power to investigate foreign embassies under the Vienna Convention, and that he raises concrete cases with the ambassador.
Dutch inspection and investigative services have no legal authority to investigate embassies, consulates and individual diplomats of other countries.
Nederlandse inspectie- en opsporingsdiensten hebben geen wettelijke bevoegdheid om onderzoek te doen bij ambassades, consulaten en individuele diplomaten van andere landen.
Vragen van de leden Hamer en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over werkzoekende ouderen (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the difficulty older jobseekers face finding work, the stigma they encounter, the future of funding for their network groups, and whether a training right and duty would help. The minister acknowledged the problem, said agreements with social partners on sustainable employability are under negotiation, noted UWV has no separate budget for older jobseekers, and said training is mainly a matter for employers and employees.
UWV has no separate budget for older unemployed people.
UWV heeft geen apart budget voor oudere werklozen.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de verenigbaarheid van de WIA met ILO Verdrag 121 (ingezonden 14 maart 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether the WIA disability benefit law complies with ILO Convention 121, including the 35% threshold and the basis for WGA follow-up benefits, and what steps will follow an ILO opinion, and whether the earlier informal ILO request was dropped. The state secretary answers by referring to a separate letter to the House on the ILO's opinion, while saying the committee's opinion is welcome.
For the answer to this question I refer to my letter of today to the House of Representatives on the ILO's opinion.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar mijn brief van heden aan de Tweede Kamer over de zienswijze van de ILO.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over een onbedoeld effect van de wijzigingen in de Uitvoeringsregeling loonbelasting (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

MPs Groot and Vermeij asked the State Secretary of Finance about the 2011 article 12.2a of the wage tax implementing regulation, which affected early-retirement schemes insured with insurers since 2006, and whether it was introduced unexpectedly and hurt holders of stamrecht rights. The State Secretary answered that the article is being amended retroactively to 1 January 2011 so it applies only to abusive pre-financing aimed at avoiding the higher 52% VUT levy, and that it does not affect the rights holders described.

I have therefore decided to amend article 12.2a of the URLB 2011 with retroactive effect to 1 January 2011 so that it only applies in situations where the inspector can demonstrate unusual pre-financing linked to the increase of the VUT levy rate.

Ik heb daarom besloten artikel 12.2a van de URLB 2011 met terugwerkende kracht tot en met 1 januari 2011 zodanig aan te passen dat artikel 12.2a van de URLB 2011 slechts van toepassing is in situaties waarin de inspecteur kan aantonen dat er sprake is van een ongebruikelijke voorfinanciering

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kwaliteit van inschrijvingen in de Gemeentelijke Basis A

MPs Heijnen and Vermeij asked the ministers of Interior and Social Affairs about address discrepancies between the UWV insurance register and the municipal GBA population register, whether the UWV may refuse to analyse them under the SUWI law, and why some agencies do not yet report back to the GBA. The minister answered that the UWV lacks grounds to report or analyse without reasonable doubt, that a joint Amsterdam–UWV review of 5,000 addresses is planned, and that the GBA quality action plan will be evaluated and reported to parliament by December 2011.
I will inform your House by December 2011 at the latest about the outcomes of the evaluation and any follow-up steps.
Ik zal uw Kamer uiterlijk december 2011 over de uitkomsten van de evaluatie en eventuele vervolgstappen informeren.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over fraude in het Westland (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the minister of Social Affairs about fraud in the Westland, including whether capacity of the Labour Inspectorate should be expanded, whether a blacklist of repeat offenders should be created, and whether fines should be raised. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, referred to earlier answers for questions 2 to 5, and pointed to the government's broader anti-fraud commitment and a letter sent to the House.
For answering questions 2 to 5, I refer for brevity to my answers to earlier parliamentary questions.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen 2 t/m 5 verwijs ik kortheidshalve naar mijn antwoorden op eerdere Kamervragen

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over burgemeesters die stoppen vanwege de FPU (ingezonden 5 janu

PvdA MPs asked whether mayors and civil servants eligible for the FPU early-retirement scheme are leaving office early to avoid pension loss, and whether the government will act so they can finish their terms. The ministers answered that retirement is an individual choice, that the bonus for working past the early-retirement age is designed to encourage later exit, and that no changes are planned because the transitional rule ends in 2015.
The moment of leaving employment is a personal choice.
Het moment van uittreden is een persoonlijke keuze.

Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de rechten die deelnemers kunnen ontlenen aan hun Uniform Pensioenoverzicht (UPO) (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension participants can derive rights from their UPO pension statement, given the AFM's view and a Rotterdam court ruling, and whether disclaimers denying such rights are permitted. The Minister agrees participants can under circumstances derive rights, that accuracy matters, and that disclaimers stating no rights can be derived are factually incorrect, but sees no need for ministerial action.
I share the AFM's view that participants can, under circumstances, derive rights from their UPO.
Ik deel de opvatting van AFM dat deelnemers onder omstandigheden rechten kunnen ontlenen aan hun UPO.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het gebrek aan toezicht op onderbetaling van werknemers (ingezonden 2 februari 2011).

MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the state secretary about underpayment of workers and alleged gaps in the labour inspectorate's oversight, including enforcement capacity, repeat inspections, sectors at risk, cao enforcement and posted or self-employed migrant workers. The minister rejected the claim of inadequate enforcement, citing rising fines and inspections, promised tougher anti-fraud measures and proposals soon, but declined to commit to expanding inspection capacity.
I am preparing a considerably stricter approach to fraud, including higher fines for violations of labour legislation.
Ik bereid een fors strengere aanpak van fraude voor, inclusief hogere boetes voor overtredingen van de arbeidswetgeving.
Vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over fiscale belemmeringen bij het fuseren van pensioenfondsen (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether transfer tax hinders mergers of pension funds, which the Pensioenfederatie says is unjustified given their non-profit nature and unchanged ownership, and whether the government will exempt pension funds as it does associations and cooperatives. The State Secretary answered that the merger exemption does not apply to pension funds organised as foundations, estimated the annual yield at EUR 2 million, and said he will examine broadening the business facilities to be legal-form neutral, to be decided in the coming budget cycle.

Apart from the specific pension fund issue, there is therefore an intention to examine whether the existing business facilities can be made more legal-form neutral and thus opened to other legal persons.

Reeds los van de specifieke pensioenfondsenproblematiek bestaat daarom het voornemen om te bezien of het mogelijk is om de bestaande ondernemingsfaciliteiten meer rechtsvormneutraal te maken en derhalve open te stellen voor andere rechtspersonen.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over langer doorwerken in de zorg voor hetzelfde pensioen (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP asks the Social Affairs minister whether it is appropriate for the healthcare pension fund PFZW to cut pension accrual and skip indexation in anticipation of later AOW-age legislation, and whether this harms workers and staff shortages in care. The minister answers that the fund must address its deficit itself, that the cuts are the fund's own decision, and that it is not for him to judge them.
It is not for me to have a judgement on this decision.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over deze beslissing.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Tony van Dijck (PVV) en Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het pensioenfonds van Smit Internationale (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

MPs Omtzigt, Van Dijck and Vermeij asked the minister whether Boskalis's former Smit management put shareholders ahead of the Smit pension fund, and whether the employer bears a moral duty and should be called to account. The minister refused to engage directly, calling it a matter between Boskalis, the pension fund board and its bodies, though Boskalis offered a one-off EUR 30 million payment conditional on withdrawal of a lawsuit.
This is a matter between Boskalis, the board of the Smit pension fund, the accountability body and the participants' council. There is no role for the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment.
Dit is een zaak tussen Boskalis, het bestuur van het pensioenfonds Smit, het verantwoordingsorgaan en de deelnemersraad. Er ligt geen rol voor de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de arbeidsomstandigheden in slachterijen (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about poor working conditions and safety in slaughterhouses, including whether higher fines or inspection intensity would help. The government acknowledged compliance has improved but remains insufficient, pointed to the Labour Inspectorate's sector-focused enforcement and work stoppages, and relied mainly on social partners' codes and a broader safety action plan.
Compared with the previous inspection project four years ago, compliance has improved. However, the level of compliance is not yet sufficient.
Ten opzichte van het vorige inspectieproject vier jaar geleden is de naleving verbeterd. Het nalevingsniveau is echter nog niet voldoende.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de arbeidsomstandigheden van arboartsen (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

PvdA MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the state secretary about working conditions of occupational physicians, citing reports of work pressure and conflicts with ethics and independence. The state secretary answered that a joint study with VWS is underway, results expected by summer 2011, that employers are responsible for occupational health provision, and that the government will await the study before acting.
The cabinet is awaiting the results of the study into the position of the occupational physician, as mentioned in the answer to question 2.
Het kabinet wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de positie van de bedrijfsarts, zoals genoemd in antwoord op vraag 2, af.
Vragen van de leden Spekman en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over ontslagzwendel en het recht op een uitkering (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

MPs Spekman and Vermeij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged dismissal fraud and whether UWV can grant advances to claimants, citing a constituent's case. The minister said fraud is a matter for criminal investigation by police or SIOD/FIOD, that the Arbeidsinspectie should only report signals, and that UWV can advance benefits when entitlement is reasonably likely.
A judgment on that is reserved for the judge.
Een oordeel daarover is voorbehouden aan de rechter.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het verkeerd voorlichten van deelnemers door het Pensioenfonds voor Werk en (re)Integratie. (ingezonden 20 se

MPs Vermeij and Spekman asked the minister whether the PWRI pension fund, which won a communication award in 2009, misinformed participants about the AOV supplementary scheme, and whether participants should be fully and clearly informed. The minister confirmed awareness of the press report, acknowledged past communication about the AOV was unfortunate that has since been improved, and agreed participants should receive complete, correct and understandable information.
I note that the communication by PWRI about the AOV scheme has been unfortunate in the past.
Ik constateer dat de communicatie door het PWRI over de AOV-regeling in het verleden ongelukkig is geweest.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over het faillissement van Kip caravans (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

MPs Vermeij and Wolbert asked ministers about the bankruptcy of Kip caravans, the chances of a restart, and how UWV, the mobility centre and local/provincial authorities are supporting workers into new jobs. The minister answered that the bankruptcy was declared, 18 parties have expressed interest in a restart, UWV and partners are placing workers, and that businesses and government each bear their own responsibility.
There is thus a realistic chance of a restart, but whether and to what extent results will be achieved with the 18 parties is not yet known at this time.
Er is dus een reële kans op een doorstart, maar of en in hoeverre resultaten bereikt worden met de 18 partijen, is op dit moment nog niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Vermeij (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de toegenomen arbeidsongeschiktheid onder flexwerkers (ingezonden 31 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in disability (WIA) inflow among flexible workers and its causes, and how well UWV reintegrates sick temporary workers, and whether employers should be responsible for reintegration. The minister attributed the WIA growth to more applications and higher award rates, noted rising sickness-benefit trajectories, and said the Ziektewet and responsibility split for reintegration would be reviewed.

In my letter to the House of Representatives of 6 September on developments concerning the Ziektewet safety net, I went into detail on the position of sick temporary workers and UWV's reintegration efforts.

In mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 6 september over ontwikkelingen rond het vangnet-Ziektewet ben ik uitvoerig ingegaan op de positie van zieke vangnetters en de re-integratie-inspanningen van UWV.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het recht van grensarbeiders op AOW (ingezonden 31 augustus

MPs Vermeij and Heijnen asked ministers about cross-border workers' AOW pension rights after a report that a Belgian-resident entrepreneur must prove entitlement despite SVB assurances. The minister answered that verification via registrations is required, premiums are refunded or compensated, and points to existing checks, portals and the border ombudsman, without committing to new measures.
Verification takes place on the basis of registrations of, for example, UWV and the Tax Authority, which will (have to) show the claimed work in the Netherlands.
