qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over belastingontwijkingsconstructies met fiscale aftrekposten

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the Finance Minister about tax-avoidance structures using investment deductions (EIA, MIA, Vamil), including whether business partnerships, leasing, debt financing and rulings allow non-entrepreneurs to claim them. The State Secretary answered that the schemes are generic, that usage figures and examples are given, that the Belastingdienst polices abuse, and declined to disclose individual cases citing tax confidentiality, while committing only to investigate publishing anonymised ruling summaries for individuals.
Given the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot discuss individual cases.
Gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over kinderopvang voor speciaal onderwijs

Two MPs asked the government about the lack of out-of-school care for children in special education and whether a statutory obligation similar to that for primary schools should be extended to special schools. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, noted that a legal obligation is complex and costly, and committed to discussing the option with the sector and developing a guidance document.
We will discuss and explore the possibilities of a statutory obligation as one of the options with the field.
We zullen de mogelijkheden van een wettelijke verplichting als een van de opties bespreken en verkennen met het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Inge van Dijk, Grinwis en Maatoug over ‘het uiterst kritische Raad van State advies over het nieuwe box 3 stelsel’

MPs from D66, CDA, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked how the government views the Raad van State's critical advice on the new box 3 wealth tax system, including delay, budgetary shortfall, the Hoge Raad's view on the forfait, and wealth inequality. The Staatssecretaris answers that a one-year delay to 2028 is expected, a shortfall of about 2.4 billion euro in 2027 will be covered by raising the forfait on other assets and lowering the tax-free allowance, and that alternatives including a wealth tax are being studied, with a reply to the advice to follow.
In a further report on that advice the cabinet will provide a full response, and I cannot anticipate that now.
In een nader rapport op dat advies komt het kabinet met een uitgebreide reactie, daarop kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Maatoug over de inrichting van nieuwe ministeries

MPs Sneller and Maatoug asked the Finance Minister about the organisation of three newly created ministries, including whether shared secretaries-general and FEZ directors comply with rules, the duration, costs, and the ministries' contribution to the staffing cut. The government answered that the arrangement is temporary until 1 January 2025, that minimal changes apply with a dedicated SG and FEZ director per ministry, and that costs are modest and not yet quantified in full, with no formal consultation with the Algemene Rekenkamer.

The Court of Audit notes in its letter on the draft budgets that sound budget management, financial management and operations cannot exist without a well-organised financial function at the ministries.

De Algemene Rekenkamer benoemt in de brief bij de ontwerpbegrotingen dat goed begrotingsbeheer, financieel beheer en bedrijfsvoering niet kan zonder goed ingerichte financiële functie bij de ministeries.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Maatoug over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris belangen in bedrijven geheim houdt

MPs Dijk and Maatoug asked the State Secretary for Finance whether his business shareholdings, reported in the formateur's report, could influence his policy and why he has not disclosed them openly. The State Secretary answered that his interests are placed at arm's length under the Landsadvocaat's assessment and that disclosure of company names is a matter for the official to weigh, while not fully committing to publish the holdings.
It is likewise for the official approached to weigh, given the business and financial interests and the arrangement to be made, whether the names of the companies concerned can be reported.

Het is eveneens aan de aangezochte bewindspersoon om te wegen, gelet op de zakelijke en financiële belangen en de te treffen voorziening, of de namen van de betrokken vennootschappen gemeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Maatoug, Stultiens, Grinwis, Teunissen, Dijk, Van Baarle, Vijlbrief en Dassen over de kosten van het afschaffen van de belasting op de inkoop van eigen aandelen

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO study criticising the revenue estimate for abolishing the share buyback tax facility, including its data basis, behavioural assumptions and whether a new CPB estimate should be requested. The State Secretary answered that the estimate used the best available data at the time, explained the 70% behavioural discount, noted the cabinet has since kept the facility so no new study is needed, but will discuss updating the research with SOMO and SEO.
I will discuss this with both SOMO and SEO.
Ik zal hiervoor met zowel SOMO als SEO in gesprek treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens ver structureel verlieslatende bedrijven

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the discrepancy between a 6% and a 13% share of structurally loss-making companies, the growth and debt patterns of conduit companies, dividend flows, and the EU UNSHELL directive. The State Secretary attributed the difference mainly to different research periods, outlined anti-abuse measures such as the minimum tax and a possible open-norm replacement for the safe harbour, and said Dutch support for UNSHELL continues while agreement remains uncertain.
In the autumn I will inform the House, in the annual monitoring letter on the approach to tax avoidance by multinationals, about the effectiveness of the general interest deduction limitation.
In het najaar zal ik uw Kamer in de jaarlijkse monitoringsbrief over de aanpak van belastingontwijking door multinationals informeren over de effectiviteit van de generieke renteaftrekbeperking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over belastingverdragen

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance why tax treaties with low-tax jurisdictions Bahrain, Barbados and Panama still block the withholding tax, the three-year renegotiation deadline having lapsed, and about Panama's EU blacklist status and the Netherlands' stance on a UN tax convention. The State Secretary replied that treaties prevail over national law, that renegotiation will restart if Bahrain and Barbados do not introduce a qualifying 9% profit tax, that Panama is cooperating and no deadline is set, and that the Netherlands abstained rather than voted against the UN tax convention terms.
I do not have the requested data.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Maatoug over het bericht «650 miljoen belastingschuld en toch dividend uitkeren: zo werkt kunstmestfabriek Yara»

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers about reports that fertiliser producer Yara pays dividends despite a large tax debt, receives green subsidies, and used transfer pricing to shift profit abroad. The minister answered that companies are free to decide their profit use within legal frameworks, that subsidies are capped to avoid overcompensation via claw-back mechanisms, and that the Tax Authority rejects profit shifting without real activity changes.
Nevertheless, the maatwerk agreements aim to prevent oversubsidy of projects, for example by including a claw-back mechanism.
Wel wordt er binnen de maatwerkafspraken op ingezet oversubsidiëring van projecten tegen te gaan, bijvoorbeeld door het opnemen van een terugvorderingsmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Grinwis over de uitvoeringsaspecten van het nieuwe kinderopvangstelsel

The MPs Maatoug and Grinwis asked whether the current childcare allowance system, which leaves parents bearing repayment risk, should be replaced by direct financing, and what deadlines, choices and information the implementation requires. The State Secretary agrees the current system is fundamentally flawed, says a reform letter will come in autumn with a bill planned for 2025, and lists the information the implementing agency needs.
The childcare allowance will be replaced by a new financing system in which the payment is transferred directly to childcare organisations.
De kinderopvangtoeslag wordt vervangen door een nieuw financieringsstelsel waarbij de vergoeding direct wordt overgemaakt naar kinderopvangorganisaties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over ontwijking van de vennootschapsbelasting

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance about corporate tax avoidance, including the participation exemption, interest deduction on non-arm's-length loans, and depreciation of goodwill and intangibles. The State Secretary largely defended existing anti-avoidance rules, announced a Belastingplan 2025 measure on the earnings-stripping threshold and further research on dividend stripping, and rejected proposals to raise the participation threshold, restrict interest deductions or ban depreciation of goodwill.
The cabinet will continue this research.
Het kabinet zal dit onderzoek voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over inflatie

MPs Maatoug and Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about inflation governance, the role of DNB and the government in price stability, measures against supply shocks, CBS measurement, and whether profits drove inflation. The minister answered that the ECB is primarily responsible for price stability while fiscal policy and social partners also matter, outlined energy-crisis support measures, and said that profit-driven inflation needs further research, with a promised discussion in the upcoming Miljoenennota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over een VPB-vrijstelling voor kinderopvang naar voorbeeld van de zorg

An MP asked the ministers whether a corporate tax exemption for childcare organisations without profit motive, modelled on the healthcare exemption, could be created, and about its rationale, budget impact and needed amendments. The government answered that such an exemption is not justified because non-profit childcare providers compete with commercial firms, that introducing one would be very restrained and raises state aid concerns, and estimated a revenue loss of at least 10 million euros.
Given that non-profit childcare organisations compete with regular market parties, a subjective exemption for these organisations cannot be sufficiently justified.

Gegeven het feit dat kinderopvangorganisaties zonder winstoogmerk in concurrentie treden met reguliere marktpartijen laat een subjectieve vrijstelling voor deze organisaties zich niet voldoende rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over partiële buitenlandse belastingplicht en de lucratiefbelangregeling

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press report on expat managers at Action avoiding Dutch tax through the lucrative-interest rules and partial foreign tax liability, and about related schemes such as swapping gross pay for allowances and the box system. The State Secretary confirmed that combining partial foreign tax liability with the lucrative-interest pass-through obligation is not possible, that the Grinwis amendment abolishes partial liability from 2025, and that the tax authority has appealed contrary rulings, while stating that data on lucrative-interest application is unavailable and that the box system and tax equalisation will be reviewed by a future cabinet.
It is not possible to determine from Tax Authority data in how many cases the lucrative-interest rule applies.
Het is niet mogelijk om op basis van Belastingdienstgegevens in beeld te brengen in hoeveel gevallen de lucratief belangregeling van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Maatoug en Dijk over belastingontwijking door de rijkste vrouw van Nederland

MPs Stultiens, Maatoug and Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by the richest woman in the Netherlands, including dividend-free capital repayments, the 5% participation exemption, and micro-company reporting rules. The government condemned tax avoidance but said capital repayments are lawful, declined to quantify or stop the routes, and promised only further study and EU-level work.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tseggai en Maatoug over het bericht ‘Hoe Netflix zijn recordwinst laat belasten: in vele ‘winstjes’ hier en daar’

MPs Tseggai and Maatoug asked whether Netflix's Dutch-based profits are shifted abroad, whether this undermines the investment obligation for streaming services, and about openness over Netflix's tax rulings. The State Secretary answered that profit allocation follows the arm's-length principle and BEPS rules, that the investment obligation is tied to Dutch revenue rather than profit, that he has no insight into Netflix's investments, and that individual tax files cannot be discussed under tax secrecy.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over “recente inzichten over arbeidsmarkttekorten in de kinderopvang”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about recent data on staff shortages in childcare, including vacancies, inflow and outflow, regional breakdowns, and sector comparisons. The minister answered with ABF Research forecasts showing a 5,900-person shortage in 2023 that is stabilising, regional figures, comparisons with healthcare and education, and a list of measures such as the Ontwikkelpad and the PNIL programme.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Maatoug over het artikel '‘Verstoorde arbeidsverhouding’ als ontslaggrond ondermijnt sociale veiligheid’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about the use of the 'disrupted working relationship' dismissal ground, its relevance for dismissals in education and for social safety, and whether the employer's culpability plays a role. The minister answered that data on the ground is not registered, that the employer's culpability can weigh in but is not decisive, that no separate research on education is planned, and pointed to existing workplace safety measures and a forthcoming handbook for employers.
This ground is not always explicitly mentioned in the request and is therefore not registered as such.
Deze grond wordt niet altijd expliciet in het verzoek genoemd en wordt dan dus ook niet als zodanig geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Palland en Maatoug over de onderwijsroute naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan het Da Vinci College te Dordrecht over de onderwijsroute Wet inburgering 2021

Three MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Wi2021 education route after a visit to Da Vinci College in Dordrecht, covering extra assessments, the share routed to the education track, national coverage, and waiting youths. The minister answered that most municipalities now offer the route, that the maximum inburgering term is three years, and that outcome data on quality and progression will only be available in 2024.
Regarding the quality and progression from the education route to regular education, there is still insufficient knowledge due to the short duration of the Wi2021.
Over de kwaliteit en doorstroom vanuit de onderwijsroute naar regulier onderwijs is nog onvoldoende bekend vanwege de korte looptijd van de Wi2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over een bailout voor banken in de stikstofaanpak

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about whether banks should be required to contribute to the nitrogen-reduction costs, including how this relates to the Landbouwakkoord, transition risks, supervision of banks, and how buyout subsidies interact with bank security rights. The government replies that it is integrally studying options for a non-voluntary bank contribution, to be reported around September, while declining to pre-empt the outcome and explaining the legal and supervisory limits on such measures.

The cabinet is studying in an integrated and coherent way, following the aforementioned motions, the possible policy options through which a financial contribution from banks to the agricultural transition and the nitrogen challenge can be secured.

Het kabinet onderzoekt integraal en in samenhang – ter opvolging van de hiervoor genoemde moties – de mogelijke beleidsopties waarmee een financiële bijdrage van banken aan de landbouwtransitie en de stikstofopgave kan worden geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het onderzoek ‘Verkenning grijze vlek binnen DC-regelingen’

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about the AFM study on the 'grey zone' in defined-contribution pensions, including contribution levels, the adequacy of pension accrual, the effect of the halving of the 'white zone', awareness, and a pension label. The minister answered that pension is a bargaining matter for social partners, declined to judge adequacy, pointed to awareness campaigns and information tools, and rejected a mandatory pension label.
It is up to employers' associations and employees' associations (hereafter social partners) to make agreements on the pension employment condition in conjunction with the other employment conditions.

Het is aan de (verenigingen van) werkgever(s) en (verenigingen van) werknemers (hierna sociale partners) om afspraken te maken over de arbeidsvoorwaarde pensioen in samenhang met de andere arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over de totstandkoming van de Kamerbrief 'Vrij en veilig onderwijs'

MPs Westerveld and Maatoug asked how the government letter 'Vrij en veilig onderwijs' on supervision of informal education was prepared, including ministry objections, the role of the Inspectorate, the complaint reporting point and a criminal complaint by Islamic organisations. The ministers answered that advice from officials was considered, that the Landsadvocaat's advice was sought, that the Inspectorate will do signal-based oversight, and that the reporting point operates with privacy safeguards, while noting that the Inspectorate still has concerns and that the Public Prosecutor saw no grounds for investigation.
The Minister for Primary and Secondary Education will take the Inspectorate's persistent concerns into account in further elaborating the bill.
De Minister voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs neemt de aanhoudende zorgen van de inspectie in de verdere uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over uitsluitingsgronden van de vrijwillige arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering voor zelfstandigen

An MP asked whether insurers' health questionnaires for self-employed people's voluntary disability insurance unfairly exclude people who have seen a psychologist, and what the government will do about it. The minister said such a visit alone normally does not lead to exclusion, that insurers assess risk individually under professional and anti-discrimination rules, and that a planned mandatory disability insurance for self-employed people is intended to resolve the problem.
In general, the mere fact that someone has visited a psychologist will not lead to a medical exclusion or rejection of the insurance application.
In het algemeen geldt dat het enkele feit dat iemand een bezoek aan een psycholoog heeft gebracht, niet zal leiden tot een medische uitsluiting of afwijzing van de verzekeringsaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder het niveau van een bijstandsuitkering omdat de regelingen niet op elkaar aansluiten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about thousands of households living below the social assistance level because income schemes do not align, asking for structural fixes, the effects of the double general tax credit reduction, and compensation options. The ministers answered that a structural solution is urgently needed, that options are being explored with a report due before June 2023, and that the answers include detailed budget and income calculations for example households.
As promised in the letter of 29 March, we will inform the House before June 2023 about progress in searching for solution directions.
Zoals toegezegd in de brief van 29 maart 1 zullen wij de Kamer vóór juni 2023 informeren over de vorderingen van het zoeken naar oplossingsrichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over de indexatie van de kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the indexation of the childcare allowance, including the extra increase for 2023, its effect on households, the use of MEV versus CEP figures, and whether the indexation system should be changed. The Minister explained the additional 1.74% indexation, gave household examples, said she will evaluate the indexation system next year, and announced a smaller 2024 indexation to fund policy measures.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Stoffer en Maatoug over 'de ondergrensindicatie bij Wet sociale werkvoorziening (Wsw-)werknemers'

MPs Stoffer and Maatoug ask about rising WIA applications among Wsw workers, the criteria and frequency of 'ondergrens' (lower limit) indications, and why such workers lose the transition payment and often cannot access an incapacity benefit. The minister answers with figures, explains the criteria and the difference between a lower-limit indication and incapacity, says ambtelijke verkenning of changes is ongoing, and states she is not in favour of abolishing periodic re-indications but will review them with UWV.
However, I want to further explore whether the right routes are available in all cases for people to get the support that fits their situation.
Ik wil echter nader verkennen of in alle gevallen de juiste routes beschikbaar zijn voor mensen om de ondersteuning te krijgen die bij hun situatie past.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Maatoug over het gevolg van een hogere instroom van jonge pensioendeelnemers voor het opbouwpercentage

MPs Nijboer and Maatoug asked whether an influx of young pension participants could lower the fiscal maximum accrual rate and pension premiums, and whether the fiscal limits should be changed. The minister answered that individual fiscal limits apply, that premiums need not fall, that no change to the law is needed, and listed the few pension schemes without a franchise.
No, that is not correct. For each participant in the pension scheme, the room for pension accrual must be determined separately.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Voor elke deelnemer aan de pensioenregeling dient afzonderlijk de ruimte voor pensioenopbouw te worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over de uitzending van Tegenlicht van donderdag 26 januari en het initiatief Collectief Kapitaal

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the Collectief Kapitaal initiative, which gives cash payments to participants and holds ANBI status as a knowledge institution, is treated as income, and about related policy. The government answered that tax treatment depends on the facts, that it cannot disclose details of an individual ANBI under secrecy rules, and that it will follow such small private initiatives and consult municipalities.
Because the Tax Administration is bound by the secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), no further information can be provided about individual institutions.

Omdat de Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over "Reactie op brief LOSR over samenloop regelingen en effect op toeslagen"

An MP asks why resolving the overlap between social assistance and tax-based allowances (toeslagen) for households at the social minimum has taken so long, since the Ombudsman raised it in 2016 and the Central Council of Appeal ruled on it. The minister answers that several options were examined without a solution free of serious drawbacks, that a compensation route is under study, that municipalities are advised to compensate in the meantime via special assistance, and that Parliament will be informed before summer 2023.
The exact number of households is not known.
Het exacte aantal huishoudens is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Maatoug over de aangenomen motie om uitgekochte bedrijven ruimhartig te compenseren, maar financiële instellingen niet

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister how the adopted motion on fairly compensating buyout of farms, while not burdening financial institutions, will be followed up, and whether mandatory buyout and compulsory expropriation affect bank collateral claims and risk responsibility. The government answers that a study into binding contributions from banks and supply-chain actors is underway, due before summer, and that legal rules on pledges and expropriation compensation are explained but offer no room for redistribution.
Once this study is completed, expected before the summer, I will inform your House of the outcomes.
Na het afronden van dit onderzoek – naar verwachting voor de zomer – zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Kathmann over de inkomenseffecten van het afschaffen van de IACK

MPs Maatoug and Kathmann asked what income effects abolishing the IACK has for parents, including new cohorts born from 2025 who lose the credit, and whether the government will compensate those with lower incomes. The minister answers that new cohorts face a negative effect (median about EUR 2,500 per year for single parents and EUR 2,400 for dual-earner couples in a simulation for 2023), that combined with minimum wage and childcare increases a net negative remains, and that there are no concrete plans to compensate, though income policy is reviewed annually.
At present there are no concrete plans to compensate this effect.
Op dit moment zijn er geen concrete plannen om dit effect te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug  over het spoedig uitkeren van de energietoeslag 2023

MPs Kathmann and Maatoug asked the minister why municipalities were told they must wait until about June 2023 to pay the 2023 energy allowance, despite earlier urging to pay early, and about funding shortfalls and continuity of local processes. The minister replied that anticipating the not-yet-enacted law is not justified this year given other income measures, that the 2022 budget via the municipal fund has no evidence of insufficiency, and promised to pursue a faster legislative process.
In my view, there are currently insufficient reasons to justify anticipating the new law.
In mijn ogen zijn er nu onvoldoende redenen die het anticiperen op de nieuwe wet rechtvaardigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Westerveld over het STAP-budget

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about training-subsidy (STAP) budget being captured by course providers through price rises and marketing, and whether the budget should target labour shortages in energy, education and care. The government acknowledges misuse signals, promises price checks, a cap on subsidies per course, a gift/affiliate marketing review, and a study of prioritising shortage sectors, while declining to commit to specific price agreements or a fixed budget split.
Your House will be informed early next year about the outcome and the further approach to this.
Uw Kamer wordt begin volgend jaar geïnformeerd over uitkomst en de verdere aanpak hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug over het bericht dat er een burn-outgolf dreigt als gevolg van de arbeidsmarktkrapte

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a looming burn-out wave caused by tight labour markets, including prevention, employer risk assessments, after-hours reachability and inspection enforcement. The Minister answered that burn-out rates rose from 12% to 17% and pointed to existing programmes (BMS, RI&E programme, subsidy scheme), inspection figures showing enforcement at 22% and 16% of first inspections, and agreed to answer before the plenary debate on the reachability bill.
I will inform the House shortly about the progress of the BMS.
Ik informeer uw Kamer binnenkort over de voortgang van de BMS.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Maatoug, Westerveld en Ellemeet over de inhuur van externe arbeid in publieke sectoren

MPs Maatoug, Westerveld and Ellemeet asked ministers about the use of external and flexible labour in the public and semi-public sectors, its effect on care quality and costs, and government steps to curb it. The government answered that it is pursuing measures to make employment under contract more attractive, tighten rules on self-employment and monitor agency and tariff arrangements, while stating it cannot provide sector-level data on many questions.
Apart from the figures below on external hiring within central government, education and care and welfare, no data are kept for (semi-)public sub-sectors.
Behalve onderstaande cijfers over inhuur van externe arbeid binnen de Rijksoverheid, het onderwijs en zorg en welzijn, worden geen data bijgehouden voor (semi)-publieke (deel)sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over Lucratief Belang

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance about the carried-interest 'lucratief belang' rules, including whether the doorstootverplichting in article 3.95b(5) lets private equity managers pay only 26.9% tax, whether it conflicts with the legislative intent, and whether combining it with the 30%-regeling creates zero-tax outcomes for expats. The State Secretary largely defends the regime as clarifying the law, says no data exist on structure counts, sees no unintended avoidance and no need for action, and states that fund managers and expats are taxed on the same basis as other earners.
I currently see no need to take action.
Ik zie vooralsnog geen noodzaak om actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over naheffingen bij schijnzelfstandigheid

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary for Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs whether bogus self-employed workers face back-payment claims for social contributions and tax, whether these are used as a threat to deter claims, and whether employers may pass such costs on to workers. The government answers that enforcement against employers is under a moratorium, that individuals may still face income-tax assessments, that it cannot give general assurances, and that it will reinforce enforcement and send a progress letter this year.
In the cabinet response to the ARK and ADR reports, it was promised that enforcement on the classification of employment relationships for payroll taxes will be recalibrated and strengthened.
In de kabinetsreactie op de rapporten van ARK en ADR 3 is toegezegd de handhaving op de kwalificatie van de arbeidsrelatie voor de loonheffingen te herijken en versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over 'berekeningen van het toetsingsinkomen voor de kinderopvangtoeslag'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the childcare allowance calculation, which uses the income-test base aligned with taxable income, unfairly disadvantages tenants compared with homeowners, and whether the rules could be revised or simplified. The minister defended aligning the test income with taxable income, said the government plans to replace the income-dependent childcare allowance with an income-independent system, and noted that housing status is not recorded.
Housing status is not a criterion on which Toeslagen pays the childcare allowance.
De woonsituatie is geen criterium op basis waarvan Toeslagen de kinderopvangtoeslag uitkeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het artikel 'Hoe een Ierse rundvleeskoning via de Zuidas voor miljoenen aan belastingen ontwijkt'

An MP (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by a company via interest-free loans and informal capital structures, and about dividend withholding rates to Luxembourg, among other things. The State Secretary answered that the 2022 anti-mismatch law applies to existing arrangements without grandfathering, that the Netherlands cannot comment on individual taxpayers under the AWR, and that the Pillar 2 minimum tax bill will be released for consultation.
Under Article 67 AWR I cannot comment on the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 AWR kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Maatoug over de arbonormen van het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

GroenLinks MPs Kröger and Maatoug asked the ministers about occupational health standards for Schiphol baggage handlers, why the labour inspectorate had not inspected since 2009, and whether Schiphol and the handling firms should compensate workers. The ministers answered that the inspectorate has started an investigation, that employers bear primary responsibility, that Schiphol should take a larger role and is pursuing a social accord, and that compensation is a matter between workers and employers.
The Minister of SZW has asked the Labour Inspectorate to consider whether improvements are possible.
De Minister van SZW heeft de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Maatoug over het bericht 'Brussel duldt geen inmenging in besteding coronamiljarden'

MPs Dassen and Maatoug asked whether the government supports the Commission's claim that disclosing documents on informal talks about the Dutch recovery plan would undermine decision-making, and how the decision-making process is defined. Minister Kaag answered that disclosure of pre-2022 documents no longer undermines the process, that the formal decision-making only started after the final plan was submitted on 8 July 2022, and that Parliament was kept informed throughout, while deferring the Commission-related questions to the Commission.

As regards the documents on the talks between the Dutch cabinet and the European Commission for this period that are in our possession, I am of the view that disclosing these documents no longer undermines the decision-making process surrounding approval of the Dutch plan.

Voor wat betreft de documenten over de gesprekken tussen het Nederlandse kabinet en de Europese Commissie voor deze periode die in ons bezit zijn, ben ik van mening dat openbaarmaking van deze documenten het besluitvormingsproces rondom de goedkeuring van het Nederlandse plan niet langer ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over de uitspraak inzake de energietoeslag voor studenten

An MP asks the Minister for Poverty Policy about a court ruling that Nijmegen wrongly excluded all students from the one-off energy allowance, and about what it means for other municipalities, co-ordination with VNG, DUO implementation and extra funding. The Minister keeps the advice that students be excluded as a group, points to individual special assistance as the alternative, and refuses to issue binding rules to municipalities, citing their policy discretion.
Because municipalities have policy discretion within special assistance, I cannot make binding statements about this.
Omdat gemeenten binnen de bijzondere bijstand over beleidsvrijheid beschikken, kan ik hier geen bindende uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Kröger over de doorwerking van groothandelprijzen in gas en energie bij huishoudens en de weerslag hiervan op koopkracht

MPs Maatoug and Kröger asked how the government monitors hardship from high energy prices, and why the CPB will not update its cost-of-living box or model uneven inflation across income groups. The minister points to CPB stress tests, a TNO energy-poverty programme, forthcoming CBS and Divosa monitors, and says the CPB judges such updates methodologically infeasible, with extra instruments promised in the Prinsjesdag purchasing-power letter; answers to questions 1-8 are deferred.
The request was to answer these questions before Prinsjesdag. Full answers are not yet possible within that timeframe.
Het verzoek was om deze vragen voor Prinsjesdag te beantwoorden. De volledige beantwoording van de vragen is nog niet mogelijk op die termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Maatoug over het afschalen van de dienstregeling van NS vanwege personeelstekorten en de stakingen bij NS

GroenLinks MPs Bouchallikh and Maatoug asked the ministers about NS cutting its timetable by 10-20% due to staff shortages and strikes, including effects on passengers, car use, wages and state responsibility as shareholder. The government answered that it shares concern, is pressing NS in talks, will inform parliament on relevant developments, and says wage and funding decisions rest with NS's board.
We will inform your House of relevant developments regarding the scaling back of the timetable due to staff shortages at NS.
Wij zullen uw Kamer informeren bij relevante ontwikkelingen ten aanzien van het afschalen van de dienstregeling vanwege personeelstekorten bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Bromet over de analyse van het ministerie over de aanpak van de stikstofcrisis

MPs Maatoug and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Finance about the ministry's analysis of the nitrogen crisis approach, including its methodology compared with Erisman and Strootman, the 39 kton ammonia reduction target, budgetary costs, farmers' debts and financial-sector risks. The government answered at length, stating the analysis is a tentative, non-binding working result shared with the RIVM, that an integral approach is preferred over nitrogen-only optimisation, and that forced write-offs of farmers' loans are legally and prudentially unacceptable.
The Cabinet will inform the House about the follow-up with the RIVM.
Over het vervolg met het RIVM zal het Kabinet uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Kröger over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a Eindhoven proposal for a national climate-jobs coalition, targets, retraining support, fragmented funding, technical training shortages, and a motion on vocational education. The government answered that it will examine the proposals within an upcoming action plan (aanvalsplan) for technical skills, promising letters to parliament, but gave largely general responses without firm targets.
Before the summer you will receive a letter with the substantive elaboration of the action plan.
Voor de zomer ontvangt u een brief met de inhoudelijke uitwerking van het aanvalsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over de reiskostenvergoeding van jonge nieuwkomers

MPs Westerveld and Maatoug asked about differing municipal rules and amounts for travel-cost reimbursement for school-going newcomers over 12, the indicators used, and the availability of newcomer schools. Minister Wiersma answered that no statutory duty exists for newcomers with a status, that municipalities decide voluntarily, that the government has no overview of municipal schemes, and that around 120 ISK schools provide nationwide coverage.
However, I do not have an overview of which allowances municipalities provide and under which conditions.
Ik heb echter geen overzicht van welke vergoedingen gemeenten verstrekken en onder welke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Maatoug over het bericht dat “investeerders hun greep op de kinderopvang vergroten"

Two MPs asked the minister whether investors' growing control over childcare is desirable, whether profit-focused ownership harms quality and equal opportunity, how decisions on takeovers and parental influence work, and what safeguards are needed before childcare becomes largely subsidised in 2025. The minister says quality is the primary concern, acknowledges worries about private equity, and promises a government study into financing forms, profit-taking and possible profit caps, but defers concrete measures until that study is complete.
That is why I announced, in answer to parliamentary questions from members Kathmann and Maatoug, that I will study the role of the different financing forms in childcare.
Daarom heb ik aangekondigd in antwoord op Kamervragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug dat ik de rol van de verschillende financieringsvormen in de kinderopvang ga onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug over private equity Bencis koopt in stilte weer kinderopvangverblijven op

MPs Kathmann and Maatoug asked the Minister of Social Affairs about private equity firm Bencis buying back childcare centres, the Estro/Smallsteps history, lack of parent information on ownership, rising tariffs, interest payments and profit levels in childcare. The minister answered that ownership is public but parents should be proactively informed, that a study of financing forms (including possible profit or tariff limits) will be launched, and that tariff caps are not currently under consideration.
That is why I want to investigate the role of the different financing forms in childcare.
Daarom wil ik de rol van de verschillende financieringsvormen in de kinderopvang gaan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over verlof bij vroeggeboorte

An MP asks whether the new birth leave under WIEG restricts partners' leave timing for premature babies and whether maternity leave is too short when babies stay in hospital. The minister confirms the partner definition was changed deliberately for administrability, explains the extended maternity leave for hospital stays, and provides an international comparison while stating the current arrangements are adequate.
This definition was deliberately changed in the WIEG.
Deze definitie is in de WIEG bewust aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Maatoug over werkenden zonder pensioenopbouw

MPs Van Dijk and Maatoug asked the minister about the roughly 936,000 employees without pensions (the 'white spot'), Wajong workers under loondispensatie, procurement conditions, and pension experiments for self-employed. The minister answered that data updates and a further CBS study are planned, that social partners' action plan is being pursued, that legal limits block pension requirements in public tenders, and that the experimental pension-saving rules for self-employed are being prepared within the pension reform bill.
I intend to have the next CBS study carried out with figures for 2022.
Ik ben voornemens om het volgende CBS-onderzoek te laten uitvoeren met cijfers over 2022
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over het CEP 2022

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the 200 euro energy allowance is enough, what minimum wage indexation alternatives would do to purchasing power, whether a one-off healthcare allowance increase is possible, and for answers before the debate. The government raised the municipal energy allowance reference amount to 800 euro, declined to deviate from the statutory minimum wage indexation method or submit the decision to parliament, and said a one-off care allowance increase is costly and slow to implement.
The cabinet proposes raising the reference amount of the energy allowance to 800 euro and has made 480 million euro extra available for this.
Het kabinet stelt voor om het richtbedrag van de energietoeslag te verhogen naar 800 euro en heeft hier 480 miljoen euro extra voor beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over Gorillas

An MP asked whether Gorillas became a Dutch holding to avoid stronger German co-determination rules and whether it sought to block a works council in Germany, and asked for a comparison of Dutch and German and European co-determination law. The minister said the company's choices are its own responsibility, could not confirm a link to German rules, noted a Berlin court rejected Gorillas' request to end works council elections, and gave a detailed overview of differences in works council rights and EU directives without committing to any action.
It is the responsibility and authority of a company to weigh the strategy and policy it pursues.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid en bevoegdheid van een bedrijf om een afweging te maken over de te voeren strategie en beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Kröger en Bouchallikh over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Climate and Education about labour shortages blocking climate ambitions, retraining routes, support for career changers and a proposed work-guarantee fund. The ministers answered that labour market shortages are broad, that government role is limited and employers and workers bear primary responsibility, that existing retraining schemes and a forthcoming Action Plan for Green Jobs are being developed, and they rejected a work-guarantee fund as not efficient.
The cabinet does not have an overview of all retraining routes for career changers aimed at the energy transition.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van alle opleidingstrajecten voor zij-instromers, die gericht zijn op de energietransitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het eerder afschaffen van de Jubelton

MP Maatoug asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax-free gift for a home (Jubelton) could be set to zero before 2024 via a parameter change, arguing this would reduce housing inequality, and why abolition was not earlier. The State Secretary answered that setting it to zero requires structural system changes, that a floor of 27,231 euro is preferred, that abolition is planned for 1 January 2024, and that the timing was constrained by ICT portfolio capacity.
It is technically possible to automate lowering the gift exemption for the owner-occupied home for parental gifts to children to one euro or another amount, but not to 0 euro.
Het is automatiseringstechnisch mogelijk om de schenkingsvrijstelling voor de eigen woning voor schenkingen van ouders aan kinderen te verlagen tot één euro of een ander bedrag, maar niet tot 0 euro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Maatoug over het EU herstelfonds

MPs Dassen and Maatoug asked the Finance Minister why the Dutch EU recovery fund (RRF) spending selection was prepared behind closed doors without parliament and local governments, and about the timeline, consultation and Commission contacts. The minister answered that spending choices were set in the coalition agreement, that consultation has occurred and will continue via two draft plans shared with parliament, and that some correspondence will be released later via a pending FOI request.
In the process leading to submission of the final plan, the House, sub-national governments and other stakeholders will be involved.
In het proces dat leidt tot indiening van het definitieve plan zullen de Kamer, medeoverheden, en andere belanghebbenden meegenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Alkaya over het nieuws dat medewerkers van Schiphol ernstige gezondheidsrisico’s lopen als gevolg van blootstelling aan ultrafijnstof

MPs asked the minister about reports that Schiphol workers face serious health risks from ultrafine particles, including inspection history, research, employer responsibility, and compensation. The minister answered that the Labour Inspectorate has two investigations ongoing, that employers bear primary responsibility, and that a sector taskforce and independent committee are being set up while several requests are deferred.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Brandbrief grote steden: duizenden vluchtelingen veroordeeld tot falend inburgeringsstelsel’

Two MPs asked the state secretary about a letter from big-city municipalities warning that thousands of refugees would be stuck under the old integration system after the new Integration Act takes effect. The state secretary answered that a transitional arrangement was rejected for legal-equality and legal-certainty reasons, that municipalities would be supported and a motion would be explored, but could not provide all answers in time.
Unfortunately, I have not been able to do that.
Dat is mij helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Gijs van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad voor Beroep inzake werken vanuit de bijstand

MPs Maatoug and Gijs van Dijk asked the State Secretary about the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling on working while on welfare benefits (bijstand) and the risk of income falling below the welfare level. The Secretary answered that about 40,000 cases a year are affected, that most municipalities are adjusting their practice while some systems are still being changed, and that she is working with VNG, Divosa and the G4 and on the Simpel Switchen project, but declined to adopt a 50% generic income disregard.
Welfare recipients whose benefit has been terminated since the CRvB ruling and who believe the termination was wrongful can turn to their municipality.
Bijstandsgerechtigden van wie de bijstandsuitkering sinds de uitspraak van de CRvB is beëindigd en die het idee hebben dat de beëindiging onterecht is, kunnen zich richten tot hun gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over "de gebrekkige transparantie van pensioenfondsen"

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Social Affairs about AFM findings that many pension funds fail to report costs correctly or fully under the Pension Act and IORP II, and about the government's responsibility as convenant partner. The State Secretary acknowledges transparency is important and that much work remains, but states the supervisor (AFM) is primarily responsible for enforcement, sees no need yet to revise the rules or approach funds directly, and points to planned IORP II evaluation in 2023.
At this moment I have no picture of the extent to which the 2020 annual reports of pension funds comply with the transparency requirements.
Op dit moment heb ik geen beeld van de mate waarin de jaarverslagen 2020 van pensioenfondsen de transparantie-eisen in acht nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het toezicht op de kinderopvang

An MP asks the State Secretary about large variation between municipalities in childcare inspection outcomes, the funding of GGD GHOR, the AEF report on cooperation in childcare supervision, and rising administrative burden. The State Secretary answers that supervision is decentralised so differences are not necessarily undesirable, that the national partners' overlap structure was revised, that evaluations of supervision and the Wet IKK start this autumn, and that results will be sent to parliament.
I will inform your House of the outcomes.
Over de uitkomsten zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over de uitspraak van de rechter inzake het verlopen van de inburgeringstermijn

An MP asks the State Secretary why the government appealed one court ruling on repayment of the integration loan after a minor deadline overrun but not a similar one, and whether discretionary, proportionate assessment and partial debt forgiveness will be introduced. The State Secretary answers that the appeal was withdrawn to fit a new policy line being developed with DUO, that a draft regulation for partial forgiveness is in internet consultation, and that a hardship clause is planned in the law.
The 10 June ruling of the Noord-Holland court has led to looking differently at debt forgiveness for the loan when a culpable deadline overrun occurs.

De uitspraak van 10 juni jl. van de rechtbank van Noord-Holland heeft ertoe geleid dat er met een andere blik naar kwijtschelding van de lening bij een verwijtbare termijnoverschrijding wordt gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over het vaccineren van arbeidsmigranten

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how migrant workers in the Netherlands are being vaccinated against COVID-19, including how many have been vaccinated, what outreach exists, and whether employers and GGDs can vaccinate on site. The minister answered that there is no separate registration for this group, describes multilingual outreach, cooperation with employers' organisations and GGDs, on-site and mobile vaccination options, and a working group led by RIVM, while declining to introduce in-company vaccination.
There is no separate registration for this target group.
Er is geen aparte registratie voor deze doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Gijs van Dijk, en Van Kent, over het artikel “Mensen in financiële nood door achterstand bij UWV”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV backlogs in WIA disability claims, forcing people into advance payments they must repay, and about hardship, shortages of insurance physicians and debt recovery rules. The minister answered with figures on advance payments and repayments, explained the causes of delays and the lack of a reimbursable-advance alternative, and committed to further talks with UWV and a letter setting out a solution.
I will engage further with VNG and UWV to assess whether this framework is adequate.
Ik ga nader in gesprek met VNG en UWV om te bezien of dit kader toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over "pensioen voor zelfstandigen"

An MP asked whether pension experiments for self-employed workers have stalled and why the related experiment legislation is delayed, and whether the Pensioenakkoord commitment to bring more self-employed into pensions will be honoured. The minister confirms the legislation is expected to take effect by 1 January 2023 for fiscal reasons, says full data-sharing and premium-facilitation demands cannot all be met, and states commitments on self-employed pension building are being worked out through the Stichting van de Arbeid and the bill.
For that reason I cannot anticipate too much on the precise content of the bill.
Ik kan om voornoemde reden niet te veel vooruitlopen op de precieze inhoud van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het bericht dat de nieuwe deurwaarderswet schuldenaars in problemen brengt

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new garnishment rules (vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet) leave debtors with too little money because fictitious rather than actual housing costs are used, and what will be done. The minister acknowledges the concerns, explains the fictitious housing cost design and the exceptions and hardship clause, and says the law will be evaluated and studied externally rather than changed now.
I will include the effects on housing costs in the external research and the statutory evaluation.
Ik zal de effecten rond de woonkosten meenemen het externe onderzoek en de wetsevaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over ''de dalende instroom in de wettelijke schuldsanering''

An MP asked the minister why entry into the statutory debt rescheduling scheme (Wsnp) has fallen again in 2020, and what is being done about it. The minister acknowledged the falling inflow, pointed to measures such as a mandatory creditor response period, a pilot allowing debt administrators to file Wsnp applications, and a forthcoming bill to improve the transition from municipal debt assistance to the statutory route, while rejecting the claim that municipalities had cut back on debt assistance.
The goal is to ensure that everyone receives suitable, good and fast help when they struggle with problematic debts.
Het doel is om te zorgen dat iedereen passende, goede en snelle hulp krijgt als hij of zij kampt met problematische schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het bericht dat er meer ‘gluurapparatuur’ wordt ingezet

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of increased use of workplace monitoring software during telework, the scale of oversight by the Inspectorate and the Data Protection Authority, backlogs at the AP, and planned measures. The minister answers that monitoring is only allowed under strict conditions, that the AP is responsible for GDPR enforcement and complaints, that the Inspectorate lacks a legal basis, that the AP prioritises complaints, and promises the policy response to the Rathenau report before the summer recess.
Supervision of compliance with the GDPR lies with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP).
Het toezicht op de naleving van de AVG ligt bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP).

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over toetsing vooraf op deugdelijkheid

Amendment requires that new schools prove beforehand, to the minister's satisfaction, that they will meet quality requirements (school plan, teacher competence, instruction time) before being placed on the funding plan.
An institution will have to demonstrate to the minister's satisfaction that these soundness requirements are met.
Een instelling zal ten genoegen van de minister moeten aantonen dat wordt voldaan aan die deugdelijkheidseisen.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Kraneveldt-van der Veen en Jasper van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het aanscherpen van de regels voor bekostiging van een nieuwe school of nevenvestiging
Lets the minister refuse funding for a new school or branch when a board has not, or not fully, followed a supervisory instruction, with a four-week right for the board to respond.
the minister may decide that the legal entity maintaining the school is not eligible for funding of a new school
kan Onze minister besluiten dat de rechtspersoon die de school in stand houdt niet in aanmerking komt voor bekostiging van een nieuwe school
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over toetsing vooraf op deugdelijkheid
Amendment requires that a new school prove, to the satisfaction of the inspectorate, that it can meet quality requirements (school plan, teacher competence, instruction time) before it can be funded.
An institution will have to demonstrate to the satisfaction of the inspectorate that those quality requirements are met.
Een instelling zal ten genoegen van de inspectie moeten aantonen dat wordt voldaan aan die deugdelijkheidseisen.
Amendement van de leden Kraneveldt-van der Veen en Jasper van Dijk over het aanscherpen van de regels voor bekostitging van een nieuwe school of nevenvestiging

Amends the education bill so the minister may deny funding for new schools or branches when the governing body faces intervention or a directive, giving the school body a four-week right to respond first.
Before applying the first paragraph, the minister gives the legal entity four weeks to present its views.
Onze minister geeft de rechtspersoon, alvorens toepassing te geven aan het eerste lid, vier weken de gelegenheid zijn zienswijze naar voren te brengen.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Kraneveldt-van der Veen en Langkamp ter vervanging van nr. 11 inzake het invoegen van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the minister to report to the States General within four years on the effectiveness and effects of the law.
Within four years after this act enters into force, our minister sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this act in practice.
Onze minister zendt binnen vier jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Kraneveldt-van der Veen en Langkamp ter vervanging van nr. 10

Earmarks the early childhood education grant to municipalities, lets the minister set eligibility criteria by decree, reclaim unspent funds, and require municipalities to supply data and cooperate with research.
Our minister may reclaim the grant in whole or in part if it has not been spent in accordance with the provisions of this law.
Onze minister kan de uitkering geheel of gedeeltelijk terugvorderen indien de uitkering niet is besteed in overeenstemming met de bepalingen van deze wet.
Amendement van de leden Kraneveldt-van der Veen en Langkamp over het behouden van de specifieke uitkering
Amendment letting the minister set criteria for a specific grant to municipalities for early childhood education, with clawback power, data duties and reporting obligations.
Our minister may reclaim the grant in whole or in part if it has not been spent in accordance with the provisions of this law.
Onze minister kan de uitkering geheel of gedeeltelijk terugvorderen indien de uitkering niet is besteed in overeenstemming met de bepalingen van deze wet.
Motie Van Gent en Kraneveldt-van der Veen over één landelijk beleidskader kwaliteitseisen kinderopvang, peuterspeelzalen en voorschoolse educatie
Motion asks the government to work toward one national policy framework for quality standards in childcare, playgroups and preschool education.
requests the government to work toward one national policy framework for quality requirements for childcare, playgroups and preschool education
verzoekt de regering toe te werken naar één landelijk beleidskader kwaliteitseisen kinderopvang, peuterspeelzalen en voorschoolse educatie
Amendement van de leden Kraneveldt-van der Veen en Langkamp over het invoegen van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds an article requiring the minister to report to the States General within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the act in practice.
Our minister sends to the States General within three years after entry into force a report on the effectiveness and effects of this act in practice.
Onze minister zendt binnen drie jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Motie Langkamp en Kraneveldt-van der Veen over effectieve programma's voor voor- en vroegschoolse educatie
Asks the government to encourage use only of proven-effective programmes for early childhood education to tackle language disadvantage.
requests the government to encourage that only proven-effective programmes for pre- and early school education are used
verzoekt de regering te stimuleren dat er enkel gewerkt wordt met bewezen effectieve programma’s voor voor- en vroegschoolse educatie
Motie Kraneveldt- van der Veen/Dibi over een formele positie voor de schoolleider
Asks the government to give the school leader a formal role in inspectorate talks under the new supervision, while keeping the option for the competent authority to request a separate meeting.
requests the government to give the school leader a formal position in the new inspection supervision to attend talks with the inspectorate
verzoekt de regering de schoolleider in het nieuwe inspectietoezicht weer formeel een positie te geven om bij gesprekken met de inspectie aanwezig te zijn
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen c.s. over inspelen op innovatieve mogelijkheden
Asks the government to run a multidisciplinary experiment at one or more schools on innovative school hours and day arrangements.

requests the government to show in practice, through a multidisciplinary experiment at one or more schools during this cabinet term, how education can respond to innovative options for school hours and day arrangements

verzoekt de regering om nog deze kabinetsperiode via een multidisciplinair experiment op één of meerdere scholen in de praktijk te laten zien hoe het onderwijs kan inspelen op innovatieve mogelijkheden voor schooltijden en dagarrangementen
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen over uitsluitend door erkende instellingen laten opleiden van gastouders
Asks the government to guarantee that training of childminders and EVC tracks are provided only by recognised educational institutions.
requests the government to guarantee that training of childminders and/or offering EVC tracks is done only by recognised educational institutions
verzoekt de regering te garanderen dat het opleiden van gastouders en/of het aanbieden van een EVC-traject uitsluitend geschiedt door erkende (onderwijs)instellingen
Motie Van Toorenburg c.s. over alleen subsidie verlenen voor EVC-trajecten van maximaal €900 inclusief btw
Motion asking the government to grant the planned childcare subsidy for EVC trajectories only up to a maximum of 900 euros including VAT, to prevent price inflation.
requests the government to grant the promised subsidy only for trajectories of a maximum of 900 euros, including VAT
verzoekt de regering de toegezegde subsidie alleen te verlenen voor trajecten van maximaal € 900, inclusief BTW
Motie Koşer Kaya en Kraneveldt-van der Veen over een onafhankelijk toezichthouder voor de kinderopvangbranche
Asks the government to establish an independent supervisor for the childcare sector to assess price increases.
requests the government to establish an independent supervisor for the childcare sector
verzoekt de regering om een onafhankelijk toezichthouder voor de kinderopvangbranche in te stellen
Amendement van het lid Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink c.s. over ouders die onder toezicht zijn gesteld en derhalve geen gastouder mogen zijn
Excludes parents whose children are under a supervision order (OTS) from being registered as childminders under the Childcare Act.
with the exception of natural persons whose children are subject to a supervision order.
met uitzondering van natuurlijke personen van wie een of meer kinderen op bij algemene maatregel van bestuur aan te wijzen gronden onderworpen zijn aan ondertoezichtstelling
Amendement van het lid Kraneveldt-van der Veen c.s. over de redelijke verhouding tussen het aantal gewerkte uren en het aantal uren kinderopvang
Adds a power to set by general administrative order (AMvB) rules on a reasonable ratio between parents' worked hours and childcare allowance hours.
By general administrative order rules may be set on the reasonable ratio between the number of hours worked, whether or not in employment
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen regels worden gesteld over de redelijke verhouding tussen het aantal, al dan niet in dienstverband, gewerkte uren
Amendement van het lid Kraneveldt-van der Veen c.s. over de evaluatie na een jaar van de voorliggende wijzigingswet

Requires the minister to report to parliament one year after the childcare amendment takes effect on the effectiveness and practical effects of the changed parts of the Childcare Act, then as part of the regular evaluation report.

one year after the entry into force of the act amending the Childcare Act regarding the reform of the host-parent childcare system, the minister reports to the States General on the effectiveness and practical effects

een jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de wet van ............ tot wijziging van de Wet kinderopvang in verband met een herziening van het stelsel van gastouderopvang ( Stb. .....) en vervolgens telkens als onderdeel van het verslag, bedoeld in het tweede lid, aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag uit
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen over een certificering of een keurmerk voor de kinderopvangbranche
Asks the government to talk with the childcare sector about developing a certification or quality mark and inform parliament in spring 2010.
requests the government to engage with the sector to develop a certification or quality mark for the childcare sector
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te gaan met de branche om tot de ontwikkeling te komen van een certificering of een keurmerk voor de kinderopvangbranche
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen en Koşer Kaya over het versterken van de positie van ouders in de kinderopvang
Asks the government to present concrete proposals to curb harmful childcare practices and strengthen parents' position.
requests the government to come up with concrete proposals this year on how it wants to counter these practices
verzoekt de regering nog dit jaar met concrete voorstellen te komen hoe zij deze praktijken wil tegengaan
Amendement van de leden Sterk en Kraneveldt om de verplichting Nederlands als eerste voertaal te gebruiken uit te breiden naar de gastouderopvang
Extends the requirement to use Dutch as the first language from daycare centres to home-based childcare (gastouderopvang).
the obligation to use Dutch as first language is extended to home-based childcare
de verplichting Nederlands als eerste voertaal te gebruiken uitgebreid naar de gastouderopvang
Motie Spekman c.s. over kinderen die naar huis gestuurd worden dan wel thuiszitten
Asks the government, before the amended Wajong takes effect, to map how many children with disabilities are sent home or stay out of school per REC school and to create day-care places for them.
requests the government, before the amended Wajong takes effect, to make visible per REC school how many children they send home
verzoekt de regering nog voor de inwerkingtreding van de gewijzigde Wajong, per REC-school of cluster REC-scholen inzichtelijk te maken hoeveel kinderen zij naar huis sturen
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen c.s. over de daadwerkelijke besteding van de zorggelden
Asks the government to commission a detailed audit of how schools actually spend the care-related education funds, reporting to the Chamber in spring 2009.
requests the government to commission an in-depth audit in primary, secondary and vocational education of the actual spending of the care funds
verzoekt de regering een diepgaand accountantsonderzoek in te stellen in het po, het vo en het mbo naar de daadwerkelijke besteding van de zorggelden

qa: Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ferrier (beiden CDA), Timmer en Kraneveldt-van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een cluster 3 school

MPs asked whether a school in Losser for children with an IQ of 35 or lower lacks structural care funding after the AWBZ package measures and why it has no education recognition from the municipality. The minister said the school needs municipal agreement, denied a confirmed funding gap, pointed to adjusted care classes and a EUR 10 million subsidy, and promised continued consultation with the health ministry.
It is not known whether there are no or fewer structural funds as a result of the AWBZ 2009 package measure for the care activities at the school.

Vragen van de leden Kraneveldt-van der Veen (PvdA) en Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het instandhouden dan wel bevorderen van openbaar onderwijs (ingezonden 12 mei 2010).

MPs asked whether it is undesirable that autonomous public-education boards may not promote public education after a Council of State ruling led to amended articles of association, and asked about a planned statutory amendment, its effect, and its timing. The minister confirmed the reported facts, explained that the ruling does not bar promotion per se but that new public schools can currently only be founded by the municipality, and said a planned amendment to allow boards to request new schools is in preparation, with its submission left to the new cabinet and no timeline given.
However, it is currently not possible for autonomous boards to submit a request to the municipality to establish a new public school.
