Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht 'Zorgwekkend tekort aan hoogopgeleide verpleegkundigen'

MPs Lucas and Schut-Welkzijn (VVD) asked the ministers of Education and Health about a report on a shortage of highly educated nurses, including unfunded training, co-financing for demand-driven funding experiments, mbo training requirements versus BIG rules, and ways to make nursing more attractive. The ministers answered that funded and unfunded institutions complement each other, that demand-driven funding experiments are delayed in care, that an independent facilitator and a commission will be set up, that interpretation room exists in hours rules, and listed several measures to address shortages mainly in community and elderly care.
By Prinsjesdag at the latest I will inform your House about the state of affairs.
Uiterlijk op Prinsjesdag zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Rog, Beertema en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht 'Leidse Greentower is in 2018 klaar

MPs asked the minister whether ROC Leiden's contribution to a bicycle parking garage near the Leiden square was capped, how it relates to earlier agreements on the square, and why the Chamber had not yet been informed. The minister answered that a 2014 agreement caps ROC Leiden's share at EUR 788,000 excluding VAT, with the municipality covering any excess, but that negotiations on the final amount are still ongoing and the Chamber will be informed once clarity exists.
At this moment the negotiations are still ongoing. As soon as I have clarity on this, I will inform you about it.
Op dit moment lopen de onderhandelingen nog. Zodra ik hier duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Veen, Visser en Duisenberg over de financiering van kennisinstituut Wetsus na 2016

Four VVD MPs asked how the knowledge institute Wetsus, a public-private water technology research centre, would be financed after 2016 and whether it could be moved into NWO, KNAW or a TO2 status. The minister replied that funding continues through transition money, NWO calls, regional funds and private contributions, that structural funding falls outside IenM's remit, and that no move to NWO or KNAW is currently planned.
For the period from 2016 onward, the Wetsus funding is foreseen as follows.
Voor de periode vanaf 2016 is de Wetsus-financiering als volgt voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas inzake het onderbrengen van private initiatieven bij bestaande BRIN-nummers

MP Lucas asked the minister about private initiatives being placed under existing BRIN numbers of vocational colleges, including a 40% overhead deduction arrangement between ROC Amsterdam and Urban Act, and about the difficulty of obtaining a BRIN number for new vocational providers. Minister Bussemaker replied that no definitive arrangement exists, that such overhead deductions would not appear to fit the legal framework, that existing rules allow private activities only if they benefit publicly funded education, and that procedures for new providers will be reviewed in a separate letter.
Creating a business model by renting out their BRIN number and deducting a percentage of funding as overhead does indeed seem not to fit within the legal framework.
Het via de «verhuur» van hun BRIN-nummer een verdienmodel creëren door een percentage van de bekostiging af te romen voor «overhead» lijkt mij inderdaad niet te passen binnen de wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over de belemmeringen van BBL-trajecten als gevolg van sectorfondsen

An MP asked whether the sector training fund and sector plan for transport and logistics unfairly favour BBL pupils placed through the sector institute STL over those placed through other temp agencies. The minister replied that STL is not a temp agency, that the funding is open to all approved training firms, and that the sector social partners chose this placement model.

The subsidy from the sector's training and development fund (SOOB) and the co-financing from the sector plan benefit all approved training companies in the transport and logistics sector that offer work placements to BBL pupils.

De subsidie uit het Opleidings- en Ontwikkelingsfonds van de sector (SOOB) en de cofinanciering uit het sectorplan komen ten goede aan alle erkende leerbedrijven in de sector Transport en Logistiek die BBL-leerlingen een leerwerk plaats bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas inzake het artikel "ROC Leiden gered van faillissement"

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the rescue of ROC Leiden from bankruptcy, governance and oversight of mbo institutions, wage-benefit rules, macro-efficiency of provision, and how bankruptcies and the curator's role relate to the minister's system responsibility. The minister answered at length, defending autonomy and institutional responsibility, pointing to an ongoing review committee reporting by 15 October 2015, and largely declining formal new powers or changes to the bankruptcy framework.
I would then gladly enter into discussion with your House.
Ik ga daarna graag met uw Kamer in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Leerwerkplekken in de knel door ontslagregels'

MPs Lucas and Anne Mulder asked whether the transition payment (transitievergoeding) under the new dismissal rules would discourage employers from offering learn-work places (leerwerkplekken) in vocational education, and whether apprentices should be excluded. The government answered that the payment applies in principle to apprentices, but employers may deduct training costs from it under an order in council, and it promised to consult social partners on collective agreements and to evaluate a pilot combined learning route.
At the same time, it is of course not intended that the introduction of the transition payment leads to fewer learn-work places being offered.
Tegelijkertijd is het uiteraard niet de bedoeling dat de introductie van de transitievergoeding leidt tot het aanbieden van minder leerwerkplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over financiële steun aan het ROC Leiden

An MP asks the minister whether the ministry will financially support ROC Leiden and ID College, for what purpose, how much, and why the February letter did not mention it. The minister confirms up to €40 million from the mbo macro budget, conditional and phased, to keep education going and improve quality, and says a commission is examining the housing decisions.
I will provide the funds under strict conditions and in phases.
Ik zal de middelen onder strikte voorwaarden en gefaseerd verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas inzake het bericht ‘Bijna klaar maar diploma ver weg’

An MP asked the education minister about several hundred MBO nursing students who faced extra required teaching hours after a change in hour norms, and whether the inspectorate and accreditation could have caught it. The minister answered that a solution was reached with the health ministry and inspectorate, that ROC Leiden no longer needs to extend the course, and that accreditation would not have helped in this case.
The Inspectorate of Education supervises the statutory professional requirements.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs houdt toezicht op de wettelijke beroepsvereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Anne Mulder inzake cao-belemmeringen van bbl-leerwerkplekken

MPs Lucas and Mulder asked whether sectoral collective agreement provisions on pay for bbl apprentices (vocational learning-work route) hinder the number of apprenticeship places, and what the minister would do about it. The minister replied that employers should agree pay with apprentices where needed, that she respects the social partners' agreements, listed measures to expand apprenticeship places, and gave figures on agreements and places.
As indicated in my response to questions 2 and 3, it is up to the social partners to make agreements on this.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn reactie op vraag 2 en 3 is het aan de sociale partners om hier afspraken over te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lucas over het bericht ‘Chinese horeca onder druk door gebrek aan koks’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about shortages of Chinese cooks and UWV's handling of work permits and job-matching for the Asian catering sector. The minister defended the labour-market test and UWV procedures, said the UWV project placed few workers, and promised further talks with the sector and UWV on a temporary solution.
I am willing to talk with UWV to examine whether the application can be simplified on a number of aspects, provided this information can be obtained in advance in another way.
Ik wil wel met UWV in gesprek gaan om te onderzoeken of op een aantal aspecten de aanvraag kan worden vereenvoudigd, mits deze informatie dan wel op een andere wijze vooraf verkregen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over het nieuwsbericht “Zelfstandigen niet voor de klas”

An MP asked the ministers whether the Tax Authority is actively questioning the self-employed status of freelance teachers in education, how it decides who counts as self-employed, and whether this threatens practical expertise in classrooms. The government answered that status is judged case by case under law and case law, that talks with education federations aim for national criteria, and that genuine self-employment will be protected while sham arrangements are tackled.
The Tax Authority is continuously in discussion with clients and their interest organisations about when self-employed persons without staff meet the criteria for self-employment.
De Belastingdienst is voortdurend in gesprek met opdrachtgevers en hun belangenorganisaties over de vraag wanneer zzp'ers aan de criteria voor zzp'er-schap voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Lucas over het bericht dat MBO scholen nee moeten verkopen

MPs Straus and Lucas asked the Minister of Education about reports that MBO schools must turn away students due to shortages of internship places. The minister acknowledged shortages in some sectors, placed responsibility on employers and schools, and said new study guides and quality agreements would address the issue rather than direct intervention.
I therefore make an urgent appeal to businesses to take their responsibility to combat youth unemployment.
Ik doe dan ook een klemmend beroep op het bedrijfsleven om zijn verantwoordelijkheid te nemen om jeugdwerkloosheid tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Aukje de Vries over crowdfunding

MPs Lucas and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about crowdfunding: the platforms licensed or exempted by the AFM, the difference between licences and exemptions, legal certainty, barriers, EU rules, investor caps and the scope for equity crowdfunding. The minister answered at length, describing the AFM regime, the planned review of the supervisory framework, and monitoring, while stating that current caps and rules stay in place for now.
I intend, together with the AFM, DNB and EZ, to re-examine the current supervisory framework for crowdfunding and to investigate whether the current regulation can be better tailored to crowdfunding.

Ik ben daarnaast voornemens om, in samenwerking met de AFM, DNB en EZ, het huidige toezichtkader voor crowdfunding opnieuw onder de loep te nemen en te onderzoeken of de huidige regelgeving nog beter op crowdfunding kan worden toegesneden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Lucas over het bericht dat een grote scheepsbouworder mogelijk naar een Spaanse scheepsbouwer gaat

MPs Schouten and Lucas asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Texel ferry operator TESO's provisional choice of a Spanish shipyard, despite Dutch innovation in the design, reflects unfair Spanish state subsidies and what the government will do to recover the order. The minister answered that Spain is bound by the EU shipbuilding aid framework, that the Commission has acted against past Spanish tax-lease aid, that he has no signals of current unlawful aid, and that he sees no reason to intervene because the order appears to be won on normal commercial terms.
At present I have no indications that the Spanish government is giving support to shipyards that leads to unfair competition.
Thans heb ik geen aanwijzingen dat de Spaanse overheid steun geeft aan werven die tot oneerlijke concurrentie leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Aukje de Vries, Jacobi en De Rouwe over het behoud van de monumentenstatus molen “Windlust”

MPs asked whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had advised against keeping the monument status of the Windlust windmill in Burum after a 2012 fire, on what criteria, and why it differs from the Schultehuis in Meppel. The minister answered that the agency started a delisting procedure because 95% of the mill was destroyed, that the municipality advised retaining status, and that a final decision awaits the Raad voor Cultuur's advice.
I will make a final decision on the monument status after receiving both advices.
Ik neem een definitief besluit over de monumentenstatus nadat ik beide adviezen heb ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over de opbouw en verdeling van het onderzoeks-budget uit de 1e geldstroom per universiteit

MP Lucas asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the 'percentages onderzoek' component of first-stream research funding is allocated by historical agreements rather than strategic or quality criteria, and why shares differ sharply between universities, correlating with degree and PhD numbers and founding dates. The Minister answers that the percentages are set by ministerial regulation and changed for substantive reasons, that the variation reflects past policy measures and institution-specific additions, denies that founding date drives allocation, and says the interdepartmental research policy review may consider the allocation criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over het bericht “Techneuten gezocht in buitenland; Fugro lijdt onder tekort aan hoogopgeleid personeel”

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that Fugro faces a shortage of highly educated technical staff, whether the government is engaging with Fugro and education institutions, and what it can do to keep the firm from relocating to Italy. The minister replies that Fugro is pursuing organic growth and works with local education providers, that no specific state help is requested, and that the government supports public-private cooperation and existing technical training and labour-market measures.
Fugro has indicated that, beyond the ongoing efforts around the Techniekpact and business policy, it does not expect specific help from the central government
Fugro heeft aangegeven op dit moment, naast de lopende inzet rondom het Techniekpact en het bedrijvenbeleid, geen specifieke hulp van het Rijk te verwachten
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucas over het artikel “Kabinet herijkt onderzoekgeld”

An MP asked about a planned interdepartmental policy review (IBO) of scientific research funding and how Parliament would be involved. The ministers answered that no formal assignment has been issued yet, the review will be budget-neutral, the final report and cabinet response will be sent to the House, and the assignments will accompany the Miljoenennota.
No formal assignment has yet been given for carrying out an IBO on scientific research.
Er is formeel nog geen opdracht gegeven voor de uitvoering van een IBO naar wetenschappelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Lucas, Neppérus en Ziengs over regeldruk door informatieuitvragen van de Centrale Dienst voor In- en Uitvoer van de Belastingdienst en van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

MPs Lucas, Neppérus and Ziengs (VVD) asked whether the CDIU and CBS collect statistics from contracting authorities and businesses in burdensome ways, such as postal-only responses and malfunctioning CBS software. The minister replied that TED data is incomplete, so missing data is requested directly, that the new Aanbestedingswet moves notifications to TenderNed, and that about 98% of statistical burden on businesses stems from EU regulation, with CBS working to reduce it.
The intention is to have the collection of data related to the statistical obligation go electronically via TenderNed in the future.
Het is de bedoeling om in de toekomst de verzameling van gegevens in verband met de statistiekverplichting elektronisch via TenderNed te laten verlopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucas over het bericht in het Financieele Dagblad van 27 februari 2013 “TNO reikt reddingsboei aan om worstelende topinstituten voor omvallen te behouden”

MP Lucas asked the minister of Economic Affairs about TNO's offer to take over struggling Technological Top Institutes, the alleged coercive contracting and competitive distortion, the request for a 40 million euro matching fund, and whether TNO's statutory tasks still count as pre-competitive. The minister defended multi-year public-private cooperation, denied that any coercion occurs, said matching is primarily for the knowledge institutions, and committed to review cooperation rules and to address TNO's statutory tasks in a forthcoming policy letter.
Regarding matching, I point to the principle that the consideration of it is in the first instance a matter for the knowledge institutions themselves.
Ten aanzien van matching wijs ik op het uitgangspunt dat de afweging daarvan in eerste instantie een zaak is van de kennisinstellingen zelf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Elias en Lucas over de dreigende sluiting Vaktechnisch Opleidingscentrum VTOC Fokker

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about the threatened closure of the VTOC Fokker aircraft maintenance training centre, its lack of standalone funding, and whether graduates are disadvantaged. The minister confirmed awareness, said the current law offers no funding route for private training, denied that only VTOC and one other centre place graduates, and promised a review with stakeholders by year-end.
It was agreed with those involved to examine how aircraft maintenance education can be offered in an accessible, high-quality and efficient way.
Met de betrokkenen is afgesproken te bezien op welke wijze het vliegtuigonderwijs op toegankelijke, kwalitatief goede en doelmatige wijze aangeboden kan worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucas over de dijkversterking bij Den Oever

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary whether the Den Oever dike reinforcement is being pursued despite a unanimously adopted motion calling for postponement, and how the motion is being implemented. The state secretary answered that the regional water board and municipality postponed the choice of preferred alternative to December 2012 to integrate it with the Masterplan Den Oever and the Afsluitdijk structure vision, while stating the project should not face further delay.
In line with the intent of your motion, more time is being taken to examine the relationship with the Afsluitdijk future structure vision.
In lijn met de strekking van uw motie wordt meer tijd genomen waarin de relatie met de Structuurvisie Toekomst Afsluitdijk wordt onderzocht

Vragen van de leden Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Jasper VanDijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Ondernemende universiteit in zwaar weer» (ingezonden 26 oktober 2

MPs asked the state secretary about a newspaper report on alleged irregular spending, property losses and integrity gaps at TU Delft, and whether the ministry should act on PwC's withheld audit approval in 2007 and 2008. The state secretary said the Inspectorate validated TU Delft's commitments and sent improvement points, and that no sanctions were imposed because non-compliance with European tendering rules carries no state sanction policy.
On the basis of this consultation, the Inspectorate of Education further validated TU Delft's input.
Op basis van dit overleg heeft de Inspectie van het Onderwijs de inbreng van TU Delft nader gevalideerd.
Antwoord vragen Lucas over de langstudeerregeling

An MP asked whether students who enrol in September and deregister before 1 October, while not studying the rest of the year, are wrongly counted as long-term students under the langstudeerregeling. The State Secretary agreed the situation is unfair and committed to an AMvB granting one extra year retroactively, to be claimed on request.
I will arrange for an AMvB to give this category of students entitlement to one extra year of study.
Ik zal regelen dat in een Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur (AMvB) deze categorie studenten aanspraak krijgt op één extra uitloopjaar.

Vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Nieuwenhuizen en Azmani (allen VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over studiefinanciering voor studenten u

MPs asked how many foreign students who also count as migrant workers receive study finance, the EU basis for the rule, other social provisions open to them, how hours worked are checked, and whether the eligibility threshold can be tightened. The state secretary reported a rising share of migrant-worker students among EU students, cited EU law and the Dutch 32-hour monthly norm checked by DUO, and announced raising the norm to 56 hours from next year.
I intend to implement this tightening with effect from next calendar year.
Ik ben voornemens deze aanscherping met ingang van volgend kalenderjaar door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schaart en Lucas over het artikel ‘Slimme dijken op komst’

MPs Schaart and Lucas asked about a newspaper report on 'smart dikes', including whether broadband cable ducts in dikes could be shared with telecom companies at marginal cost and how water boards are encouraged to combine projects. The minister answered that sensor dike technology is still being studied, that a convenant between water boards and cable operators is in preparation, and that she will consider cost-sharing when the moment is right.
A convenant between the Union of Water Boards and the Platform of Network Operators is currently being prepared.
Er wordt op dit moment gewerkt aan een convenant tussen de Unie van Waterschappen en het Platform Netbeheerders
Antwoord vragen Lucas en De Liefde over het gegeven dat NWO en AMOLF een tafel hebben gekocht bij een fundraising-diner van Museum Boerhaave

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary why NWO and AMOLF (FOM) bought a €2,500 table at a fundraising dinner for Museum Boerhaave, given the ministry's policy of more private funding for that museum, and whether these costs were efficient spending. The state secretary acknowledged the purchase (about €2,082.50), agreed it is not efficient use of public money, said NWO will not use its funds for such purposes again, and declined to reclaim the amount given its small size.
I do not regard the expenditure on the fundraising dinner as an efficient use of public funds.
Ik beschouw de uitgaven voor het fundraising-diner niet als doelmatige besteding van overheidsmiddelen.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het voornemen van voortgangstoetsing van drie samenwerkende hogescholen (ingezonden 16 november 201

MPs Jadnanansing and Lucas asked why a joint proposal by three universities of applied sciences to develop progress tests, submitted in September 2010 with a requested subsidy, had no decision for over a year. The State Secretary replied that the process was paused during an Inspectorate study on assessment practice, that €8 million has since been reserved for 2012-2015 to improve assessment, and that the institutions may pursue the plan independently.
Nothing prevents the institution from pursuing the plan independently, as happened in the past with five medical faculties attached to universities.
Er staat de instelling niets in de weg het plan zelfstandig op te pakken zoals dat in het verleden is gebeurd bij vijf medische faculteiten verbonden aan universiteiten.
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over voorlichting omtrent de studie Omgangskunde (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asked whether students of the Omgangskunde teacher training were misled about job prospects, since the subject is barely taught in secondary education and the 2006 teacher qualification law limits teachers to their own subject. The state secretary acknowledged the subject is mainly taught in vocational colleges, that many students are career-changers, and that the four colleges promised clearer information for prospective students, without any sanction.
The colleges promised me on that occasion that they would leave no doubt in their information materials about the qualification the certificate confers.
De hogescholen hebben mij bij die gelegenheid toegezegd in hun voorlichtingsuitingen geen enkele twijfel te laten bestaan over de bevoegdheid die aan het getuigschrift is verbonden
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de verbinding tussen Bergen en Nieuw Bergen (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why only the first layer of flood protection (dike raising) was addressed around Bergen and Aijen, leaving the access road cut off at high water, and asked about cost estimates for a bridge. The secretary answered that prevention is the responsibility of the ministry and water boards, evacuation planning lies with safety regions, the Maaswerken project lowers river levels, a federal bridge is not an option, and a Rijkswaterstaat review found the municipality's bridge design does not meet permit requirements.
Federal financing of a high-water bridge between Bergen and Nieuw Bergen is currently not an option.
Financiering door het rijk van een hoogwaterverbinding (brug) tussen Bergen en Nieuw Bergen is nu geen optie.
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris particuliere studenten zou straffen (ingezonden 29 augustus 2011).

An MP asked whether students who first completed an unfunded private bachelor's degree should pay institutional tuition for a second bachelor's degree, and whether this conflicts with the one-funded-bachelor principle. The State Secretary answered all four questions by referring to the answer given to earlier questions from another MP, without restating the substance here.
See the answer to question 2 from MP Jadnanansing.
Zie het antwoord op vraag 2 van het Kamerlid Jadnanansing.
Vragen lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het project Munnikenland en PKB Ruimte voor de Rivier (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Munnikenland project's nature zoning under the Ruimte voor de Rivier PKB allows agricultural nature management, and whether the Rijk should engage the municipality of Zaltbommel before its July 2011 zoning decision. The state secretary answered that agricultural co-use is possible within the nature designation, that Rijkswaterstaat safeguards flood safety regardless of who manages the land, and that the programme directorate has been in contact with the alderman and project organisation.
Within the nature designation agricultural co-use is possible; a dual designation is not needed for that.
Binnen de bestemming «natuur» is agrarisch medegebruik mogelijk; een dubbelbestemming is daarvoor niet nodig.
Vragen van het lid Lucas aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over prijsafspraken universiteiten (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether price-fixing by universities on tuition for second degrees is objectionable, and whether the government will set criteria for reasonable fees, include tuition in performance agreements, or talk to the VSNU. The secretary replies that each institution sets its own tuition under student council advisory rights, that no price agreement was made, that fee policy will be monitored until 2013, and that he will not intervene while the matter is before the court.
I see no reason at this time to hold a discussion about institutional tuition with the VSNU, since this matter is currently before the court.

Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om een gesprek over het instellingscollegegeld te voeren met de Vereniging van Samenwerkende Universiteiten (VSNU), aangezien deze kwestie op dit moment onder de rechter is.

Vragen van de leden Leegte en Lucas (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Windpark slecht voor stabiliteit dijken»

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether reports that a wind farm endangers the stability of Noordoostpolder dikes are accurate, what measures and costs follow, and how the unrest will be handled. The minister declined substantive comment because the matter is pending before the Raad van State, noting that effects on the dikes were assessed and that no construction or operation will occur before the court rules.

Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de ongewenste prikkel bij onderwijsinstellingen om buitenlandse studenten binnen te halen (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the former border-region policy and recruitment of German-language students create an undesirable incentive for universities to recruit abroad, and whether this lowers per-student funding and quality. The state secretary answered that the border-region policy has ended, that German-language programmes are open to all, that foreign students are welcome for quality reasons, and that he will remind institutions to aim recruitment at quality goals.
I will draw the institutions' attention to that.
Ik zal de instellingen daarop attenderen.
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bijverdiengrens (ingezonden 18 mei 2011).

An MP asked why the student work-income limit is calculated per calendar year, why DUO's website gave little information on counting months without student finance, and why students who pause finance mid-year face repayment while those who stop near year-end do not. The state secretary answered that the calendar-year system is legally required and tied to tax data, that information was improved, and that the system prevents gaming by pausing finance.
In response to your question, DUO has since further improved the information provision by also placing the relevant texts directly on the webpages.
Naar aanleiding van uw vraag heeft DUO de informatievoorziening inmiddels verder verbeterd door de desbetreffende teksten ook rechtstreeks op de webpagina's te zetten.
Vragen van de leden Huizing en Lucas (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de drempel in vaargeul De Boontjes (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the threshold in the De Boontjes shipping channel will be removed in 2011 as agreed, and why a new study might delay it. The minister answered that the Rijk committed 5 million euro, that the province handles the planning study and permits, that no new study is taking place, and that Rijkswaterstaat is preparing execution in parallel.
No new study is taking place.
Er vindt geen nieuw onderzoek plaats.
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de selectieve master notarieel recht te Utrecht (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a proposed selective two-year public-private master in notarial law at Utrecht, and whether competitors' objections to the macro-efficiency test are genuine or self-interested. The secretary answered that no decision has been taken, explained the criteria for macro-efficiency and accreditation, and committed to informing parliament only once a formal application exists.
There has, however, not yet been a macro-efficiency application received on which I must decide.
Er is thans echter nog geen macrodoelmatigheidsaanvraag ontvangen waarop ik moet beslissen.
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over een defecte OV-studentenchipkaart (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about students having to pre-pay travel costs when their OV student chip card is defective and about a proposed temporary letter granting free travel. The secretary said reimbursement arrangements with transport operators shorten the pre-payment period to at most three weeks, but rejected a DUO letter as impractical and open to misuse.
I do not consider it desirable to depart from the current regime regarding the production of replacement cards.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk af te wijken van het huidige regime waar het gaat om de productie van vervangende kaarten.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Interior Ministry about poor compliance with the European Accessibility Act, citing NOS reporting that most Dutch websites fail accessibility criteria, and asked about enforcement, ministry coordination, and complaint channels. The government answered that the directive only binds private firms, that supervisors have adequate powers and mandate, that it is too early to judge effects so an implementation review is planned, and that complaint reporting channels exist though no figures are yet available.
I will therefore first await practical experience and intend, together with the other relevant ministries, to have an implementation review of the European Accessibility Directive carried out.
