The government does not interfere in how care providers deliver care, insofar as it concerns medical-substantive considerations.
De overheid bemoeit zich niet met de manier waarop zorgverleners zorg verlenen, voor zover het medisch-inhoudelijke overwegingen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het artikel 'Faillissementsgolf mkb door corona schulden, Nederland wereldwijd koploper'

Two MPs from JA21 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the rise in bankruptcies among SMEs is caused by unpaid tax and corona debts, and about support, repayment options and tax measures. The minister answered that bankruptcies are currently below pre-pandemic levels and rising towards them, that repayment arrangements (NOW, tax deferral) are available, and that the government will report on debt solutions after the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over Bevindingen onderzoek DUO naar fraude met studiefinanciering

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked whether DUO's student-finance fraud findings, which reportedly fall disproportionately on students with a migration background, reflect indirect discrimination and whether the risk-indicator algorithm will be adjusted. The Minister says most DUO decisions survive appeal, will await an external independent investigation of DUO's working method before drawing conclusions, and will not set aside striking outcome patterns in advance.
I am having DUO's working method investigated externally and independently.
Ik laat de werkwijze van DUO extern en onafhankelijk onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het wegnemen van obstakels om recreatiewoningen te bestemmen voor permanente bewoning

An MP asked the minister whether recreational homes converted to permanent dwellings count as new housing under the Schiphol airport zoning decree (LIB), and whether obstacles to such conversion would be removed. The minister answered that conversions of existing recreational homes are not new housing locations under the LIB, that obstacles are being discussed with provinces and gemeenten, and that he will talk with Nieuwkoop and Zuid-Holland.

In view of this, existing recreational homes that are converted into dwellings do not fall under the concept of a new housing location and therefore not under the prohibition in article 2.2.1d, first paragraph, of the LIB.

Gelet hierop vallen bestaande recreatiewoningen die worden getransformeerd naar woningen niet onder het begrip nieuwe woningbouwlocatie en dus evenmin onder het verbod van artikel 2.2.1d, eerste lid, van het LIB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over de A-status van COVID-19

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked why the minister opposes their amendment moving COVID-19 from list A to B2 of the Public Health Act, when a separate bill to drop A-status is planned. The minister answers that the amendment is opposed because RIVM advice shows no epidemiological need for listing, that the bill will go to parliament before summer recess, and that the reporting duty will be relaxed by ministerial regulation from 1 July.
I hope to submit the bill to your House before the summer recess.
Ik hoop het wetsvoorstel voor het zomerreces in te dienen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verwenij en Omtzigt over de bestrijding van desinformatie door de denktank Desinformatie

MPs Pouw-Verwenij and Omtzigt asked the health and interior ministers about the government's role in countering vaccine disinformation through the Denktank Desinformatie, including access to platform reporting portals, membership, mandate, definitions, interventions and legal basis. The state secretary answered that the think tank had no special platform status or decision-making power, that no complete overview of government contacts with platforms exists, and that participants acted on personal title, while documents were attached.
There is no overview of the deployment of the Ministry of VWS and the bodies falling under it in the area of disinformation.
Er is geen overzicht van de inzet van het Ministerie van VWS en de daaronder vallende gremia op het gebied van desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over de A-status van corona en het RIVM-advies over een mogelijke wijziging van die status

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked the health minister when RIVM was asked to advise on the A-status of COVID-19, for the advice, the handling perspective, possible changes to the status, and a faster advice timeline. The minister answered that RIVM was asked on 31 May, the advice was shared with parliament on 12 June, and the minister decided to follow it so COVID-19 no longer carries the A-status or any other listed group status.
I received the advice from RIVM on 12 June and shared it with your House the same day.
Ik heb het advies van het RIVM op 12 juni jl. ontvangen en diezelfde dag met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over het aanpassen van boeken

JA21 MPs Eerdmans and Pouw-Verweij asked whether the government objects to publishers altering classic books such as those by Roald Dahl, Agatha Christie and Ian Fleming after sensitivity readers flagged wording, and about copyright protections for deceased authors. The government replied that word changes are a matter for publishers, writers and translators, that copyright and moral rights (including the author's right to object to harmful changes) are explained, and that designating national heritage is not a government task.
I do not see it as a government task to prescribe which books belong to our national heritage.
Ik zie het niet als een taak van de overheid voor te schrijven welke boeken tot ons nationale erfgoed behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over de toenemende kritiek op de Dutch Approach in de transgenderzorg voor minderjarigen

Two MPs asked the health minister about growing criticism of the Dutch Approach to gender care for minors, citing Swedish and English reviews, and asked for an independent systematic review, a revision of the quality standard, and information on detransition and causes of rising demand. The minister replied that the standard is being evaluated by the medical specialists' knowledge institute, that the Zorginstituut is not the body to conduct an independent review, that the IGJ has no signals of unsafe care, and that two studies (SiRM and Radboud UMC) will be sent to the House shortly.
It is up to professional parties to jointly give content, through professional standards and guidelines, to the question of what good care is
Het is aan veldpartijen om gezamenlijk, middels professionele standaarden en richtlijnen, invulling te geven aan de vraag wat goede zorg is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het artikel 'Brancheorganisatie BMK wil prijsplafond voor kinderopvang in 2025'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a proposed price cap on childcare, the risk that prices rise above the reimbursed amount, costs, and alternatives to keep childcare affordable. The minister acknowledges risks to accessibility and market concentration, says tariff regulation will be explored and its costs and variants examined, and mentions a price monitor as an interim step.
That is why I announced in the progress report on the childcare financing reform that I will further explore tariff regulation.
Daarom heb ik in de Voortgangsrapportage herziening financieringsstelsel kinderopvang aangekondigd tariefregulering verder te gaan verkennen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Drost, Bisschop, Pouw-Verweij, Beertema en Van der Plas over de antwoorden op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog al

Five MPs asked the minister about a school identity statement that was misquoted in earlier answers as rejecting homosexuality. The minister confirmed the statement does not address sexual orientation, apologised, rectified the record, and said a broader review of the motions on identity statements will be reported to parliament later this year.

In the wording of the parliamentary questions and in the answers to them, a link was unintentionally made between a passage from the Gomarus College identity document and views on marriage and sexual orientation.

In de vraagstelling van de Kamervragen en de beantwoording van de Kamervragen is onbedoeld de link gelegd tussen een passage uit het identiteitsdocument van het Gomarus College en opvattingen over het huwelijk en seksuele oriëntatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Drost, Stoffer, Pouw-Verweij en Palland over de beeldvorming van leven met downsyndroom

MPs from five parties asked the government about a biology textbook passage on Down syndrome, its implications for inclusion, prenatal counselling and support for people with disabilities. The minister said the publisher withdrew the passage, that schools must promote democratic basic values, and described existing policy on inclusion, counselling and support, but declined to evaluate the effects of the prenatal screening funding change.
I am always open to societal signals following funding changes, but an investigation is not appropriate.
Ik sta altijd open voor maatschappelijke signalen naar aanleiding van bekostigingswijzigingen, maar een onderzoek ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de genderkliniek die homoseksualiteit probeert te genezen

An MP asked the Minister about reports from the UK Tavistock gender clinic, including claims that gender treatment may function as conversion of homosexuality, and whether Dutch gender care faces similar risks. The Minister said the UK situation cannot be compared, the Inspectorate received few signals and none about disguised conversion, and the quality standard for transgender care is under evaluation with results expected end 2023.
Responsibility for the quality of care lies with field parties (care providers, patient associations, etc.).
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van zorg ligt bij veldpartijen (zorgverleners, patiëntenverenigingen etc.).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij en Bikker over het bericht dat het gebruik van zelfdodingspoeder Middel X flink steeg nadat Coöperatie Laatste Wil bekend maakte welke stof het bevat

MPs from SGP, JA21 and ChristenUnie asked whether the rise in use of suicide powder Middel X after the Coöperatie Laatste Wil disclosed its substance was causal, whether reporting duties for doctors or a ban on the cooperative were warranted, and about the status of investigations. The minister answered that a causal link cannot be established from NVIC data, that a reporting duty would conflict with medical confidentiality and is not currently appropriate, that prosecution of ten people is being prepared with the investigating judge, and that a dissolution request is for the Public Prosecution Service to judge.
The Public Prosecution Service has previously publicly announced that it intends to prosecute ten persons involved or formerly involved with the Coöperatie Laatste Wil.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft eerder publiekelijk kenbaar gemaakt dat het voornemens is om tien personen te vervolgen die betrokken zijn of waren bij de Coöperatie Laatste Wil.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over vervanging geluidsschermen A10 Noord bij Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the delayed replacement of noise barriers along the A10 North in Amsterdam, which left thousands of residents with more traffic noise and asked for faster replacement and a temporary fix. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat will lay quieter asphalt before summer 2023, aims to bring the barrier replacement forward from 2025 to 2024, and will reduce speed to 80 km/h only as a less effective option.
The quieter asphalt is expected to be laid in the North region before the summer holidays of 2023.
Naar verwachting wordt het stillere asfalt voor de zomervakantie regio Noord 2023 aangebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Pouw-Verweij, Ceder en Van der Staaij over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2023

MPs from CDA, JA21, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the foreign minister about Open Doors' 2023 persecution-of-Christians ranking, Dutch initiatives on violence and impunity, Nigeria, Sahel mercenaries, China, North Korea and dual-use exports. The minister largely acknowledged the concerns, described existing programmes and dialogues, and said that prospects for change in North Korea are small and that dual-use risks are handled by export control and corporate due diligence.
I receive the same signals from the embassies that concern me.
Ik krijg vanuit de ambassades dezelfde signalen die mij zorgen baren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over zwaargewonden die niet naar een traumacentrum worden gebracht

An MP asked the Minister of Health how many seriously injured patients end up outside the eleven trauma centres, why the 90% norm is not met, and what sanctions will apply. The minister said about 30% are treated outside trauma centres on average, committed to agreements under the Integral Care Agreement and IGJ supervision, and listed improvement measures without introducing sanctions.
I will periodically put the progress on these agreements on the agenda in the consultation held within the IZA framework on acute care.
Ik zal de voortgang op deze afspraken periodiek agenderen in het overleg dat in het kader van het IZA over de acute zorg wordt gevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij  over het artikel 'Lelylijn-discussie trekt zich na Europese erkenning vacuüm, bevindt zich in een stukje niemandsland tussen voorvechters en tegenstanders - zonder te weten wa

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure about the Lelylijn rail project's inclusion in the EU TEN-T network, its financing, German coordination, the 160 km/h speed issue and planning steps. The State Secretary answered that the line was added to the extended TEN-T network, that financial consequences are not yet clear pending the MIRT study, and that regional co-financing and contacts with Germany will follow.
I am pleased that in the agreement of the Transport Council of 5 December the Lelylijn is now included in the extended network of the trans-European transport network (TEN-T).
Ik ben blij dat in het akkoord van de Transportraad van 5 december jl. de Lelylijn nu is opgenomen in het uitgebreide netwerk van het trans-Europees vervoersnetwerk (TEN-T).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij, Den Haan, Van Kent, Léon de Jong en Ephraim over onbegrijpelijke en op het eerste oog onjuiste scenario’s die DNB gemaakt heeft op basis van de adviezen van de commi

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Pensions why the 2022 Parameter Committee lowered the expected stock return while DNB's scenario charts appeared to show higher returns, and about standard deviation, validation and the release of draft DNB calculations. The minister answered that the scenarios follow the committee's advice, that the charts are consistent with it, and declined to share draft DNB reports, citing the value of confidential expert exchange, while committing to answer by a set date.
I do not consider it appropriate to share draft reports with your House.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om conceptrapportages met uw Kamer te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened. The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over fysiotherapeutische zorg die medisch noodzakelijk is, maar die niet in het basispakket zit

An MP asked whether physiotherapy needed for older people with basic insurance could be covered earlier, through a German-style treatment plan set by doctors, and whether a pilot could be run under the Integrated Care Agreement. The minister agreed that timely physiotherapy can save costs, but rejected giving doctors a role in setting physiotherapy plans and pointed to a Zorginstituut advice process aiming for a proper benefit by 2025.
I am therefore not in favour of a system comparable to Germany's, in which we give doctors a role again in determining the physiotherapy treatment plan.
Ik ben daarom geen voorstander van een vergelijkbaar systeem als in Duitsland, waarbij we artsen weer een rol geven in het bepalen van het fysiotherapeutische behandelplan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Pouw-Verweij over het bericht dat de National Health Service een fundamentele koerswijziging doorvoert in de behandeling van genderdysforie bij minderjarigen

MPs Van der Staaij and Pouw-Verweij asked the Minister of Health whether the government would respond to the UK NHS's stricter approach to puberty blockers and early social transition for minors with gender dysphoria, and whether it would contact UK, Finnish and Swedish authorities and evaluate Dutch transgender care standards. Minister Kuipers answered that the government does not interfere with medical-substantive decisions of care providers, declined to contact foreign authorities, and said the Dutch somatic standard is under evaluation with results expected around summer 2023.

As I answered in previous parliamentary questions on this subject, the government does not interfere with the way care providers deliver care insofar as medical-substantive considerations are concerned.

Antwoord 2 Zoals ik in eerdere Kamervragen 3 over dit onderwerp heb geantwoord, bemoeit de overheid zich niet met de manier waarop zorgverleners zorg verlenen voor zover het medisch-inhoudelijke overwegingen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht dat bedrijven de door de mbo-school aangedragen stagiair moeten accepteren

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Education whether the plan to require companies to accept a school-nominated intern undermines their freedom to choose, and what risks and alternatives exist. The minister defended stagematching for first-year students as a way to combat stage discrimination, argued companies bear shared responsibility, and said the stagepact would set out a broader package of measures.
I am working to improve internship supervision and to strengthen contact between the training company and the school for all internships.
Ik zet mij in om de stagebegeleiding te verbeteren en ook het contact tussen leerbedrijf en de school te versterken voor alle stages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over de bedreiging van het wokisme

JA21 MPs asked the education minister whether alarming signs of woke-culture intimidation at universities, such as students at Erasmus University fearing backlash, were being downplayed, and whether the minister would act on academic freedom. The minister found no threat to academic freedom in the cited cases, said debate should be respectful, and promised to report on talks with universities on self-censorship by year end.
I will inform your House of the outcomes before the end of this calendar year.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het einde van dit kalenderjaar op de hoogte stellen van de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het bericht dat honderden verdwijnstudenten uit het buitenland misbruik maken van studentenvisa

Opposition MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked whether international students using study visas who then disappear from view, and whether a quota and higher fees would help. The minister answered that such misuse is undesirable, that the IND is investigating Bangladeshi student cases, that a quota has no legal basis, and that more monitoring and sector measures will follow.
This gave the IND cause to examine this further.
Dit was voor de IND aanleiding om dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het lamleggen van de woningbouw

JA21 MP Pouw-Verweij asked Minister De Jonge whether excessive regulation is stalling large housing projects, what he did after developers warned that his housing targets were unrealistic, and how he will restore investor confidence. The minister denied that projects are stalled by too many rules, pointed to market and capacity problems, promised provincial housing agreements in October, and said he would present rent-regulation contours in the autumn after talks with market parties.
This sometimes requires adjusting plans, but there is by no means any question of large housing projects being nearly brought to a standstill by too many rules.
Dit vraagt soms om aanpassing van plannen maar van het nagenoeg stil komen te liggen van grote woningbouwprojecten door teveel regels is geenszins sprake.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het nieuws dat de National Health Service (NHS) Tavistock kliniek, de enige genderidentiteitskliniek voor kinderen en jongeren in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, heef

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked the government about the closure of the Tavistock gender identity clinic in the UK, how Dutch gender care for minors compares, whether rising referrals occur in the Netherlands, and whether the planned legal change to the gender entry in birth records (Transgenderwet) should be paused. The Minister answered that the Dutch approach is multidisciplinary and not affirmative in the Cass-review sense, that referral numbers rose 183% since 2018 with causes still under study, and that he sees no reason to pause the bill, since a judicial review protects children under sixteen.
I see no reason to pause the handling of bill 35 825.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel 35 825 aan te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eppink over het verdwijnen van huisartsen in de regio

JA21 MPs asked the health minister about shortages of GPs in regions, whether insurers' claims of force majeure stop complaints, commercial GP chains and foreign operators, and whether small-town GP posts are essential. The minister replied that regional labour-market plans, a 2022 labour-market approach with nine regions, and a planned strengthening of basic care organisation are underway, while noting that the questions were not all answered within three weeks.
Your House will be informed before summer 2022 about the outcomes of this process.
Uw Kamer wordt voor de zomer van 2022 geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van dit traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het WHO-verdrag voor pandemische preventie

Two MPs asked the Health Minister and the Prime Minister about preparations for a WHO pandemic prevention treaty, including draft texts, negotiation mandate, timeline, EU competence, the 2021 op-ed signed by Rutte, and whether the structural 300 million euro pandemic preparedness budget relates to the treaty. The minister described the INB process, said drafts will be shared when available and parliament informed before the second INB session, and denied a link between the budget and the treaty.
Once the contours of the pandemic treaty are clearer, parliament will be informed.
Zodra de contouren van het pandemieverdrag duidelijker zijn, zal het parlement worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het beëindigen van de Begeleidingscommissie Digitale Ondersteuning Bestrijding COVID-19

MPs Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked why the minister is ending the advisory Begeleidingscommissie DOBC for COVID-19 digital tools while requesting nearly 30 million euro for their further development, and whether the advisory body opposed the decision. The minister defends the termination, says other advisory bodies remain available, and agrees to share correspondence with the commission while refusing to reverse the decision.
In this phase I no longer consider the Begeleidingscommissie DOBC necessary for combating COVID-19.
In deze fase acht ik de Begeleidingscommissie DOBC niet meer noodzakelijk voor de bestrijding van COVID-19.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Hijink, Omtzigt, Van der Plas en Pouw-Verweij over de positie van zorgverleners die als gevolg van long covid lange tijd thuis zitten

Four MPs asked the health minister about healthcare workers off work for long periods with long COVID, including compensation, income loss and whether those costs are covered. The minister replied that no special social security regime exists for long COVID, that a temporary subsidy for employers retaining such workers was introduced, and that causation from workplace infection cannot be established in many cases.
No registration is kept of the number of healthcare workers who are partly or fully off work after a coronavirus infection.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van het aantal zorgverleners dat na een coronabesmetting deels of volledig thuiszit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Verhuren koophuis frustreert starters'

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Eerdmans asked about the rise of keep-to-let and buy-to-let housing, its effects on starters, and whether mortgage conditions are being breached. The minister said keep-to-let is stable at about 4% of transactions, outlined measures such as the transfer tax differentiation and a box 3 reform, and declined further research on unreported rental, citing lender estimates below 10%.
I therefore see no reason to commission additional research.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor het laten uitvoeren van aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de snelheidsbegrenzer in nieuwe auto’s

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the mandatory intelligent speed assistance (ISA) in new cars: its privacy safeguards, sign-recognition error margins, possible tax use of data, and whether it could later become compulsory for existing cars. The minister answered that ISA only warns the driver, stores no data on trips or drivers, is not planned to become mandatory retroactively, and cannot be used for taxation.
ISA does not record any data about the trip or about the driver.
ISA legt geen gegevens vast over de rit danwel over de bestuurder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pouw-Verweij over de Kamerbrief van 20 december 2021 ‘Toekomstige organisatie van zorg voor patiënten met aangeboren hartafwijkingen’

MPs Van der Plas and Pouw-Verweij asked whether concentrating high-complexity congenital heart surgery in two centres accounts for the projected doubling of adult patients, the vulnerability of a two-centre network, the lack of geographic spread and patient travel burden, knock-on effects on other paediatric care, why the DC3 plan was rejected, and the rationale for limiting concentration to complex adult procedures. The minister defends the two-centre model as needed for quality and continuity, notes that outpatient care stays regional, and commits to asking the NZa for an impact analysis before the summer recess.
I will also ask the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) to carry out an impact analysis and map the consequences of choosing these two locations before the summer recess.
Ik zal ook de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) vragen een impactanalyse uit te voeren en nog voor het zomerreces de gevolgen van de keuze voor deze twee locaties in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Gündoğan, Simons en Omtzigt over het behoud van personeel bij de GGD’en

MPs asked the health minister about GGD staffing shortages, the medium-term outlook for testing and contact tracing, and whether temporary staff can be retained given rising demand. The minister replied that GGDs are responsible for their own personnel policy, that enough staff exist for the booster campaign, and that cost compensation and permanent contracts for essential staff provide assurance, though long-term plans are still under review.
Each GGD is responsible for its own personnel policy, and the way its staff is organised can vary considerably.
Elke GGD is verantwoordelijk voor zijn eigen personeelsbeleid, waarbij de manier waarop het personeelsbestand is vormgegeven sterk kan variëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Bikker, Ceder en Pouw-Verweij over het bericht 'Nederland grote abortussponsor'

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and JA21 asked whether the Netherlands funds over 250,000 abortion services per year in poorer countries, how many were actual abortions, and how oversight, reporting and SRGR budgets are handled. The minister says abortion services are not consistently defined or counted, so the figures cannot be verified, and that partners report under general indicators without a separate abortion-service requirement, though audits, evaluations and monitoring apply.
For these methodological reasons, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs decided to stop adding up and tracking the numbers of abortion services from 2017 onward.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft er om deze methodologische redenen voor gekozen om vanaf 2017 de aantallen abortusdiensten niet langer bij elkaar op te tellen en bij te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de eis van goedkeuring door een andere rijschool voordat een kandidaat mag afrijden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the CBR plans to require a second driving school's approval before a candidate may take the practical driving test, and related questions on fraud and cost impacts. The minister denied that such a requirement is under consideration, explained that a pilot on collegial assessment is being prepared, and said a full response to the Roemer advice will follow.
No, the CBR is currently not considering asking driving schools to have the approval of another driving school before a candidate can take the practical exam.
Nee, het CBR overweegt momenteel niet om aan rijscholen te verzoeken om een goedkeuring van een andere rijschool te hebben alvorens een kandidaat praktijkexamen kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Eppink over het bericht van 1 december 2021 in het NRC dat ‘bij defensie duizenden boosterprikkers klaarstaan’

Two JA21 MPs asked the health minister, on behalf of defence, about reports that thousands of military staff were available to administer COVID booster shots, and about the pace of the booster campaign. The minister answered that the campaign had been accelerated, that 2,000 military personnel were made available for support tasks, and that the GGD and GP involvement was being arranged, but largely restated the campaign's objectives and did not give a full account of why the military capacity was not used sooner.
Unfortunately, that was not possible due to pressure of work.
Dat is helaas door drukte niet gelukt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over de mogelijke uitbreiding van het coronatoegangsbewijs (ctb), dat als bijlage was verstopt in een reactie van 21 december 2021 van de minister op de motie-Den H

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked why the government did not send the critical advice of the Begeleidingscommissie on expanding the corona access pass (ctb) to Parliament before deliberating on the related bills, and why it was attached as an annex to another letter. The minister answers that the advice concerns technical app matters outside the bills' scope, that it was addressed in the reply to the Den Haan motion, and that he sees no consequences, while largely restating existing policy.

It is not obvious that the Begeleidingscommissie should advise on the bills, because both the expansion of the ctb and the introduction of 2G are policy choices outside the scope of the commission's mandate.

Het ligt niet voor de hand dat de Begeleidingscommissie adviseert over de genoemde wetsvoorstellen, omdat zowel de uitbreiding van het ctb, alsook de invoering van 2G, beleidskeuzes zijn die buiten de reikwijdte van de opdracht van de Begeleidingscommissie liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht ‘Uitspraak in supermarktoorlog Didam bedreigt Nederlandse woningbouw’

An MP asked the minister whether the Hoge Raad's Didam ruling, requiring equal opportunity when municipalities sell land, threatens housing construction and causes delay and damage claims. The minister answered that the ruling may complicate municipal land sales but does not affect privately owned land, that delays are possible where selection processes do not comply, and that the government will publish guidance and support municipalities.
I have therefore published a first factsheet with questions and answers on the website www.woningmarktbeleid.nl following this ruling.
Ik heb daarom op de website www.woningmarktbeleid.nl een eerste factsheet 3 geplaats met Vraag en Antwoord naar aanleiding van dit arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het artikel 'Regering en OMT onderbouwen QR-code met onbetrouwbare modellen'

An MP asks the Minister of Health about press reports that the government and OMT based the COVID vaccination-pass (CTB) on weak models, and whether the CTB and its extension to 2G and wider use are scientifically validated. The Minister rejects the claim that the models are unreliable, says the CTB is supported by several models and field research, and promises further TU Delft research before the bills are debated.
I aim to share that research with your House in January 2022, before the bills on the wider use of the corona access certificate and 2G are debated.
Ik streef ernaar dat onderzoek op januari 2022 met uw Kamer te delen, voor de behandeling van de wetsvoorstellen over de bredere inzet van het coronatoegangsbewijs en 2G.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij en Gündugan over opschalingsplannen voor de IC en de tekorten aan Coronamedicijnen, terwijl een week geleden gemeld werd dat er een voorraad van drie maanden was

MPs Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij and Gündugan asked the health minister about ICU expansion plans (LNAZ, the 350-bed figure, outsourcing and concentration of ICU care) and about shortages of COVID medicines despite a reported three-month stockpile. The minister answered by describing the timing of the LNAZ reports, the scenarios in the Aanpak Najaar, the Corona Crisis Voorraad composition, and declined to answer question 9 about splitting the answers for the supplementary budgets.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over het vernietigende advies van de Raad voor de rechtspraak over de wetsvoorstellen 2G en 3G op de werkvloer, dat vlak voor kerst, met vijf weken vertraging, aan

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked why the Council for the Judiciary's critical advice on the 2G/3G workplace bills was sent to parliament late, why its criticisms (necessity, proportionality, dismissal risk, privacy) were not summarised in the explanatory memorandum, and why ministers may not have seen it. The minister answers that the advice was omitted by error and sent later, that the bills were substantially amended in response, and that the government considered the advice fully.
The advice was mistakenly not sent to the House of Representatives together with the other advice issued on the two bills.
Het advies is abusievelijk niet tezamen met de andere over de twee genoemde wetsvoorstellen uitgebrachte adviezen naar de Tweede Kamer gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de aankoop van 11,6 miljoen mondkapjes bij DSM als compensatie voor het niet afgeven van een garantie aan DSM

An MP asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers why 11.6 million FFP2 masks were ordered from the DSM-VDL joint venture without competitive tendering, and whether this was justified by urgency, given large existing stocks and a withdrawn DSM guarantee. The government answered that urgency from expected demand justified direct award, denied that a commercial disagreement was the reason, declined to disclose the price as commercially confidential, and said there is currently no formal state involvement in domestic mask production.
A price was paid to Dutch PPE Solutions that was market-conform at the time. The amount is commercially confidential information.
Er is een prijs betaald aan Dutch PPE Solutions die destijds marktconform was. De hoogte daarvan is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de geldigheidsduur van een vaccinatiecertificaat voor reizen

An MP from JA21 asks the Health Minister why the Netherlands supports a nine-month validity for EU travel vaccination certificates instead of twelve months, and why it moved in Brussels before negotiations began. The minister answers that nine months (six-month booster interval plus three months for implementation) is well-founded and supports EU coordination, while stating that serology is not yet ready as a basis for recovery certificates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over "Verplichte ideologische indoctrinatie aan de Radboud Universiteit"

An MP asked the education minister whether universities may tailor teaching to ideological views, whether to engage the Radboud University on compulsory sustainability content and a sustainability certificate, and whether activist-style assignments blur science. The minister answered that quality of programmes is for the institution and the NVAO accreditation panels, declined to intervene, and called the sustainability plans not alarming while stressing academic freedom.
The institution is responsible for content and quality. Assessment of the content and quality of a programme lies with the NVAO.
De instelling is verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud en kwaliteit. De beoordeling van de inhoud en kwaliteit van een opleiding ligt bij de NVAO
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Bikker, Kuzu, Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over eiwit-vaccins

MPs asked the health minister about people who want a protein-based COVID-19 vaccine, the cancellation or reduction of Sanofi and Novavax orders, and vaccine efficacy data. The minister said the government has no data on the size of this group, chose Novavax over Sanofi and bought fewer Novavax doses because mRNA vaccines were already sufficient, and gave efficacy figures while noting approval and procurement decisions rest with EMA and the Gezondheidsraad.
I therefore see no need to investigate this in further detail, but will ask the RIVM to keep paying attention to this in its monitoring.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om dit in verder detail uit te zoeken, maar zal het RIVM vragen ook hier in de monitoring aandacht voor te blijven houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het varend ontgassen op het Markermeer en de randmeren van Flevoland

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the legality of venting gas from ships on the Markermeer and Flevoland lakes, the ILT map that appears to allow it, and the division of responsibilities with the province. The minister replied that the provincial bans do not apply on national waters, that the Dutch ban awaits ratification of the Scheepsafvalstoffenverdrag, and that a taskforce and ambassadorial efforts are pushing for faster ratification.
Unfortunately, the Netherlands cannot bring the ban into force on its own.
Helaas kan Nederland het verbod niet eigenstandig in werking laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij , Omtzigt, Den Haan, Gündoğan, Hijink en Westerveld over het tijdspad van boostervaccinaties

MPs asked the Dutch health minister why the Netherlands had not yet started voluntary COVID-19 booster vaccinations for over-65s and care residents, citing declining vaccine effectiveness, rollouts in Denmark, Sweden and the UK, and vaccine stock. The minister answered that vaccine effectiveness remained high, that the Health Council had advised boosters for the oldest groups and institutional residents, that a start date of 19 November was set, and that preparation (staffing, invitations, GGD capacity) required time.
From 19 November, booster vaccination will start.
Met ingang van 19 november start het vaccineren met de booster.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het journalistieke televisieprogramma Propaganda over de besluitvorming rond ‘Dansen voor Janssen’

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked the Health Minister about the decision-making behind the 'Dansen met Janssen' campaign after a TV programme alleged misleading information and a changed advice on the Janssen vaccine for young people. The minister answered that the age limit was not changed, that the Health Council advice was followed, and that the information given was objective, while rejecting claims of misleading communication.
I have not provided misleading information.
Ik heb geen misleidende informatie verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het onderzoek naar en het verdere verloop van de gang van zaken rond de zogenoemde mondkapjesdeals van Sywert van Lienden

An MP asked sixteen questions about the delayed independent investigation into the face-mask purchases involving Sywert van Lienden, including why data collection is slow, the role of the ministry in the RGA order, and when the reports and documents will be published. The State Secretary answered that results are expected by year-end at the earliest, attributed delays to data complexity and privacy rules, and deflected several questions to ongoing procedures or the investigators.

Should the results of the first part of the investigation, concerning the agreement with Hulptroepen Alliantie (HA) / Relief Goods Alliance B.V. (RGA), not be final by the first quarter of 2022, I will at the latest in that quarter share the status at that time.

Mochten de resultaten van het eerste deel van het onderzoek – de overeenkomst met Hulptroepen Alliantie (HA) / Relief Goods Alliance B.V. (RGA) nog niet in het eerste kwartaal van 2022 definitief zijn dan deel ik uiterlijk in dat kwartaal de stand van zaken van dat moment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de schending van grondrechten door vaccinatiedwang door bedrijven

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether Leaseplan's vaccination pressure on employees, which lacks a clear legal basis, violates fundamental rights, and whether the government will act and inform parliament. The minister replied that there is no vaccination obligation in the Netherlands, that compliance with rights depends on the situation and would be decided by courts, pointed to earlier letters and website guidance, and did not comment on Leaseplan specifically.

In case of disagreement, the judge will rule on whether the infringement is provided for by law, whether the employer pursued a legitimate aim, and whether the measures taken were justified, proportionate and subsidiary.

In geval van onenigheid zal de rechter uitspraak doen of de inbreuk bij wet is voorzien, of de werkgever een legitiem doel nastreefde en of de door de werkgever getroffen maatregelen het te bereiken doel rechtvaardigden en proportioneel en subsidiair waren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het aanvullend onderzoek door Deloitte Forensic & Dispute Services B.V (Deloitte) naar de inkoop van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen voor de zorg (PBM)

An MP asked the government to release the full Deloitte assignment for the investigation into PPE procurement for healthcare, to explain delays, and to commit to a thorough probe of procurement irregularities. The Staatssecretaris provided the assignment confirmation as an annex, withheld the underlying service agreement as commercially confidential, gave a partial answer on the scope and delays, and pointed to a meldpunt and to the landsadvocaat's advice.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het verloop rond het ontslag van oud-staatssecretaris Mona Keijzer en de afwezigheid van kabinetsleden bij de hoofdelijk stemming over de invoering van de QR-toegangspas

An MP asked several ministers how they were informed of and consented to the dismissal of State Secretary Mona Keijzer, whether the cabinet's rules of procedure were followed, and why a minister was absent from a vote on the QR access pass. The government answered that the dismissal was materially in line with cabinet procedure via consultation with the vice-prime ministers, and that the ministers' disagreements were part of normal cabinet deliberation.
This materially guarantees that the decision was taken in accordance with the sense of the Council of Ministers and does justice to its rules of procedure.
Hiermee is materieel gewaarborgd dat het besluit is genomen in overeenstemming met het gevoelen van de ministerraad en recht gedaan aan het reglement van orde van de ministerraad.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht dat een kapotte koelkast vol Janssenvaccins in Nieuwegein tot het besluit leidde om jongeren ermee in te enten en ze zo een vrijbrief te geven om te gaan stapp

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Health whether a broken fridge with Janssen vaccines in Nieuwegein, rather than an advisory decision, led to vaccinating young people and whether this misled them. The minister denied any link, stating the choice line was based on Health Council advice, the Nieuwegein incident was separate and approved by RIVM, and the factors were not the cause of rising infections.
The RIVM gave the green light to use these vaccines to prevent them having to be thrown away.
Het RIVM gaf groen licht deze vaccins in te zetten om te voorkomen dat ze weggegooid moesten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Van der Staaij over de verkoop van zelfmoordpoeder

Two MPs asked the health and justice ministers why suicide powder sold on Marktplaats and by a Eindhoven seller was not restricted despite deaths, and whether the ban or criminal law should be tightened. The minister answered that the industry code is being reviewed, that new legislation would be counterproductive and disproportionate, that the criminal penalty for assisting suicide is justified, and declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation into the Coöperatie Laatste Wil network.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, we cannot make any statements about this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kunnen wij hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over het vertrek van Minister van Nieuwenhuizen van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

Two MPs asked the PM whether former Minister Van Nieuwenhuizen's move to lobby for the energy industry association created a conflict of interest with her infrastructure portfolio, and whether a cooling-off period for ministers should be introduced. The government answered that a minister may choose post-ministerial work within legal limits, that a recusal arrangement was agreed, that a binding cooling-off period would conflict with the constitutional right to free choice of work, and that the question of statutory rules is still under deliberation.
Within legal limits, it is up to a minister themselves to decide which positions they take on after serving as minister.
Het is, binnen wettelijke kaders, aan een Minister zelf om te bepalen welke functies hij of zij vervult na het vervullen van het ministersambt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over valse toegangsbewijzen met de app CoronaCheck

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether a data breach at test provider Testcoronanu, which let people obtain fake CoronaCheck access certificates, was serious and whether such leaks could be ruled out. The minister acknowledged a serious security flaw, said access for that provider was cut and no other leaks were found, and committed to a further investigation and tighter accession conditions if warranted.
The Ministry of Health is starting a further investigation into the accuracy of the evidence documents submitted by Testcoronanu BV.
Het Ministerie van VWS start een nader onderzoek naar de juistheid van de aangeleverde bewijsstukken door Testcoronanu BV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het reorganisatieplan lerarenopleidingen

The MP Pouw-Verweij (JA21) asks Minister Van Engelshoven whether the Bestuursakkoord on flexibilising teacher training is justified, and questions its links to PISA and McKinsey findings, the generalist-versus-expert debate, teacher shortages, and the Dijsselbloem commission's conclusions. The minister responds that the accreditation and final qualifications remain unchanged, that the reform aims to make training more flexible and accessible, and that the programme is carried out with the training institutions themselves.
The final qualifications of the teacher training programmes will not be changed.
De eindkwalificaties van de lerarenopleidingen worden niet veranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht 'Pijnlijke ironie: de coronamiljarden voor scholen vergroten het lerarentekort'

An MP asked the minister whether the corona education funds, by drawing teachers toward schools with the greatest needs, worsen teacher shortages in some schools and whether the Dutch big-city teacher shortage reflects the difficulty of working in disadvantaged schools. The minister answered that the Nationaal Programma gives schools flexibility, that a 375 million euro labour-market allowance aims to retain teachers, that teacher choices are their own, and that the government will report on mobility and city covenants in the autumn.
In the autumn I will report to the House, as in autumn 2020, on the mobility of teachers between regions.
In het najaar rapporteer ik de Kamer, net als in het najaar 2020 over de mobiliteit van leraren tussen regio's.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het artikel in de Telegraaf van 12 juni jl. “Inbreuk op de academische vrijheid door de woke-cultuur en cancel-praktijk op universiteiten en hogescholen”

An MP asked the Minister of Education about alleged woke culture, cancel practices and diversity officers undermining academic freedom at Dutch universities, citing a Telegraaf article. The Minister denied seeing signs of censorship or cancel practices, described diversity policy as institutional responsibility, and said academic freedom must be protected.
I have no signals that this is practice at Dutch universities and universities of applied sciences.
Ik heb geen signalen dat dit op Nederlandse universiteiten en hogescholen gebruik is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over de luchtspiegeling van een luchtbrug

The MP asks whether the minister knows that the KLM air bridge Van Lienden cited as part of his mask deals was a false claim, and why the government kept that claim in place knowing the air bridge was reserved for the government. The minister confirms awareness of the article and says how the ministry assessed the KLM claim is part of an ongoing forensic audit by Deloitte, referring to an earlier letter.

How the Ministry of VWS assessed and handled the claim that KLM was involved as a partner in Van Lienden's alliance is part of the investigation being carried out by forensic accountant Deloitte into this case.

Hoe het Ministerie van VWS de claim dat de KLM als partner betrokken was bij de alliantie van Van Lienden en partners heeft beoordeeld en behandeld is deel van het onderzoek dat de forensisch accountant Deloitte uitvoert naar deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bikker en Pouw-Verweij over sterke toename van het aantal gevallen van euthanasie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bikker and Pouw-Verweij asked whether the sharp rise in euthanasia notifications in 2020 is worrying, whether the RTE commissions' ethical review is weak, whether video consultations and the RTE's narrowed 'questions-raising' selection undermine safeguards, and whether isolation in care homes is driving requests. The minister answered that the rise tracks the overall increase in deaths, that COVID-19 played only a minor direct role, that deviation from in-person consultations is allowed under the KNMG/ministry COVID arrangements, that no signals of rising euthanasia wishes in Dutch care homes were found, and that an evaluation will examine physician attitudes.
I see no reason for further investigation into the increase in the absolute number of euthanasia notifications to the RTE in 2020.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar de stijging van het absolute aantal euthanasiemeldingen bij de RTE in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht ‘De geheime coronadeals van Sywert van Lienden’

An MP from JA21 asks the Minister of Health why the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen awarded large face-mask orders to Sywert van Lienden's commercial company Relief Goods Alliance, despite conflict-of-interest concerns, and whether the masks were rejected or unpaid. The Minister denies undue preference, says all leads were assessed on price, quality and delivery, rejects conflict of interest, and states the masks were CE-certified and that an accountant's report will follow.
As soon as the accountant's report is available, I will send it to you.
Zodra het accountantsrapport er is, zal ik u dit doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over gemeenten die bijstandsontvangers fors meer willen laten bijverdienen dan de Participatiewet toestaat

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about municipalities such as Amsterdam and Arnhem wanting to let welfare recipients earn up to 500 euro per month permanently, exceeding the Participatiewet limits, and whether this misuses the activation premium and conflicts with the wage-work incentive. The minister answered that the law does not allow this without reducing benefits, that the activation premium is legal only if aimed at labour integration and not structural, that Amsterdam has no concrete plans yet, and that he will inform municipalities via Gemeentenieuws and engage with them if signals of rule-breaking arrive.

If a municipality does not stay within the legal framework, a situation of legal inequality may arise. If I receive signals about this, I will consult with the municipality or municipalities concerned.

Indien een gemeente niet binnen de wettelijke kaders blijft, kan de situatie ontstaan dat rechtsongelijkheid wordt gecreëerd. Mochten mij daarover signalen bereiken, dan zal ik met de betreffende gemeente(n) in overleg treden.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het aanpakplan 'kinderen van femicide slachtoffers en femicide overlevers'

An MP asked the State Secretaries about an action plan on children of femicide victims and survivors, including a coordinator for the youth protection chain, combined criminal and family court hearings, amending inheritance law to exclude perpetrators, and a full government response. The government says it will pursue these recommendations through ongoing talks, a planned inheritance-law consultation in 2026, and a broader response in the first half of 2026.
I aim to put a draft of this bill out for internet consultation in 2026, before summer.
Ik streef ernaar een concept van dit wetsvoorstel in 2026 vóór de zomer in internetconsultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Struijs over het bericht 'Ouderenmishandeling veel te weinig gemeld. Het komt misschien wel vaker voor dan kindermishandeling'

An MP asks whether elder abuse is under-reported and whether it is as common as child abuse, and what the government will do about detection, reporting, expertise centres, Veilig Thuis powers and funding. The state secretary answers that reporting figures are stable at about 2,000–2,500 per year, that new Maastricht research is expected in mid-2026, and that existing alliances make a new expertise centre unnecessary, while promising awareness campaigns, a signalling page and further monitoring.
I do not therefore simply share the conclusion that elder abuse occurs much more often than the prevailing estimate.
Ik deel daarmee niet zondermeer de conclusie dat ouderenmishandeling veel vaker voorkomt dan de gangbare schatting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Vliegenthart over de uitzending van Max Meldpunt Actueel aangaande ouderenmishandeling

MPs Bushoff and Vliegenthart asked the health ministry about under-reporting of elder abuse after a Max Meldpunt broadcast, including prevalence, prevention, GP detection, caregiver leave and a proposal to give Veilig Thuis court-petitioning powers. The state secretary acknowledged under-reporting, announced a Maastricht prevalence study due mid-2026, pointed to existing awareness measures, and rejected giving Veilig Thuis primary petitioner powers in court.
I do not share the view, however, that Veilig Thuis should be given more powers as primary petitioner before the court.
Ik deel de opvatting echter niet dat Veilig Thuis meer bevoegdheden als primaire verzoeker bij de rechter zou moeten krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘Behoeften en ondersteuning van mantelzorgers op Bonaire’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a report on carers' needs and support on Bonaire, showing overload, bureaucratic obstacles and lack of support. The State Secretary responded that local policy is primarily the Public Body's responsibility, that the Ministry has supported maatwerk provisions and a carers' support point, and that a possible intensification pilot could be discussed in the CKO.
Forming local policy for carers is therefore mainly the responsibility of the Public Body.
Het vormen van lokaal beleid voor mantelzorgers is dus hoofdzakelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het bericht 'Verpleeghuizen kampen met leegstand terwijl bijna 18.000 ouderen op de wachtlijst staan: hoe kan dat?'

An SP MP asked the state secretary how to prevent nursing home places from disappearing through financial failure amid vacancies, and about the link between falling care requests and the policy of keeping elderly people at home longer. The state secretary said that providers are responsible for their own finances, that RIVM research into the decline in demand is underway, and that the continuity policy would apply if problems arise.
I have asked the RIVM to conduct research into this.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om hiernaar onderzoek te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Hove over het bericht dat de eerste wijkkliniek die ouderen helpt revalideren ondanks het succesvolle concept toch onverwachts moet stoppen en zorgverleners hierdoor compleet verrast zi

An MP from the PVV asked the Health State Secretary about the closure of the Amsterdam wijkkliniek for elderly rehabilitation despite its success, and about the new Zorgverzekeraars Nederland vision. The State Secretary answered that the insurers' vision is not yet shared by providers and professional bodies, that the NZa and ZiNL will examine the closure with the parties involved, and that it is not her role to force insurers to contract specific providers.
It does not fit my role to require health insurers to contract care with specific providers.
Het past niet bij mijn rol om zorgverzekeraars te verplichten om zorg te contracteren bij specifieke zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het Grevio rapport 'Building trust by delivering support, protection and justice Netherlands First thematic evaluation report'

An MP asked the state secretary about GREVIO's first thematic evaluation of the Netherlands on violence against women and domestic violence, covering gender-sensitive definitions, screening in divorce cases, Clare's Law, shelter capacity, temporary home bans, a national coordinator, a 24/7 reporting point, data collection and data sharing. The government answered in detail, largely by describing ongoing projects, pilots and studies, and committed to several concrete steps while giving no firm timelines for some measures.
In addition, I am preparing an expansion of the current legal definition of domestic violence in the Social Support Act 2015.
Daarnaast bereid ik een verruiming voor van de huidige wettelijke definitie van huiselijk geweld in de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Korte over het artikel ‘Cordaan en Amsterdam UMC stoppen na zeven jaar met Wijkkliniek in Zuidoost’

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of the Cordaan/Amsterdam UMC community clinic for acute elderly care in Amsterdam Zuidoost and whether it conflicts with the Zorginstituut advice. The government says it values the concept, attributes the closure to disagreement among the parties and financial factors, and points to nationwide scale-up and NZa review.

The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) oversees careful contracting and, together with the Zorginstituut Nederland (ZiNL), is talking with Cordaan, Zilveren Kruis and Amsterdam UMC to understand what happened and which lessons can be drawn.

De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) ziet toe op zorgvuldige contractering en gaat samen met het Zorginstituut Nederland (ZiNL), in gesprek met Cordaan, Zilveren Kruis en het Amsterdam UMC om te begrijpen wat er is gebeurd en welke lessen hieruit getrokken kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het artikel ‘Cordaan en Amsterdam UMC stoppen na zeven jaar met Wijkkliniek in Zuidoost’

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of the Cordaan/Amsterdam UMC wijkkliniek in Amsterdam Zuidoost and whether the minister would press insurers to keep it open and support such models structurally. The state secretary replied that care capacity for the region is assured, that the NZa and ZiNL are discussing lessons learned with the parties, and that the minister will not force insurers to contract specific providers, though the wijkkliniek concept continues in a revalidation payment experiment.
The NZa and ZiNL are taking up their system responsibility by entering into discussion with Cordaan and Zilveren Kruis.
De NZa en ZiNL pakken hier hun systeemverantwoordelijke rol door samen in gesprek te gaan met Cordaan en Zilveren Kruis
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de problemen met hulpmiddelenbedrijf Medipoint

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about many complaints over delayed, refused or wrong deliveries by aid-products supplier Medipoint, and whether municipal tendering on lowest price contributes. The State Secretary calls the situation unacceptable, rejects the lowest-price analysis, points to municipal responsibility under the Wmo 2015 and ongoing national measures, and reports that Medipoint is improving its customer service.
Municipalities must, under the Wmo 2015 and alongside sufficient minimum quality requirements, also apply a realistic price.
Gemeenten dienen op basis van de Wmo 2015 – naast voldoende minimum kwaliteitseisen – ook een reële prijs te hanteren binnen de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het feit dat de vergoeding van vervoerskosten voor een deel van de mensen met een beperking is verlaagd

SP MPs Dobbe and Dijk asked why the tax deduction for medical travel costs was lowered for some people with disabilities, and whether this breaches the UN CRPD standstill principle. The state secretary replied that the flat-rate per-kilometre system simplifies the rules, that some individuals will receive less, that the leefkilometers amount was raised to 925 euro with 1 million extra structurally, and that the change is compatible with the CRPD and will be monitored and evaluated.
The amendment of the scheme does not aim at a deterioration, but at a simplification and clarification of the fiscal support.
De wijziging van de regeling beoogt geen verslechtering, maar een vereenvoudiging en verduidelijking van de fiscale ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf, Mutluer en Bruyning over de beschikbaarheid van acute hulp voor vrouwen naar aanleiding van de femicide-campagne 'Waar Ben Je'?

MPs asked whether the 24/7 Veilig Thuis chat for femicide signals is available everywhere, how the campaign's effect is monitored, and whether the statutory task should be extended to 24-hour availability. The state secretary answered that Veilig Thuis already has a legal duty to be reachable in acute situations, no national monitoring of the campaign effect exists, a 24/7 chat is being developed, and no change to the statutory task is planned.
Veilig Thuis does have the statutory duty to be reachable and available at all times in situations where immediate performance of its legal tasks is required.
Wel heeft Veilig Thuis de wettelijke taak om te allen tijde bereikbaar en beschikbaar te zijn in situaties waarin onmiddellijk uitvoering van de wettelijke taken geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het gebrek aan tolken voor mensen die slechthorend of doof zijn en spraakherkenningshulpmiddelen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the shortage of sign-language and writing interpreters for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, and about reimbursement of speech-recognition aids such as Speaksee, including differing assessment procedures for workers and non-workers. The State Secretary responds that interim measures (a reorganised standby interpreter pool) are in place, that reimbursement is case-by-case and depends on whether the aid is for private life, work or education, and that answers to all questions could not be provided in time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Achterhoekse ouderenzorg gaat op de schop: dit is wat er gaat veranderen’

Dobbe (SP) asked the state secretary for health how care for elderly people in the Achterhoek would be affected by plans for clustered 'zorgbuurten', including whether conditions like training or moving house could be imposed and whether cost cutting drives the plans. The state secretary said all eligible elderly must get care including in rural areas, that training and moving must never be conditions, and that the plans stem from local cooperation with no cuts figures known, while staff shortages are acknowledged as a factor.
I have no insight into any possible cuts intended with the plans described in the news report.
Ik heb geen zicht op eventuele bezuinigingen die beoogd zijn met de in het nieuwsbericht beschreven plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Anna (14) blijft altijd als baby, toch krijgt ze plots veel minder zorg: vader Jonas vreest zijn baan te moeten opzeggen’

MP Dobbe (SP) asks why about half of recent extension requests for additional home care (meerzorg) are refused, what this means for families, and whether regional differences are acceptable. The State Secretary acknowledges the hardship, cites a small sample showing refusals, says no national refusal figures are available yet, and commits to clearer, more uniform rules with care offices and the Zorginstituut.
Currently I do not have national figures on the percentage of refusals of additional care requests in the home situation.
Momenteel beschik ik niet over landelijke cijfers over het percentage afwijzingen voor meerzorg-aanvragen in de thuissituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over klachten tegen kritische rechters binnen de jeugdsector

MP Bruyning asked whether a child-protection certified institution (Jeugdbescherming Noord) filing complaints against a children's judge and holding talks with the court board undermines judicial independence and rule-of-law norms, and asked about oversight and certification. The minister answered that the court and the institution followed the complaint procedure, the talks did not concern substantive cases, certification is for the KMI and inspectorates, and no new rules or sanctions are planned.
The conversations did not relate to the substantive assessment of cases; appeal is open for that.
De gesprekken hadden geen betrekking op de inhoudelijke beoordeling van zaken, daar staat het hoger beroep voor open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de casus van Ymere en Philadelphia en de Stimuleringsregeling Zorggeschikte Woningen

MP Westerveld asks why the Ymere and Philadelphia application for the care-suitable housing subsidy (SGZW) was rejected, given housing shortages and a Chamber motion to widen the scheme to older people with intellectual disabilities, and whether the rules were clearly communicated. The State Secretary answers that the applicants knew the requirement that construction must not have started (needed for state-aid reasons under a DAEB agreement) was not met, that the rejected application cannot be revived retroactively, and that no further options exist within the scheme, while pointing to the broadened scheme and care-provider duties.
Ymere and Philadelphia also submitted an application in this new round.
Ymere en Philadelphia hebben ook in deze nieuwe ronde een aanvraag ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over het artikel ‘Bewoners van wooncomplex in Enschede verdrietig: ‘Niet meer dat gezellige kopje koffie’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health about a care provider (Livio) converting a residential care complex in Enschede into social housing, with residents feeling isolated by neighbourhood visitors and facing higher costs. The State Secretary said the situation is regrettable, that community-building is generally positive, that no residents hold a Wlz care indication, and that Livio has offered a rent freeze and is working to improve atmosphere.
I am not aware of any cost increases resulting from this change.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van verhoging van kosten die het gevolg zijn van deze wijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over privatisering van zorgvastgoed

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the sale of Pro Senectute's care group and its real estate to investment companies, questioning effects on care quality, client rights and whether the Wibz would prevent such situations. The State Secretary answers largely in general terms, says quality of care must come before financial interest, notes the Wibz tightens the definition of profit distribution and conditions it, and declines to comment on the individual case or on use of sale proceeds.
I want to be reticent in responding to individual cases, especially when I do not know all the details.
Ik wil terughoudend zijn met het reageren op individuele casuïstiek zeker wanneer ik niet alle details ken.

verzoekt de regering om, de energiebesparingsverplichting onder de Wet milieubeheer te verbeteren en aan te vullen
Motie van het lid Moorlag c.s. over werven van technici en vakmensen
Asks the government to include in the climate and energy agreement arrangements for training, retraining and recruiting technicians and skilled workers for the energy transition.
noting that the energy transition, including making the housing stock energy neutral, requires large numbers of technicians and skilled workers
constaterende dat de energietransitie, waaronder het energieneutraal maken van de woningvoorraad, grote aantallen technici en vakmensen vraagt
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over de SBIR-oproepen
Asks the government to reserve part of extra applied research investment for SBIR innovation calls for start-ups.
requests the government to reserve part of the extra investments in applied research for SBIR calls

Asks the government to keep the current netting scheme for solar power at least until 2023.
requests the government to keep the current netting scheme in any case until 2023
verzoekt de regering, de huidige salderingsregeling in ieder geval tot 2023 te behouden
Motie van het lid Paternotte c.s. over een SBIR-oproep op het gebied van serious gaming
Asks the government to launch an SBIR innovation call on serious gaming to address societal challenges.

Asks the government to develop a transition agenda for shrinking the livestock farming sector in the Netherlands.
requests the government to develop a transition agenda for the shrinking of livestock farming in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, een transitieagenda te ontwikkelen voor de inkrimping van de veehouderij in Nederland
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over digitalisering door het brede mkb
Asks the government to speed up digitalisation among broad SMEs through regional practice tests, feasibility study of digitalisation scans and scaling best practices.
set in motion regional practice tests
regionale praktijktesten in gang te zetten
Amendement van de leden Van der Lee en Moorlag over dekking voor sluiting Hemweg kolencentrale
Reduces the municipal fund by 55 million euro to finance the closure of the Hemweg coal plant.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by 55,000 thousand euro
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 55.000
Amendement van de leden Van der Lee en Moorlag over 55 miljoen voor sluiting Hemweg kolencentrale
Adds EUR 55 million to the energy budget to fund negotiations with Nuon/Vattenfall on closing the Hemweg coal plant, financed from the municipal fund.
By means of this amendment 55 million euros is freed up to start negotiations with Nuon/Vattenfall on closing the Hemweg coal plant
Door middel van dit amendement wordt 55 miljoen euro vrijgemaakt om onderhandelingen te starten met Nuon/Vattenfall over sluiting van de Hemweg kolencentrale
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Lee ter vervanging van nr. 44 over 3 miljoen voor toezicht op energiebesparing
Shifts 3 million euro within the energy ministry budget to fund a second tranche for energy-saving supervision by environmental services.
With this amendment the second tranche of 3 million euro for energy-saving supervision is continued.
Met dit amendement wordt de tweede tranche van € 3 miljoen bedoeld voor toezicht op energiebesparing doorgezet.
Amendement van het lid Van der Lee over 3 miljoen voor toezicht op energiebesparing
Moves 3 million euros from business policy to energy policy to fund a second tranche of energy-saving supervision by regional environmental services.
With this amendment this funding is arranged.
Met dit amendement wordt deze financiering geregeld.
Motie van het lid Van der Lee c.s. over de 50-50-verhouding in de opslag duurzame energie
Asks the government to study the effects on purchasing power, competitiveness and energy use of changing the 50-50 split of the sustainable energy levy between households and businesses.
requests the government to have studied what the effects are on the purchasing power of citizens
verzoekt de regering te laten onderzoeken wat de gevolgen zijn voor de koopkracht van burgers
Amendement van het lid Van der Lee over het verdelen van de lasten over huishoudens en bedrijven volgens een 40:60-verdeling
