This amendment provides that the ODE burdens fall 60% on large consumers and 40% on households

Amendement van het lid Van den Berg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over herstel van bestaande regels voor medegebruik van antenne-opstelpunten
Amends the telecommunications bill to restore specific rules on reasonable fees for shared use of antenna sites for broadcasting, with the burden of proof on the provider and ACM review.
In disputes, the provider meeting the sharing request bears the burden of proving the reasonableness of the fee.
Daarbij draagt de aanbieder die aan het verzoek tot medegebruik voldoet bij geschillen de bewijslast voor de redelijkheid van de vergoeding.
Amendement van het lid Van der Lee over het behouden van specifieke regels voor hoge antenne-opstelpunten
Restores the specific rules for reasonable compensation for sharing high antenna sites, requiring efficient, transparent, non-discriminatory pricing and placing the burden of proof on the provider.
A reasonable fee for shared use of antenna sites for broadcasting exists if the fee is efficient, transparent and non-discriminatory
Van een redelijke vergoeding voor medegebruik van antenne-opstelpunten voor omroep, is sprake als de vergoeding efficiënt, transparant en niet-discriminatoir is
Motie van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over het transparanter laten verlopen van onderhandelingen over belastingverdragen
Asks the government to make negotiations on tax treaties more transparent and to consult stakeholders on draft treaty texts, so parliament can influence them.
requests the government to make negotiations on tax treaties more transparent from now on and to consult stakeholders in the interim
verzoekt de regering om, onderhandelingen over belastingverdragen voortaan transparanter te laten verlopen en om belanghebbenden tussentijds te consulteren

Asks the government to use the UN model tax treaty as the minimum standard in negotiations with developing countries on taxation.
requests the government to use the UN model treaty as the lower limit in negotiations with developing countries

Motie van het lid Weverling c.s. over verbeteringen in het informatieproces van begrotingen en jaarverslagen

Asks the government to improve information to parliament on budgets and annual reports, including policy changes, links between goals and resources, and effects, and to involve the House in this process.
requests the government, in future and insofar as budget rules allow, to supplement its information provision
verzoekt de regering, in de toekomst, voor zover de begrotingsregels dat toelaten, haar informatievoorziening aan te vullen
Motie van het lid Van der Lee over middelen voor het ROAD-project op alternatieve wijze inzetten
Asks the government to use the funds freed by the ROAD carbon capture project's collapse to raise the share of renewable energy.
Requests the government to use the financial resources intended for the ROAD project in an alternative way to achieve a higher share of renewable energy.
verzoekt de regering, de financiële middelen die bestemd waren voor het ROAD-project op alternatieve wijze in te zetten voor het bereiken van een hoger aandeel hernieuwbare energie
Amendement van het lid Van der Lee over verhogen van de boete
Raises the maximum fine for failing to provide a country report to the inspector from the fourth to the sixth category.
'fourth category' is replaced by: sixth category
wordt «vierde categorie» vervangen door: zesde categorie
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de exportkredietverzekeringen voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about export credit insurance for the Mozambique LNG project, including resumed dredging by Van Oord, security risks in Cabo Delgado, monitoring of harms and whether the state's obligations are fulfilled. Minister Heinen answered that the state is bound by the issued policies under Dutch insurance law, that the dredging was Total's own decision, that the government sees no breach of environmental and social standards, and that Total has since dropped the Dutch-insured financing so no reassessment remains.

As previously set out in answers to parliamentary questions of 1 and 29 September 2025 and in my letter of 11 November 2025, it is correct that Van Oord, on behalf of Total and anticipating a project restart, carried out preparatory dredging works.

Zoals eerder uiteengezet in de beantwoording van Kamervragen op 1 en 29 september 2025 en in mijn brief van 11 november 2025 klopt het dat Van Oord in opdracht van Total, anticiperend op een herstart van het project, voorbereidende baggerwerkzaamheden heeft uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Nispen over het (demissionaire) kabinetsstandpunt inzake het initiatiefwetsvoorstel Centraal Aandeelhoudersregister (CAHR)

MPs Van der Lee and Van Nispen asked the government about its position on the initiative bill for a central shareholders register (CAHR), including the KPMG report, the UBO register's 25% threshold, and notary and Chamber of Commerce feasibility. The acting government declined to pre-empt parliamentary handling, said it would give its appraisal when the bill is debated, and stated the UBO register and CAHR are complementary.
The cabinet does not anticipate the parliamentary handling of the initiative bill for a central shareholders register (CAHR).
Het kabinet loopt niet vooruit op de behandeling van het initiatiefwetsvoorstel voor een centraal aandeelhoudersregister (CAHR) door uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over omzeiling van sancties tegen Rusland via Centraal- Aziatische landen

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked whether Dutch exports to Kyrgyzstan, which appear to be transshipped to Russia, would be investigated, what sanctions consequences apply to firms, and how transshipment via Central Asia will be prevented. The minister answered that sanctions evasion is a priority, enforced by Customs with prosecution of deliberate evaders, and that the Netherlands is pushing for measures in the 19th sanctions package.
Countering sanctions evasion is an important priority for both the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Customs.
Het tegengaan van sanctieomzeiling is een belangrijke prioriteit voor zowel het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken als de Douane.
Antwoord op de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de stand van zaken omtrent een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs asked about the status of an independent review of security and human rights risks behind an export credit guarantee for the Mozambique LNG project, whether Van Oord resumed work under force majeure, and related questions on Rwandan troop payments, UK Export Finance, NGO involvement, UN investigation and corruption. The Minister says the external analysis is not yet complete and expected after summer, the Dutch decision on amending the financing policy is pending, the export policy remains in force for Van Oord's exporter policy, and the government will not commit to a UN-led investigation, referring to Mozambique's own prosecutor.
I expect to be able to share the final report with your House after the summer, except for any confidential elements.
Ik verwacht het definitieve rapport, behoudens eventuele vertrouwelijke elementen, na de zomer met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over piramideschema’s van multi-levelmarketingsbedrijven

Van der Lee (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about young people being drawn into multi-level marketing schemes resembling pyramid games, the B:hip case, and whether the law should be changed. The minister, answering on behalf of economic affairs, said MLM is legal as such, that enforcement lies with the ACM, Ksa and AFM, declined new research and a reporting obligation, and said no change to the definition of pyramid games is needed.
There are no representative figures on the extent of MLM in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen representatieve cijfers over de omvang van MLM in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Lee, Van der Burg en Dassen over Chinese spionage via diplomatieke posten

MPs from several parties asked whether US concerns about Chinese espionage linked to the large Chinese embassy in London also affect the Netherlands, including via financial infrastructure, internet hubs and diplomatic expansion, and whether the EU should adopt joint risk-analysis guidelines for diplomatic buildings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, points to existing measures such as DORA, the Wbni and the forthcoming Cbw, says no Chinese embassy expansion request is pending in the Netherlands and no increase in Chinese diplomats has occurred, and states it will raise China-related issues within the EU.
The cabinet makes no public statements about the investigations or working methods of the services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de onderzoeken of werkwijze van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn, Van der Lee en Stultiens over de gevolgen van toenemende robotisering voor werkgelegenheid en belastinginkomsten

Greens-Labour MPs asked whether the government sees Mercedes and BMW testing humanoid robots as a sign of labour market change, whether research and tax-base scenarios on robotisation exist, and whether alternative taxes such as a robot tax should be explored. The minister answered that automation is a continuing structural trend rather than a sudden shift, pointed to labour market reforms and lifelong learning plans, and said uncertainty is large, so the tax system should be robust and simple, citing ongoing box 3 and tax reforms.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Beroepsorganisatie NBA staakt jacht op frauderende accountants

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the NBA can no longer pursue disciplinary action against accountants for exam fraud because large audit firms refuse to cooperate, and what the government will do. The minister answers that the NBA lacks powers to obtain information, that a review of the professional regulation system will be commissioned this year, and that legislative changes will follow if needed.

It is undesirable if the professional organisation has no power to obtain the necessary information to establish whether there are accountants against whom it wishes to file a complaint with the Accountantskamer.

Het is onwenselijk als de beroepsorganisatie geen bevoegdheid heeft om de nodige inlichtingen in te winnen om te achterhalen of er accountants zijn jegens wie zij een klacht aanhangig wil maken bij de Accountantskamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Van der Lee en Hirsch over het over het bericht 'EU Omnibus: EU finance ministers back proposal, Parliament heavily divided'

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about the Ecofinraad discussion of the 'stop-the-clock' proposal delaying CSRD sustainability reporting, and whether the minister urged extending the pause to first-wave companies. The minister confirmed he suggested that first-wave companies also receive a pause, citing the Commission's planned scope reduction and simplification of ESRS, while stating the NFRD remains in force and the Chamber would be informed in time.
However, I made clear in the Ecofin Council that the Netherlands is still studying the proposal and there is not yet an official cabinet position.
Wel heb ik in de Ecofinraad duidelijk gemaakt dat Nederland het voorstel nog aan het bestuderen is en er nog geen officiële kabinetspositie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Beleid staatsdeelnemingen kan beter wat betreft marktverstoring en klimaatrisico’s

An MP asked the Finance Minister about separation of public and commercial activities at state holdings such as NS and Holland Casino, climate risk disclosure, the Tennet loan, and OECD guidance. The minister replied that NS keeps a strict accounting separation reported to the transport ministry, that other holdings lack such separation, that climate risks are managed by boards and reviewed in the periodic policy evaluation, and that Nordic models and OECD recommendations will be considered later.
Because of competitively sensitive information, this separation is not made visible in NS's public annual report.
Vanwege concurrentiegevoelige informatie wordt deze scheiding in het publieke jaarverslag van NS niet inzichtelijk gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Troebele Hollands glorie in de Baai van Manilla: hoe baggeraar Boskalis zich vertilde aan een prestigeproject'

MPs Hirsch and Van der Lee asked about the Dutch export credit guarantee for the Manila Bay airport project by Boskalis and San Miguel, raising sea-level rise, habitat compensation, relocated families and transparency concerns. The government answered that the project meets international standards, that compensation is being monitored and largely delivered, and that it sees no reason to change its decision.

An independent evaluation of the monitoring of this project, recently shared with your House, shows that it is robust and adequately designed to address any irregularities in implementation in a timely manner.

Uit een onafhankelijke evaluatie van de monitoring van dit project die recent met uw Kamer is gedeeld, blijkt dat deze robuust is en adequaat is ingericht om eventuele misstanden in de uitvoering tijdig te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over de geheime deportatie van 48 Oeigoeren naar China door de regering van Thailand

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about the reported secret deportation of Uyghurs from Thailand to China and what the Dutch government had done to prevent it. The minister confirmed the deportation, said Thailand breached non-refoulement, described diplomatic outreach to Thai and Chinese authorities and EU and UN statements, and said the Dutch embassy in Beijing would monitor the situation.

From the Dutch embassy in Bangkok, the Dutch Permanent Representation to the UN in Geneva and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in The Hague, active outreach was made to the Thai authorities up to the day of deportation.

Vanuit de Nederlandse ambassade in Bangkok, de Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiging bij de VN in Genève en vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in Den Haag is actief outreach gedaan naar de Thaise autoriteiten tot op de dag van uitzetting.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het rapport "Dutch financial institutions decarbonising their energy portfolios. Analysing financial flows to fossil fuels and renewable energy" van de Eerlijke

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a report showing Dutch financial institutions invest only about 20 cents in renewables per euro in fossil fuels, and how the 6:1 renewable-to-fossil ratio by 2030 will be achieved, including prudential supervision, disclosure and reporting obligations. The Minister, Heinen, answered that the government relies on climate policy, the Klimaatcommitment and existing EU rules, rejects additional national obligations, says prudential supervisors already expect climate risk management, and argues full public disclosure of portfolios is disproportionate due to commercial and privacy concerns.
Mandatory full public disclosure on a large scale is also not proportionate because commercial, business-sensitive information could end up in the public domain.
Verplichte algehele openbaarmaking op grote schaal is ook niet proportioneel omdat commerciële, bedrijfsgevoelige informatie op straat kan komen te liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het bericht dat Talpa jaarcijfers aan het zicht onttrekt

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked whether Talpa's use of the 'Blokker construction' to withhold annual accounts from public view is lawful, and what sanctions and changes are available. The state secretary answers that failing to publish a required subsidiary account breaches the publication duty, that the fine is modest but further civil and personal liability remedies exist, and that no legislative change is planned.
Failing to file the annual accounts is an economic offence.
Het niet deponeren van de jaarrekening is een economisch delict.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Cryptowereld creëert systeemrisico dat aan kredietcrisis doet denken

MP Van der Lee (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Finance about a report that crypto 'cloning' and layered reuse of collateral create systemic risk resembling the 2008 credit crisis, asking about risks, regulation, and investor protection. Minister Heinen answered at length that current systemic risks are limited, that MiCA and Basel-based rules address them, that an EU evaluation is due in June 2025, and that a study into crypto trading risks is underway.
At present, the risks of these developments for financial stability in the Netherlands are limited.
Op dit moment zijn de risico's van deze ontwikkelingen voor de financiële stabiliteit in Nederland beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van der Lee over “de online surveillance van Bunq”, naar aanleiding van een artikel in het Financieele Dagblad van 19 december 2024

MPs Kathmann and Van der Lee asked whether bank Bunq pressured customers via its app to stop online criticism, whether it may link user data to such posts, and whether supervisors should investigate. The minister replied that Bunq denies threatening or terminating customers, that banks cannot use online criticism as a legal basis to process customer data, and that the independent supervisors AFM and DNB cannot be instructed to investigate a specific case.
The AFM and DNB are independent administrative bodies and function as independent supervisors. I therefore cannot ask the supervisors to investigate a specific situation.
De AFM en DNB zijn zelfstandige bestuursorganen en functioneren als onafhankelijke toezichthouders. Ik kan de toezichthouders daarom niet vragen om een specifieke situatie te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over concurrentievervalsing van de Big Four

An MP asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about alleged competition distortion by the Big Four accountancy firms, following a complaint by OvRAN to the European Commission and ACM. The minister answers that ACM found no evidence of prohibited conduct, that joint market power is not itself unlawful, and that no further action is planned.
I therefore see no reason to take further action.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om verdere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de 48 Oeigoeren niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Van der Lee over een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voor een project in Kazachstan

MPs Hirsch and Van der Lee asked about a 2014 Dutch export credit guarantee for a Van Oord canal project at Tengiz oil field in Kazakhstan, including corruption, UBO ownership of the debtor Tenizservice, environmental and social risk assessment, and monitoring. The ministers answered that no claims were paid, the project was assessed under the 2014 policy with risks judged mitigated, UBO identification was not then required, and monitoring was introduced only from 2022.
No, at the time the policy was issued monitoring was not yet laid down in the policy.
Nee, ten tijde van afgifte van de polis was monitoring nog niet vastgelegd in het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Vriendjespolitiek en intimidatie bij Europa’s investeringsbank'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports of cronyism and intimidation at the European Investment Bank, including poor staff survey results on integrity and whistleblowing. The minister said he shares the concern, supports the new EIB president's action plan, says Dutch pressure has been raised in the Board, and that the EIB management committee holds responsibility for workplace safety.
The Netherlands will closely monitor the implementation of the action plan and continue to press for a safe and open work culture within the EIB.
Nederland zal de uitvoering van het actieplan nauwgezet monitoren en erop blijven aandringen dat er binnen de EIB een veilige en open werkcultuur is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Van der Lee en Boswijk over de situatie van Oeigoeren in Thailand

MPs from D66, VVD, GroenLinks-PvdA and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the detention in Thailand of over 48 Uyghurs fleeing China, and whether Thailand's threatened deportation breaches non-refoulement. The minister replied that the Netherlands urges third countries to respect non-refoulement, raises the case with UNHCR and Thai authorities privately rather than publicly, and answered every question on substance.
For now, the considered approach is not to publicly address UNHCR and to continue regular contacts with UNHCR on this matter.
Vooralsnog is de afweging om UNHCR niet publiekelijk aan te spreken en in te blijven zetten op de regelmatige contacten met UNHCR hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘AFM bezorgd over stijging marktaandeel van private equity in de accountancy’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the AFM's concern that private equity's share of the accountancy sector rose from 11% to 21% in a year, and whether this threatens audit quality and what measures are planned. The minister answers that existing and proposed rules already safeguard independence, that the effects are uncertain and could be positive or negative, that primary responsibility lies with audit firms, and that no specific measures against private equity are planned, while monitoring with the AFM continues.

I am not in favour of specific measures targeting private equity parties, because I currently have no reason to assume that the influence of private equity on balance harms the quality of statutory audit.

Ik ben geen voorstander van specifieke maatregelen gericht tegen private-equitypartijen, omdat ik op dit moment geen aanleiding heb te veronderstellen dat de invloed van private equity per saldo afbreuk doet aan de kwaliteit van de wettelijke controle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘AI fraude neemt snel toe in de financiële sector’

MP Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about a report that AI-enabled fraud is rising fast in the financial sector, whether firms lack resources to tackle it, and whether biometric checks and eID could better protect clients. Minister Heinen agreed the trend is worrying, pointed to the MOB security working group and the Integrated approach to online fraud, said banks already use strong customer authentication and biometrics, and reported no signals that the sector lacks means or expertise.
So far I have received no signals that the financial sector in the Netherlands currently lacks the means and expertise to tackle this threat.
Ik heb tot nu toe geen signalen ontvangen dat de financiële sector in Nederland op dit moment niet over de middelen en expertise beschikt om deze bedreiging aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht China verlaagt rente en plant extra stimulus voor economie

Rep. Van der Lee asks the Finance Minister about China's interest rate cut, deflation risks, its rising public debt, and the implications for Europe and the Netherlands. The minister answers that the cut aims to support the Chinese economy, that IMF projections show rising Chinese debt, and that the effects on Europe and the Netherlands are limited and mainly trade-related.
However, it is not for the cabinet to speculate about hypothetical developments and the associated geopolitical implications.
Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om te speculeren over hypothetische ontwikkelingen en bijbehorende geopolitieke implicaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Bijna driekwart van de notarissen maakt nevenfuncties niet openbaar: na fraudeschandaal is weinig verbeterd’

An MP asked about reports that most notaries fail to disclose their side jobs (nevenfuncties) and whether oversight has improved since the 2021 fraud scandal. The Secretary of State answered that no figures exist, that non-compliance mostly involves forgotten or unrecognized private holding companies, that BFT and KNB will raise awareness, and that the BFT's oversight and evaluation are its own responsibility.
The BFT and the KNB will continue to draw the notaries' attention to the importance of correctly registering side activities.
Het BFT en de KNB zullen verder aandacht bij de notarissen blijven vragen voor het belang van correcte registratie van de nevenactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee en Koekkoek over de exportkredietverzekering voor het LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee and Koekkoek asked the ministers about the export credit insurance for Total's LNG project in Mozambique, including the re-assessment process, independence of security information, Total's role, the Palma attacks, and compliance with the Thijssen motion. Minister Heinen answered that the re-assessment is not finished, that all Proximities report recommendations were implemented, that the government will not postpone the decision as the motion asked, and that delayed Woo requests led to penalty payments.
As long as the assessment process is ongoing, I cannot make statements about its content in order to ensure a careful process.
Zolang het beoordelingsproces loopt, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de inhoud daarvan om zo een zorgvuldig proces te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over inflatie

MPs Maatoug and Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about inflation governance, the role of DNB and the government in price stability, measures against supply shocks, CBS measurement, and whether profits drove inflation. The minister answered that the ECB is primarily responsible for price stability while fiscal policy and social partners also matter, outlined energy-crisis support measures, and said that profit-driven inflation needs further research, with a promised discussion in the upcoming Miljoenennota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over het proces tegen Jimmy Lai, hoofdredacteur van de voorheen grootste vrije krant in Hongkong

MPs Paternotte, Van der Burg and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister about delays in the trial of Jimmy Lai, the erosion of rights in Hong Kong under the 1984 Sino-British Declaration and the ICCPR, and whether the Netherlands would join calls for his release, the Council of the EU agenda, and the matter being raised. The minister answered that Netherlands shares concern and speaks out with the EU and like-minded states, attends the trials, but will not issue a separate statement or put the case on the Foreign Affairs Council agenda for now.
At this moment I therefore do not intend to put this case on the agenda of the Foreign Affairs Council.
Op dit moment ben ik daarom niet van plan deze zaak op de agenda van de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over cryptotoezicht door AFM

MPs Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about the AFM's crypto supervision budget, which the ministry reportedly limited to a 'minimal' scenario despite risks to young investors. The minister defends the chosen capacity (about €7 million) as sufficient for risk-based supervision, promises a review at the end of 2025, and notes the AFM can draw on contingency funds if needed.
With this [allocated] capacity the AFM can supervise well, in a risk-based manner
Met deze [toegekende] capaciteit kan de AFM goed toezicht houden, op een risicogestuurde manier
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over rekeninggluren over “rekeninggluren door medewerkers van de Bunq-bank” naar aanleiding van het krantenbericht van de NRC van 26 juni 2024

An MP asked the Finance Minister about bank employees at Bunq secretly viewing customer account data, whether this is a privacy breach, whether the bank and supervisors are responsible, and what measures will prevent recurrence and identify other banks with the problem. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the existing legal framework, DNB and Data Protection Authority supervision, and the disciplinary body, and said no additional measures were currently deemed necessary.
It is up to the independent supervisor to assess whether a bank meets its legal obligations and, if not, to enforce against it.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke toezichthouder om te beoordelen of een bank aan haar wettelijke verplichtingen voldoet, en als dat niet zo is, om daar op te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Thijssen en Kröger over de toename van fossiele financieringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee, Thijssen and Kröger asked whether banks' rising fossil financing conflicts with Paris goals, how the climate commitment measures CO2 (relative versus absolute), and why finance does not invest more in Dutch sustainability. The government answered that the IEA sees no room for new oil and gas fields, that the climate commitment guidance will be revised to include absolute and sectoral targets, and that a review of further measures is underway, though it could not answer all questions in time.
The revised version of the guidance will be published after the summer.
De herziene versie van de leidraad wordt na de zomer gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de ramingen en realisaties van het EMU-saldo

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the gap between forecast and realised EMU balance (deficit) over 15 years, including whether forecasts are systematically too pessimistic and how underspending affects forecasts. The minister answered that realisations have on average been more favourable than forecasts, explained underspending and the in=uit taakstelling mechanisms, and said forecasts are realistic and being made more accurate, without committing to new oversight measures.
The starting point for the forecasts of the EMU balance is realistic forecasting, which means there is in advance no forecast deviation.
Het uitgangspunt voor de ramingen van het EMU-saldo is realistisch ramen, wat inhoudt dat er op voorhand geen sprake is van een ramingsafwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het niet nemen van juridische vervolgstappen tegen KLM vanwege gebrekkige naleving van steunvoorwaarden

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the state is not taking legal action against KLM for failing to comply with state aid conditions, including tax-avoidance facilitation by pilots and the structural cost-reduction requirement. The minister answered that legal analyses found no real prospect of success and no state damage, that the aid conditions were not decisive for EU approval, and that an independent evaluation by EY and an external committee is underway.
The legal analyses show that the State has not suffered damage to its assets as defined in the Civil Code.
Uit de juridische analyses komt naar voren dat de Staat geen vermogensschade heeft geleden zoals gedefinieerd in het Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens  over gebrekkig inzicht in juridische duurzaamheidsrisico’s

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the Finance Minister about gaps in oversight of legal sustainability risks (climate litigation) by DNB, pension funds and financial institutions, and about how CSDDD article 15 and possible climate rules for the financial sector would apply. The government answered that legal sustainability risks are already part of supervision, that the existing framework leaves room for supervisors, that CSDDD transition plans are an effort obligation, and that decisions on financial-sector climate legislation will be informed to the House around summer.
The supervisory framework and the current legal framework leave sufficient room for supervisors to give content to this.
Het toezichtkader en het huidige juridische kader bieden voldoende ruimte voor toezichthouders om daar invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de besluitvorming rond het AML-pakket

An MP asks the Finance Minister how the EU AML package changed during trilogue so that data-sharing moved from an optional clause to a harmonised obligation, and how it relates to the national Plan van Aanpak Witwassen bill, including KYC data-sharing, processing of sensitive data, cash limits and reporting of unusual versus suspicious transactions. The minister answers all 13 questions on substance, explaining the EU negotiation outcome, saying national safeguards will be examined during implementation, and defending Dutch reporting practice.
During the implementation process of the AML package it will be examined whether additional national safeguards are necessary.
Tijdens het implementatietraject van het AML-pakket zal worden bezien of aanvullende nationale waarborgen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de over de uitwerking van het Europese begrotingsraamwerk

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the effects of the revised EU fiscal rules on the Dutch structural primary balance and spending growth, including the gap with the Studiegroep Begrotingsruimte and the required adjustment. The minister answered that updated preliminary Commission calculations imply a target of 0.3% of GDP in 2028 instead of 0.7%, that the Commission's forecasts are not yet final, and gave indicative ranges for the adjustment needed.
It is currently difficult to say which structural primary balance the Commission will forecast for 2028, as this will depend on the latest economic developments and macroeconomic assumptions.

Het is op dit moment moeilijk om te zeggen welk structureel primair saldo de Commissie voor 2028 zal ramen, omdat dit zal afhangen van de laatste economische ontwikkelingen en macro-economische aannames.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en De Hoop over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof over steun aan KLM

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister how the government will respond to the General Court ruling annulling the Commission's approval of state aid to KLM, including whether the aid remains compatible if the holding and Air France are also beneficiaries, and what financial consequences may follow. The minister replied that talks with the Commission and France are ongoing, that the Commission is expected to appeal, that no direct financial obligations follow from the ruling yet, and declined to give the uncertain consequences or the tax-deferral figures, citing confidentiality of individual firms.
As previously promised in my letter to your House, I will inform the House if there are concrete new developments.
Zoals eerder toegezegd in mijn brief aan uw Kamer zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren als er concrete nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de gebrekkige concurrentie in de Nederlandse bankensector en achterblijvende spaarrentes

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why savings rates lag behind mortgage and ECB rates, whether banks should be pressed to raise them, and what instruments exist such as ACM market scrutiny, state bonds for savers and windfall-profit measures. The minister answered that Dutch savings rates have risen more than the EU average, that the ACM is investigating the savings market, and that further policy options will await the ACM report.
I see no reason at this moment to hold new talks.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om opnieuw gesprekken te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Voordeel familiehypotheek groter dan jubelton’

Van der Lee (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked whether family mortgages at market rates, where interest is effectively refunded, allow an unfair mortgage interest deduction that entrenches wealth inequality, and how large the budget impact is. The State Secretary answered that such constructions are not an undesirable tax construction, that the budgetary effect is estimated at around 150-200 million euros but possibly overstated, and that no plans exist to restrict the deduction.
Because the caretaker cabinet does not consider this an undesirable tax construction, it has no plans to restrict the mortgage interest deduction.
Omdat er naar de mening van het demissionaire kabinet geen sprake is van een «onwenselijke fiscale constructie» heeft het demissionaire kabinet geen plannen om de hypotheekrenteaftrek te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de Rabobank en de ontbossers

MPs asked the government about Rabobank financing deforestation actors, whether financial services should be regulated like deforestation-free products, and whether Dutch and EU policy on livestock reduction and financing is consistent with the Paris goals. The ministers answered that banks are responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines, that the Commission will assess regulating financial institutions by mid-2025, and that the Finance Minister will report on financial-sector measures by year end.
The cabinet expects financial institutions to act in line with international standards for responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht van financiële instellingen dat zij handelen conform de internationale standaarden voor internationaal verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Lee over de gevangenschap van en de rechtszaak tegen journalist en uitgever Jimmy Lai in Hongkong

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would condemn the national security trial of journalist Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong as an attack on press freedom, whether it would act against the breach of the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration, and whether it would join the US and UK in calling for his release. The minister answered that the Netherlands, with 23 other countries in the Media Freedom Coalition, has voiced serious concern and will keep raising the issue and monitoring the trials, but did not commit to calling for release or dropping the case.
The Netherlands will continue to raise attention to this together with this coalition of like-minded countries, including the US and the UK.
Nederland zal hier in samenwerking met deze coalitie van gelijkgezinde landen, waaronder de VS en het VK, aandacht voor blijven vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het faciliteren van fossiele investeringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the Finance Minister whether banks that underwrite fossil-fuel bonds share responsibility for green-washing and the failure to green bond markets, and why a motion on sustainability legislation for the financial sector had not been implemented. The minister acknowledged the findings and said underwriting would be discussed with the financial sector and its umbrella bodies, but ruled out a ban and said the legislative exploration is still ongoing, with an update promised by year-end.
I aim to inform your House further on the progress before the end of the year.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar nader te informeren over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het nalaten om juridische vervolgstappen tegen KLM te ondernemen

MP Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked why the government did not pursue legal action against KLM for failing to comply with conditions attached to its COVID-19 support package, and why the state agent was not informed of the decision. Minister Kaag answered that legal analyses by two external advisers found little chance of success, that the package ended in April 2023, that the evaluation of the package will address compliance and enforcement, and that the legal analyses will be made available confidentially to parliament.
I will therefore make the legal analyses available to parliament on a confidential basis.
Ik zal de juridische analyses daarom vertrouwelijk ter inzage leggen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hammelburg, Piri, Van der Lee en Dassen  over ‘De Russische oorlog tegen Oekraïne is eenpraktijkexamen voor Europa – en de tijd begint te dringen’

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and Volt asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government sees risks to US military aid to Ukraine from congressional gridlock and a possible 2024 US administration cutting support, and whether Europe can cover any shortfall. The government answered that US, European and international support remains essential, that a new House speaker has been appointed, that Europe must take more responsibility, and that it will continue support in consultation with allies while F-16 transfer and munitions decisions depend on training, infrastructure, US export approval and EU criteria.
The cabinet will continue to support Ukraine for as long as necessary.
Het kabinet blijft Oekraïne steunen zolang als dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de aardbevingen in Afghanistan

MPs asked about the humanitarian needs after the October 2023 Herat earthquakes in Afghanistan, and whether Dutch aid could be provided without supporting the Taliban. The minister listed needs and aid channels (Dutch Relief Alliance, CERF, OCHA fund, EU funding) and stated that aid runs under strict conditions barring direct Taliban involvement.
They work in line with humanitarian principles, without interference from the de facto authorities or direct support to the Taliban regime.
Zij werken conform de humanitaire principes, zonder inmenging van de de facto autoriteiten of directe steun aan het Taliban-regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Hammelburg en Van der Lee  over het bericht dat het moederbedrijf van Douwe Egberts en Pickwick, JDE Peet's, weigert om zich terug te trekken uit Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Hammelburg and Van der Lee asked whether JDE Peet's, parent of Douwe Egberts and Pickwick, should exit Russia, whether government contracts with such firms are acceptable, and whether the Russia sanctions package should ban non-essential goods. The minister answered that firms may trade in Russia if they comply with EU sanctions, that existing government contracts will not be ended while compliance holds, that a list of firms with government contracts will be sent confidentially, and that the luxury goods list may be broadened without disclosing future measures.
This overview will be sent to the House for confidential inspection.
Dit overzicht wordt ter vertrouwelijke inzage aan de Kamer nagezonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de berichten 'China-led AIIB’s communications chief quits, criticises bank’s management' en 'Canada freezes ties with China-led AIIB, probes allegations of Communist domina

A GroenLinks MP asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers about reports that the AIIB's communications chief resigned alleging Chinese Communist Party domination, and that Canada froze ties and launched a probe. The government replied that an internal review found no evidence of covert CCP influence, identified governance and HR improvements to pursue as a shareholder, and defended delegated decision-making at the bank as common among multilateral development banks.
The Netherlands will work to ensure proper follow-up on these recommendations.
Nederland zal zich inzetten voor een gedegen opvolging van deze aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Piri en Van der Lee over de levering van F-16’s aan Oekraïne

Three MPs asked the government about the timeline, conditions, pilot training and number of F-16 aircraft to be delivered to Ukraine. The Minister of Defence answered that delivery depends on completed training, infrastructure, coalition coordination and US approval, that the Netherlands expects to make 12 to 18 aircraft available for a training centre in Romania, and that the exact numbers are not yet fixed.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged delivery timeline.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Westerveld over "pgb-zorgverleners zonder sociaal vangnet”

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers whether persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) care workers without social safety nets, including family carers, should receive unemployment, sick-pay and disability benefits after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling, and what would be done. The minister answered that the ruling covers only employment-contract workers under the Rdah, that family carers working on service contracts lack an employment relationship and are excluded, that possible solutions are being explored with a decision expected in autumn, and that extending benefits to the excluded group would cost about 115 million euro structurally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat illegaal teakhout uit Myanmar gebruikt is bij de renovatie van de Groene Draeck

An MP asked whether illegal Myanmar teak was used in the publicly co-funded renovation of the royal yacht Groene Draeck, whether its origin can be verified, and whether an independent investigation will be held. The Prime Minister replied that the renovation is a matter for the Royal Household, that the wood was bought from a German supplier within the EU with a due diligence declaration, that its origin cannot be traced because records were discarded, and that no independent investigation is warranted.
The public interest is not at stake, and I therefore see no reason for an investigation.
Het openbaar belang is niet aan de orde, en ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding voor onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het artikel “Betaald voetbal predikte loonmatiging tijdens corona, maar spelers kregen meer”.

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether Eredivisie clubs that received NOW wage subsidies while promising wage restraint had acted improperly, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that loonmatiging was not a NOW condition, that UWV checks eligibility and may reclaim subsidy in case of non-compliance with NOW rules, and that no sector-specific agreements with the KNVB or clubs existed.
Wage restraint was not a condition for the NOW and is therefore not a relevant factor in the determination.
Loonmatiging was geen voorwaarde voor de NOW en is dus geen relevante factor in de vaststelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over seizoensarbeid

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the seasonal-work exception to the fixed-term chain rule's break period is kept, whether seasonal workers can be kept in repeated temporary contracts without a permanent contract, and whether seasonal work can be legally defined. The Minister answered that the exception stays because it balances worker protection and employer needs, that collective agreements designate the functions and enforcement lies with social partners, and that a statutory definition for a differentiated unemployment premium is not feasible.
I therefore do not intend to remove the existing possibility that collective agreements can designate functions of recurring temporary work for which a 3-month break applies.
Ik ben dus niet voornemens de bestaande mogelijkheid te schrappen dat bij cao functies voor terugkerend tijdelijk werk aangewezen kunnen worden waarvoor een tussenpoos van 3 maanden geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de instroom in de sociale zekerheid tijdens een crisis

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unemployment benefits (WW) and social assistance (Participatiewet) can cope with a sharp rise in claims during a crisis, what analysis was done, and what lessons apply to the proposed crisis job-retention scheme. The minister answered that WW proved operationally resilient in past crises, that no specific study was done for the Participatiewet, and that the new scheme aims to reduce inflows, while describing lessons from the NOW wage subsidy and the trade-off between wage and income subsidies.
No research was conducted on the Participatiewet regarding the effects of a sharply rising inflow in the event of a crisis.
Er is voor de Participatiewet geen onderzoek gedaan naar de gevolgen van een fors oplopende instroom in het geval van een crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat huurlingen voor het front op de loonlijst staan van Russische bedrijven waartegen nog geen sancties zijn ingesteld

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister whether Russian firms (Rusal, Novatek, PIK Group) that pay mercenaries should be sanctioned, whether the EU should extend sanctions to more sectors, and whether the Wagner group should be listed as a terrorist organisation. The minister answered that sanctions discussions are ongoing in the EU, declined to comment on specific persons or entities, noted existing Wagner sanctions, and explained that terrorism listing requires conditions not currently met.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch position in these negotiations to make public statements about specific persons and entities.
Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse inzet in deze onderhandelingen om publiekelijk uitspraken te doen over specifieke personen en entiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van der Plas over het aanpakken van piramidespellen voor jongeren

MPs Van der Lee and Van der Plas asked the government about IM Academy, a pyramid-style scheme targeting young people, including whether it should be banned and whether regulators should investigate. The Minister of Finance replied that the company is not yet proven to have breached Dutch law, that enforcement is for the competent regulators (ACM, AFM), and that no investigations can be announced.
At this moment I see no reason to conduct further research.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over aanpassingen in de WW premiedifferentiatie

An MP from GroenLinks asks why the line between on-call and other contracts under the lower WW premium is unclear, why the government dropped planned changes to the on-call and Wfsv decrees, and whether that increases misuse risk. The minister answers that the decrees were judged too complex and disproportionate, that monitoring via UWV reports was chosen instead, and that a bill abolishing on-call contracts is in consultation, with the Wab evaluation due around mid-2025.
I have therefore for the time being chosen monitoring.
Ik heb daarom vooralsnog gekozen voor monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Het leed in Hawija erkennen en verzachten is mislukt'

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Defence Minister about reports that Dutch-funded reconstruction in Hawija failed to directly compensate bombing victims, including questions on individual compensation, IOM and UNDP spending, alleged corruption, community involvement and a possible IOB evaluation. The Minister defended the 2020 decision for collective voluntary compensation, reported project outcomes, said there is no evidence of corruption in the final reports, declined an IOB study for now, and noted a possible virtual visit to Hawija.
Defence is in discussion with IOM about whether and how the financial accountability can be shared with your House.
Defensie is in gesprek met IOM of en hoe de financiële verantwoording met uw Kamer kan worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over ambitieuze implementatie van standaarden voor duurzaamheidsverslaggeving

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister about the Commission's draft ESRS sustainability reporting standards, which weaken EFRAG advice by making biodiversity transition plans voluntary, making all disclosures subject to materiality, and widening phase-in exceptions. The Minister broadly supports the materiality approach but says she regrets the lower ambition, will argue in the consultation for mandatory biodiversity transition plans, retained phase-ins and a justification for non-material themes, and will not push other member states to object now.
I therefore advocate maintaining the reporting obligation on the biodiversity transition plan from the EFRAG advice in the ESRS.
Ik pleit daarom voor het handhaven van de rapportageverplichting ten aanzien van het transitieplan voor biodiversiteit uit het EFRAG-advies in de ESRS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kathmann over een uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over het uitzendbeding

MPs Van der Lee and Kathmann asked the minister about the Supreme Court ruling on the temp-agency termination clause and its consequences, including repeated four-week contracts, misuse against holiday pay and pregnancy, and whether the ketenbepaling should apply to phase A. The minister explained the new cao rules, acknowledged some reports of misuse, but declined to extend the chain rule to phase A or change the four-week minimum, promising only an exploratory review of sick-leave termination.
Under the law there is no obligation whatsoever regarding the duration of such an agreement.
Op basis van de wet geldt geen enkele verplichting voor de duur van een dergelijke afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Israël maakt bouw van illegale nederzettingen een stuk gemakkelijker'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Foreign Minister about Israel's move to ease the approval process for settlement construction in the occupied West Bank, and what the Netherlands will do about it, including EU action and an independent review of Dutch discouragement policy toward companies. The minister condemns the change, says the Netherlands and EU have voiced opposition and will keep supporting a two-state solution, but declines an independent review, saying Dutch firms are already informed of the discouragement policy.
On behalf of the cabinet, I have publicly expressed my concerns about this development.
Ik heb namens het kabinet publiekelijk mijn zorgen geuit over deze ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een CBS-onderzoek naar graaiflatie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a CBS survey on whether firms pass on cost increases, and whether 'profit-driven inflation' can be inferred from such surveys, questioning the survey's methodology and question wording. The minister rejected the term 'graaiflatie', defended the survey's method and its split question, and declined to commission new research, saying CBS is independent.
At this moment we see no reason to commission additional research into the extent to which companies can pass on their higher costs to customers and what obstacles they encounter.

Op dit moment zien wij geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek uit te zetten naar de mate waarin bedrijven hun hogere kosten kunnen doorberekenen aan hun klanten en tegen welke obstakels zij aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat het BKR de bewaartermijn van BKR-registraties bekort

The MPs asked why the BKR shortens registration of debt-relief only to six months after a completed debt-relief trajectory while full debt repayment keeps credit data for five years, and why that is not equal treatment. The minister confirmed the change, explained that debt-relief registrations are separate from credit registrations, said the credit retention period will be set in a bill to be shortened from five to three years, and rejected a general shortening for everyone who repays in full.
Keeping credit registered for a longer period allows credit providers to consult this data when assessing whether granting a new credit is responsible.
Het langere tijd geregistreerd laten staan van krediet stelt de kredietverstrekkers in staat om deze gegevens te raadplegen bij de beoordeling of het verstrekken van een nieuw krediet verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Racismecoördinator: 'Structurele discriminatie van moslims bij banken'

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Finance about reports that the national anti-racism coordinator found structural discrimination of Muslims by banks under the anti-money-laundering law (Wwft), and whether the Wwft is applied in a discriminatory way. The minister said she is shocked, is investigating discriminatory elements with banks, DNB and AFM, will report back in an autumn update, and will first gain a better picture before considering changes to Wwft guidelines.
Following the signals from the NCRD, I want to investigate the presence of discriminatory elements in the approach to money laundering, terrorist financing and fraud.
Mede naar aanleiding van de signalen van de NCRD, wil ik de aanwezigheid van discriminerende elementen in de aanpak van witwassen, financieren van terrorisme en fraude onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee, Dassen en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Germany unsure if Orbán fit to be ‘EU president’'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks, Volt and VVD asked whether Hungary's upcoming EU Council presidency in July–December 2024 is acceptable given its unresolved rule-of-law and corruption problems, its Article 7 procedure, and risks to the MFF and Ukraine solidarity, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister replied that the rotation follows the agreed Council decision, that the cabinet will stress Hungary's presidency duties and keep pressing on rule of law, that it will not seek to change the rotation, and that it has no information on Germany opposing the presidency.
In the run-up to the Hungarian EU presidency, the cabinet will, together with as many like-minded member states as possible, emphasise that it expects Hungary to meet these responsibilities.
Het kabinet zal in aanloop naar het Hongaarse EU-voorzitterschap, samen met zo veel mogelijk gelijkgezinde lidstaten, benadrukken te verwachten dat Hongarije deze verantwoordelijkheden nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een waardevast minimumloon

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the development of the statutory minimum wage relative to inflation, international comparisons, and whether indexation should be changed to include a CPI floor. The Minister answers with data, says the evaluation and cabinet response on adequacy come in autumn, and rejects changing the indexation method, arguing it would raise public spending and risk job losses.
I will then send the evaluation to the House together with a cabinet response.
Ik zal de evaluatie dan samen met een reactie van het kabinet aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Van der Lee over het bericht 'OESO tikt Just Eat Takeaway op de vingers om tegenwerking vakbondsvorming'

MPs Thijssen and Van der Lee asked the minister whether the government will hold Just Eat Takeaway to account after the OECD National Contact Point found it violated trade union rights and the OECD Guidelines, and what consequences apply when a firm rejects such a ruling. The minister answered that the Guidelines are voluntary but the government attaches consequences to non-compliance, such as withholding trade support, procurement exclusion options and talks with the company, and noted the NCP ruling supports Israeli couriers without a direct Dutch role.
Compliance is not legally enforceable. The NCP is a non-judicial complaints mechanism.
Naleving is niet juridisch afdwingbaar. Het NCP is een niet-juridisch klachtenmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboeren Van der Lee over private deelname in TenneT Duitsland na verkoop door de Nederlandse Staat

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked the ministers of Finance and Climate about possible private participation in the German TenneT grid after the Dutch state's sale, and about the risks to the energy transition. The ministers answered that the Dutch TenneT stays fully state-owned, that the sale is negotiated and not yet concluded, and that the government cannot guarantee the future ownership of German TenneT.
We will inform your House before the summer about the status of the negotiations.
Wij zullen uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de status van de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over lonen en winsten

Opposition MP Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether wages will keep pace with profits, and whether profit-driven inflation is occurring in the Netherlands and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that wage-setting is primarily for employers and employees, that wages are now rising substantially, and that the government will review the cost-of-living and tax picture in August while the ACM monitors market competition.
Setting wages is in the first instance a matter for employers and employees.
Het vaststellen van lonen is in eerste instantie aan werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Gewiekst vindt graanhandelaar Cargill toch weer een route om belasting te ontwijken, via Nederland

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance whether multinationals such as Cargill still avoid tax via the Netherlands and Luxembourg, and how such structures work. The government says it cannot discuss individual firms due to tax secrecy, points to anti-avoidance measures and the coming Pillar 2 minimum tax, and sees no need for additional measures yet.
I cannot discuss the tax situation of an individual company because of the tax secrecy obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR).
Ik kan niet ingaan op de fiscale situatie van een individueel bedrijf vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Thijssen over het vermoeden van het afnemen van Russisch uranium door de Nederlandse kerncentrale in Borssele

Opposition MPs asked whether the Borssele nuclear plant (EPZ) may be supplying Russia's war effort through fuel-element trade and reprocessing of uranium in Russia, and asked about export controls, EU sanctions and oversight. The minister answered that EPZ says it no longer trades directly with Russia, that the regulator sees no signs of irregularities, that EU sanctions on Russian nuclear supplies lack support, and that Euratom and the IAEA do not oversee Russian nuclear revenues.
In general, the cabinet makes no statements regarding commercially confidential information.
Antwoord 2 In het algemeen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken ten aanzien van bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over de werkwijze van de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO)

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee ask whether DUO misuses the Passport Act to list former students abroad and whether a former student must repay study finance despite timely graduation. The minister denies misuse, explains the conditions for passport signalling, says the hardship clause is theoretically available, and promises a review of statutory deadlines.
I intend to conduct a study into the various deadlines in the law and whether they still fit how we now view our citizens and their capacity to act.
Ik ben voornemens om een onderzoek te doen naar de verschillende termijnen in de wet en of die nog passen bij hoe we nu naar onze burgers kijken en hun doenvermogen.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over de ophanden zijnde juridische hervormingen in Israël

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister about proposed Israeli judicial reforms curbing the Supreme Court, their effect on democracy and on Palestinians' legal recourse, and what Netherlands and EU steps are possible. The minister called the reforms concerning for judicial independence, said Netanyahu paused them for talks, and described raising concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
An independent judiciary is the foundation of a democratic constitutional state.
Een onafhankelijke rechterlijke macht is het fundament voor een democratische rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Van der Graaf, Van der Lee, Klink, Jasper van Dijk en Thijssen over de situatie in Turkije en Syrië na de aardbevingen van 5/6 februari jl.

Members of parliament asked about access for international aid to Syria after the February 2023 earthquakes, the role of civil society in opposition areas, EU reconstruction funding, psychosocial and care needs, and aid worker safety. The minister answered that aid access to northwest Syria remains dependent on Turkey-based UN deliveries, that the EU is coordinating mid- to long-term support through existing channels, and that psychosocial support is integrated into programmes.

As promised during the committee debate on humanitarian aid after the earthquake in Turkey and Syria of 22 February, I asked the European Commission on behalf of the cabinet, ahead of the EU donor conference, to prepare a proposal for medium- and long-term aid and to coordinate its implementation.

Zoals toegezegd tijdens het commissiedebat Humanitaire Hulp na de aardbeving in Turkije en Syrië van 22 februari jl. heb ik voorafgaand aan de EU-donorconferentie namens het kabinet de Europese Commissie verzocht een voorstel te maken voor het leveren van middellange- en lange-termijnhulp en de implementatie hiervan te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat een ex-werknemer van ASML bedrijfsinformatie verduisterde

An MP asked the minister whether a former ASML employee who allegedly stole company data was dismissed, what protocols prevent such theft, what information was taken, and whether this affects chip export agreements with China. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, saying companies are primarily responsible for their own information security, and said the incident does not affect chip exports to China while referring to earlier export-control letters.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraak over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van der Lee over de verhuizing van Ferrovial

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance about Ferrovial's planned move of its top holding company to the Netherlands, including contacts with Dutch bodies, possible tax arrangements, and revenue effects. The State Secretary answered that the company gave no tax motives, that the Tax Authority cannot disclose a taxpayer's fiscal position, that no recent Tax Authority contact occurred, and that revenue effects cannot be reliably estimated.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act, however, it is not permitted to make information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer publicly known.
Op basis van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen is het echter niet toegestaan informatie over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige voor iedereen kenbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over de Nederlandse steun voor het project van Boskalis in Manila

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the government about Dutch support (export credit insurance) for Boskalis's New Manila International Airport project, including alleged rights and environmental harms, information-sharing, compensation of fishers and the Global Witness allegations. The government answered that ADSB and Boskalis meet OECD/UN standards, that compensation is being carried out under monitoring by independent consultants, and that it sees no need for additional measures or an independent investigation, while commissioning a monitoring review by Steward Redqueen.
This picture is confirmed by ADSB, which had an independent consultant investigate this aspect.
Dit beeld wordt bevestigd door ADSB die een onafhankelijke consultant onderzoek heeft laten doen naar dit aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over vergiftiging van schoolmeisjes in Iran

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about the poisoning of about 700 Iranian schoolgirls, whether the regime is responsible, and whether the Netherlands will push for ICC investigation and evidence-gathering programmes. The minister condemned the poisonings, said the perpetrators are unknown though Iranian authorities announced an inquiry and arrests, and explained that an ICC referral is legally unavailable while Nederland supports the UN Fact Finding Mission and evidence guidelines.
The cabinet will continue to closely follow this.
Het kabinet zal dit op de voet blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over uitspraken van de Israëlische Minister van Financiën en verdere escalatie van het geweld

MP Van der Lee asks the Foreign Minister to confirm and condemn Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich's call for the Palestinian village of Hawara to be wiped out, and asks what concrete steps the Netherlands and the EU will take to halt escalating violence, protect Palestinians, and secure accountability. The minister confirms the remarks, calls them unacceptable, and repeats calls for de-escalation and support for regional initiatives, but says Dutch options for concrete protection are limited and EU action remains under discussion.
It is in the interest of both parties to prevent further escalation.
Het is in het belang van beide partijen om verdere escalatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het bericht dat teakhout uit Myanmar illegaal bij Nederlandse superjachtbouwers belandt

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the ministers about reports that illegal teak from Myanmar reaches Dutch superyacht builders despite EU sanctions on Myanmar Timber Enterprise, and about enforcement differences across member states, a total import ban, and humanitarian support. The government answered that sanctions are strictly implemented in the Netherlands, that enforcement is a national competence, that companies are responsible for compliance, and that it is pursuing EU-level clarification, while offering no commitment to a total ban beyond the existing de facto ban via MTE sanctions.
The Netherlands interprets and implements EU sanctions in a strict manner. Enforcement of sanctions is a national competence.
Nederland interpreteert en implementeert EU-sancties op een strikte manier. Handhaving van sancties is een nationale competentie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over de uitzending van Tegenlicht van donderdag 26 januari en het initiatief Collectief Kapitaal

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the Collectief Kapitaal initiative, which gives cash payments to participants and holds ANBI status as a knowledge institution, is treated as income, and about related policy. The government answered that tax treatment depends on the facts, that it cannot disclose details of an individual ANBI under secrecy rules, and that it will follow such small private initiatives and consult municipalities.
Because the Tax Administration is bound by the secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), no further information can be provided about individual institutions.

Omdat de Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het afbouwpad van fossiele subsidies

GreenLeft MPs asked why a 2018 motion to phase out fiscal incentives undermining climate goals has not been fully implemented, why many fossil-energy exemptions remain, and for details on the largest emitters' benefits, the refinery exemption, free ETS allowances and related schemes. The government answered that it is phasing out some exemptions and plans a transparency action plan, cited treaty and double-taxation constraints, but declined to disclose company-level benefits citing confidentiality.
Regarding individual companies' entitlement to exemptions, subsidies and other benefits, as far as known, I cannot go into it due to confidentiality.
Op de aanspraak van individuele bedrijven op vrijstellingen, subsidies en andere voordelen, voor zover bekend, kan ik uit hoofde van vertrouwelijkheid niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de gewelddadige aanslagen in Palestina en Israël en de dreiging van escalatie van het conflict

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about the lethal Israeli operation in Jenin, a deadly attack on a Jerusalem synagogue, calls for condemnation and EU follow-up, and why the Netherlands abstained on the UN resolution referring the occupation to the ICJ.
