The minister expressed concern, called on both sides to de-escalate and to respect international law, and explained the abstention by late timing and wording concerns, without committing to new concrete steps.
The Netherlands actively works within the EU to bring balance to the designation of the holy sites.
Nederland zet zich actief in binnen EU-verband om balans in te brengen in de aanduiding van de heilige plaatsen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het actieplan Nederland-Marokko

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked about the Netherlands-Morocco action plan, its timing relative to journalist Omar Radi's conviction, a clause on non-interference in internal affairs, and advance notice of NGO funding. The minister answered that the Netherlands took the initiative, that the plan is a non-binding cooperation document, that human rights remain part of dialogue despite the non-interference clause, and that the parties agreed to inform each other in advance of project funding, without inspection or approval.
The cabinet sees no link between the date of Mr. Radi's conviction and the date of signing of the action plan
Het kabinet ziet geen verband tussen de datum van de veroordeling van dhr. Radi en de datum van ondertekening van het actieplan

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de onafhankelijke review naar de veiligheidssituatie LNG project Mozambique

An MP asked why the government has not yet sent Parliament the promised independent review of the security situation at the Mozambique LNG project, and whether it will arrive before year end. The State Secretary says the review was extended with an additional assignment, the final report is expected in February 2023 with a policy response before the 23 February debate, and gives a brief security update.

The expectation is that the final report will be delivered in February, so that it, accompanied by a policy response, can be sent to your House before the committee debate on export credit insurance of 23 February 2023.

De verwachting is dat het eindrapport in februari zal worden opgeleverd, zodat het, vergezeld van een beleidsreactie, voorafgaand aan het commissiedebat exportkredietverzekeringen van 23 februari 2023 aan uw Kamer kan worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee inzake ‘fossiele investeringen met Europees geld

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister whether the EU REPowerEU negotiations were in their final stage, whether Do No Significant Harm exceptions should be subject to Commission review, whether oil should be excluded from REPowerEU financing, and whether the Commission should assess EU supply-security needs first. The minister answered that a provisional agreement was reached on 14 December 2022, that the Netherlands pushed for justification and narrower exceptions, that oil is excluded except for states exempted under the sixth and ninth sanctions packages, and that the Commission assesses how plans contribute to REPowerEU goals.
The Netherlands kept arguing in the negotiations for proper justification by member states if the Do-No-Significant-Harm exception is used within the REPowerEU chapter.

Nederland is in de onderhandelingen blijven pleiten voor een goede onderbouwing door lidstaten als binnen het REPowerEU-hoofdstuk van de Do-No-Significant-Harm -uitzondering (hierna: DNSH) gebruik gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over het bericht ‘Bedreigde Iraans-Nederlandse activist kreeg telkens nul op rekest bij Nederlandse politie voordat hij werd vermoord’

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked how police failed to protect an Iranian-Dutch activist who reported repeated threats before being murdered, whether a reporting point for diaspora threats and stronger measures against foreign-regime intimidation are planned, and whether embassies of Morocco, Turkey, China and Iran were confronted. The minister declined to discuss the specific case for security reasons, said protection responsibility lies with local authorities, outlined diplomatic sanctions and a three-track approach, and promised further information on a reporting point.
For security reasons I cannot go into a specific case or the considerations made or not made.
Omwille van veiligheidsredenen kan ik niet ingaan op een specifieke casus en de afwegingen die wel of niet gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het standpunt van het kabinet inzake mensenrechten en internationale sporttoernooien

MPs Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the government how it will respond to calls from KNVB and FNV to improve migrant worker rights in Qatar ahead of the World Cup, and how it intends to influence sports federations and FIFA on human rights and compensation. The ministers answered that constructive-critical diplomacy and dialogue with Qatar are the chosen approach, noting reforms but ongoing concerns, and largely pointed to sports federations, companies and the KNVB for further action while expressing openness to compensation and diplomatic support.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to operate in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de VN-richtlijnen voor bedrijfsleven en mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Piri over het bericht dat Israël een recent gebouwde Palestijnse basisschool heeft verwoest

MPs Van der Lee and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Israeli forces demolished a Palestinian primary school in Masafer Yatta, its legality under the UN Children's Rights Convention, the threatened forced relocation of residents, and the Netherlands' settlement discouragement policy. The minister said the Netherlands and the EU have raised serious concerns bilaterally and in EU statements, reiterated Israel's international obligations, and described the settlement discouragement policy's scope without listing concrete annual targets or results.
The Dutch discouragement policy applies to activities of Dutch companies when they directly contribute to the establishment and maintenance of settlements.
Het Nederlandse ontmoedigingsbeleid is van toepassing op activiteiten van Nederlandse bedrijven als zij direct bijdragen aan de aanleg en instandhouding van nederzettingen.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van der Lee en Thijssen over de intentieverklaring tussen Nederland en met Oman over samenwerking op het gebied van groene waterstof

MPs Kröger, Van der Lee and Thijssen asked why the Dutch-Omani green hydrogen memorandum lacks safeguards on human rights, environment and labour rights, given Oman's weak labour record and the port of Sohar joint venture. The government answered that MoUs are non-binding, that Dutch companies must apply OECD due diligence, that an IMVO risk analysis on hydrogen chains is under way, and that future MoUs may refer to the SDGs.
A letter of intent does not create legally binding agreements from which safeguards, rights or obligations can be derived.
In een intentieverklaring worden geen juridisch bindende afspraken gemaakt waaraan waarborgen, rechten of plichten kunnen worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over Iraanse studenten in Nederland

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked how many Iranian students and academics are in the Netherlands, how institutions support them amid protests in Iran, and what consequences the protests have for cooperation with Iranian institutions. The minister gave counts (424 Iranian first-nationality HBO and 475 WO students), described existing support services and cooperation, and provided no commitments to new action.
For staff data, educational institutions are bound by privacy legislation. Nationality is a special category of personal data that may not simply be disclosed.
Voor de personeelsgegevens geldt dat onderwijsinstellingen gehouden zijn aan de privacywetgeving. Nationaliteit is een bijzonder persoonsgegeven dat niet zondermeer mag worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Van der Lee over het duurzaamheidsrisicobeheer van banken

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about an ECB study finding that 96% of banks have blind spots in managing environmental risks, and about monitoring of the financial sector's climate commitment. The Minister agreed the findings are worrying, said DNB received a better picture of Dutch banks but the results are confidential and not publishable, and promised a letter on the first progress report and a later report on 2030 targets.
The research results are based on supervisory-confidential information and I do not have authority over that.
De onderzoeksresultaten zijn gebaseerd op toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie en daarover beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het stoppen van fossiele subsidies in 2023

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the Netherlands' signing of the Glasgow declaration commits it to ending direct state support for the international fossil energy sector by end-2022, whether phasing out is compatible with that commitment, and whether other countries' non-signature should affect Dutch implementation. The government confirms it will end new support for fossil energy activities by end-2022 with narrow exceptions aligned with 1.5°C and EU energy security, referring to a letter of 3 November 2022 and an assessment framework.
The cabinet is not opting for gradual phase-out but for ending new support that is not in line with the declaration by the end of 2022.
Het kabinet kiest niet voor stapsgewijze uitfasering, maar voor beëindiging van nieuwe steun, die niet in lijn is met de verklaring, per eind 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het recent uitgebrachte VN rapport over de mensenrechtenschendingen jegens de Oeigoeren in Xinjiang

MP Van der Lee asked the government about the UN OHCHR report on serious human rights violations against Uyghurs in Xinjiang, whether it changes Dutch policy, the share of Dutch trade with Xinjiang, and whether trade measures or mandatory supply-chain due diligence should follow. The ministers answered that the report is credible, Dutch policy is unchanged, Xinjiang accounts for under 1% of trade with China, and they pointed to EU and national due diligence and forced-labour proposals, while stating Nederland cannot unilaterally impose trade measures and that Dutch efforts continue in the Human Rights Council.
As an EU member state, the Netherlands cannot independently introduce a trade measure.
Nederland kan als EU-lidstaat niet zelfstandig een handelsmaatregel introduceren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Kuzu, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Brekelmans, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons en Piri over het bericht dat waarnemers van de Organisatie voor Veiligheid en Samenwerkin

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about two Ukrainian OSCE staff members sentenced to over ten years by courts in the unrecognised Luhansk region, asking about their detention conditions, pressure on Russia, evacuation of local staff, and whether Turkey could help secure their release. The minister confirmed the sentences, said detention location is unknown, listed joint EU and OSCE calls for release, and said the OSCE Secretary General is working on their release.
At this time it is not known where the detainees are being held.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend waar de gevangenen worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het op grote schaal dumpen van plastic afval in landen als Vietnam & Indonesië door Nederland

An MP asked the government about Dutch plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries such as Indonesia and Vietnam, which reportedly doubled and may end up dumped or burned. The minister acknowledged the concern, said export is allowed only for clean recyclable waste under strict rules, and pointed to the pending EU Waste Shipment Regulation revision and enforcement measures.
However, I believe the rules for exports from the EU should be further tightened, which is also currently happening in the ongoing revision of the European Waste Shipment Regulation (EVOA).

Wel ben ik van mening dat de regels voor export uit de EU verder moeten worden aangescherpt, wat op dit moment ook gebeurt in de huidige herziening van de Europese Verordening Overbrenging Afvalstoffen (EVOA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Studieschuld niet afbetaald? Dan geen paspoort. 'Ik begrijp niet waarom Duo dit doet''

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked the ministers about DUO withholding passports from former students with unpaid study debt, including whether this is a fair pressure tool and how often hardship clauses are used. The government answered that DUO uses passport signalling only as a last resort, that the Paspoortwet legally allows it to protect state finances, and that the Staatssecretaris of BZK will evaluate the system.
DUO does not register how often a tailored solution is reached or how often the hardship clause is applied.
DUO registreert niet hoe vaak een maatwerkoplossing getroffen wordt of de hardheidsclausule wordt toegepast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Kuzu, Van der Lee en Piri over het feit dat Taiwan graag waarnemend lid wil worden van de Internationale Burgerluchtvaartorganisatie

MPs from seven parties asked the government about Taiwan's wish to become an observer at the ICAO, including whether it could be invited under the Council's rules, its safety relevance for flights, and whether the Netherlands would support its participation at the 41st Assembly. The minister answered that Taiwan could in principle be invited as an 'other body' observer to the Council only if China agreed, is excluded from the Assembly under Taiwan's non-state status, and that the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwan participation in coordination with like-minded countries while respecting its one-China policy.
Taiwan is not considered a state by the Netherlands and most other states in the world and therefore cannot in principle participate as an observer in these meetings.
Taiwan wordt door Nederland en de meeste andere staten in de wereld niet als staat beschouwd en kan daarom in principe niet als waarnemer aan deze vergaderingen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de aanzwellende protesten in Iran na de dood van de vrouw Mahsa Amini

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about protests in Iran after Mahsa Amini's death, her treatment by the religious police, and the protests' economic dimension. The minister says Netherlands has repeatedly called for an impartial investigation, condemned the repression, and will push for EU human rights sanctions and an EU statement at the Foreign Affairs Council.
The Netherlands further works towards introducing EU human rights sanctions.
Nederland zet zich voorts in voor het instellen van EU-Mensenrechtensancties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'The backdoor that keeps Russian oil flowing into Europe’

An MP asked the ministers whether Shell and other firms blend Russian fuel into diesel to evade the appearance of Russian origin, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that origin is assessed case by case under EU customs rules, that no signals of breaches by Shell were found, that indirect Russian oil may still enter the mix, and that the government is preparing possible further sanctions and a phase-out plan, but the answer was given late.
I have no signals that Shell, or other European parties, are not complying with the European sanctions rules.
Ik heb geen signalen dat Shell, of andere Europese partijen, zich niet aan de Europese sanctieregels houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Bromet en Van der Lee over door de Nederlandse regering erkende MTCS-certificaten voor Maleisisch hout

Greens MPs asked the state secretary about a lawsuit by timber firm Samling against the NGO SAVE Rivers over MTCS-certified timber, whether MTCS should be suspended, and related Tropical Timber Organisation funding. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the lawsuit and said TPAC would be asked to discuss the complaints with PEFC International, while stating TPAC has no independent power to act beyond the minister's request.
I will ask TPAC to discuss with PEFC International, following the signals I have received about MTCS, the signals and how they were handled.
Ik zal TPAC verzoeken om, naar aanleiding van de door mij ontvangen signalen over MTCS, in gesprek te gaan met PEFC International 3 over de signalen en de wijze waarop deze zijn opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat Hongarije toestemming geeft voor de bouw van twee Russische kerncentrales

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Hungary approving two Russian-built nuclear reactors, the Hungarian decision's conflict with EU sanctions aims, and whether Rosatom should be sanctioned. The minister said the decision does not breach EU law, that the cabinet will keep raising EU unity and energy dependence, and that he supports further sanctions but will not comment on specific listing proposals.
The cabinet supports additional sanctions measures but makes no statements about specific listing proposals.
Het kabinet is voorstander van aanvullende sanctiemaatregelen, maar doet geen uitlatingen over specifieke listingsvoorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het artikel ‘Sancties tegen Russen bleven maand liggen.’

An MP asked the ministers why Dutch enforcement of Russia sanctions was delayed by more than a month after the Chamber of Commerce held relevant data, and whether the delay was caused by legal issues and how recurrence will be prevented. The minister answered that the data could not be shared without a legal basis, that the legal gaps are being closed through changes to the sanctions regulation and modernisation of the sanctions system, and that a permanent sanctions team has been set up.

The sharing of these personal data was partly addressed with the amendment of the sanctions regulation in April, but it became clear that a more structural modernisation of the sanctions system would be needed.

Het delen van deze persoonsgegevens is met de wijziging van sanctieregeling territoriale integriteit Oekraïne 2014 in april deels ondervangen, maar duidelijk werd dat een meer structurele modernisering van het sanctiestelsel nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de Fiscale Monitor

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretaries of Finance about questions and statements in the Fiscale Monitor, including statements on childcare benefit fraud and whether the survey asks about the Tax Authority's harshness and courtesy. The government answered that the survey measures tax and benefit morale, that it is not designed to question people's honesty, that wording will be reviewed, and that an external review is planned.
The wording of the statements used to measure morale will be evaluated and adjusted where necessary.
De bewoordingen van de gebruikte stellingen waarmee moraal wordt gemeten, zullen worden geëvalueerd en waar nodig worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht dat er 8 olietankers met Russische fossiele brandstof op weg zijn naar de havens van Rotterdam en Amsterdam

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether eight tankers carrying Russian fossil fuels bound for Rotterdam and Amsterdam could be refused entry, and whether the government would act against such vessels. The government answered that Dutch law under current EU sanctions does not allow refusal of non-Russian-flagged tankers, that an EU oil import ban will take effect after transition periods, and that it has no further legal grounds to block the ships.
At present it is not possible for the government to refuse non-Russian-flagged ships carrying Russian oil products.
Van regeringswege is het op dit moment niet mogelijk om niet-Russisch gevlagde schepen met Russische olie(producten) te weren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekoek en Van der Lee over noodvisa voor journalisten

MPs Koekkoek and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister how Dutch posts in Russia can continue supporting human rights defenders and journalists after the expulsion of diplomats, and why emergency visas for at-risk journalists are not more readily available given EU guidelines and a parliamentary motion. The minister answered that support continues in limited form, that humanitarian visas remain possible in exceptional cases, that a band-with-the-Netherlands criterion applies under the Visa Code, and that ministries are still studying how to implement the motion.
The Ministries of Foreign Affairs and of Justice and Security are jointly examining the possibilities to implement the above-mentioned Dassen and Van der Lee motion.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid bekijken gezamenlijk de mogelijkheden om uitvoering te geven aan de bovengenoemde motie-Dassen en Van der Lee
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het omzeilen van regels door cryptobedrijven

An MP asked the Finance Minister about foreign crypto firms offering products to Dutch consumers without DNB registration, enforcement gaps, and whether crypto advertising should be restricted like gambling ads. The minister answered that registration is mandatory, DNB handles cases on signals, MiCA will address third-country providers and advertising at EU level, and a youth awareness campaign is planned.
If there is a suspicion that a crypto service provider does not comply with the registration obligation, DNB starts a case.
Indien het vermoeden bestaat dat een cryptodienstverlener niet aan de registratieplicht voldoet start DNB een zaak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Piri, Kuzu, Teunissen, Stoffer, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Brekelmans en Dassen over het gebrek aan humanitaire toegang in de Tigray-regio in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the lack of humanitarian access to Tigray, Ethiopia, including calls for UN investigations, sanctions, safe zones and press freedom. The minister answered that Nederland supports independent investigation and humanitarian access, has pressed for sanctions and an arms embargo within the EU without sufficient support, and will raise press access with the EU Special Envoy.
The Netherlands will continue to press, in EU and international contexts, on the three priorities mentioned above.
Nederland zal zich in blijven zetten, in EU- en internationaal verband, op de hierboven genoemde drie prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Israëlische ordetroepen gebruiken geweld bij begrafenis Al Jazeera-journalist’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli security forces disrupting the funeral procession of Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh and whether an independent investigation could be pursued. The minister condemned the excessive conduct, welcomed Israel's own police inquiry, and said the Netherlands supports a joint investigation with possible international third-party support.
The conduct of the Israeli security forces that day was excessive.
Het optreden van de Israëlische veiligheidstroepen was die dag buitensporig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Journalist Al Jazeera doodgeschoten op Westelijke Jordaanoever'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the shooting of Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh on the West Bank, whether it condemns the act, and whether it will press Israel for an independent investigation and better protection of journalists. The minister said the government is shocked, has called publicly and to Israeli and Palestinian counterparts for a thorough, transparent investigation, and will raise concerns with authorities, but gave no firm commitments beyond that.
In addition, I have called for a thorough and transparent investigation with the aim of bringing the facts to light.
Daarbij heb ik tevens opgeroepen tot een grondig en transparant onderzoek met als doel de feiten boven tafel te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Lee, Kröger, Piri en Thijssen over het bericht dat Rusland stopt met het leveren van aardas aan Polen en Bulgarije

MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about Russia halting gas supplies to Poland and Bulgaria, Dutch firms' dealings with Gazprom and Gazprombank, EU and Dutch preparedness for next winter, and whether Russian state firms like Gazprom can be sanctioned out of the Dutch energy system. The minister answered that Dutch firms' use of Gazprombank and new Gazprom contracts is unknown, that the Dutch plans are set out in earlier letters, that the Bergermeer storage cost levy is still being designed, and that the legal options to exclude Russian firms are under study with a further letter promised.
The House will be further informed about this.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer nog nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over beschoten Palestijnen

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank, including a shooting near Surif, rising incidents, and lack of prosecution, and about Israel's new government and diplomatic steps. The minister answers that the government consistently raises settlements and settler violence with Israel, notes concern but limited policy change, and promises a letter on his visit.
The cabinet is very concerned about the violence by settlers.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over het geweld door kolonisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk asielzoekers een enkele reis Rwanda geeft

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether the government shares concerns about the UK plan to send some asylum seekers one-way to Rwanda, including human rights and refugee convention compliance, and whether it would confront the UK. The government answered that the UK is outside EU asylum law but bound by the Refugee Convention and ECHR, that Rwanda's human rights concerns depend on implementation, and that it would raise the matter bilaterally or internationally only if international law were shown to be breached.
Should it turn out that the UK is thereby violating international law, the cabinet will raise this both bilaterally and internationally.
Wanneer zou blijken dat het VK hiermee internationaal recht schendt, zal het kabinet dit aankaarten op zowel bilateraal als internationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een artikel in Trouw over mogelijke betalingen aan IS, corruptie en fraude door Ericsson in Irak

An MP asked ministers about a Trouw report on alleged payments to IS, corruption and fraud by Ericsson in Iraq, including the role of IMVO due diligence rules and alternatives to Huawei and Ericsson for 5G. The minister said terrorism financing is unacceptable and already criminal, that KPN and Ericsson are handling the matter, and that the government has no plans to contact the Swedish government.
Financing terrorism is worrying, unacceptable and punishable.
Het financieren van terrorisme is zorgelijk, onaanvaardbaar en strafbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van der Lee  en Arib over de berichten dat de Belastingdienst discriminerende criteria in de fraudesignalering voorziening (FSV) verzweeg en dat de Belastingdienst op onrechtmati

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Authority concealed discriminatory criteria in the fraud signalling facility (FSV) and unlawfully blocked access to blacklists. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, admitted the ministry knew of the discriminatory handbook since 2020, acknowledged the FSV processing was unlawful and will pay the fines, and said that FSV access requests are being handled and letters sent, while formal refusals of some access requests remain subject to a balancing of interests.
Yes, the manner in which personal data was processed in FSV was unlawful.
Ja, de wijze van verwerking van persoonsgegevens in FSV was onrechtmatig.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, die 5 jaar geleden ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneemt om haar terug te krijgen in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Legal Protection what concrete steps the government has taken to bring Dutch child Insiya back from India, whether Dutch court rulings oblige her return, and whether the state visit from India would be used to raise the case. The ministers answered that diplomatic requests, repeated raising in bilateral talks, and handing over Dutch rulings to Indian authorities continue, but that Dutch rulings are not automatically binding in India and the mother must seek enforcement before an Indian court.
The Netherlands closely monitors the rulings in the proceedings in India.
Nederland volgt uitspraken in de procedures in India nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Van der Lee en Omtzigt over de stroperige implementatie van sancties in Nederland

MPs Klaver, Van der Lee and Omtzigt asked why sanctions implementation in the Netherlands is slow and fragmented, covering ministerial responsibility, the tax secrecy exemption, APA/ATR rulings linked to sanctioned persons, frozen assets held by trust offices, and supervision gaps for non-financial assets. The government answered that sanctions coordination and enforcement are split across ministries and the OM, that the Belastingdienst obtained an exemption from tax secrecy and is reviewing rulings, and that a national coordinator's report with recommendations will follow in May.
The national coordinator is preparing a report with recommendations, to be submitted in mid-May and shared with your House.
De nationaal coördinator is bezig met een rapport met aanbevelingen dat medio mei zal worden aangeboden en met uw Kamer zal worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat de Nederlandse Ontwikkelingsbank FMO voor €230 miljoen leningen heeft uitstaan in Oekraïne en buurland Wit-Rusland

An MP asked the ministers about FMO's EUR 230 million in loans in Ukraine and Belarus, the specific activities funded, the financial risks, and the implications for the Dutch state as shareholder. The ministers answered that FMO is monitoring risks, has written down part of its loans, is considering payment suspensions with clients, and that FMO's capital position remains strong, though the full impact is too early to assess.
The Minister of Finance and I will of course keep a close eye on the situation and remain in close contact with FMO about it.
De Minister van Financiën en ik zullen de situatie uiteraard goed in de gaten houden en hierover in nauw contact blijven met FMO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de zorgelijke situatie bij de voormalige kerncentrale in Tsjernobyl

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about the Chernobyl plant's staffing, power supply and radiation monitoring, and what diplomatic routes exist to fix them. The minister answered that the IAEA coordinates on-site risk mitigation, that the plant's grid connection was restored on 14 March, and that short-term radiological risk is considered low, with no new staff rotation yet possible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Kaag wil extra sancties trustkantoren, grote gevolgen voor Zuidas'

MPs Klaver and Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about Russian assets held through Dutch letterbox companies, the effectiveness of sanctions and enforcement, possible bans on trust services, asset confiscation, a global asset registry, anti-abuse and transparency measures, and treaty safe harbours. The minister answered that the government will consider further sanctions including a ban on trust services to Russian and Belarusian clients, that a working group and a trust-sector study are underway, and that EU-level measures and registers are being pursued, while deferring several questions to the State Secretary and other departments.
As Minister of Finance, I do not have data on Russian assets held in Dutch letterbox companies.
Als Minister van Financiën beschik ik niet over data betreffende Russisch vermogen in Nederlandse brievenbusfirma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over het CEP 2022

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the 200 euro energy allowance is enough, what minimum wage indexation alternatives would do to purchasing power, whether a one-off healthcare allowance increase is possible, and for answers before the debate. The government raised the municipal energy allowance reference amount to 800 euro, declined to deviate from the statutory minimum wage indexation method or submit the decision to parliament, and said a one-off care allowance increase is costly and slow to implement.
The cabinet proposes raising the reference amount of the energy allowance to 800 euro and has made 480 million euro extra available for this.
Het kabinet stelt voor om het richtbedrag van de energietoeslag te verhogen naar 800 euro en heeft hier 480 miljoen euro extra voor beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de consul van Rusland in Maastricht

An MP asked whether the minister would summon the Russian honorary consul in Maastricht over his public refusal to condemn Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and whether he supported a petition to close the consulate. The minister said the honorary consul's stance is firmly rejected, that Maastricht sent him a letter, and that the Russian ambassador was summoned and held responsible for the consul's statements, without committing to a separate summons or closure.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly rejects the honorary consul's position.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken keurt het standpunt van de honorair consul ten zeerste af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Lee en Sjoerdsma over de acties van China tegen Litouwen naar aanleiding van het openen van een Vertegenwoordiging van Taiwan in Vilnius

MPs Van der Lee and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister how the government supports Lithuania against Chinese economic coercion after Taiwan opened a representative office in Vilnius, and whether these measures breach WTO rules. The minister replies that the Netherlands expresses solidarity, raised concerns with China, backs the EU's WTO consultation request and the EU anti-coercion instrument, and says businesses are responsible for their own risk analysis while the government monitors the situation.
The cabinet fully supports this step by the EU.
Het kabinet staat volledig achter deze stap van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Ook 200 belastingadviseurs bestempeld als fraudeur: onterecht volgens Achmed, die nu dak- en werkloos is'

An MP asked the government about the Combiteam Aanpak Facilitators (CAF), which labelled about 200 tax advisers as fraudsters, and about asset seizure and compensation for affected advisers and clients. The State Secretary answered that the CAF handled 218 cases, that an external investigation into its working method will be commissioned, and that there is no separate compensation scheme for tax advisers while the restoration operation concerns mainly childcare-benefit victims.
I have decided to have this investigation carried out by an external party.
Ik heb besloten dit onderzoek door een externe partij te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de verduurzaming van de financiële sector

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister about DNB's finding that the Dutch financial sector is greening too slowly, with climate-transition risks rising, weak integration of sustainability risk in risk management, and a low share of firms reporting CO2 impact under the financial sector climate commitment. The minister agrees the findings are concerning, promises stronger expectations from DNB, sector action plans by 2022, and further steps including a summer letter, while stopping short of binding measures and placing the commitment on a voluntary basis.
I therefore call on the sector to go a step further than the current commitment.
Ik roep de sector daarom op een stap verder te zetten ten opzichte van het huidige commitment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over technologieoverdracht aan China

MP Van der Lee asked the government about Dutch companies investing in China, possible circumvention of US sanctions, IMVO and export controls for technology transfer. The minister replied that outward investment monitoring is not planned, existing export controls and IMVO expectations apply, and the issues are raised within the EU.
A mechanism for monitoring outward investments to increase transparency is not something we currently have in the Netherlands or Europe.
Een mechanisme waarbij uitgaande investeringen worden gemonitord om de transparantie te vergroten, kennen we op dit moment niet in Nederland of Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een opmerkelijke ommekeer van de Autoriteit Consument & Markt

An MP asked the ministers why the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) reversed its draft guidance so that network operators may no longer own electrolysers, and whether this hinders the energy transition. The ministers answer that the ACM is entitled to interpret the law, that the legal framework on network operators and electrolysis is unclear, and that they will clarify it through consultation and a future Energy Act, while the existing Gasunie hydrogen storage pilot is unaffected.

Based on the ACM's guidance on network companies and alternative energy carriers, I find that the current statutory provisions on the scope of network companies in relation to electrolysis are not sufficiently clear and are open to interpretation.

Mede op basis van de «Leidraad netwerkbedrijven en alternatieve energiedragers» van de ACM constateer ik dat de huidige wettelijke bepalingen rondom de ruimte van netwerkbedrijven in relatie tot elektrolyse niet voldoende helder zijn en openstaan voor interpretatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het via Nederland wegsluizen van vaccinwinsten door Pfizer

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Pfizer routed about 15 billion dollars of profits, including vaccine profits, through a Dutch conduit company to the United States, why this is possible given the ban on retaining profits, and whether this prompts faster action on the Ter Haar committee's recommendations. The government refused to discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer citing tax secrecy, and pointed to recent anti-avoidance measures, a pending EU proposal and a forthcoming reaction on the committee's recommendations.
Under the tax secrecy obligation laid down in Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht die is neergelegd in artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over jongeren die in crypto’s beleggen

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether young people are exposed to excessive, unwelcome risky crypto investment and advertising, and how the existing rules and the forthcoming MiCA regulation protect them. The minister answers that the risks are concerning, points to existing conduct rules, the AFM's supervision and product intervention powers, and MiCA's fair-conduct and advertising requirements, but does not commit to new measures beyond monitoring and European initiatives.
To protect investors, there are strict requirements for advertising.
Om beleggers te beschermen bestaan er strenge eisen voor reclame-uitingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Alkaya en Dassen over het bericht ‘Belasting besparen: zo doen Zuidas-partners dat’

MPs asked whether Zuidas partners' use of BV structures and DGA arrangements lets them pay less tax than employees, whether the Tax Authority's agreements on reasonable salaries are acceptable, and whether a 20-partner BV constructions should be banned. The State Secretary acknowledges a possible gap, describes the excessive-lending bill and the reasonable-salary rules, says new policy options are unnecessary, and states that ministers' business interests were disclosed under a motion.
The Tax Authority does not address individual cases because of its statutory duty of confidentiality.
De Belastingdienst gaat in verband met zijn wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat de vermogenstaks 2017 en 2018 in strijd zijn met het eigendomsrecht

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance how the government will respond to the Supreme Court ruling that the 2017 and 2018 box 3 wealth levy, based on a fictitious return, violates property rights, including the scope of refunds, budget costs, and whether the switch to actual-return taxation can be accelerated. The State Secretary answers that the consequences and the restoration operation are still being worked out, that the legislation will be amended earlier than 2025 if feasible, and that the Chamber will be informed in early February.
Once the details are clear, I will inform the Chamber about this.
Zodra de uitwerking helder is, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de veroordeling tot vijf jaar van activist Alaa Abdel Fattah door Egypte

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the five-year sentence of activist Alaa Abdel Fattah in Egypt, his detention conditions, and possible EU sanctions. The minister confirmed the sentence, said Dutch concerns were conveyed privately and publicly, and declined to consider sanctions as not opportune.
However, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not have verifiable information about his detention conditions.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beschikt echter niet over verifieerbare informatie over zijn detentieomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de humanitaire gevolgen van tyfoon Rai op de Filipijnen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the humanitarian impact of Typhoon Rai in the Philippines, including whether the EU's EUR 1.7 million aid was sufficient and whether the Netherlands would provide extra funding. The Minister answered that the Netherlands has not allocated extra funds, relying on unearmarked multilateral channels, and will consider an additional contribution in early 2022 depending on developments.
In this light, the Dutch government has not made additional funds available.
De Nederlandse overheid heeft in dit licht geen extra middelen beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van der Lee over hoe Nederlandse vlees-, zuivel- en veevoerbedrijven ontbossing, landroof en corruptie stimuleren

MPs Teunissen and Van der Lee asked how Dutch meat, dairy and feed companies contribute to deforestation, land grabbing and corruption via soy supply chains, and whether soy traceability, certification and due diligence are adequate. The minister answers that OESO guidelines do not require full supply-chain transparency, that mixed trade models make soy origin hard to trace, that certification has been effective, and that mandatory IMVO legislation is planned but left to a new cabinet.
The cabinet therefore welcomes the European Commission's proposed law to keep products, including soy, linked to deforestation and forest degradation off the European market.

Het kabinet verwelkomt daarom dat er nu een voorstel van wet van de Europese Commissie voorligt om producten, waaronder soja, van de Europese markt te weren die gerelateerd zijn aan ontbossing en bosdegradatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het strafproces tegen een Nederlander voor zijn hulp aan vluchtelingen op Lesbos

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about the Greek criminal prosecution of a 73-year-old Dutch volunteer for rescuing and aiding refugees on Lesbos, including whether Nationally consular help was given and whether EU law forbids criminalising such aid. The State Secretary declined to judge the individual case, said the Netherlands will not interfere in Greek proceedings, outlined consular assistance, and argued that the Commission's guidance is not binding and that the government disagrees with its reading on NGO sea rescue.
The Netherlands cannot and will not interfere in the legal proceedings of another country, just as the Netherlands expects other countries not to do so in our legal proceedings.
Nederland kan en wil zich niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land mengen, net zoals Nederland verwacht dat andere landen dat niet doen in onze rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Is belasting betalen weer iets voor de dommen?'

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked whether the 2021-2022 increase of the corporate tax low-rate bracket invites companies to split into multiple BVs to avoid tax, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answers that the effect is not yet known, the government will monitor fragmentation and report next year, and no legislative change is currently committed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Nederland deed mee in herfinanciering van omstreden gasproject Australië'

MP Van der Lee asked why the state-backed export credit insurer financed the Ichthys LNG project, which flares gas, and how such support will be prevented in future, and whether such credits belong on the fossil fuel subsidy list. The Secretary of State explained the 2012 policy predated the 2021 exclusion rule, that a 2020 change was technical, and that new COP26-based policy to end fossil export support is being developed for end-2022 implementation, while declining to treat export credit as a subsidy.
Following the policy tightened this year, an application for an export credit insurance will from now on be checked for whether gas is routinely vented or flared.
Naar aanleiding van het dit jaar aangescherpte beleid zal bij een aanvraag voor een exportkredietverzekering (ekv) voortaan gekeken worden of er routinematig ontgast of afgefakkeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de gebrekkige beheersing van duurzaamheidsrisico’s door Europese banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister about ECB findings that most significant European banks inadequately manage climate and environmental risks, and about progress, Dutch banks' exposure, EU coordination, the climate commitment, and the CRR/CRD proposals. The minister answered that progress is slow but banks have started, that DNB and the ECB oversee Dutch banks, that the climate commitment focuses on CO2 impact rather than risk, and that the CRR/CRD proposals would embed ESG risk in supervision.
Information on the material climate and environmental risks for individual Dutch systemically important banks therefore lies in the first instance with the supervisor.
De informatie over de materiële klimaat- en milieurisico's voor individuele Nederlandse systeemrelevante banken ligt zodoende in eerste instantie bij de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over vaccindonaties aan de WHO voor lage-inkomenslanden

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Health and Development ministers why the Netherlands had not made firm vaccine donation commitments to COVAX, how it compared with other rich countries, its stockpile and fair share, and what it would do about low vaccination rates in low-income countries. The government answered that firm donation mandates of 22 million doses were already in place, that it would meet 'Get one – Give one', and that it would keep pursuing supply, local production and TRIPS-waiver negotiations, while declining to swap its place in the queue.
Netherlands has thus done what it promised for this year and will continue to make efforts in this regard.
Nederland heeft daarmee gedaan wat het voor dit jaar heeft beloofd en zal zich hiervoor blijven inspannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over ontwikkelingen rond de exportkredietverzekering voor een gasproject in Mozambique

An MP asked the government about export credit insurance for the Mozambique LNG gas project, including the use of a 2°C climate analysis, the due diligence on security and human rights risks, and whether to end export support for new oil and gas projects. The government answered that the insurance follows IFC emissions standards rather than specific temperature scenarios, that due diligence was conducted carefully though risks materialised, and that it will work on new policy to end fossil fuel export support by end 2022.
The cabinet signed the COP26 declaration on international public support for the green energy transition on 8 November.
Het kabinet heeft op 8 november de COP26 verklaring over internationale publieke steun voor de groene energietransitie ondertekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Vrede in Bosnië onder druk: leider Serviërs morrelt aan voortbestaan staat'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Foreign Minister about Milorad Dodik's provocations in Bosnia and Herzegovina, possible Bonn Powers use, EU/US sanctions, electoral law changes, and Commissioner Várhelyi's handling of rule-of-law and LGBTI concerns in Serbia's enlargement report. The minister acknowledges rising tensions and supports PIC statements and EU diplomacy, rejects no sanctions outright but says instruments must be weighed carefully, and takes a cautiously critical line on Serbia's progress, opposing opening two clusters as too optimistic.
The cabinet is in discussion with EU partners on de-escalating the situation.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met EU-partners over de-escalatie van de situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Thijssen en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Energiebedrijf loost klanten vanwege hoge gasprijs'

MPs asked whether an energy company unilaterally terminating contracts because of high gas prices is lawful, what protection consumers have, and what the government will do. The Minister answers that such unilateral termination is not allowed, points consumers to the ACM, complaints committee and courts, reports an ACM order-with-penalty against one supplier, and announces tax relief and extra funding for vulnerable households.
Unilaterally changing the agreed terms is not permitted, unless the parties have explicitly agreed to it.
Het eenzijdig wijzigen van de gemaakte afspraken is niet toegestaan, tenzij partijen dit expliciet zijn overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Nederlandse overheid moet doen wat ze belooft’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the Netherlands did not vote for an IUCN motion on Amazon deforestation and whether it supports 80% Amazon protection by 2025. The minister says the motion was not known in advance, that the Netherlands would have supported it had it been, and that it supports Indigenous peoples and the 2030 zero-deforestation goal.
This partly led to the Dutch delegation not voting for this motion.
Dit heeft er mede toe geleid dat de Nederlandse delegatie niet heeft gestemd voor deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over Israël die zes verschillende Palestijnse ngo’s heeft bestempeld als terroristisch

An MP asked the government whether it would press Israel to explain its designation of six Palestinian NGOs as terrorist, whether it would condemn the move with EU partners, and whether Dutch funding to these organisations can continue. The government replied that it has requested the underlying information from Israel, has raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU, and is monitoring the consequences, without yet announcing a change in funding.
The Netherlands has asked Israel, both bilaterally and within the EU, to provide access to the underlying information on which the listing decision is based.
Nederland heeft zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband Israël verzocht om inzage te geven in de onderliggende informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan het besluit tot listing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Juntaleider Myanmar reageert na uitsluiting voor deelname aan regionale top’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Myanmar junta leader's exclusion from a regional summit, reports of thousands of political prisoners still held and mistreated, the EU's diplomatic pressure and sanctions options, humanitarian aid, and the relocation of Rohingya refugees to Bhasan Char. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the grave situation, describing EU sanctions efforts and aid, and stating that Rohingya relocation must be voluntary.
The cabinet continues to call for the immediate and unconditional release of all these prisoners.
Het kabinet blijft oproepen tot onmiddellijke en onvoorwaardelijke vrijlating van al deze gevangenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en van der Lee over het bericht ‘Wij waren hun enige hoop’ van de Groene Amsterdammer

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked about a Groene Amsterdammer report on the end of Dutch funding to the White Helmets via Mayday Rescue, including the IOB review, the Grant Thornton audit and the withheld final payment. The ministers answered that the contract simply expired in November 2018 due to changed security conditions, defended the IOB process and the withholding of EUR 57,435, and said resumption of stabilisation support is not appropriate, while noting humanitarian funding via Grand Challenges Canada.
There was no decision to stop Dutch support to the foundation Mayday Rescue: the contract for the activity expired on 30 November 2018.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een besluit tot stopzetting van de Nederlandse steun aan de stichting Mayday Rescue: het contract van de betreffende activiteit liep af per 30 november 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het rapport van Reclaim Finance met de titel ‘Banks fuelling expansion of oil-and-gas Arctic extraction’

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about a Reclaim Finance report showing Dutch banks and investors still fund oil and gas firms active in the Arctic, and whether the government would act on it. Minister Knapen answered that the government opposes Arctic oil and gas exploitation, expects financial institutions to follow OECD and UNGP standards, and will raise the issue in EU and Arctic Council channels, but could not provide an overview of investments or policies and deferred several points.
The cabinet does not have such an overview.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Van der Lee over de stijgende energierekening

MPs Thijssen and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising energy bills, energy poverty, insulation, ISDE subsidy conditions, long-term gas contracts and the gas curtailment plan. The government answered by pointing to temporary energy tax cuts worth about 430 euro per average household in 2022, a 150 million euro insulation fund via municipalities, and a planned Gaswet amendment, while declining to give precise forecasts and stating that gas prices are outside its control.
I am therefore preparing an amendment to the Gas Act to provide for this and expect to be able to present this proposal to the House next year.
Ik bereid daarom een wijziging van de Gaswet voor om hierin te voorzien en verwacht dit voorstel volgend jaar aan de kamer te kunnen aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Van der Lee en Ellemeet over de voortgang van evacuaties uit Afghanistan

MPs Bromet, Van der Lee and Ellemeet asked the government how people covered by the Belhaj motion can still contact the Dutch state after the evacuation mailbox closed, what further evacuation efforts are planned, and how the Taliban treat those groups. The government answered that it continues limited evacuations, a special scheme for two groups is planned, about 20,000 unique emails were received, and it cannot yet confirm the Taliban's conduct clearly.
It is difficult to obtain a clear picture of the situation in Afghanistan and the conduct of the Taliban.
Het is moeilijk een eenduidig beeld te krijgen van de situatie in Afghanistan en het handelen van de Taliban.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de alliantie die Costa Rica en Denemarken vormen om de winning van fossiele brandstoffen te stoppen

An MP asks whether the Netherlands will join the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance with Costa Rica and Denmark, and how the government will implement a motion calling for a phase-out plan for fossil fuel financial incentives. The State Secretary declines to join the alliance for now, citing the need for Dutch small-field gas production, and points to existing reports and EU proposals on phasing out fossil energy tax exemptions rather than committing to a concrete phase-out plan.
Because the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance does not sufficiently align with national policy, I do not currently intend to join this initiative.
Omdat de Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance onvoldoende aansluit op het nationale beleid, ben ik nu niet voornemens om bij dit initiatief aan te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het Follow the Money artikel over Nordstream 2 en de Werkgroep Energie

MPs Van der Lee, Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about a Follow the Money report on the Dutch-Russian Energy Working Group, its restart, possible agreements linked to Nord Stream 2, and the protocol and sanctions implications. The minister replies that the working group made no agreements on specific projects such as Nord Stream 2, that the 2018 protocol has no formal status, and that the government keeps a neutral position on Nord Stream 2 as a commercial project.
There was (and is) no question of agreements on specific energy projects, such as Nord Stream 2.
Er was (en is) geen sprake van afspraken over specifieke energieprojecten, zoals Nord Stream 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit ongeveer dertig Palestijnen heeft gearresteerd in Ramallah

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Palestinian Authority's arrest of about thirty protesters in Ramallah after activist Nizar Banat's death, including detention of activists, hunger strikes, Dutch security cooperation and calls for an independent investigation. The minister answered that the detainees were released, Nizar Banat's death had been raised with the PA via EU and bilateral demarches, and that the Netherlands has no direct cooperation with Palestinian security services beyond two missions.
On 24 June I called on the Palestinian Authority to have an independent and impartial investigation carried out into the death of Nizar Banat.
Op 24 juni jl. heb ik de Palestijnse Autoriteit opgeroepen onafhankelijk en onpartijdig onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de dood van Nizar Banat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de exportkredietverzekering rond een groot gasproject in Mozambique

An MP asked the government about export credit insurance issued for a large gas project in northern Mozambique, including the insured values, the decision process, the armed-violence risk, and the force majeure situation. The state secretary answered that the decisions followed national policy and due diligence, acknowledged the mitigation proved inadequate in hindsight, and said conditions will be set before any resumption of the project.
The cabinet agrees that, in hindsight, the risk analysis and mitigating measures on security proved inadequate.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat de risicoanalyse en mitigerende maatregelen op veiligheidsgebied achteraf gezien ontoereikend zijn gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de schade aan mens en milieu door de winning van mangaan in Zuid-Afrika

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development about human and environmental harm from manganese mining in South Africa, global manganese markets, company responsibility, and Dutch due diligence legislation. The minister answered at length, acknowledging the report's findings, citing EU and national IMVO initiatives, and stating the government would not raise the South African findings with Pretoria but would prepare national due diligence legislation if EU progress stalls.
The Netherlands has no own research available on the global manganese market.
Nederland heeft geen eigen onderzoek beschikbaar naar de wereldwijde mangaanmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het rapport 'Bescherming drinkwater bij het boren naar aardwarmte; Stille wateren in diepe gronden'

Two Green Left MPs asked the ministers about an Algemene Rekenkamer report finding drinking water sources inadequately protected against geothermal drilling, and whether rules, regional consultation, monitoring and subsidies should be strengthened. The state secretary answered that the Tijdelijk Beleidskader and the forthcoming Mijnbouwwet amendment already strengthen oversight, consultation of provinces and water boards is adequate, extra monitoring will be explored with SodM, and subsidy adjustments are being studied.
The advisory right of the decentralised governments is laid down in the Mining Act.
Het adviesrecht van de decentrale overheden is vastgelegd in de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het rapport 'Policies for a climate-neutral industry: Lessons from the Netherlands'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an OECD report on climate policy for industry, including the CO2 levy's effects, technology support and overall policy design. The ministers broadly welcomed the OECD's findings, defended the combined pricing and subsidy approach, and committed to some follow-up such as evaluations and infrastructure programmes while rejecting several recommendations.
The cabinet has also long worked with the broader Human Capital Agendas of the top sectors and the Techniekpact.
Het kabinet werkt daarnaast al langer met de bredere Human Capital Agenda's van de topsectoren en het Techniekpact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over noodsteun aan Haïti

Rep. Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the humanitarian, socio-economic and political situation in Haiti after the August 2021 earthquake, the needs and pledges for aid, the Dutch contribution via the Red Cross and Dutch Relief Alliance, further funds from acute-crisis reserves, and how lessons from 2010 are applied. The minister described the needs (around 500,000 people), listed pledges from the UN CERF, IFRC, EU and USAID, reported that EUR 11.5 million of acute-response funds had been used, and said a naval patrol vessel would be deployed at a cost of about EUR 1.7 million.
That is not self-evident in a country where only a third of the population is registered and neighbourhoods are infiltrated and dominated by armed groups.
Dat is niet evident in een land waar maar een derde van de bevolking geregistreerd is en buurten geïnfiltreerd en gedomineerd worden door gewapende groeperingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het bericht 'Nog slag te slaan: helft Nederlandse kantoren voldoet niet aan juiste energielabel'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about a report finding half of Dutch offices fail the required energy label and about enforcement of the label C obligation for offices by 2023. The minister replied that RVO monitoring matches the Colliers figures, that owners were informed via letters and intermediaries, that government buildings are to be upgraded through portfolio routemaps, and that municipalities, as the competent authority, decide on sanctions.
The competent authority is the municipality. The municipality ultimately determines which sanction is appropriate.
Het bevoegd gezag is de gemeente. De gemeente bepaalt uiteindelijk welke sanctie passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over corruptie rond de kobaltwinning in de Democratische Republiek Congo (DRC)

An MP asked the government about corruption in Congolese cobalt mining, ABP's Glencore investments, Glencore's human rights standards, and Dan Gertler-linked companies in the Netherlands and possible sanctions. The minister answered that ABP's investment decisions are for the pension board, that prosecutors do not comment on ongoing cases, that Glencore's compliance with OECD and UN guidelines is not officially checked, and that sanctions and anti-corruption listing criteria are being studied.
The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements on whether criminal investigations or lawsuits are ongoing against particular legal entities.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen uitspraken over de vraag of er strafrechtelijke onderzoeken of rechtszaken tegen bepaalde rechtssubjecten lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de uitspraak van de rechter in de zaak tussen Milieudefensie en Shell

An MP asked the ministers about the consequences of the court ruling in Milieudefensie v. Shell, including its implications for other companies and for Dutch climate policy. The ministers answered that the reduction obligation applies only to Shell, that effects are still being analysed with a report to parliament after the summer, and that the case does not judge government climate policy.
An analysis is currently being carried out, on which your House will be informed after the summer.
Er wordt nu een analyse uitgevoerd, waarover uw Kamer na de zomer wordt geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Van der Plas, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder en Eppink over het bericht dat Indonesië dreigt met 'uitroeiing' separatisten op Papoea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Indonesia threatened to 'eradicate' Papuan separatists, the killing of an intelligence officer, fears of disproportionate military violence and displacement, Papuans' political rights, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that Indonesia has security duties but concerns about military presence, civilian harm and rights restrictions are shared, and said the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue without intervening in foreign court cases.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indonesian authorities for a meaningful dialogue between all parties involved.
Nederland zal bij de Indonesische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op een betekenisvolle dialoog, tussen alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het bericht dat de Franse president Macron Mali waarschuwt Franse troepen terug te trekken

MP van der Lee asks the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Macron warned he would withdraw French troops from Mali if it slides into jihadism, and about the consequences of the coup for MINUSMA and Dutch contributions. The ministers answer substantively on each point, noting ECOWAS mediation, the EU's conditions, unchanged MINUSMA legal basis and Dutch C-130 contribution, and that a parliamentary letter will follow after the summer.
Your House will receive the promised supplementary Article 100 letter after the summer and well before the planned deployment, which will also cover the latest developments in Mali.

Uw Kamer zal na de zomer en in ieder geval ruim voor aanvang van de voorziene inzet de toegezegde aanvullende artikel 100-brief toekomen, waarin ook de laatste ontwikkelingen in Mali worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de arrestatie van de leider van de Russische oppositiegroepering

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Russian opposition leader after his plane was stopped in Saint Petersburg, about EU and US coordination on sanctions against Belarus, and about whether proposed sanctions go far enough. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises repression bilaterally and multilaterally, that the EU adopted a fourth package of targeted sanctions and sectoral economic sanctions, and that the Netherlands is working for effective EU measures.
The Netherlands raises this bilaterally and multilaterally.
Dit stelt Nederland bilateraal en multilateraal aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat vicepremier Dritan Abazovic wordt bedreigd door een drugsbende
