An MP asked the Foreign Minister about threats against Montenegro's deputy prime minister from a drug gang, whether contact had been made with Montenegro, what the EU does on corruption and funding, and whether Dutch and EU attention would be raised at accession talks. The minister condemned the threats, pointed to Dutch rule-of-law support projects and EU IPA funding, said Montenegro had announced extra protection measures, and said Nederland raises rule-of-law and anti-corruption issues in EU enlargement meetings.
Additional action by the Netherlands is therefore not necessary at this moment.
Aanvullende actie door Nederland is op dit moment dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Bromet, Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland een grote aanjager is van wereldwijde ontbossing

MPs asked the ministers whether the Netherlands is a major driver of global deforestation per a WNF report, and about its links to nitrogen, climate, EU trade deals (Mercosur) and import tariffs. The ministers largely contest the report's attribution to the Netherlands, cite certification schemes and EU-level measures, and promise continued EU engagement on deforestation-free supply chains.
The Netherlands faces a major task in reducing nitrogen deposition.
Nederland heeft een stevige opgave om de neerslag van stikstof terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en van der Lee over duurzaamheidsrisico’s van staatsobligaties

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked the Finance and other ministers about the climate and sustainability risks of sovereign bonds, transparency on those risks, and how Nederland compares internationally on green recovery spending. The government answered that it supports transparency and integrating climate risks into IMF and World Bank debt analyses, that no current sovereign debt runs past 2060 and climate risks do not yet directly affect Dutch creditworthiness, and that it will raise climate risks more proactively with investors.
The Agency will therefore also proactively address climate risks and how the Netherlands tackles them in future presentations to prospective investors.
Het Agentschap zal daarom ook in de toekomst proactief in de presentaties voor beoogde investeerders aandacht besteden aan klimaatrisico’s en de wijze waarop Nederland deze risico’s adresseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het verder escalerende geweld in Noord-Mozambique

An MP asked the government about escalating violence in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, including the Palma attack, human rights abuses, the Total gas project, export credit insurance and humanitarian access. The government answered at length, largely describing the situation and EU and SADC responses, stating it is concerned, that Total declared force majeure, and that Atradius DSB monitors the situation without committing to a change in insurance policy.
The cabinet is closely monitoring the situation.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Van der Lee over de petitie voor het beschermen van adresgegevens in het Handelsregister van de Kamer van Koophandel

MPs Bouchallikh and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary about a petition to shield home addresses of sole traders in the Trade Register from misuse for intimidation, and about the public role of business addresses for due diligence and legal certainty. The State Secretary agreed that intimidation is a concern, is amending the Trade Register decree to shield registered home addresses, but will not shield business seat addresses due to EU law and anti-money-laundering obligations, and will consult stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Meer beschietingen op Israël en Palestijnse gebieden: doden in Gaza’

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to escalating violence in Israel and Gaza, the threatened eviction of Palestinian families in East Jerusalem, and whether Israel's conduct will be condemned and what further measures will be taken. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, has urged de-escalation and restraint by all parties, opposes settlement expansion and the evictions as contrary to international law, and points to earlier Kamerbrieven and the EU discussion for details.
The cabinet remains, like the EU, very critical of Israeli settlement expansion in the West Bank and East Jerusalem.
Het kabinet is en blijft, net als de EU, zeer kritisch ten aanzien van Israëlische nederzettingenuitbreidingen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever en in Oost-Jeruzalem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de executie van ruim tien onbewapende mannen door Ethiopische soldaten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about the reported execution of more than ten unarmed men by Ethiopian soldiers in Tigray, the G7 and EU condemnation, possible ethnic cleansing and sanctions, humanitarian aid, and gathering evidence for accountability. The minister confirmed awareness, stated Dutch and EU condemnation, backed an independent EHRC/OHCHR investigation with Dutch funding, and said humanitarian contributions totalled about EUR 9.5 million for 2021.
The Netherlands has declared itself willing to contribute financially to the costs of such an investigation.
Nederland heeft zich bereid verklaard financieel bij te dragen aan de kosten van een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Ophef over het gebruik van ‘foute’ Chinese zonnepanelen’

Rep. Van der Lee asked the ministers about reports that solar panels sold in the Netherlands may use polysilicon produced with Uyghur forced labour in Xinjiang, and about Dutch dependence on Chinese supply. The government said it lacks data on Xinjiang content, will raise IMVO due-diligence obligations with the solar sector and the EU, and cannot confirm forced labour beyond cited reports.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to comply with the OECD Guidelines and the UNGPs.
Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal ondernemen dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen en de UNGP’s naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee en Amhaouch over het bericht 'EU efforts to observe the Palestinian election fall flat'

MPs Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee and Amhaouch asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU efforts to observe the Palestinian elections had stalled, including whether the EU could still observe and support the vote, Israel's reasons for not admitting EU staff, and alternative partners. The minister replied that President Abbas postponed the elections without a new date, that the EU has urged a new date and called on Israel to facilitate elections, and that the EU will renew its observation effort once a date is set.
Once a new date for the elections is set, the EU will again work towards organising an observation mission.
Wanneer een nieuwe datum voor de verkiezingen is vastgesteld, zal de EU opnieuw inzetten op de organisatie van een waarnemingsmissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat Nederland nog steeds een claimparadijs is voor brievenbusfirma’s

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch investment treaties allow letterbox companies to bring ISDS claims against states, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that the renegotiation of bilateral investment treaties on the modernised model text is largely stalled due to COVID-19 restrictions, that the government is committed to resuming it, and that the Energy Charter modernisation includes excluding letterbox firms.
The cabinet is committed to modernising the Dutch BITs and is looking at ways to resume the (re)negotiations as soon as possible.
Het kabinet is gecommitteerd aan de modernisering van de Nederlandse IBO's en bekijkt de mogelijkheden om de (her-)onderhandelingen zo snel mogelijk te hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de stop van de subsidie energiebesparing eigen huis (SEEH)

An MP asked whether the SEEH energy-saving subsidy for homeowners' associations (VvE's) was closed early, why the advice-cost window closed while budget remained, and whether it would reopen with additional funds. The minister confirmed the temporary closure to free budget for already submitted applications, and committed to reopening the scheme with roughly 31 million euro in total, including about 14 million for new measures.
I informed your House of this in my letter of 1 March 2021 and in the answers to the earlier questions from the SGP faction.
Ik heb dit aan uw Kamer gemeld in mijn brief van 1 maart 2021 en in de antwoorden op de eerdere vragen van de SGP-fractie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Subsidie voor fossiele brandstoffen ongekend groot’

An MP asks the ministers why the government's estimate of 4.5 billion euro in annual fossil fuel subsidies differs from an article's estimate of 17.5 billion, and what it will do about fiscal stimulation of fossil energy use. The minister answers that CBS data cannot be used one-to-one because it requires arbitrary benchmark choices, that the 4.5 billion figure is incomplete but not distorted, and that the government intends to phase out such incentives, with reviews of energy tax and renewable levy pending and decisions left partly to a new cabinet.
In addition, several national processes are currently underway in which the financial incentives relating to fossil fuels are being examined.
Daarnaast lopen er op dit moment meerdere nationale trajecten waarin de financiële prikkels met betrekking tot fossiele brandstoffen worden bekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het vaststellen van Erkende Maatregelen

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about how Erkende Maatregelen for energy saving are set, including whether subsidies should be counted in payback calculations and whether a transparent framework exists. The minister answers that the payback methodology was fixed in 2019, that subsidies are deliberately excluded because they are uncertain and not mandatory, and that the lists will be updated in 2021-2022 with Parliament informed during 2021.
Parliament will be informed during 2021 about the process and planning of the next update.
Uw Kamer wordt in de loop van 2021 geïnformeerd over het proces en de planning van de volgende actualisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over energiebesparing van datacenters

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about energy-saving obligations for new data centres, which fall under the EU ETS and are exempt from Wet milieubeheer energy-saving duties, and about PUE standards and waste heat. The minister confirmed the exemption, said a review of norms for ETS firms is ongoing with a decision left to a future cabinet, declined to give individual PUE figures, and pointed to planned broadening of the energy-saving duty and the Wet Collectieve Warmtevoorziening heat-pickup right.
It is up to a future cabinet to decide on any norms for energy saving.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om over eventuele normering op energiebesparing te besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Grote bedrijven maken hun belofte om energie te besparen niet waar'

A Labour Party MP (Van der Lee, GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that large companies had not met their energy-saving pledges under the MEE agreement, including an unexplained 24 PJ residual. The minister denied the residual was excluded, argued total energy use fell in 2019, and said the agreements lacked sanctions and are being reviewed, with a decision left to a future cabinet.
This item has been included in the results of the MEE agreement.
Deze post is meegenomen in de resultaten van het MEE-convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Bouwen met hout? Dat is niet duurzaam, zegt de norm'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the MPG building-environment norm discourages timber construction because it does not credit stored CO2, and asked about a French 50% biobased materials rule and the motion on sustainable timber. The minister agreed the norm does not credit CO2 storage in biobased materials, agreed to examine how to include it and to explore a French-style rule, and described existing and planned actions.
In my answer to questions from MP van Eijs I committed to determine how the environmental impact of CO2 storage in biobased materials, including timber, can be included in our national system.

In mijn antwoord op vragen van lid van Eijs heb ik toegezegd te bepalen hoe de waardering van de milieueffecten van de opslag van CO 2 in biobased materialen, waaronder hout, kan worden opgenomen in onze nationale systematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Zonne-eilanden in IJsselmeer als mogelijke energiebron'

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked the ministers about a proposal for solar islands on the IJsselmeer, the route map for solar on water, the Agenda IJsselmeergebied 2050, and the Wieringerhoek MIRT project that excluded energy generation. The minister answered that a route map was sent to parliament, a pilot pre-study is ordered, the Wieringerhoek scope will be assessed at the planuitwerkingsfase, and more clarity is expected in 2021 and autumn 2021.
In addition, Rijkswaterstaat has been commissioned to carry out a pre-study for a pilot with floating solar panels on the IJsselmeer.
Daarnaast is opdracht gegeven aan Rijkswaterstaat tot een pre-verkenning voor een pilot met drijvende zonnepanelen op het IJsselmeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van der Lee over het bericht dat het Noorse verzekeringsbedrijf ‘DNV GL’ de certificatie voor Nord Stream 2 intrekt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about DNV GL withdrawing certifications for Nord Stream 2, the consequences for completion, the status of the court and arbitration cases, and enforcement of the EU gas directive. The government answered that alternative routes are unknown, that it opposes US sanctions but will not anticipate their effects, that the cases are pending and the gas directive is currently applied strictly, and that it will not comment on matters before courts.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to respond to matters that are before the courts.
Het past het kabinet niet om te reageren op zaken die onder de rechter zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de brief van 19 december 2019 van de gemeente Horst aan de Maas aan mij over geothermie in Noord- en Midden Limburg en het nieuwsbericht ‘Aardwar

MPs Van der Lee and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked about a Horst aan de Maas letter and news report on halting geothermal projects in Limburg over possible seismic links, and the roles of the ministry and SodM. Minister Wiebes answered that geothermal near the Roer fault is not yet safe enough, that SodM is supervisor and adviser, and that he sees no pilot project as a good idea.
SodM is first of all a supervisor and in addition an adviser in the permitting process, including for the extraction plan.
SodM is allereerst toezichthouder en daarnaast adviseur in het vergunningsverleningsproces, waaronder ook bij het winningsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het rapport van ENCO

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee ask the minister about the ENCO report on nuclear energy, questioning its quality, independence, assumptions about renewables and costs, and how it was commissioned. The minister answers that the study followed proper procurement and transparency rules, will release the related documents after the Wet Openbaarheid van bestuur procedure, and defends the report's assumptions while declining a separate review before the roundtable.
Once the procedure has been carefully completed, I will send the documents to your House.
Nadat de procedure zorgvuldig is doorlopen, zal ik de stukken aan uw Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de investeringsaftrek voor windenergie op zee

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether windfarm investment should be made attractive, given the investment deduction available to offshore gas. The minister replied that offshore wind is key to the energy transition, that the investment deduction applies only to oil and gas projects under the Mining Act, and that the government will send a broader letter on the future rollout of offshore wind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee naar aanleiding van het bericht 'ACM Congestieproblemen nemen komende jaren verder toe'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about ACM's warning that grid congestion will worsen and that network operators are investing too little, and about financing, technician shortages and investment rules. The minister acknowledged the congestion problem, pointed to coordination via regional energy strategies and the regulator's review of investment rules, and said that ACM alone decides whether investments are efficient.
I will therefore continue, in cooperation with the grid operators, ACM, local governments and market parties, to work on alleviating the problem.
Ik zal daarom in samenwerking met de netbeheerders, de ACM, decentrale overheden en marktpartijen blijven inzetten op verlichting van de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het bericht ‘Black turbine blade ‘can cut bird deaths’’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about a report that painting turbine blades black could cut bird deaths, and whether the government would test this in the Netherlands. The minister replied that no black-blade test is currently running in the Netherlands, that the sector has shown interest in one at Eemshaven, and that bird-protection measures are being pursued through a joint programme with provinces and the sector.
In principle I am open to this kind of testing by the sector, provided that safety for air traffic is well assured.
Ik sta in principe open voor dit soort testen door de sector, mits de veiligheid voor het luchtverkeer goed geborgd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht ‘Verontwaardiging over voorkeur minister Ollongren voor windmolens op zee’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether her reported preference for offshore rather than onshore wind and solar was at odds with the Climate Agreement, which requires at least 35 TWh of onshore renewables. The minister denied contradicting the Climate Agreement, affirmed onshore wind and solar are needed, and stressed regional RES planning and public support.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Gevoelige nederlaag voor netbeheerders in strijd om verwijderingsbijdrage’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a court ruling on gas grid disconnection charges and its wider consequences, including whether residents who ordered disconnection can reclaim costs and whether a structural solution and dialogue with grid operators are needed. The minister declined to comment substantively on the ruling because similar cases are pending, said the ruling is case-specific, and promised to consult the ACM and grid operators on an interim solution and report to parliament later this year.
I do not consider it my place to comment substantively on the court ruling, partly because similar legal cases are currently pending.
Ik vind het niet aan mij om inhoudelijk in te gaan op de rechterlijke uitspraak, mede omdat er momenteel nog vergelijkbare rechtszaken spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het ondersteunen van de fossiele energiesector in Nederland naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Oil Change International en Milieudefensie

An MP asked the government about a study by Milieudefensie and Oil Change International claiming over EUR 8 billion a year in support for the fossil sector, about export credit insurance for fossil projects, about ending support for new North Sea gas drilling, and about implementing a motion to phase out fiscal incentives. The minister disputes many of the study's figures, says export credit premiums are cost-covering, refuses to end fossil support unilaterally or to push other North Sea states to abolish their incentives, and sends a letter on phasing out fossil incentives.
At this time I do not think it wise to seek, together with the other North Sea countries, the abolition of fiscal incentives for new gas drilling in the North Sea.
Ik vind het op dit moment niet verstandig om met de andere Noordzeelanden te streven naar afschaffing van fiscale prikkels voor nieuwe gasboringen in de Noordzee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over flinke methaanlekken op de Noordzee

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a study finding methane leaking from abandoned North Sea wells and whether licensing and the offshore mining policy should be tightened. The minister said TNO will research the anthropogenic share of emissions, that SodM will act if measures are needed, and that no decision on policy changes or consultation with other North Sea states is yet warranted.

SodM, as supervisor of oil and gas extraction in the North Sea, has already instructed TNO to further investigate what share of emissions at and around wells is anthropogenic and what share is natural.

SodM heeft, als toezichthouder op de olie- en gaswinning in de Noordzee, TNO inmiddels opdracht gegeven nader uit te zoeken welk aandeel van emissies bij en rond putten antropogeen is en welk aandeel natuurlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het niet isoleren van opslagtanks voor oliën die warm gehouden moeten worden

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why half of heated oil storage tanks are poorly insulated and what will be done to enforce insulation and energy-saving duties. The minister said there is no central registry, that responsibility lies largely with decentralised authorities, pointed to voluntary energy agreements and monitoring, and noted a planned CO2 levy, without committing to a new concrete measure.

Because decentralised authorities (provinces, municipalities, delegated environmental services) are the competent authority for permitting and for supervision and enforcement of the energy-saving obligation, no central register is kept of insulation of oil storage tanks in the Netherlands.

Omdat de decentrale overheid (provincie, gemeente, gemandateerde omgevingsdiensten) bevoegd gezag is voor vergunningverlening en voor toezicht en handhaving van de energiebesparingsplicht, wordt er geen centrale registratie bijgehouden van isolatie van opslagtanks voor olie in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het injecteren van afvalwater in Twente en Zuidoost-Drenthe

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reinjecting wastewater from oil and gas production in Twente and Southeast Drenthe, including corrosion, a leak at Emlichheim, costs, water use, and whether the risk assessment framework should be re-evaluated before expanding injection. The minister answered that the injected water is not hazardous, that the regulator SodM oversees well integrity, and that the scheduled six-yearly evaluation will be brought forward to 2021 while the current methodology is considered adequate, but gave no detailed cost or energy figures.
I cannot give specific information on the costs of maintenance, repair and renewal of the transport pipelines and injection locations.
Ik kan geen specifieke toelichting geven op de kosten voor onderhoud, reparatie en vernieuwing aan de transportleidingen en injectielocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een brand bij de RWE centrale in de Eemshaven

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a fire at the RWE coal plant in Eemshaven, whether it occurred in the biomass fuel intake, what caused it, and whether investigations and safety reviews would prevent recurrence. The minister answered that the owner is investigating the cause, partly through an external party, that the fire was in the logistics intake on the quay rather than the biomass processing section, and that the competent authority, the province of Groningen, decides on any further measures.

Based on the conclusions of the investigation and any recommendations, it is up to the competent authority to assess whether there is reason to make adjustments, within the applicable laws and regulations.

Op basis van de conclusies van het onderzoek en eventuele aanbevelingen is het aan het bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of er aanleiding is om aanpassingen te doen, binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee inzake het bericht 'Oplossing dubbele heffing energiebelasting loopt vertraging op'

An MP asks the ministers whether the double levy of energy tax on battery storage will be resolved, given the delay and the absence of a fix in Budget 2021. The State Secretary answers that the issue is being studied with the sector, is delayed by the Climate Agreement, COVID-19 and forthcoming EU rules, and will be part of the upcoming energy tax evaluation.
The cabinet continues to actively work on developing a solution to implement this motion in consultation with the sector.
Het kabinet blijft actief inzetten op het uitwerken van een oplossing ter uitvoering van deze motie in overleg met de branche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Miljoenen slimme meters ongeschikt voor energietransitie'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether millions of smart meters can continuously transmit energy data, why no requirements were set, and what will happen to the PAMR frequency used by grid operators. The minister answered that the current P4 readout meets present needs, that the frequency licence was extended to 2024 with commitments to protect meter continuity, and that a policy decision on future use will follow after further studies.
When the frequency space is re-issued, provisions will be made where necessary to ensure the continuity of the smart meters.
Bij een heruitgifte van de frequentieruimte zullen zo nodig voorzieningen worden getroffen om de continuïteit van de slimme meters te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Thialf moet zonnepanelen uitzetten om verzekerd te blijven’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the Thialf ice rink must switch off its solar panels to keep its insurance, whether the government would mediate, and whether a state insurance scheme could be introduced. The minister called it a specific case, said he would stay involved in general industry talks but saw no role for government in the individual dispute, and ruled out a government insurance scheme.
Since the talks between Thialf and its insurer concern an individual case, I see no additional role for the government in these talks.
Aangezien de gesprekken tussen Thialf en hun verzekeraar een individueel geval betreffen zie ik in deze gesprekken geen aanvullende rol voor de overheid weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het toezicht en de handhaving van de energiebesparingsplicht

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about weak supervision and enforcement of the energy-saving obligation by municipal environmental services, including infrequent inspections, missing re-inspections and absent municipal energy targets, and asks whether companies' Covid support should be conditional on compliance. The Minister replies that municipalities are responsible for enforcement, offers additional capacity funding including re-inspections, and says he has urged municipalities to act, but declines to link Covid support to compliance, saying the effects of Covid on climate policy are still being explored.
Because the decentralised government is the competent authority for supervision and enforcement of the energy-saving obligation, no central register is kept.
Omdat de decentrale overheid bevoegd gezag is voor de toezicht en handhaving van de energiebesparingsplicht, wordt er geen centrale registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van der Lee over een mogelijke uitzondering voor Nord Stream 2 op de Gasrichtlijn

MPs Van Ojik and Van der Lee asked the ministers whether Nord Stream 2 could obtain an exemption from the EU Gas Directive, what input the Netherlands gave the German regulator, and how energy dependence and security are being addressed. The minister answered that the Netherlands considers it the German regulator's decision, that Nord Stream 2 may appeal and has pursued other legal routes, and that the government sees no immediate need for extra measures on energy dependence.

In my response to the Bundesnetzagentur, I indicated on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs as well that it is not up to the Netherlands to assess whether EU regulations provide a sufficient basis for granting the derogation Nord Stream 2 requested.

In mijn reactie aan Bundesnetzagentur heb ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aangegeven dat het niet aan Nederland is om te beoordelen of de EU-regelgeving voldoende basis biedt voor het verlenen van de door Nord Stream 2 gevraagde afwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het bericht “Kabinet schuift vanwege corona ook CO2-heffing industrie voor zich uit”

GreenLeft MPs asked why a press report said the government was postponing the industry CO2 levy due to COVID-19, whether the 2022 start date still held, and why climate plans were leaked to the press rather than shared with parliament. The State Secretary replied that the levy is still planned for 1 January 2021 as agreed in the Climate Agreement, that the bill goes to parliament with Budget Day, and that the Urgenda package was already sent to parliament.
The bill will be presented to your House as part of the 2021 tax package on Budget Day.
Het wetsvoorstel zal als onderdeel van het belastingplanpakket 2021 met Prinsjesdag worden aangeboden aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Eijs over de Gemeentelijke VerduurzamingsRegeling

MPs Van der Lee and Van der Eijs asked the Minister of Interior about the Gemeentelijke VerduurzamingsRegeling (GVR), a municipal home-insulation financing scheme, its legal soundness, and its role in the energy transition. The Minister answered that building-linked financing is planned for 2022, that the GVR's use of the municipal betterment levy is legally problematic and advised against, and that the Klimaatakkoord measures are the preferred route.
I therefore advise municipalities not to use the GVR, and advise them to point homeowners to the existing range of financing options.
Ik raad gemeenten daarom af gebruik te maken van de GVR, en raad hen aan woningeigenaren te wijzen op het bestaande palet van financieringsopties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht ‘Zonne-energiesector laat doos van Pandora gesloten: ‘Producent van morgen betaalt recyclingkosten voor producent van gisteren’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether solar panel recycling costs are financed by current producers paying for past panels, and whether a funding shortfall could arise. The state secretary answered that producers and importers bear recycling costs under extended producer responsibility, that the pay-as-you-go system avoids a shortfall, and that an AVV application by Stichting OPEN has been submitted for assessment.
I will assess the application and publish a draft decision for public comment in the Staatscourant as soon as possible.
Ik zal de aanvraag beoordelen en zo spoedig als mogelijk is een ontwerpbeschikking voor zienswijze publiceren in de Staatscourant.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over strengere regulering en betere certificering van zowel installateurs als installatiebedrijven met betrekking tot kleinschalige duurzame energie installaties

MP Van der Lee asked the ministers whether stricter regulation and certification of installers and installation firms for small-scale renewable energy systems is needed, citing fire problems with pellet stoves and poor installations. The minister replied that installer quality is a shared concern, that EZK required certified installers and product standards under ISDE, that no broadly supported industry proposal emerged, and promised talks with industry and a letter to the House afterwards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over schaliegas en plastic

MPs Van der Lee and Diks asked about plastic pellet pollution, shale gas-driven plastic production, bank and insurer investments in shale gas and plastics companies in Argentina, and whether damages can be recovered from polluters. The minister answered that the government shares concern about plastic pollution, points to EU and national initiatives, says it has no oversight of the investments or the claimed harms, leaves responsibility for IMVO due diligence and compensation with companies and financial institutions, and confirms that polluters bear restoration costs under Dutch law.
The cabinet has no insight into the investments of the named banks and insurers in shale gas and plastics companies and therefore cannot confirm the investment figures.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de investeringen van de genoemde banken en verzekeraars in schaliegas- en plasticbedrijven en kan investeringscijfers dan ook niet bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de uitzending van EenVandaag over biomassa uit de Verenigde Staten

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the ministers about an EenVandaag broadcast on US wood pellets and whether whole trees are used for biomass sold to the Netherlands. Minister Wiebes said he lacked 2019 data, would not name companies citing commercial confidentiality, and argued that sustainability criteria apply regardless of origin and of US Paris Agreement membership.
I cannot say which companies these are, because this is commercially confidential information.
Ik kan niet aangeven om welke bedrijven dit gaat, omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de correctie op transporttarieven voor grootverbruikers

MP Van der Lee asked whether the statutory volume correction gives large consumers up to 90% off electricity transport tariffs, which sectors and how many firms benefit, the total cost, whether it rewards flat consumption rather than off-peak use, and whether it has been evaluated. Minister Wiebes answered that the correction varies between 0% and 90%, that 60 firms (mainly data centres and energy-intensive industry) used it in 2019 at a total of EUR 48 million, that it does reward flat consumption but cannot be redesigned for savings or off-peak use without breaking cost-causation rules, and that perverse effects will be considered in the forthcoming Energy Act.
In doing so I will also look at whether the volume correction scheme has any perverse effects.
Ik zal daarbij ook kijken naar het bestaan van eventuele perverse effecten van de volumecorrectieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat een vooraanstaande klimaatscepticus werd gefinancierd door Nederlandse multinationals en klimaatbeleid probeerde te frustreren

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that Dutch companies funded a prominent climate sceptic who allegedly sought to undermine climate policy, including how ministry officials supported him and whether the damage could be recovered from the companies. The Minister declined to speculate on company intentions, said specific lobbying influence cannot be assessed, could not say which officials had contacts with him, and said the focus is on achieving future climate goals with business cooperation.

It cannot be determined with whom Mr Böttcher had contact within the Ministry of Economic Affairs during his career, and to what extent this had any influence on political choices made in that period.

Het is niet te achterhalen met wie de heer Böttcher binnen het Ministerie van Economische Zaken gedurende zijn carrière contact heeft gehad en in hoeverre dit enige invloed heeft gehad op politieke keuzes die in die periode zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over een wetenschappelijk onderzoek dat aantoont dat de methaanuitstoot van de fossiele energiesector veel hoger is dan gedacht

An MP asked the minister whether a study showing much higher fossil-sector methane leakage implies underreporting, and what Dutch emissions and measures follow. The minister answered that the national reporting is sound, offshore TNO measurements match industry figures, and an offshore methane convenant aims to halve emissions, while deferring the scientific question to IPCC processes.
There is no reason to assume that methane emissions would be greater.
Er is geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat de methaanuitstoot groter zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over 70 branden met pelletkachels, d.d 21 december 2019

An MP asked about 70 fire incidents involving pellet stoves in northern provinces and about the causes, data and effect of ending the subsidy. The minister answered that no national fire data exist, that most incidents were overheating or smoke rather than house fires, and agreed to consult the stove trade about installer quality.
Inquiries with Brandweer Nederland revealed that no national data on fires involving pellet stoves are kept.
Uit navraag bij Brandweer Nederland is gebleken dat er geen landelijke gegevens van branden met pelletkachels worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over de vertraging van duurzame energieprojecten vanwege de stikstofproblematiek

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why sustainable energy projects, including hydrogen projects in Groningen, are delayed by the nitrogen problem, and what measures are being taken to complete them on time. The minister answered that stricter permitting after the PAS ruling delays some large energy projects, that no complete overview exists, and listed measures such as netting schemes, lease of nitrogen space, and a planned bundling programme, with a further letter promised in spring.

There is no complete overview of projects affected, because the competent authority lies with different governments (municipalities, provinces and central government) and initiators can be both public and private parties.

Er is geen compleet overzicht van projecten die hiermee te maken hebben, omdat het bevoegd gezag hiervoor bij verschillende overheden (gemeenten, provincies en Rijk) ligt en initiatiefnemers zowel overheden als private partijen kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over scholen die in de clinch liggen met de Belastingdienst over zonnedaken

GroenLinks MPs asked why schools must charge VAT on electricity fed back to the grid and whether they could be exempted, citing a 2018 motion and the Urgenda ruling. The Secretary of State answered that the new small-business scheme from 2020 lets schools opt out of VAT on feed-in, that a blanket exemption is not possible under EU VAT rules, and that no mandatory rollout of solar panels on school roofs is planned.
An exemption for feed-in to the grid by all schools is not possible.
Een vrijstelling voor de netleveringen door alle scholen is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht ‘Vraag naar elektrische bouwmachines groeit, aanbod blijft nog achter’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether electric construction machinery can reduce nitrogen and greenhouse emissions, how tender procedures weigh e-machinery, and whether financial incentives exist. The minister answered that electrification helps air quality and emissions, that a roadmap to zero-emission machinery is being prepared, and that tax schemes (MIA/Vamil) and the DKTI subsidy support adoption.
The national government, together with construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers of construction equipment, is mapping the developments needed to speed up the pace.
Het Rijk brengt samen met bouwbedrijven, fabrikanten en leveranciers van bouwmaterieel de benodigde ontwikkelingen in kaart om het tempo op te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht “Aanleg van zonnedaken stokt door stijgende verzekeringspremies”

An MP asked the minister whether doubled insurance premiums for rooftop solar threaten the energy transition, whether they are proportionate, and whether independent research and training measures are needed. The minister said premiums are a small part of renewable costs, that insurance pricing is primarily a market matter overseen by the ACM, and pointed to existing certification and information initiatives.
It is up to insurers themselves to assess the risks and set premiums on that basis.
Het is aan verzekeraars zelf om een inschatting te maken van de risico’s en op basis daarvan de premies te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het bericht dat de overheid tuinders hielp om het ETS te ontwijken

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked whether the government helped greenhouse growers avoid the EU ETS by splitting companies and treating gas boilers as back-up, and why this was not debated with parliament. Minister Schouten answered that the affected firms left the ETS for legitimate reasons, that the NEa supervises to prevent misuse, that the rules were not put to parliament as they implement EU-based provisions, and that removing the back-up rule would be undesirable and contrary to EU law.
The NEa checks permit applications from companies that thereby cease to fall under the ETS against the legal framework so that the rules cannot be abused.
De NEa toetst de vergunningaanvragen van bedrijven waardoor ze niet langer onder ETS vallen aan het wettelijk kader zodat geen misbruik gemaakt kan worden van de regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Overheid hielp tuinders Europese CO2-prijs te ontwijken'

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee asked whether the government helped greenhouse growers escape the EU ETS carbon price by splitting firms and classifying gas boilers as backup, and whether this undermines climate targets. The minister denies any evasion: the firms left the ETS legitimately, the NEa supervises misuse, and the sector remains subject to the CO2 sector system with compensation for overshoot.

There are three reasons why companies no longer participate in the ETS: 1. companies reduced the capacity of their installations; 2. companies split up; 3. companies no longer meet the ETS criteria based on the 'back-up scheme'.

Er zijn drie redenen dat bedrijven niet meer deelnemen aan het ETS: 1. Bedrijven hebben het vermogen van hun installaties verminderd; 2. Bedrijven hebben zich opgesplitst; 3. Bedrijven voldoen op basis van de «back-up regeling» niet langer aan de ETS-criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de aflevering van het programma Radar over de installatie van warmtepompen

An MP asked the ministers about consumer complaints over heat pump installations, calling for stricter government oversight, accreditation of installers and guarantee schemes. The minister answered that the market and sector should first address the problems, saw no role for the government in intensified supervision or mandatory accreditation, but committed to consulting the installation sector on better quality assurance.
I currently see no role for the government in supervising more intensively or imposing direct regulation in the form of accreditation.
Ik zie vooralsnog geen rol voor de overheid om intensiever toe te zien of directe regulering in de vorm van accreditatie op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het INTERREG-programma

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether INTERREG A programmes should fund cross-border bottlenecks beyond innovation, such as infrastructure, labour market, education and governance, and whether the new Flanders-Netherlands programme could include such themes. The State Secretary answered that the cabinet focuses INTERREG A programmes on innovation, sustainability, energy transition and climate adaptation while reducing border barriers, with programme budgets still dependent on the EU multiannual financial framework negotiations.
For Interreg A programmes the cabinet is focusing further on the societal themes of innovation, sustainability, energy transition and climate adaptation, and on reducing the border-barrier effect.

Het kabinet zet voor Interreg A-programma's in op een verdere focus op de maatschappelijke thema's innovatie, duurzaamheid, energietransitie en klimaatadaptatie en het verminderen van de barrièrewerking van grenzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over bodemverontreinigingen bij mijnbouwinstallaties

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether soil contamination at Wanneperveen-1 and other mining sites could stem from underground leakage, including barium from drilling mud, and whether oversight and research are adequate. The minister answers that contamination is shallow, consistent with historic drilling-mud practices and not evidence of underground leakage, that SodM applies current rules, that the Monster gas leak was repaired under SodM supervision, and that ongoing SodM monitoring of abandoned wells continues.
SodM supervises the proper functioning of the well integrity management system of the mining company.
SodM houdt toezicht op de adequate werking van het putintegriteitsmanagementsysteem van de mijnbouwonderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van het Van der Lee over de berichtgeving aangaande het onderhoud op de NAM locatie in Rossum

MP Van der Lee asked about reports of bacterial corrosion and maintenance at NAM's Rossum wastewater injection sites, whether injection should be halted, whether the regulator will test the wells and sample the water, and about incidents at Schoonebeek and contact with German authorities. The minister answered that corrosion inspections and maintenance are underway, that SodM sees no need to stop injection or to conduct its own well or water sampling (while announcing extra targeted checks on sampling), and listed ten incidents at Schoonebeek since 2011.
SodM sees no reason to do so. The pressure present between the casing and the injection tube shows the integrity of both tubes and proves that both barriers are still intact.
SodM ziet daartoe geen aanleiding. De aanwezige druk tussen de verbuizing en de injectiebuis toont de integriteit van de beide buizen aan en bewijst dat beide barrières nog intact zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over compensatie voor de gaswinning in het Waddengebied

MPs Van der Lee and Bromet asked whether the 448 million euro investment agenda for compensating gas extraction under the Wadden Sea is justified, whether the Waddenfonds has been used for natural restoration, and whether it should be used for nature and farmers' transition. The minister answered that the proposed projects were narrowed to a 6 million euro per year contribution over ten years conditional on extraction, that the Waddenfonds has spent roughly 46% on ecology since 2012, and that the fund's allocation will reach a 50/50 split by 2026.
I do not intend to spend 448 million euros and will also not charge the taxpayer.
Ik ben niet van plan 448 miljoen euro uit te geven en zal ook geen rekening bij de belastingbetaler neerleggen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de UN Climate Action Summit van 23 september

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government knows banks and insurers invest heavily in shale gas and plastics, whether it will press for action at the UN Climate Action Summit, and whether it will pressure financial institutions to restrict such financing. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to national climate policy, the ban on new shale gas exploration permits, plastics programmes, and the Platform for Sustainable Finance, but made no commitment to restrict financing directly.

It is a good thing when insurers, banks and other financial institutions are open about the environmental and climate effects of their investments, so that their customers can make an informed choice.

Het is een goede zaak wanneer verzekeraars, banken en andere financiële instellingen open zijn over de milieu en klimaateffecten van hun investeringen, zodat hun klanten een gefundeerde keuze kunnen maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de reactie op het verzoek van het lid Van der Lee inzake aanwijzingen dat staalfabriek Tata Steel meer CO2 uitstoot dan wordt opgegeven (Kamerstuk 32813, nr. 397)

An MP asks the minister to respond to a Groene Amsterdammer analysis suggesting Tata Steel emits more CO2 than reported, based on its permit application, and asks whether further investigation will be done. The minister replies that the permit-based figures are not directly comparable to actual emissions, defends the reported NEa data as verified, and declines additional measurement as disproportionately costly.
I have confidence in the NEa's judgement of the figures reported by Tata.
Ik heb vertrouwen in het oordeel van de NEa over de door Tata gerapporteerde cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over de primaire energiefactor (PEF) voor elektriciteit

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked whether a primary energy factor (PEF) of 1.45 for electricity is still realistic, given 2018 renewable shares of 7.4% and the need to align with the KEV forecast, and whether a low PEF misleads home buyers. The minister maintains 1.45 is realistic because renewable growth and coal reduction will bring the outcome in line, rejects revising the PEF to the KEV because it would delay near-zero-energy buildings, and says the PEF change was requested by the heat pump sector and the NEN committee.
No, that is not my intention.
Nee, dat is niet mijn voornemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Nederland verontwaardigd: 'onze' Clauscentrale wil stroom gaan leveren aan België'

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a plan by RWE to supply electricity from the Clauscentrale directly to Belgium, raising concerns about security of supply and CO2 emissions. The minister agreed the supply should go via the interconnector rather than a direct connection, said he has raised this with RWE and his Belgian counterpart, but declined to commit to shifting CO2 emissions to Belgium, citing the ETS point-source rules.

However, I am of the view that the supply of electricity to the Belgian grid should take place via the Dutch-Belgian interconnection capacity and not via a planned direct connection to the Belgian grid

Ik ben echter van mening dat de levering van stroom aan het Belgische elektriciteitsnet dient plaats te vinden via de Nederlands-Belgische interconnectiecapaciteit en niet via een voorgenomen rechtstreekse aansluiting op het Belgische net
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de onderschatting van economische groei

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether GDP growth is systematically underestimated due to digitalisation and quality adjustment, what the cabinet and CPB do about it, whether a formal trajectory will be started, and which spending would change. The minister partly agrees, says more research is needed, notes ongoing CBS and UN/EU revision work, sees no need for a new formal trajectory, and says it is hard to name affected spending.
Given these ongoing trajectories, I do not consider it necessary to formally start a new trajectory.
Gezien deze lopende trajecten, acht ik het niet nodig om in formele zin een nieuw traject te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het advies van SodM op het winningsplan van Nedmag

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about SodM's advice on Nedmag's salt mining plan and whether the cumulative subsidence effects in the region, as demanded by an adopted motion, were studied before deciding. The Minister said cumulative subsidence was covered in the advice, will address the motion in the final decision, has asked TNO for subsidence maps, and does not expect a decision before Q1 2020 after further advice and public objection procedures.
In assessing the application I will give effect to this motion.
Bij de beoordeling van de aanvraag zal ik invulling geven aan deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Sienot over het bericht ‘Toezicht op energiebesparingsplicht bedrijven faalt’

MPs Van der Lee and Sienot asked why the energy-saving obligation for businesses is poorly enforced, because regulators do not know which firms are covered and grid operators may not share consumption data, and asked about capacity and use of a EUR 3 million amendment. The minister answered that the scope was known to be unclear, that a court case on data sharing is pending, that a legal duty for grid operators to share data is being considered, and that reporting and extra funds are improving oversight.
A court case is currently pending between a municipality, on behalf of an environmental service, and a grid operator over providing the consumption data.
Er loopt op dit moment over het verstrekken van de verbruiksgegevens een gerechtelijke procedure tussen een gemeente, namens een omgevingsdienst, en een netbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel “Verplichte bijmenging waterstof in gasnet om vraag te creëren”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about proposals to mandate hydrogen blending into the gas grid and related technical, sectoral and market questions. The minister answered that blending is being explored at European level, that grey hydrogen blending makes little climate sense, and that a broader hydrogen programme under the Climate Agreement will be pursued, without committing to a binding mandate.
I see the hydrogen envoy's proposal in the context of an emerging European discussion.
Ik zie het voorstel van de waterstofgezant in de context van een beginnende Europese discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de nieuwe interne regels van de Europese Investeringsbank (EIB) voor het uitlenen van geld aan energieprojecten

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked whether the government would oppose the EIB's revised Energy Lending Policy, specifically the loopholes for gas plants with 'credible' low-carbon gas plans and a one-year extension for gas infrastructure projects, and whether it would push for a firm emissions limit before the 15 October 2019 Board meeting. The Minister answers that the Netherlands supports a firmer policy, prefers the original emissions limit definition, and will push for phasing out fossil fuel financing and for an ambitious outcome, while noting the decision is still under negotiation.
The Netherlands is strongly committed to this in the negotiations and will work to bring other countries along to a clear and ambitious policy.
Nederland maakt zich hier in de onderhandelingen hard voor en zet zich in om andere landen mee te krijgen voor een beleid dat helder en ambitieus is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over vergunningen voor grote staalhardingsovens in Schiedam

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a steel hardening furnace expansion at Dominial in Schiedam, which allegedly started before its permit, and its extra gas use amid Groningen gas reduction and climate goals, along with the municipality's objections and calls for a policy framework. The minister replies that the gas increase is manageable given Dominial can use pseudo-Groningen gas, that the Klimaatakkoord will give municipalities more tools (Wet Milieubeheer update by 1 July 2020), and that permits are currently halted pending the PAS fallout.
With the agreements from the Klimaatakkoord, municipalities and provinces will get more opportunities to anticipate the energy transition.
Met de afspraken uit het Klimaatakkoord krijgen gemeenten en provincies meer mogelijkheden om te kunnen anticiperen met het oog op de energietransitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Samenwerkende overheden brengen advies aan minister uit over Zuid-West 380kV hoogspanningsverbinding’

MP Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the above-ground 380kV Zuid-West line through the Natura 2000 Brabantse Wal and Bergen op Zoom area conflicts with the routing principle of avoiding new landscape crossings, and why the underground cable option in the existing pipeline corridor, supported by residents and municipalities, is not chosen, including in light of the Council of State's PAS ruling. The Minister answered that the choice was a broad weighing of several aspects, that TenneT and LSNed found an underground option in the pipeline corridor feasible, and that he intends to ask TenneT to investigate an extended cable route, without deciding on the tracé yet.

I intend, in line with the advice of the cooperating authorities, to ask TenneT to examine, together with stakeholders, an extended cable route in the pipeline corridor connecting to the Brabantse Wal.

Ik ben voornemens, in overeenstemming met het advies van de samenwerkende overheden, aan TenneT te vragen om samen met de belanghebbenden een verlengd kabeltracé in de buisleidingstraat aansluitend op de Brabantse Wal nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over een interview met MKB-Nederland en Greenpeace bij het radioprogramma Radio EenVandaag

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an EenVandaag interview on energy tax exemptions and the Opslag Duurzame Energie (ODE) levy, including which sectors are exempt, shares of gas and electricity unpaid, revenue foregone, ETS firms' payments, and whether exemptions will be abolished. The minister answered that exemptions are largely mandated by EU rules, gave estimates and data limits (no firm-level data available), and said the Klimaatakkoord proposal shifts burden toward large industrial users while SMEs are protected.
Consumption figures for individual companies are not available.
Verbruikscijfers voor individuele bedrijven zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de berichten 'Uitstoot vervuilend lachgas Chemelot jaren niet gemeld' en 'Lachgas: het stille klimaatprobleem van Limburg'

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about reports that Chemelot's Anqore plant had emitted large amounts of nitrous oxide unmeasured and unreported for decades, and about oversight and accountability for that. The minister acknowledged the omission, said Limburg province is the competent authority responsible for monitoring, and said the emissions have been corrected in the registry and that a one-off financial incentive of €42 million is being provided to Fibrant to reduce nitrous oxide.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Zonnepanelen in Den Haag blijken stoorzender en moeten uit tijdens bezoek Ivanka Trump’

An MP asked why solar panels in The Hague had to be switched off for three weeks during a visit by Ivanka Trump, and who would compensate the owners. The minister explained the C2000 emergency network required a temporary antenna, that compensation was given out of goodwill by the Foreign Ministry, and that installer knowledge and certification are primarily the sector's responsibility.
It is primarily a matter for producers and installers to ensure this.
Het is primair een zaak van producenten en installateurs om hier zorg voor te dragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘SodM legt last onder dwangsom op aan Akzo, Nedmag en Frisia’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about SodM's penalty order against salt-mining firms over incomplete REACH chemical safety reports, groundwater contamination from diesel leaks, abandonment policy, and diesel storage in caverns. The minister acknowledged the failures, said SodM's enhanced supervision continues, and outlined remediation plans and ongoing SodM review.
For that reason SodM has imposed a penalty order on the salt-mining companies.
SodM heeft om die reden de zoutwinningsbedrijven een last onder dwangsom opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht 'Steeds meer biomassacentrales, goed of slecht voor het klimaat?'

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether biomass power plants should be paused, given air quality and sustainability concerns, and when sustainability and cascading criteria will be set. The minister replied that the sustainability framework is expected in Q1 2020, that emission standards for smaller plants are under review, that the government will not intervene in specific projects, and that it sees no legal basis to refuse permits when all rules are met.
The cabinet is not involved in the development of specific projects and intervention is therefore not an option.
Het kabinet is niet betrokken bij de totstandkoming van specifieke projecten en een interventie is dus niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Amerikaanse kerncentrales in Saoedi-Arabië, en Urenco?'

MPs Van der Lee and Van Ojik asked whether the US would sell nuclear technology to Saudi Arabia despite the Khashoggi case and Saudi nuclear weapons ambitions, and whether Urenco would supply enriched uranium to Saudi Arabia under the Almelo Treaty. The ministers answered that the US has not confirmed any export, that civil nuclear use is permitted under the NPT, that Urenco supply oversight lies with the Joint Committee whose deliberations are confidential, and that no supply to Saudi Arabia is foreseen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Scholen moeten vijf keer zo hard verduurzamen als ze nu doen’

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked about reports that schools must decarbonise five times faster, the low number of energy-efficiency upgrades, the Schooldakrevolutie motion, new school-building rules, and a 2016 Court of Audit recommendation on clear national school-housing ambitions. The minister replied that climate agreement commitments, the Activiteitenbesluit energy-saving duty, the Green Deal Scholen, pilot programmes and waterside balancing studies are underway, and that a Berenschot-style housing monitor is planned for 2022.
In the draft Climate Agreement, agreements have been made to achieve CO2 reduction in the built environment.
In het ontwerpKlimaatakkoord zijn afspraken gemaakt om tot een CO 2 -reductie in de gebouwde omgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de uitfasering van fluorescentiebuizen

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked why the mercury exemption for fluorescent tubes under the RoHS directive has been extended beyond its five-year term, citing LED alternatives, mercury content, CO2 savings and WHO concerns. The State Secretary answered that the Commission has not yet decided on the extension requests, that a socio-economic study is nearly ready, and that the government supports a phase-out weighed against overall environmental effects and will keep pressing the Commission.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het bericht ‘Open letter on climate-related financial risks’

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked the finance and economic affairs ministers how they respond to a central bank open letter with four recommendations on climate-related financial risks, and whether the government will engage with the NGFS and open up climate data. The minister answers that the recommendations are valuable and largely in line with government policy, citing DNB stress tests, the Klimaatakkoord, and EU and international initiatives, while stating that the NGFS is a central bank network in which ministers are not directly involved.
I therefore strongly advocate, together with DNB and the AFM, at European and international level for integrating climate risks into banks' risk management and supervision.
Ik maak mij dan ook – samen met DNB en de AFM – in Europees en internationaal verband hard voor het integreren van klimaatrisico’s in het risicobeheer van banken, alsmede in het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Opnieuw toestemming voor gaswinning zonder proefboring’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about gas extraction permits granted for small fields without prior test drilling, criticised by the Mijnraad, and whether such permits will be refused in the Wadden area. The Minister confirmed the permits, argued that coordinated drilling and extraction procedures and geological comparability make the approach safe, and said Natura 2000 areas are already protected by statute, without committing to a general ban on permits without test drilling.

I have prescribed that the mining company must submit to me, after the planned drilling, the results of the drilling, including at least the expected production, the expected consequences for subsidence and the Seismic Risk Analysis.

Ik heb voorgeschreven dat de betreffende mijnbouwonderneming na afloop van de voorgenomen boring de resultaten van de boring, waaronder in ieder geval de te verwachte productie, de gevolgen voor de verwachte bodemdaling en de Seismische Risico Analyse bij mij indient.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Netbeheer Nederland verwacht op veel meer plaatsen problemen met netcapaciteit'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Netbeheer Nederland's expectation of grid capacity problems in many more places, its ten action points, and whether the minister would evaluate each one and send a letter on interim technical solutions. The minister answered that the action points will be taken into account, that he will consult with Netbeheer Nederland, and that he will send the letter in May.
I will take the action points of Netbeheer Nederland into account when drafting my letter on the technical interim solutions and will consult with Netbeheer Nederland.
Ik zal de actiepunten van Netbeheer Nederland meenemen bij het opstellen van mijn brief over de technische interim-oplossingen en met Netbeheer Nederland in overleg gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten ’Deze omstreden afvalberg mag van de provincie blijven liggen. Bewoners maken zich zorgen' en 'Gedeputeerde Tekin geeft verkeerde informatie over af

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the oxykalkslik waste heap at Tata Steel, why it was allowed to remain, the health and environmental risks, and why enforcement lapsed after 2010. The State Secretary answered that the province of Noord-Holland is the competent authority, that monitoring showed no groundwater risks, that the matter was handled through the province, and that a letter to parliament on enforcement at Tata Steel would follow in May.
The competent authority lies with the province of Noord-Holland.
Het bevoegd gezag ligt bij de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht “Met nieuwe PBL-cijfers daalt CO2-boete naar nul” in NRC Handelsblad

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the proposed CO2 malus in the Climate Agreement could fall to zero if the EU ETS price rises, and whether a CO2 tax on top of ETS would avoid this. The minister confirmed the malus could become zero under the minimum-price design, said the cabinet will present a new CO2 levy proposal, and did not commit to re-running the PBL analysis with different assumptions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over Pallas en het Lighthouse project

MP Van der Lee asked whether the Jules Horowitz and FRM-II reactors could supply large shares of the European medical isotope market, whether Pallas lacks financiers and cannot produce before 2025, and whether the government unfairly favoured Pallas over Lighthouse. The State Secretary answered that the new reactors' capacity is well below existing reactors, that Pallas is not expected to produce before 2025, that Lighthouse received only facilitation because private investors judged the technical risk too high, and that backing both projects was judged the right course.
I am of the view that at that time it was not wise to make a choice between the two initiatives.
Ik ben van mening dat het op dat moment niet verstandig was om een keuze te maken tussen beide initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de marktstabiliteitsreserve en het annuleren van emissierechten bij sluiting van kolencentrales

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the waterbed effect in the EU ETS, the Market Stability Reserve, and whether closing coal plants and cancelling emission allowances is still worthwhile. The minister answered that the waterbed effect partly returns in phase 4, that coal phase-out timing is set out in a forthcoming bill, and that cancelling allowances has reduced effect but comes at significant cost.
The bill and the explanatory memorandum will be submitted to your House shortly.
Het wetsvoorstel en de memorie van toelichting zullen op korte termijn bij uw Kamer aanhangig worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over de stijgende energierekening

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked why the cabinet's estimate of a 108 euro rise in household energy bills differs from the CBS figure of 334 euro, and whether the cabinet will correct its distributional and purchasing-power estimates using CPB findings. The minister attributes most of the gap to market price assumptions and differing energy-use assumptions, says current inflation data give no reason to doubt the purchasing-power figures, and promises a CPB analysis of the Klimaatakkoord income effects and to improve information with PBL, CBS and others.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a clear view of how energy costs affect different households.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om goed zicht te houden hoe de energielasten neerslaan bij verschillende huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Renkema over het rapport ‘Last Gasp: The coal companies making Europe sick’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about a report attributing 231 premature deaths in Europe to emissions from Dutch coal plants, and asked whether the two oldest plants should close by 2020, whether the Clean Air Accord covers this, whether Germany's RWE should be pressed, and whether RIVM should study health effects further. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to a planned legal ban on coal for electricity by 2029 (2024 for the oldest plants), said the Clean Air Accord considers power-sector emissions, reported intensified dialogue with Germany, and declined extra RIVM research.
The cabinet aims for a permanent improvement of air quality, so as to reduce health risks from air pollution.
Het kabinet streeft naar een permanente verbetering van de luchtkwaliteit, om zo te komen tot een vermindering van gezondheidsrisico's door luchtverontreiniging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Tekort aan stroomkabels voor grote hoeveelheid zonne-energie’

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether grid operators could get earlier access to wind and solar site locations, and whether relaxing the N-1 grid redundancy requirement from 99.9% to 99% would speed up connecting renewables. The minister said investment and location checks are being explored with ACM and grid operators, that the N-1 rule can be waived by general administrative order, and that a relaxation is under review without committing to a specific change.
I am investigating with ACM and the grid operators which solution is suitable for timely investment and whether the regulations should be amended for this.
Ik onderzoek met ACM en de netbeheerders welke oplossing passend is voor tijdig investeren en of de regelgeving daarvoor gewijzigd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel 'Boorlocatie Ameland weggespoeld, vrees voor vervuiling'

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a storm washing contaminated soil from the Hollum drilling site on Ameland into the sea, why remediation took so long, and whether NAM has enough capacity to clean up old sites. The minister confirmed the contamination with diesel and barium, explained the site had been monitored and remediation planned since 2016, declined to provide a nationwide list of unremediated sites, and said there was no indication of insufficient NAM capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van der Lee over de afvalwaterinjectie in de voormalige gasvelden in Twente

MPs Mulder (CDA) and Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked why NAM keeps injecting produced wastewater from Schoonebeek into former gas fields in Twente rather than treating it, and whether NAM complies with its injection permits. The minister replies that the 2015-2016 six-yearly evaluation found injection still the most suitable method, that NAM will test new purification technologies at a planned test facility, and that SodM is reviewing NAM's technical evaluation report and reports NAM complies with permit conditions.
The State Supervision of Mines (SodM) supervises NAM's water injection.
Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) houdt toezicht op de waterinjectie van NAM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Miljoenen liters pekelwater weggelekt’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a leak of several million litres of brine from a Nedmag pipeline in Veendam, which was discovered late and possibly caused by heavy traffic and drought. The minister answered that the province of Groningen is the competent authority for this installation, that Nedmag must pay for damage and will replace weak pipe sections, but declined to investigate causes beyond the province's role.
With regard to Nedmag's mining activities, I am the competent authority and the State Supervision of Mines (SodM) is the supervisor.
Ten aanzien van de mijnbouwactiviteiten van Nedmag ben ik het bevoegd gezag en is Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen (SodM) de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de besluiten en het proces rondom de rol van biomassa en de duurzaamheidscriteria binnen het Klimaatakkoord

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister how biomass policy and sustainability criteria are being shaped within the Climate Agreement, who decides, and how biomass is prioritised and how much it will be used. The minister answered that the Visie Biomassa 2030 was translated into the draft Climate Agreement, that an independent sustainability framework will first be drafted technically and then advised on by the SER, that the cabinet decides after consulting stakeholders, and that PBL estimates additional biomass demand of 340–570 PJ by 2030, while the timing of some answers could not be met.
The cabinet decides on the sustainability criteria for biomass.
Het kabinet beslist over de duurzaamheidscriteria voor biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Windindustrie verzet zich tegen betalen van huur voor zeebodem’

An MP asked whether the ground rent of 0.98 euro/MWh that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf charges offshore wind developers for the seabed is market-conform, why no EU exemption was sought, and whether it would make Hollandse Kust zuid 3 and 4 require subsidy. The minister answered that an independent valuation set the rent, that EU state-aid rules require a market-conform fee, that the business case can bear it so no exemption was requested, and that tendering without subsidy is still expected.
The amount was determined on the basis of an independent valuation that was carried out.
De hoogte is bepaald op basis van een uitgevoerde onafhankelijke taxatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Van der Lee en Nijboer over woningen die eerst versterkt zouden worden, maar nu veilig blijken te zijn volgens het HRA-model

MPs Beckerman, Van der Lee and Nijboer asked the minister why Groningen homes in batches 1581 and 1588, promised reinforcement under earlier motions, now appear safe under the HRA model, and how residents keep control over their homes. The minister says reinforcement continues for batch 1588, that batch 1581 is handled via prepared advice with owner choice, declines to comment on individual cases, and stresses owners have the final say while admitting uncertainty remains.
It does not befit me as Minister to publicly exchange views on an individual case.
Het past mij als Minister niet om in het openbaar van gedachten te wisselen over een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht 'Experts boos over soepeler BENG-eisen'

GroenLinks MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked why the proposed BENG energy performance requirements for nearly zero-energy buildings were softened, who lobbied for it, and what it means for the energy transition and household bills.
