The minister replied that the higher numerical value reflects a new calculation method rather than a weakening, listed the consulted parties and denied any lobbying, and said the figures are not comparable and that a tighter renewable-energy requirement could hurt cost-optimality.

That the numerical value is higher than in the previously proposed requirements does not mean that the BENG requirements about to be submitted for consultation are much more lenient than the previously proposed requirements.
Dat de getalswaarde hoger is dan in de eerder voorgenomen eisen betekent niet dat de BENG-eisen die binnenkort voor consultatie worden voorgelegd veel soepeler zijn dan de eerder voorgenomen eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het zogenaamde 'Afschakelplan G-gas'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the 'Afschakelplan G-gas' (gas shutdown plan) was not shared with parliament earlier, what its status is, who is responsible for gas shutdown and how the minister's responsibility is safeguarded, and how the plan handles enforcement powers, Groningen safety trade-offs and cross-border supply. The minister answered that the plan is still under development as the 'Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas', that a definitive version is expected mid-2019, that the minister is considering clarifying his own role in the regulation, and that the plan will address enforcement and cross-border effects.
Once the definitive plan is ready, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra het definitieve plan gereed is zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het stimuleren van kleinschalige windprojecten

MPs from GroenLinks, CDA, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about decommissioning of small wind turbines, municipal refusals to allow replacement of solitary mills, subsidy levels for medium-sized turbines and uncertainty around the postcode rose scheme. The Minister responded that some decommissioning is planned and monitored, that location decisions rest with provinces and municipalities, that he does not favour a separate SDE+ tariff for medium turbines, and that the successor to the net-metering scheme is still being worked out.
I note that in its report ECN calculated base amounts for hub heights of 40 to 50 metres and 50 to 60 metres respectively.
Ik teken hierbij aan dat ECN in haar rapport basisbedragen heeft berekend voor ashoogten van respectievelijk 40 tot 50 meter en 50 tot 60 meter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over de primaire energiefactor (PEF) voor elektriciteit

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders question the government's change of the primary energy factor (PEF) for electricity to 1.45, based on the NEV 2017 forecast for 2020 rather than realised performance, arguing it implies an unrealistic 69% generation efficiency and could encourage low-efficiency electric systems. Minister Wiebes defends the change as aligning the standard with the BENG requirements from 2020, rejects the claim that low-efficiency systems will be favoured, and says the PBL uses the same data in its climate agreement calculations.
The revised PEF of 1.45 has been set on the basis of realistic expectations regarding the share of renewable electricity in 2020.
De herziene PEF van 1,45 is vastgesteld op basis van realistische verwachtingen ten aanzien van het aandeel hernieuwbare elektriciteit in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de Waarderegeling

An MP asks why the NAM Waarderegeling compensates only a 95% purchase guarantee under the Koopinstrument for houses in the Groningen earthquake area, and why 5% is not reduced, citing the Moerdijk scheme as precedent. The minister defends the 95% level as a safety net that preserves market sales incentives, and declines to revisit it.
Against this background I see no reason to adjust the purchase price of 95% of the appraised value.
Tegen deze achtergrond zie ik geen aanleiding voor aanpassing van de aankoopprijs van 95% van de getaxeerde waarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het ontwerp instemmingsbesluit gaswinningsplan voor Spijkenisse-Intra en de ontwerp omgevingsvergunning Spijkenisse-Oost

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about the draft gas extraction approval for Spijkenisse-Intra, including whether a test drilling would precede decisions, long-term effects, groundwater, noise, resident information and damage assessment. The minister answered that the field's properties are assumed similar to neighbouring fields, that a plan revision would follow if test results differ, that monitoring and a damage route exist, and that a national damage protocol is expected in March 2019.

If the outcomes of the test drilling lead to greater expected environmental effects, subsidence and seismic risk compared with the extraction plan, NAM will have to submit a revised extraction plan, on which a new approval decision must be taken.

Als de uitkomsten uit de proefboring leiden tot grotere verwachte omgevingseffecten, bodemdaling en seismisch risico ten opzichte van het winningsplan, dan zal NAM een aangepast winningsplan moeten indienen, waarop een nieuw instemmingsbesluit moet worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de afhandeling van de aardgascondensaatlekkage in Farmsum

An MP asks the minister whether the NAM was uncooperative and denied involvement in the Farmsum condensate leak, whether it applied for extra storage without consent, and whether residents were properly informed. The minister acknowledges the water board's complaint, says SodM found no failing by the NAM on storage, and promises to hold the NAM to transparency via SodM's supervision.
The picture the dijkgraaf gave of the NAM's attitude can be taken into account by SodM and the Public Prosecution Service in the ongoing investigation.
Het beeld dat de dijkgraaf heeft gegeven over de houding van de NAM kan door SodM en het Openbaar Ministerie worden meegenomen in het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Windparkbouwers vrezen tulpenmanie als Wiebes gaat veilen’

A GroenLinks MP asked Minister Wiebes about reports that offshore wind developers feared a tulip-mania-style auction and about the choice between SDE+ subsidies, two-way contracts for difference and auctions with price floors under the Wind Energy at Sea Act. The minister answered that the bill adds comparative-test and auction routes, that a subsidy or guarantee cannot be used for projects that would proceed without it, that CfD would require a separate legal basis, and that post-2025 budget decisions are for future cabinets.
The bill amending the Wind Energy at Sea Act supports the plans for rolling out offshore wind energy until 2030.
Het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Wet windenergie op zee ondersteunt de plannen voor de uitrol van windenergie op zee tot 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het verlenen van de SDE+ subsidie door RVO

An MP asked the minister about SDE+ subsidy refusals for solar parks holding only temporary environmental permits, including cooperatives whose permanent permits arrived late, and whether RVO should allow more room to supplement applications. The minister confirmed the permit requirement, said temporary permits under 15 years are a problem and about twenty of over 4,000 spring 2018 applications were refused, and rejected extra room for applicants, saying they can reapply in the next round.
I do not consider further investigation necessary.
Verder onderzoek acht ik niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht 'Woningwet blokkeert subsidie voor zonnepanelen voor woningcorporaties'

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked whether the Woningwet blocks housing corporations from claiming SDE+ subsidy for solar panels because the electricity flows to an energy company, and whether they should amend article 45(2)(c). The minister answered that the Woningwet does not exclude SDE+ subsidy, that corporations may generate electricity only when it is directly linked to housing, and that the Woningwet evaluation including the Autoriteit woningcorporaties will examine possible obstacles by year end.
The evaluation of the revised Woningwet is currently being completed. I expect to send it to your House before the end of this year.
De evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet wordt op dit moment afgerond. Ik verwacht deze voor het eind van dit jaar naar uw Kamer te versturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Levensduurverlenging kerncentrale Borssele in strijd met verdrag van Aarhus’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked whether the Aarhus Committee's finding that Borssele's lifetime extension breached the Aarhus Convention, and related questions on public participation, environmental impact assessment and the safety benchmark, were accepted. The State Secretary rejected a general Aarhus breach, argued the 2013 licence update required no MER, and said the second safety benchmark report is expected by the end of the year.
That is why I will study in the coming months whether additional (legal) measures need to be taken to increase citizen participation.
Daarom zal ik de komende maanden nog bestuderen of er aanvullende (wettelijke) maatregelen getroffen moeten worden om inspraak van burgers te vergroten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht ‘Digitalisering van stroomnet loopt gevaar’

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Social Affairs about reports that a shortage of technical staff endangers digitalisation of the power grid and the energy transition, and what measures, cooperation with municipalities and UWV, and use of refugee status holders are planned. The minister answers that the government is continuing the Techniekpact, the Klimaatakkoord task group on labour market and training, a labour-market programme (VIA) and a heat-pump training Green Deal, while acknowledging that no specific grid-digitalisation initiative has been launched.
Yes, I recognise the signals from the grid operators.
Ja, ik herken de signalen van de netbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Rutte in gesprek met Alibaba over Europees distributiecentrum’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked about reports that the Prime Minister met Alibaba about a European distribution centre near Maastricht-Aachen Airport, with questions on jobs, environmental and noise impacts, the RLI mainport report, Belgian airspace arrangements and whether the government would reconsider. The minister declined to disclose details of the meeting as commercially confidential, called environmental effects a matter for future permit procedures, and reaffirmed general support for logistics investment.
It is not for the cabinet to disclose information from conversations with individual companies, as these are often commercially confidential in nature.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om informatie uit de gesprekken met individuele bedrijven openbaar te maken, omdat deze veelal bedrijfsvertrouwelijk van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het stimuleren van economische sectoren rond de Waddenzee

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a national tourism summit, the Wadden islands' plea against new gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether tourism rather than mining should be promoted there. The minister said the summit was a provincial initiative, that the Mijnbouwwet already restricts mining in the Wadden area, that the budget has no specific funds for Wadden tourism or mining, and that a one-dimensional focus is rarely possible in a densely populated country.

Partly on that basis, article 7a of the Mining Act, amended on 1 January 2017, was included, which in addition to the restrictions already in the Structuurvisie Waddenzee sets further limits on mining activities in the Wadden area.

Mede op basis daarvan is in de per 1 januari 2017 gewijzigde Mijnbouwwet artikel 7a opgenomen, waarin aanvullend op de beperkingen die reeds waren opgenomen in de Structuurvisie Waddenzee, nog nadere beperkingen zijn gesteld aan mijnbouwactiviteiten in het Waddengebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel 'Volop zonnestroom, maar de kabel is te dun'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a newspaper report that the Dutch grid cannot absorb rapidly growing solar power, including concerns about grid capacity, responsibility of grid operators versus government, and whether subsidised solar park owners face losses. The minister acknowledges capacity limits, says new substations take time, points to the Climate Table and regional energy strategies, and declines to make special arrangements for subsidised solar park owners.

To prevent grid capacity from becoming a short-term problem for connecting solar parks, the governments involved, grid operators and initiators are therefore seeking practical solutions through mutual consultation.

Om te voorkomen dat op de korte termijn netcapaciteit een probleem vormt voor de aansluiting van zonneparken zoeken betrokken overheden, netbeheerders en initiatiefnemers daarom in onderling overleg naar praktische oplossingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het onderzoek ‘Europe's renewable energy directive poised to harm global forests’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about a Princeton study warning that the revised EU renewable energy directive could harm global forests by counting wood as a low-carbon renewable fuel. The minister rejected the claims of mass deforestation and rising emissions, citing sustainability criteria and stricter Dutch rules, and promised to send a reaction before the European Parliament vote.
Your House will receive my reaction before the final vote on the revision of the renewable energy directive by the European Parliament.
Uw Kamer ontvangt mijn reactie voordat er definitief gestemd wordt over de herziening van de richtlijn hernieuwbare energie door het Europees Parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Limburgse aardwarmte stuit op breuklijnen en strenge toezichthouder’

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about start-up problems in geothermal projects, including the claim that half of existing projects are stalled, and whether these problems are structural and what has been done since a critical SodM report. The Minister disputes that half are stalled, says there is no sign of a structural problem, and points to the revised mining law, the sector's Masterplan Geothermie and an innovation roadmap, plus a planned expanded role for EBN.
I do not recognise the finding that half of the geothermal projects are stalled.
Ik herken de constatering dat de helft van de geothermieprojecten stil ligt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Boze gasleveranciers stellen staat aansprakelijk voor kosten inkoop gasverliezen’

An MP asked the minister whether fourteen gas suppliers holding the state liable for gas-loss costs after 2019 is accurate, and whether a deleted legal basis in the Energy Transition Act was an error and when it will be fixed. The minister confirmed the letter and the drafting error, said the fix will be introduced quickly but practical implementation is set for 1 January 2020, and does not expect liability claims to succeed.
The legal basis for incorporating the costs into the tariffs will be introduced as quickly as possible through the amendment note referred to in the answer to question 3.
De wettelijke basis om de kosten in de tarieven te verdisconteren wordt met de in het antwoord bij vraag 3 genoemde nota van wijziging zo snel mogelijk ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Windparkbouwers vrezen tulpenmanie als Wiebes gaat veilen’

An MP asks the minister whether the wind sector's warnings about overoptimistic bidding in subsidy-free auctions for offshore wind justify government guarantees, and why a Contract for Difference option is excluded from the law. The minister replies that bidders bear the market risk, that the subsidy procedure remains as a fallback, that the option of a guaranteed price floor cannot be written into law because subsidies can only be granted where needed, and that the bill will not be delayed until the Klimaatakkoord is concluded.
It is up to the market parties to make bids such that the wind farm is realised.
Het is aan de marktpartijen om zodanige biedingen te doen dat het windpark wordt gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Ojik over het ‘Verdrag tussen de Regering van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Regering van Australië inzake olievoorraadovereenkomsten’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the Netherlands-Australia oil stockholding treaty is efficient given Australian stocks stored in the Netherlands, whether it mainly benefits Dutch oil companies, and what value it has for citizens. The minister answered that stock location does not matter in IEA collective actions, that Australia has long failed its stockholding obligation, and that the treaty lets Australia buy oil tickets from Dutch firms, a usual commercial activity.
The treaty makes it possible for Australia to purchase oil tickets from oil companies established in the Netherlands.
Het verdrag maakt het voor Australië mogelijk om olie-tickets aan te kopen bij in Nederland gevestigde oliebedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Ongeplande uitval kerncentrale Borssele kost zeker tien miljoen’

An MP asked about the unplanned outage of the Borssele nuclear plant, the decommissioning fund, cost estimates, ageing risks and the finances of the shareholders. The government answered that the decommissioning fund is on schedule (EUR 201.4 million by end 2017), that the plant's reliability is not expected to decline, and that closing early would cost more than the planned 2033 closure.
I do not have the requested information for each central plant in Europe.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie per centrale in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel ‘Shell krijgt subsidie voor bouw waterstofstations’

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked why Shell received about EUR 4 million from RVO's DKTI-Transport subsidy for four hydrogen stations, whether hydrogen from natural gas is sustainable, and why battery-electric charging stations received less support. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is technology-neutral, that the four stations received EUR 3.28 million in cofinancing under the programme's rules, and that both hydrogen and battery-electric vehicles are needed for climate goals.

The DKTI-Transport is a technology-neutral scheme that supports solutions for the development of climate technologies and innovations in the transport sector as well as the rollout of infrastructure for alternative fuels.

De DKTI-Transport is een technologie-neutrale regeling die oplossingen ondersteunt van de totstandkoming van klimaattechnologieën en -innovaties in de sector transport alsmede de uitrol van infrastructuur voor alternatieve brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel ‘Man smokkelt wapenonderdelen uraniumfabriek Gronau binnen’

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked whether a smuggled weapon part at Urenco's Gronau enrichment plant could happen at Almelo, whether Almelo has been checked, what extra measures were taken, and what the regulator ANVS did. The state secretary answered that Almelo has had no weapons or parts found, daily checks are done, no extra measures were needed beyond awareness programmes, and ANVS asked all nuclear sites to pay extra attention to detecting prohibited objects.
Following the Gronau incident, the ANVS asked Dutch nuclear facilities to pay extra attention to detecting prohibited objects.
Naar aanleiding van de gebeurtenis in Gronau heeft de ANVS de Nederlandse nucleaire inrichtingen gevraagd extra aandacht te besteden aan detectie van ongeoorloofde voorwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Palmolieproducent verstopt ‘foute’ plantage in schaduwbedrijf en maskeert ontbossing'

MPs Diks and Van der Lee asked whether palm oil firms use shadow companies to hide deforestation and whether rules and enforcement should be tightened. The Minister answered that the matter is largely for producer countries to regulate, that Dutch industry commitments are the key lever, and that existing certification and forest governance efforts continue.
Adjusting the legislation on this is up to these countries themselves and is currently no reason to tighten laws in the Netherlands or Europe.
Aanpassing van de wetgeving daar omtrent is aan deze landen zelf, en vormt nu geen reden om de wet- en regelgeving in Nederland of Europa aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het Dutch Venture Initiative (DVI-I en DVI-II)

An MP asked the economic affairs ministry about the Dutch Venture Initiative (DVI-I and DVI-II), concerning whether public funds crowd out private investors, whether pension funds get unique access, whether the revolving fund makes the state act like a bank, and whether investments should only go where markets fall short. The State Secretary answered that the funds aim to crowd in private capital, that DVI can take smaller shares to leave room for market parties, and that the state's participation is not comparable to bank lending.
This concerns genuine investments in a fund. I therefore do not share the view that the government acts as a bank by using revolving funds.
Dit gaat echt om investeringen in een fonds. Ik deel dan ook niet de mening dat de overheid zich met het gebruik van revolverende fondsen als bank opstelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het rapport ‘Beschikbaarheid van Nederlandse verse houtige biomassa’, van Probos, d.d. 10 augustus 2018

An MP asked the minister about a Probos report on available fresh woody biomass, citing risks of rising demand, cheap unsustainable imports and price increases undermining existing plants, and asked about monitoring, SDE+ changes and an import norm. The minister largely defended current policy, opened a wood pellet category for district heating from 2019, and rejected an import norm, promising no proactive government warnings to initiators.

To also give these projects the opportunity to become sustainable without further burdening the market for fresh woody biomass, I will open a district heating category for boilers based on wood pellets from the spring SDE+ 2019 round.

Om ook deze projecten de mogelijkheid te geven te verduurzamen zonder de markt voor verse houtige biomassa verder te belasten, zal ik een categorie stadsverwarming voor ketels op basis van houtpellets open gaan stellen vanaf de voorjaarsronde SDE+ 2019
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het oordeel van hoogleraar ondernemingsrecht Bartman, dat het akkoord dat de minister met Shell en Exxon sloot ‘buitengewoon mager’

An MP asked the minister about law professor Bartman's view that the Shell and Exxon Groningen gas agreement was 'remarkably meagre', including whether the state could have dissolved the original contract or claimed mining damage as unforeseen circumstances, and whether the agreement was legally binding. The minister defended the agreement as balanced, said it was binding since signing, pointed to the courts for the unforeseen-circumstances question, and declined to reopen negotiations or involve parliament more beforehand.
I will provide your House with more clarity on the commercially confidential elements of the Agreement in principle during the confidential technical briefing in September.
Ik zal uw Kamer meer duidelijkheid over de bedrijfsvertrouwelijke elementen van het Akkoord op Hoofdlijnen verschaffen tijdens de vertrouwelijke technische briefing in september.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het instellen van een bouwdepot voor gebouweigenaren in het Groningse aardbevingsgebied

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a critical article claiming that the decision to end Groningen gas extraction disrupted damage settlement, reinforcement, village renewal and regional outlook, and asked for an independent study of a building-fund proposal giving owners control over their building budgets. The Minister acknowledged a course change requiring rethinking of the reinforcement operation, rejected the claim that prior steps had collapsed, and said the building-fund option is being explored alongside other options with a new approach to be informed to parliament soon.
My aim is to inform your House of the progress in the short term.
Mijn streven is om uw Kamer op korte termijn te informeren over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Alders: De NAM mengt zich toch in nieuwe versterking'

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether NAM improperly interfered in the Groningen house-reinforcement operation by sending calculations and positions to TNO and NEN, contrary to earlier assurances, and what the government will do to restore trust. The Minister answered that the information exchange was an ordinary part of independent advisory work, that the NAM email caused an unwarranted impression that was quickly clarified, and that NAM will not co-decide but will pay for reinforcement, with a regional consultation outcome promised in autumn.
I am currently in consultation with the region on how the reinforcement operation is organised.
Ik ben op dit moment in overleg met de regio over de inrichting van de uitvoering van de versterkingsopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het artikel “Reductie van broeikasgas blijft achter, biomassa is slechte energiebron”

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the Ministers whether they share concerns that growing biomass energy use worsens air quality and health, and asked about integrating climate and air quality policy and tightening emission rules for medium-sized boilers. The government answered that biomass does not necessarily worsen air quality, referred to the Schone Lucht Akkoord and a stookalert under development, said emission rules are already in place and to be reviewed in the 2019 ISDE evaluation, but declined to fully integrate climate and air quality policy.
In the 2019 evaluation of the ISDE scheme I will include the effects on (local) air quality as one of the criteria in assessing the scheme.
Bij de evaluatie van de ISDE-regeling in 2019 zal ik de effecten op de (lokale) luchtkwaliteit meenemen als een van de criteria bij de beoordeling van de regeling.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Meer meten in aardbevingsgebieden’ waaruit blijkt dat er te weinig meetopstellingen in Noord-Holland zijn om aardbevingen door gaswinning goed te analyseren

An MP asked whether the seismometer network in North Holland is adequate to analyse gas-induced earthquakes, whether the Warder gas field could be larger than assumed, whether the soil composition makes the area more sensitive, and whether the minister will consult the Onafhankelijk Meten Effecten Mijnbouw platform. The minister replied that the six existing stations meet the SodM risk-based guideline, the annual monitoring plans can be adjusted if needed, no evidence suggests the field is larger than stated, clay and peat are common in the Netherlands, and staff will consult the platform.
That does not mean, incidentally, that the size of the monitoring network is set in stone.
Dat wil overigens niet zeggen dat de omvang van het meetnet in steen gebeiteld is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Ruim 600 euro ‘afsluitboete’ voor huiseigenaar die gasloos gaat wonen, dat mag dus niet’

MP Van der Lee asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why network operators such as Liander require full removal of gas connections when customers cancel, making such cases depend on costly disputes, and whether sealing is sufficient and fees can be abolished. The Minister says the Dispute Commission ruled Liander had not shown removal was necessary, that the government asked network operators to justify removal and consider cheaper options within the Climate Agreement, and that cost-based charging rules apply, while defending cost recovery.

That is why I have also asked the network operators to promptly inform me about the necessity of always removing the connection and to further examine whether cheaper solutions are actually responsible.

Daarom heb ik de netbeheerders ook gevraagd mij spoedig te informeren over de noodzaak om altijd de aansluiting te verwijderen en om nader te bezien of goedkopere oplossingen daadwerkelijk verantwoord zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het rapport ‘Reflectie op de Nieuwbouwregeling – Van schadevergoeding naar stimuleringsregeling in het Groningse aardbevingsgebied’

An MP asked the minister about a report recommending replacement of the Groningen new-build earthquake-resistance regulations, the NAM's dominant role in the allocation committee, and construction delays. The minister acknowledged the report, said he would consult regional parties and send a reflection with supplementary research by September 2018, but gave no firm commitment on the NAM role or the six proposed changes.
I will send the reflection together with the additional research by the RVB to your House by September 2018 at the latest.
Ik zal de reflectie tezamen met het aanvullende onderzoek van het RVB uiterlijk in september 2018 aan uw Kamer sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat de voormalig inspecteur-generaal van het Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen het onbegrijpelijk vindt dat de versterking van 1588 woningen momenteel opgeschort is

MP Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the reinforcement of 1,588 homes in Groningen has been suspended after former SodM inspector-general Jan de Jong called this incomprehensible, and whether the minister accepts De Jong's view on earthquake risk. The minister answered that all necessary reinforcement will proceed, that the Mijnraad advice due around 1 July 2018 will be awaited before decisions on the batch, and that he will act on that advice in consultation with the region.
Pending the advice the Mijnraad will deliver around 1 July 2018, no new reinforcement advice letters will be sent for a short period.
In afwachting van het advies dat de Mijnraad omstreeks 1 juli 2018 zal opleveren worden kortstondig geen nieuwe versterkingsadviezen verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de tegenstelling tussen de woorden en daden in het innovatiebeleid van het departement

MP Van der Lee asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the ministry's innovation spending contradicts its stated focus on specific, thematic innovation, citing a press analysis showing generic spending rising while specific spending fell. The State Secretary disputes that analysis, presenting figures showing specific innovation spending rose 56% (EZK) since 2012 and generic spending 8%, and says generic and specific policy complement each other and will both be kept.
Before the summer I will send your House a letter elaborating this policy adjustment in connection with the intensification of funds for applied research in the coalition agreement.
Voor de zomer stuur ik uw Kamer een brief waarin deze beleidsaanpassing wordt uitgewerkt in samenhang met de in het Regeerakkoord opgenomen intensivering van middelen voor toegepast onderzoek.
Antwoord op van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘IT-controleurs: te weinig investeringen in cyberbeveiliging’

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked whether accountant reports give enough attention to cybersecurity and ICT, whether rules exist requiring accountants to check companies' cybersecurity measures, and whether supervision should assess effectiveness. The state secretary agreed cybersecurity matters, pointed to existing audit-related rules and the NIS Directive, and said the government prefers to leave organisations free to choose their own instruments.
I want to give organisations further room for now to choose for themselves the right instruments to make their business cybersecure.
Ik wil organisaties verder vooralsnog de ruimte geven om zelf de juiste instrumenten te kiezen om hun bedrijf cybersecure te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Van der Lee over het SER-advies Energietransitie en werkgelegenheid

MPs Özdil and Van der Lee asked ministers about an SER advisory report on the energy transition and employment, including shortages of qualified staff, language barriers for status holders, and VCA certification requirements. The ministers acknowledged the labour-market challenge, pointed to retraining, a Klimaatakkoord task group, and talks with industry on certification differentiation, without committing to specific new government investment.
Where this does not lead to the desired results, there must be a good social plan.
Daar waar dit niet tot de gewenste resultaten leidt moet er een goed sociaal plan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Ruim 600 euro 'afsluitboete' voor huiseigenaar die gasloos gaat wonen, dat mag dus niet’

GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Geschillencommissie Energie ruling that a grid operator could not charge a homeowner over 600 euro for fully removing a gas connection, and whether the Wet VET and the motion on low disconnection tariffs remain adequate. The minister answered that the ruling has no general effect, that grid operators will be asked to review whether cheaper sealing solutions are safe, and that talks with grid operators on lowering disconnection costs are ongoing.
This ruling has no general effect.
Deze uitspraak heeft geen generieke werking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Betalen om op te zeggen’

An MP asked the government whether insurers charging cancellation fees after one year or more deter consumers from switching, and whether insurers should fall under the Van Dam Act if the Insurers' Association keeps charging them. The minister replied that such fees must be disclosed pre-contractually, that the Association will review its code of conduct with insurers, and that no extension of the Van Dam Act is currently planned.
I am keeping an eye on developments.
Ik houd de ontwikkelingen in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de risico's die de overbelasting van de elektriciteitsvoorziening brengt voor de digitale koppositie van Nederland

An MP asks the minister about grid capacity shortages threatening datacenter growth in the Netherlands, including a Schiphol outage, the causes of delays, and industry proposals. The minister answers that no current shortage is shown, that a new substation site is needed in Haarlemmermeer, that investment-planning rules were tightened in the Wet Voortgang Energietransitie, and that the issue will be addressed in the climate accord talks, without committing to a dedicated working group.
The cause of the outage that occurred at Schiphol on 29 April is not yet known.
De oorzaak van de storing die zich 29 april jl. op Schiphol heeft voorgedaan is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel 'Bij revolverende fondsen fungeert de overheid als bank'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an article claiming that public revolving funds (FMO's catalysed capital, DVI investment leverage, market distortion) are misreported and that parliament lacks information on their results. The State Secretary rejects the criticism, says the calculation differences do not apply to ministry funds, and promises to share the Court of Audit's forthcoming study on revolving funds with parliament.

The information on the revolving funds and the cabinet's response to the study and any recommendations of the Court of Audit will be shared with parliament as soon as possible upon completion of the study.

De informatie over de revolverende fondsen en de reactie van het kabinet op het onderzoek en eventuele aanbevelingen van de Algemene Rekenkamer, worden met de afronding van het onderzoek zo snel mogelijk gedeeld met het parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Energy Hogs: Can World's Huge Data Centers Be Made More Efficient?’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the energy use and CO2 emissions of data centres, the transparency of large players such as Netflix, use of renewable energy and waste heat, and the PUE efficiency index. The Minister answered that data centres emit indirectly via electricity generation, that the MJA3 covenant and the Climate Agreement address efficiency, renewables and waste heat, and that no share of waste-heat potential is measured.
A percentage of the total potential that is usefully used has not been mapped.
Een percentage van het totale potentieel dat nuttig gebruikt wordt, is niet in beeld gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Steenkolenoverslag Rotterdamse haven met 25 jaar verlengd'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether Rotterdam port should discourage coal transshipment, whether it can use tariffs, who is responsible for its long-term strategy, whether there is a vision for jobs as fossil sectors phase out, and whether coal quays could handle containers. The minister replied that restricting coal transshipment would only shift flows to Germany and Belgium, that reductions are already visible, that tariffs are a matter between the port authority and its clients, and that the port authority and the state share strategic responsibility within the Havenvisie and the climate agreement process.
Phasing out coal transshipment in Rotterdam would merely shift this cargo flow and the associated added value and employment to German and Belgian seaports.
Het afbouwen van kolenoverslag in Rotterdam zou deze ladingstroom en de daaraan verbonden toegevoegde waarde en werkgelegenheid enkel verplaatsen naar Duitse en Belgische zeehavens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Lee over de overname chipbedrijf NXP door Qualcomm

MPs Van den Berg and Van der Lee asked the minister about the US block of Broadcom's bid for Qualcomm, whether the Qualcomm takeover of NXP warrants investigation on national-security or critical-infrastructure grounds, and related EU competition and battery questions. The minister declined to judge the US decision because the CFIUS advice is confidential, found no reason to treat chip design and manufacturing as a vital process, and said the EU supports 5G development.
Because the CFIUS report is confidential, it is not known on what grounds CFIUS reached its advice to the President.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van het CFIUS-rapport is niet bekend op welke gronden CFIUS tot het advies aan de President is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de uiterste afrekendatum van warmteverbruikers

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Heat Act sets no deadline for heat suppliers to send annual or final bills, leaving consumers exposed to late surprise bills, and whether a six-week deadline and enforcement tools would be introduced. The minister agreed the gap is a problem, pointed to an amendment to the Heat Act and decree setting a six-week deadline, and said consumers can use dispute committees or courts, so no further measures are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en  Van der Lee over het definiëren van de markt met betrekking tot marktmacht

MPs Van den Berg and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary how market definition by the ACM affects findings of market power, whether new or existing law is more effective against dominant tech firms, and whether the ACM can use consent agreements like the US FTC. The State Secretary answered that existing competition law should be used first with new EU rules where needed, that market definition is an important but not decisive step, that the ACM already has binding commitment decisions, and that an EU proposal on platform-business relations is expected in April.
I will inform the House after publication via a BNC fiche about the proposal and my position in Europe.
Ik zal uw Kamer na publicatie per BNC-fiche informeren over het voorstel en mijn inzet in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over het rapport «Human rights in windturbine supply chains» van ActionAid en SOMO

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government to respond to an ActionAid/SOMO report on human rights in wind turbine supply chains and whether Dutch wind park permits and subsidies require due diligence. The government acknowledged the report, said current permits lack supply-chain human rights criteria, pointed to the UN Guiding Principles and OECD guidelines, and committed to encouraging a sector IMVO covenant for wind energy without a firm binding timetable.
The cabinet encourages the wind energy sector to conclude an IMVO covenant; the government also wants to participate in that covenant itself.
Het kabinet moedigt de windenergiesector aan om een IMVO-convenant te sluiten; de overheid wil ook zelf deelnemen aan dat convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Tongeren over waterzijdig inregelen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether waterside balancing of central heating systems is known to save energy, whether it is being promoted for SMEs, whether the estimated savings and payback period are correct, and whether it should be added to mandatory measures under the Environmental Management Act. The Minister confirmed awareness, said the measure will be addressed in talks with industry and Energy Agreement partners and in updating the approved measures list with a 5-year payback criterion, and said the payback estimates will be examined.
In the updating process I will examine in which sectors the measure meets the 5-year payback criterion.
In het actualisatieproces zal ik onderzoeken in welke branches de maatregel aan het criterium van 5 jaar terugverdientijd voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het uitstel van de Nota Mobiele Communicatie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the delay of the Mobile Communications Note, the timing of the 5G rollout and frequency auctions given the T-Mobile/Tele2 merger, and the Burum satellite ground station. The State Secretary said he is in contact with the regulator and considers the rollout timing, committed to informing parliament on the Burum options before the Spring Memorandum, but declined to give a firm deadline or two-scenario publication because that would frustrate the regulator's decision-making.
It is undesirable to elaborate and publish the auction design for all possible (sub)scenarios.
Het is onwenselijk om voor alle mogelijke (sub)scenario's de opzet van de veiling uit te werken en te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over het stellen van hogere kapitaaleisen aan leningen voor fossiele investeringen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether higher capital requirements should apply to loans for fossil investments and whether a green supporting factor should be resisted. The minister answered that capital rules serve prudential purposes and should not be used to steer investment, that other policy options are more effective, and that the government will not push for higher capital requirements on fossil lending.
No, capital requirements serve a prudential purpose and should not be used for other policy objectives.
Nee, kapitaaleisen dienen een prudentieel doel en moeten niet ingezet worden voor andere beleidsdoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten 'CO2-uitstoot auto's in EU met een derde omlaag in 2030' en ‘Autokoper gaat weer voor groot en zwaar’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about the EU proposal for tighter CO2 standards for new cars from 2025 and 2030, the rise in average CO2 emissions of new cars after the Autobrief II tax changes, and whether a ban on fossil-fuel car imports is planned. The state secretary answered that a detailed position will follow in a BNC-fiche, that emissions may temporarily rise but are expected to fall as zero-emission car sales grow, and that an import ban would conflict with the EU treaty on free movement.
You will shortly receive the BNC-fiche containing the cabinet position and the Dutch negotiating stance for the upcoming negotiations.
U ontvangt op korte termijn het bnc-fiche met daarin het kabinetsstandpunt en de Nederlandse inzet voor de aankomende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het besluit over de toekomst van de postmarkt

An MP asks why the state secretary announced to the press that a decision on the future of the postal market would be delayed by a year, and why the coalition agreement's description of the current compensation model is incorrect. The secretary says the timing remark concerned legislative procedure rather than political decision-making, plans a postal dialogue with results before summer 2018, and says the 80% employment norm for postal deliverers will be enforced by the ACM, which decides independently.
This is of course something I want to discuss with the House first.
Dit is uiteraard iets wat ik eerst met de Kamer wil bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de belastingvlucht van brillenketens

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the low corporate tax paid by large spectacle retail chains via foreign structures, whether this is aggressive tax planning, whether an advance pricing agreement with Specsavers exists and was reviewed by the inquiry committee, whether Guernsey will face withholding tax, and how ruling practice avoids distorting competition. The State Secretary refused to confirm or deny individual rulings or tax positions under the confidentiality rule of article 67 AWR, stated ruling access is equal for all, and said the government will pursue its approach against tax avoidance while keeping an attractive investment climate.
Regarding the tax affairs of an individual taxpayer, I cannot make any statements given the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over belastingaangelegenheden van een individuele belastingplichtige kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Subsidietermijn te kort voor VVE’s en andere besparingsblokkades’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether the short subsidy deadlines block homeowner associations (VvE) from energy-saving measures and whether they could be extended, and asked for single-measure subsidies and a one-stop information point. The minister acknowledged the obstacles, announced longer implementation deadlines for complex packages and an advice-subsidy extension, refused single-measure subsidies to limit free riding, and pointed to a campaign, an information toolkit and the new VvE law.
I intend, at least for VvEs carrying out complex measure packages (so-called very energy-efficient packages), to lengthen the deadlines for implementing the measures

Ik ben voornemens om in ieder geval voor VvE's die ingewikkelde maatregelpakketten (zogenoemde zeer energiezuinige pakketten) laten uitvoeren, de termijnen voor het uitvoeren van de maatregelen langer te maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Tongeren, Van der Lee en Beckerman over overheidssteun voor de productie en het gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen

MPs from GroenLinks and the SP asked the government about the ODI/CAN-E report on public support for fossil fuels, the Netherlands' commitment to phase out inefficient fossil fuel subsidies, the absence of a consolidated overview of such support, and the state's share of decommissioning costs. The government denied direct specific support to fossil fuel firms, said budgets do not separate fossil from renewable support, and pointed to the Masterplan for Decommissioning and the new Nexstep platform.

Overviews that specifically distinguish between companies that use and/or produce fossil energy and companies that use and/or produce renewable energy are not available, as that distinction is not made in the budgets.

Overzichten die een specifiek onderscheid maken tussen bedrijven die fossiele energie gebruiken en/of produceren en bedrijven die hernieuwbare vormen van energie benutten en/of produceren, zijn niet voorhanden, aangezien dat onderscheid in de begrotingen niet wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat 66% van het stimuleringsgeld van Economische Zaken naar het buitenland gaat

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the Dutch Dutch Venture Initiative Beheer BV existed, whether it was a shell company used to channel public funds to Luxembourg, and whether the DVI should have been tendered. The minister answered that the BV was a shareholding vehicle dissolved in 2017 with no activities, that DVI is a private-law entity not subject to tender, and that the Luxembourg structure was chosen because the EIF is based there.

DVI is a private-law entity aiming to invest on market terms in venture capital funds for innovative enterprises and, like similar funds the EIF has set up for other European countries, does not need to be tendered.

DVI is een privaatrechtelijke entiteit die tot doel heeft om marktconform te investeren in risicokapitaalfondsen voor innovatieve ondernemingen en hoeft, net als soortgelijke fondsen die het EIF voor andere Europese landen heeft opgezet, niet te worden aanbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht “Nieuw faillissement voor voormalig Aldel"

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the second bankruptcy of the former Aldel aluminium smelter, the total state subsidy it received, lessons learned, whether energy-intensive industry support should be ended, and the status of a direct Germany power interconnector. The minister said about 4.57 million euro in ETS indirect emission compensation was paid in 2016-2017, that support for energy-intensive firms will not be categorically excluded, and that the interconnector plan has been shelved for now.
I do not intend to categorically exclude energy-intensive companies from the regular instruments or from consideration of any additional government efforts.
Ik ben niet voornemens om energie-intensieve bedrijven bij voorbaat uit te sluiten van het reguliere instrumentarium of bij de overweging van eventuele extra overheidsinspanningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Raan en Van der Lee over de APA-/ATR-praktijk

MPs Leijten, Van Raan and Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance how the critical assumption in informal capital rulings (that a complete and accurate picture is given to foreign tax authorities) can be met without proactive disclosure, how compliance is checked, and about exchange of information, the Belgian state aid case, the 1986-1995 suspension, hybrid entities and the value involved. The State Secretary answered that non-compliance (failure to provide information on request) ends the APA/ATR, that 19 ATRs and 40 APAs were checked in 2016 leading to three ATR terminations, and that the government does not track the total value of informal capital rulings.
Since the introduction of the APA/ATR practice, the number of rulings with an informal capital element has not been systematically recorded when registering requested and granted APAs.
Sinds de invoering van de APA-/ATR-praktijk is bij het registeren van aangevraagde en toegewezen APA’s het aantal rulings met een informeel kapitaalelement niet systematisch bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat 66% van het stimuleringsgeld van Economische Zaken naar het buitenland gaat

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why about two-thirds of DVI venture capital investment went abroad, and whether the approach and costs should change. The minister defended the fund-of-funds approach through leverage, said the aim is for investments in the Netherlands to be about four times the government's contribution, and promised a 2018 evaluation of the risk-capital instruments.
In 2018 the risk capital instruments, including DVI, will be evaluated and I will inform your House of the outcomes and my findings in due course.
In 2018 zal het risicokapitaalinstrumentarium, waaronder DVI, worden geëvalueerd en ik zal uw Kamer te zijner tijd over de uitkomsten en mijn bevindingen daarbij informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Haven stoot meer CO2 uit dan ooit’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the government about reports that the Rotterdam port emits more CO2 than ever, whether it will help the port's climate ambitions, and how it will address the CCS project and local air quality. The state secretary answered that the transition is a multi-step process, pointed to existing port decarbonisation projects, and deferred most concrete choices to the incoming cabinet, while confirming the CCS ambition remains and alternative talks are ongoing.
It is up to the new cabinet, based on the coalition agreement presented on 10 October, to further shape the climate and energy transition in the Netherlands, and therefore also in the Rotterdam port.

Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om op basis van het op 10 oktober jl. gepresenteerde regeerakkoord de klimaat- en energietransitie in Nederland, en dus ook in de Rotterdamse haven, verder vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat er een groei van 122% is geconstateerd in varianten van ransomware

An MP asked the ministers whether the reported 122% growth in ransomware variants would continue, whether Dutch society and economy are sufficiently resilient, and what EU-level steps are being taken on device security certification. The government answered that growth is hard to predict, pointed to extra cybersecurity funding of 26 million euros from 2018, awareness campaigns, and EU proposals on a certification framework that will be discussed further.
The cabinet has therefore reserved additional funds for cybersecurity on Budget Day.
Het kabinet heeft daarom bij Prinsjesdag aanvullende middelen voor cybersecurity gereserveerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de mogelijke rol die de EU gaat krijgen bij controversiële bedrijfsovernames in lidstaten

An MP asked the Economy Minister about the EU's possible new role in controversial foreign takeovers of companies, and whether this would affect Dutch plans to protect firms from hostile bids. The minister said the Commission's proposal is a framework for screening foreign investment on national security grounds, that the Dutch government will assess it in a BNC-fiche, and that proposals on protecting Dutch firms are for a future cabinet.
The cabinet will now study the Commission proposal in more detail, after which the House will receive an assessment in the usual way via a BNC-fiche.
Het kabinet zal het Commissievoorstel nu nader bestuderen, waarna de Kamer volgens de gebruikelijke wijze een appreciatie zal ontvangen middels een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de populariteit van het fonds voor gemene rekening als constructie om vermogensbelasting te ontwijken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the rising popularity of open funds for joint account as a way to avoid wealth tax, and whether this is linked to the forthcoming UBO register. The government answered that the rise in registrations is clear but still limited, that the tax effect depends on realised returns, that it will not take legislative steps now given its caretaker status, and that it will keep monitoring and inform parliament.
At this moment, also given the caretaker status of the cabinet, I do not consider it opportune to take legislative measures.
Op dit moment vind ik het, ook gegeven de demissionaire status van het kabinet, niet opportuun om wettelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de stagnatie in de uitwisseling van belastinggegevens tussen OESO-lidstaten

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether international tax information exchange between OECD states has stagnated despite BEPS and EU measures, and what the government would do to speed implementation. The State Secretary denied any stagnation, pointed to OECD peer review progress and Dutch measures (narrowing the fiscal privilege, a UBO register, bearer share rules), and gave no commitment beyond the planned initiatives.
No, I do not share this view. There is in fact no stagnation.
Nee, ik deel deze mening niet. Van stagnatie is namelijk geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het rapport 'Wordt de 25% emissiereductie van broeikasgassen in 2020 gehaald?'

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the government whether the CE Delft report showing the 25% CO2 reduction target for 2020 is uncertain should be accepted, what concrete measures will ensure it is met, and why each factor (wind yield, ROAD cancellation, lower electricity imports) pushes emissions higher. The state secretary referred to earlier answers, said the NEV 2017 will give an integrated overview expected in October, promised the ROAD status update for the 2018 budget, and offered no new concrete measures.
The NEV 2017, expected in October, will give an integrated overview of the effects of all relevant energy developments affecting greenhouse gas emissions in the Netherlands.

De NEV 2017, die naar verwachting in oktober uitkomt, zal een integraal overzicht geven van de effecten van alle relevante ontwikkelingen op energiegebied die van invloed zijn op de broeikasgasuitstoot in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht “Greenpeace spant kort geding aan om biomassameestook RWE te stoppen”

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Greenpeace's kort geding to stop RWE's biomass co-firing, whether substantive agreements on sawdust origin existed before subsidy payment, and whether the subsidy should be withdrawn. The minister confirmed awareness, said the sustainability criteria are set in the SDE+ scheme, that the dispute falls under a private convenant the government is not party to, and that he will not interfere, declining to withdraw the subsidy.
Given the private-law nature of the agreements in the convenant, I do not wish to interfere in this discussion.
Gelet op het privaatrechtelijke karakter van de afspraken uit het convenant, wil ik mij niet mengen in deze discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de totstandkoming van een fiscaal gunstige tegemoetkoming aan chemieconcern ICL

Green Left MP Van der Lee asked the State Secretary of Finance and the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade about emails suggesting a tax ruling was agreed with chemical group ICL, despite the State Secretary's claim that he did not know one existed, and about related audit, negotiation and subsidy questions. The government declined to confirm or deny a ruling citing tax secrecy, described the ICL correspondence as a letter of intent and pre-meeting, and rejected the characterisation of negotiation and subsidy as reflecting actual practice.

As indicated in the thirty-member debate of 5 July, the cabinet cannot, because of the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, confirm or deny whether an APA or ATR was issued to ICL.

Zoals in het dertigledendebat van 5 juli jl. is aangegeven, kan het kabinet vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen niet bevestigen of ontkennen of een APA (Advance Pricing Agreement) of ATR (Advance Tax Ruling) is afgegeven aan ICL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat de Duitse recherche de zogenaamde Panama Papers heeft gekocht

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether he would contact German authorities to obtain access to the Panama Papers, share the information with Dutch tax and prosecution bodies, and publicly release the data. The State Secretary confirmed the German BKA is willing to share, that talks are ongoing, and that the Tax Administration will report aggregated progress in its half-yearly reports without individual cases, while declining to commit on public release.
As agreed when the Panama Papers appeared in 2016, the Tax Administration's half-yearly reports will inform your House of the progress of processing this information
Zoals afgesproken bij het verschijnen van de Panama Papers in 2016 wordt in de halfjaarsrapportages van de Belastingdienst uw Kamer verslag gedaan van de voortgang
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van der Lee over belastingontwijking door mijnbouwbedrijven via Nederland

MPs Diks and Van der Lee asked the government about tax avoidance by mining companies using Dutch financing and holding companies, including the lack of employees, trust offices, treaty misuse, UBO register access for developing-country tax authorities, and whether tax avoidance should be a priority in mining sector convenants. The State Secretary answered that Dutch structures are a risk signal but tax evasion was not proven, pointed to BEPS measures, the MLI, Addis Tax Initiative, planned partial public UBO register access, and said tax avoidance would be actively raised in convenant prioritisation.
The government will actively raise the theme of tax avoidance for consideration when setting the convenant priorities.
De overheid zal het thema belastingontwijking actief ter overweging inbrengen bij de vaststelling van de convenantprioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Westerveld over het artikel "Scholen steken voor onderwijs bedoelde miljoenen in de kachel"

Two MPs asked the government whether it is undesirable that school boards spend education funds on cleaning, maintenance and energy, and whether it will act on school energy use and building sustainability. The State Secretary answered that lump-sum funding gives school boards freedom of spending, that primary school finances are sound, and pointed to existing energy rules and a subsidy scheme for school sustainability advice.
School boards themselves weigh whether to spend more or less on materials or personnel.
Schoolbesturen maken zelf de afweging om meer of minder middelen uit te geven aan materieel of personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de grootste belastingfraude ooit in Duitsland

MP Van der Lee asked whether the German cum/ex dividend tax scheme, which allegedly cost Germany 1.5 billion euros a year, could also be used in the Netherlands and whether the government would proactively investigate. The State Secretary replied that German authorities are examining double refunds of dividend tax up to 2012, that Dutch cum/ex transactions had different tax consequences so the double-refund problem did not arise in the Netherlands, and did not commit to an investigation.
In the Netherlands, the problem of reclaiming dividend tax twice, as it manifested itself in Germany, therefore did not occur.
In Nederland heeft zich de problematiek met het tweemaal terugvragen van dividendbelasting, zoals die zich in Duitsland heeft gemanifesteerd, daarom niet voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Maak haast met gasloos’

MPs Van der Lee and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a news report on slow progress in building gas-free new homes, and whether the gas connection obligation should be scrapped and gas networks replaced with renewable heat plans. The minister said gas-free building is already possible, a change to the Gas Act is planned via an amendment, and no national overview of network replacement dates exists yet.
Amending the Gas Act is desirable to give effect to the Energy Agenda intention that in principle no new gas infrastructure is laid in new-build neighbourhoods.
Aanpassing van de Gaswet is wenselijk om het voornemen uit de Energieagenda te effectueren dat in beginsel geen nieuwe gasinfrastructuur meer aangelegd wordt in nieuwbouwwijken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Voortman over het bericht ‘Energielabel is waardeloos’

MPs Van der Lee and Voortman asked whether the minister shares FedEC's criticism that the home energy label is unreliable, whether he will strengthen it and engage stakeholders, and how this relates to the EU infringement procedure. The minister rejects the criticism, cites studies showing 86-92% consistency, notes the EU procedure is ongoing, and promises follow-up research reports after the summer.
I do not share the criticism from FedEC.
De kritiek van FedEC deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de Nederlandse industrie in 2016 niet is gedaald

GroenLinks MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked why industrial CO2 emissions stayed flat in 2016, whether this conflicts with the Urgenda ruling and Paris commitments, and whether ETS alone is insufficient so national measures are needed. Ministers Kamp and Dijksma attributed the flat figure to higher production and shifts in the power sector, agreed deep cuts are needed, and said the government is consulting industry on additional measures under the Energy Agenda.
Yes, as also indicated in the answers to the previous questions, the cabinet is in discussion with various societal parties and companies on the further elaboration of the Energy Agenda.
Ja, zoals ook aangegeven in de beantwoording van de voorgaande vragen is het kabinet in gesprek met diverse maatschappelijke partijen en bedrijven over de verdere uitwerking van de Energieagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over duurzaamheidscriteria voor biomassa

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked whether coal plant operators and other Energieakkoord parties still lack agreement on biomass sustainability criteria, whether RWE will co-fire biomass at AMER9 and whether SDE+ subsidies for co-firing with non-FSC-equivalent certificates are permitted. The minister replied that agreement was reached in 2015, only implementation talks remain, a transitional reporting regime applies, and an independent advisory committee will assess certificates, with its composition to be announced soon.
An independent advisory committee will advise me on the extent to which certificates meet the Dutch sustainability criteria after the transitional regime.
Een onafhankelijke adviescommissie zal mij gaan adviseren in hoeverre certificaten na het overgangsregime voldoen aan de Nederlandse duurzaamheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over bij- en meestook van duurzame biomassa

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidised biomass co-firing risks deforestation and conversion of valuable nature, prompted by a Zembla broadcast, and how sustainability is checked for foreign pellet production. The minister answered that the Dutch sustainability criteria are strict and verified through certification and independent verifiers, that monitoring of domestic deforestation runs through regular forest inventories, and that subsidies can be reduced or withheld for shortcomings, while declining to judge the pellet production shown in the broadcast without more information.
I will inform your House before the summer recess about the status of the processing of the applications and about the second opening of the SDE+ 2017.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het zomerreces informeren over de stand van zaken van de behandeling van de aanvragen en over de tweede openstelling van de SDE+ 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het rapport 'Perspectives for the Energy Transition. Investment needs for a low-Carbon Energy Transition'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the IEA/IRENA report on the investment and scale of the global energy transition, including Netherlands' fair share and projected GDP and job effects. The minister agreed the transition must be unprecedented in scale, rejected the claim that the Netherlands lags behind, and pledged to support Germany's G20 climate action plan.
Yes, I am, together with other members of the cabinet, willing to do so.
Ja, daartoe ben ik, samen met andere leden van het kabinet, bereid.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het feit dat de EU steeds meer ‘vuile’ kolenstroom importeert

Two GreenLeft MPs asked whether the EU's growing net import of coal-generated electricity should be curbed by a carbon border levy, and whether the Netherlands will champion one. The government responded that it is positively curious about a Commission-planned carbon border adjustment mechanism, pending a proposal in 2021, but gave no firm timeline, design, or commitment to lead.
The willingness to take a leading role on a CBAM will depend on the further development of the Dutch position.
De bereidheid een voortrekkersrol ten aanzien van een CBAM te vervullen, zal afhangen van de verdere uitwerking van de Nederlandse positie.

m: Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over privécellen als meerpersoonscellen inzetten
Asks the government to fill the many private cells as shared cells instead of releasing convicted criminals early.
requests the government, instead of releasing convicted criminals early, to ensure that the many thousands of private cells are further occupied as shared cells
verzoekt de regering om in plaats van veroordeelde criminelen vervroegd vrij te laten, ervoor te zorgen dat de vele duizenden privécellen voorts als meerpersoonscel zullen worden bezet
Amendement van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het verlagen van de grens voor strafbeschikkingen naar maximaal drie jaar
Lowers the maximum sentence threshold for prosecutor-imposed penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen) from six to three years, narrowing the public prosecutor's power to decide without a judge.
the submitter argues for limiting the power to impose penalty orders for offences with a maximum prison sentence of six years by halving this threshold to three years
pleit de indiener ervoor om de bevoegdheid om strafbeschikkingen op te leggen bij delicten met een maximale gevangenisstraf van zes jaar te beperken, door deze grens te halveren naar drie jaar
Amendement van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het schrappen van de mogelijkheid van strafbeschikkingen voor misdrijven tegen de zeden, persoonlijke vrijheid en mishandeling
Removes the public prosecutor's power to issue penal orders (strafbeschikkingen) for sexual, personal liberty and assault offences, so such cases must go to court.
The public prosecutor cannot issue a penal order for any of the offences described in Titles XIV, XVIII and XX
De officier van justitie kan geen strafbeschikking uitvaardigen bij een van de misdrijven omschreven in de Titels XIV, XVIII en XX
Amendement van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Vondeling over het schrappen van de bevoegdheid om strafbeschikkingen op te leggen aan criminele asielzoekers
Bars the public prosecutor from issuing penal orders (strafbeschikkingen) to foreign nationals, including asylum seekers.
The public prosecutor cannot issue a penal order if the suspect is a foreigner
De officier van justitie kan geen strafbeschikking uitvaardigen indien de verdachte een vreemdeling is
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het verbieden van ngo's die zich actief bezighouden met migrantensmokkel
Asks the government to ban NGOs that actively engage in smuggling migrants, including sea rescue groups.
requests the government to ban NGOs that actively engage in smuggling migrants
verzoekt de regering om ngo's die zich actief bezighouden met het smokkelen van migranten te verbieden
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over een voorstel om ngo's die als schakel binnen de mensensmokkel- en mensenhandelketen een cruciale rol spelen te verbieden
Asks the government, with Italy, to propose banning NGOs that play a crucial role in the people smuggling and trafficking chain, modelled on the ban on outlaw motorcycle gangs.
requests the government to work with Italy on a proposal, by analogy with the ban on outlaw motorcycle gangs
verzoekt de regering in samenwerking met Italië tot een voorstel te komen, naar analogie van het verbod op outlaw motorcycle gangs
Motie van de leden Van der Velde en Emiel van Dijk over maatregelen treffen die de veiligheid bij culturele bijeenkomsten en uitingen die vallen onder immaterieel erfgoed waarborgen
Motion asking the minister to take measures to guarantee safety at cultural gatherings and expressions of intangible heritage, such as Sinterklaas processions, against threats.
requests the Minister, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, to take measures that safeguard safety at cultural gatherings and expressions falling under intangible heritage
verzoekt de Minister, in samenwerking met de Minister van JenV, maatregelen te treffen die de veiligheid bij culturele bijeenkomsten en uitingen die vallen onder immaterieel erfgoed waarborgen
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het sluiten van de Nederlandse grenzen voor asielzoekers en reguliere migranten uit islamitische landen
Asks the government to close the Dutch borders to asylum seekers and regular migrants from Islamic countries.
requests the government to close the Dutch borders to asylum seekers and regular migrants from Islamic countries
verzoekt de regering, om de Nederlandse grenzen te sluiten voor asielzoekers en reguliere migranten uit islamitische landen
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het strafbaar stellen van illegaliteit
Asks the government to criminalise illegal residence and return all illegally staying foreigners to their country of origin.
requests the government to make illegality punishable and to return all illegally residing foreigners
verzoekt de regering, illegaliteit strafbaar te stellen en alle illegaal in Nederland verblijvende vreemdelingen terug te sturen
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het intrekken van de tijdelijke verblijfsvergunningen van 44.000 in Nederland verblijvende Syriërs
Asks the government to revoke the temporary residence permits of 44,000 Syrians living in the Netherlands and return them to Syria.
to revoke the temporary residence permits of the 44,000 Syrians living in the Netherlands
om de tijdelijke verblijfsvergunningen van de 44.000 in Nederland verblijvende Syriërs in te trekken
Motie van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over het instellen van sancties tegen Marokko vanwege de weigering om hun eigen onderdanen op te nemen
Asks the government to impose sanctions on Morocco for refusing to take back its own nationals.
requests the government to impose sanctions on Morocco because of its refusal to take back its own nationals
verzoekt de regering, om sancties in te stellen tegen Marokko vanwege de weigering om hun eigen onderdanen terug te nemen
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over toevoegen van Moldavië aan de lijst van veilige landen
Asks the government to add Moldova to the national list of safe countries of origin and to send Moldovan asylum seekers straight back without the normal procedure.
put all Moldovans now in reception or procedure on tour buses and send them straight back to Moldova
alle Moldaviërs die nu in de opvang/procedure zitten op tourbussen te zetten en linea recta terug te sturen naar Moldavië
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over stoppen met het compenseren van asielzoekers
Asks the government to stop paying daily penalty payments (dwangsommen) to asylum seekers for slow asylum procedures.
calls on the government to stop compensating asylum seekers by no longer paying out penalty payments
roept de regering op te stoppen met het compenseren van asielzoekers door geen dwangsommen meer uit te keren
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over overlastgevende asielzoekers op het vliegtuig naar het land van herkomst zetten
Asks the government to deport troublesome asylum seekers and illegal migrants directly by aircraft to their countries of origin, as Turkey does.
requests the government to put nuisance asylum seekers and illegal migrants on planes to their countries of origin, like Turkey
verzoekt de regering om à la Turkije overlastgevende asielzoekers, illegalen en andere vreemdelingen die we hier niet willen hebben, gewoon op het vliegtuig naar het land van herkomst te zetten
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over criminele asielzoekers net zo lang vastzetten tot ze kunnen worden uitgezet
Asks the government to detain criminal and nuisance-causing asylum seekers until they can be deported.
pick up nuisance-causing and criminal asylum seekers and detain them until they can be deported
overlastgevende en criminele asielzoekers op te pakken en net zo lang vast te zetten tot ze het land kunnen worden uitgezet
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over de administratie bij het Munitiebedrijf
Asks the government to adopt the Algemene Rekenkamer recommendation on munitions stock administration and to investigate whether the problem exists across Defence.
requests the government to adopt the Algemene Rekenkamer recommendation on the administration of munitions storage
verzoekt de regering, de aanbeveling van de Algemene Rekenkamer betreffende de administratie van de munitieopslag over te nemen
Motie van het lid Emiel van Dijk over beantwoorden van de schuldvraag
Asks the government to use all possible means to establish blame for Defence incidents that caused injuries and deaths and to attach consequences.
requests the government to use all possible means to make it possible to answer the question of blame
verzoekt de regering, alle mogelijke middelen in te zetten om het beantwoorden van de schuldvraag mogelijk te maken
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over het bericht dat een Joods echtpaar met jonge kinderen in de omgeving van Arnhem is afgeperst door een crimineel die eerder optrad als kroongetuige in moordza

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about a report that a Jewish family near Arnhem was extorted by a former crown witness, demanding action against the perpetrators, passport revocation and the minister's contact with the victims. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the antisemitism strategy, said passport revocation is limited by statute, and said assessing crown witness credibility is for the courts.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in individuele zaken te treden.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over de schriftelijke vragen van 18 april 2025 (2025Z07899) over Mohammed B
