MPs Gabriëls and Kostić asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about steel slag use: whether soil rules will be tightened for leaching of non-regulated substances, why rules were not updated sooner, whether a permit requirement or total ban is warranted, liability of Tata Steel, classification as waste versus by-product, and Natura 2000 risks. The State Secretary replied that a temporary emergency regulation restricts risky uses, a notification duty is coming, the soil rules are under review, and that no retroactive ban or total prohibition is planned for now.
If there are new scientific insights into the substances relevant to properly mapping the risks of a building material in use, I will review this again.
Als er nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten zijn over de stoffen die van belang zijn om de risico’s van een bouwstof bij toepassing goed in beeld te brengen zal ik dit opnieuw bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Slagt-Tichelman en Gabriëls over het bericht dat gemeenten een landelijke aanpak voor bestrijdingsmiddelen willen

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the minister about municipalities' calls for a national approach to pesticides in bulb cultivation, including a statutory spray-free zone and national rules, and about the government's health-in-all-policies approach. The minister answered that a legal framework already exists for municipalities to act locally, that a study on spray-zone width is under way, that the sector is reducing pesticide use voluntarily, and that no national statutory spray-free zone will be introduced.
I agree with the municipality of Midden-Drenthe that this issue is complex, and I endorse the importance of mutual trust and open communication between farmers and residents.
Ik ben het eens met de gemeente Midden-Drenthe dat dit vraagstuk complex is, en onderschrijf het belang van onderling vertrouwen en open communicatie tussen agrariërs en omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en De Hoop over het bericht dat ambtenaren regels omzeilden om PFAS-grond van Schiphol weg te werken

MPs Gabriëls and De Hoop asked the state secretary whether officials bypassed rules to dispose of heavily PFAS-contaminated soil from Schiphol at the Aalsmeerderbrug site, and about temporary storage, health risks and remediation. The state secretary answered that the soil was lightly contaminated, the competent authority was the municipality of Haarlemmermeer via the ODNZKG, the soil was moved to Rozenburg and met applicable norms, and referred several questions to the competent authority; the answer to the question on the committee debate was that it could not be completed in time.
For that reason I refer you for further substantive questions about the course of events to the competent authority.
Om die reden verwijs ik voor verdere inhoudelijke vragen over de gang van zaken graag naar het bevoegde gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en De Hoop over de brug bij Urmond

MPs Gabriëls and De Hoop asked whether no alternative crossing for cyclists and pedestrians will be provided during the roughly eighteen-month closure of the Urmond bridge for renovation, and about access, transport alternatives and a temporary ferry. The minister confirms no alternative crossing will be built, says the municipality and a working group are studying traffic measures, bus and wish-car options, and a ferry, with costs not yet known.
Rijkswaterstaat will not realise an alternative river crossing during the renovation works on the Urmond bridge.
Rijkswaterstaat zal geen alternatieve oeververbinding realiseren tijdens de renovatiewerkzaamheden aan brug Urmond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Kröger over het bericht dat wetenschappers twijfelen aan de maatregelen tegen stank en zoutzuur van het bedrijf ICL

MPs Gabriëls and Kröger asked the State Secretary about reports that scientists doubt ICL's measures against odour and hydrochloric acid emissions, including repeated exceedances of permit limits and possible cancer links. The State Secretary answered that enforcement lies with the province of Noord-Holland and the Omgevingsdienst Noordzeekanaalgebied, which imposed a penalty of 500,000 euro and will tighten permit conditions, while declining to commission a cancer study and pointing to the responsibility of the competent authority.
It is for the competent authority to assess this.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om dit te beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over de gang van zaken rondom het toepassen van staalslakken met schadelijke gevolgen voor milieu en daarbij volksgezondheid en de rol van het Ministerie, Rijkswaterstaat en andere

Gabriëls (GroenLinks-PvdA) asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, after media reports, why the ministry and Rijkswaterstaat downplayed environmental and health risks of steel slag, the 2017 legal opinion treating it as a by-product, the Haak om Leeuwarden project, and whether the government will communicate risks, tighten oversight and withdraw the opinion. The State Secretary answers that the internal investigation timeline is provided, that the 2009 specification change was not an environmental decision, that the 2017 opinion was case-specific and will not be withdrawn, that certain 2021 passages rest on unverifiable claims, and promises broader risk communication and regulatory measures while mostly deferring on commercial and historical details.
In 2009 Rijkswaterstaat took no decision to stop permitting steel slag in onshore projects.
In 2009 is er door Rijkswaterstaat geen besluit genomen om staalslakken bij projecten op land niet meer toe te (laten) passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht: Provincie wil PFAS-lozing op riolering Weert tegen adviezen in, toestaan: “Grote impact op het milieu”

An MP asks why the province of Limburg intends to permit PFAS discharge from CFS in Weert into the sewer despite opposition from the ILT, the water board and a drinking water company, and how this fits the minimisation duty and a possible general PFAS discharge ban. The State Secretary replies that the province is the competent authority and may grant the permit under current rules, that bronaanpak and BBT are already required, that the ministry has no formal role in the permit decision, and that a study into targeted discharge bans is underway.
The ministry plays an advisory role in the legal framework for permit granting by sub-national authorities, which as competent authorities take decisions independently within the legal framework.
Het ministerie vervult een adviserende rol bij het wettelijke kader rond vergunningverlening door medeoverheden, die als bevoegd gezag zelfstandig besluiten nemen binnen het wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Beckerman en Gabriëls over het bericht 'Uitvoering reorganisatie Aardwetenschappen halfjaar uitgesteld'

MPs Beckerman and Gabriëls asked whether the VU's planned reorganisation of its Earth sciences department, and the national budget cuts behind it, endanger national knowledge capacity, and asked the minister to intervene. The minister answered that the reorganisation stems from several factors besides cuts, that institutions are autonomous, and that he will not intervene or pause the decision-making, while noting the VU is consulting and commissioning an external study.
Institutions have autonomy over starting, stopping and shaping their teaching and research.
Instellingen hebben autonomie over het starten, stoppen en het vormgeven van hun onderwijs en onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Hirsch over de verwerking van ingezamelde kleding door modeketens

MPs Gabriëls and Hirsch asked about Radar's finding that clothing collected by fashion chains is often exported to developing countries rather than reused or recycled, and about transparency, consumer information, enforcement and export rules. Minister Madlener answered that export data and transparency are limited, that the UPV Textiel reporting and enforcement are still being built out, and that the revised EU waste shipment regulation and waste framework directive will tighten export rules from 2027.
There is currently little transparency about what happens to the clothing after it has been collected.
Er is op dit moment weinig transparantie over wat er met de kleding gebeurt nadat het is ingezameld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Stultiens over de berichtgeving waarin bedrijven in een manifest de regering oproepen met voortvarender beleid te komen ter stimulans van de circulaire economie

MPs Gabriëls and Stultiens asked why the circular economy is lagging despite the 2030 targets, following a business manifesto calling for faster government action. The state secretary acknowledged the urgency, pointed to an updated Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie due after the summer, and listed fiscal measures replacing the withdrawn polymer levy, while largely deferring concrete commitments.
The policy measures the cabinet will take will be included in the previously mentioned update of the NPCE.
De beleidsmaatregelen die het kabinet zal nemen zullen worden opgenomen in de eerder genoemde actualisatie van het NPCE.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent, Koekkoek en Kostić over de berichten dat milieutoezichthouders strengere regels wilden voor staalslakken

MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that environmental inspectors (ILT) wanted stricter rules for steel slag, why the ILT advice was not shared with parliament, and whether slag use as a building material is safe. The State Secretary answered that the ILT advice was tied to a permit application never filed, that a notification duty will replace the planned information duty (expected early 2026), and that use of LD slag as sand substitute in layers thicker than half a metre is being investigated, while ruling out generic classification of slag as waste.
The advice did not acquire formal status because no permit application was submitted.
Het advies heeft geen formele status gekregen vanwege het ontbreken van een aanvraag voor een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gabriëls over het bericht dat er meer 'zombiebranden' zijn door klimaatverandering

MPs Kröger and Gabriëls asked the government about reports that climate change is causing more 'zombie fires' and what the Netherlands is doing on climate adaptation, drought, water management and spatial planning. The minister replied that such overwintering fires have not been documented in the Netherlands, cited existing funding and planned measures including a new National Climate Adaptation Strategy due in 2026, and gave substantive answers on most questions while declining to provide the strategy draft before year-end.
According to the current planning, the draft NAS will be opened for public consultation at the end of this year.
Volgens de huidige planning zal de ontwerpNAS eind dit jaar opengesteld worden voor publieke consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en De Hoop over de scheepsramp voor de kust van Hull

MPs Gabriëls and De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about environmental effects of the Hull tanker collision, its causes, differences in shipping rules, Dutch preventive measures, and whether the Dutch North Sea safety approach needs strengthening. The minister answered that effects and causes are not yet known, pending British investigations, and pointed to existing Dutch routing, monitoring and cooperation measures plus a planned risk-analysis approach.
It is therefore not yet known what the environmental effects of this incident are.
Het is dus nog niet bekend wat de milieueffecten van dit incident zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent en Kostić over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how citizens, animals and the environment are protected against LD steel slag, which RIVM classifies as hazardous, and how regulation, enforcement and interbestuurlijk toezicht will be strengthened. The State Secretary answered that duty-of-care rules and enforcement apply, that several steps (information duty, updated circular, regulatory review) are underway, and that the risks are recognised, while stating that municipalities and provinces carry enforcement responsibility.
That is why steps have been taken and I am currently working, as part of the review of soil regulation, on
Daarom zijn er stappen ondernomen en ben ik op dit moment in het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving aan de slag met
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over Chemours

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and Volt asked the State Secretary about Chemours, its recent leak and past accidents, its lobbying in Europe against the PFAS ban, and the scientific claims used by industry. The State Secretary answered that supervision of the Seveso site is shared with inspection partners, that the leak caused no soil, water or drinking water effects, and that the PFAS restriction is under assessment by ECHA, with the government saying it would take a position once the Commission proposal exists.
I am not responsible for that.
Antwoord op vragen de leden White en Gabriëls over het circulaire economiebeleid in Caribisch Nederland

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about circular economy policy in the Caribbean Netherlands, the state of waste management and plastic pollution there, and whether extended producer responsibility should be extended to these islands. The State Secretary answered that the islands have no specific circular economy policy but have environmental plans and plastic bans, that the ministry supports waste policy there, and that extending producer responsibility is not supported without prior research, while committing to examine further measures with the islands.
I am willing to examine with those islands how the actions already in place to further reduce plastic pollution can be continued.
Ik ben bereid met die eilanden te onderzoeken hoe verdergegaan kan worden met de acties die al ingesteld zijn om de plasticvervuiling verder te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wingelaar en Gabriëls over strengere regels voor het gebruik van Beaumix

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports on Beaumix, a secondary building material, and calls for stricter rules, following RIVM and Court of Audit warnings. The State Secretary replied that the findings will be incorporated into the ongoing review of soil regulation, that Beaumix may continue to be used under current quality standards if applied correctly, that lab results from Stein may be considered if representative, and that Parliament will be informed in summer 2025.
Should research show that these quality requirements need to be tightened, I will of course take that into account in implementing the aforementioned motion.
Mocht uit onderzoek blijken dat deze kwaliteitseisen moeten worden aangescherpt, dan zal ik dat vanzelfsprekend meewegen in de uitvoering van bovengenoemde motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Piri over de erkenning van het recht op een gezonde leefomgeving in het Europese Verdrag van de Rechten van de Mens

MPs Gabriëls and Piri asked whether the Netherlands will support recognising a right to a healthy environment in the European Convention on Human Rights, given other EU states' constitutional recognition and UN resolutions. The minister replied that Dutch law already protects the environment through the Constitution, Omgevingswet and related statutes, that the Netherlands is still studying the Council of Europe's CDDH report, and that a national position will be sent to Parliament later.
Your House will be informed about this position in due course by letter to Parliament, in accordance with motion 32 735 no. 373.
Uw Kamer wordt t.z.t. over deze inzet geïnformeerd per Kamerbrief conform motie 32 735 nr. 373.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over de kosten voor kwaliteitsborging van verplaatsbare tiny houses

An MP asked the Minister of Housing about the costs of private quality assurance under the Wkb for movable tiny houses, including claims that they cost up to four times as much as municipal checks and must be re-inspected at each relocation. The Minister denied the fourfold claim, said costs are comparable to the prior municipal leges for standard dwellings, but agreed to study simpler re-inspection and a standardised approach, while rejecting a price cap for now.
Recently I informed the Senate that I will examine, for the renovation, the extent to which the current quality assurance system is appropriate.
Recent heb ik de Eerste Kamer aangegeven dat ik voor verbouw zal nagaan in hoeverre de huidige systematiek van kwaliteitsborging passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Bromet over de berichten dat Zeeuwse buffels te veel PFAS binnenkrijgen

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked why the NVWA knew for two years that Zeeland water buffalo contained too much PFAS without informing the province or nature organisation, and what risks and remedies exist. The State Secretary answered that the owner was informed, no food safety risk existed since the meat was no longer sold, communication improvements and RIVM research are underway, but no direct action on the province's request was committed.

Because the buffalo were no longer slaughtered for human consumption and there was no food safety risk, there was no need to inform other parties such as the province of Zeeland and the nature organisation Het Zeeuwse Landschap.

Omdat de buffels hierna niet meer werden afgevoerd voor humane consumptie en er geen sprake was van een voedselveiligheidsrisico, bestond geen noodzaak andere partijen zoals de provincie Zeeland en natuurorganisatie Het Zeeuwse Landschap op de hoogte te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht dat vervuilende staalslakken worden geïmporteerd vanuit het buitenland

MP Gabriëls asked the State Secretary about reports that polluting steel slag is imported from abroad as waste and then used as a building material, including whether import should be restricted given health and environmental uncertainties. The State Secretary answered that import volumes are only indicative, that slag can be safely used under soil regulations regardless of waste status, and that the government will look at better safeguards in the soil regulation review but will not restrict imports.
No data can be obtained from waste monitoring for this.
Uit de monitoring van afvalstoffen zijn hiervoor geen gegevens te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht 'Een op de drie provincies voor de rechter om drinkwater'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising legal disputes over drinking water, groundwater abstraction and pricing, and how scarce groundwater should be allocated. The minister said the ministry keeps no figures on lawsuits, that groundwater extraction permits are the provinces' responsibility, and that pricing and regulation measures are being prepared, without committing to a new concrete step.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management does not keep data on the number of lawsuits concerning drinking water supply or threats thereof.
Het Ministerie van IenW houdt geen gegevens bij van aantallen rechtszaken met betrekking tot de drinkwatervoorziening of dreigingen daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White, Gabriëls en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Bewoners Bonaire geëvacueerd na grote brand bij de vuilstort’

MPs White, Gabriëls and Slagt-Tichelman asked about a large fire at the Selibon waste dump on Bonaire, its health and environmental effects, and the permit and oversight failures at the site. The government answered that the underground fire is not yet controlled, that the acting Kingdom Representative has taken over permitting and enforcement from the island authority due to neglect of duty, and that a waste plan and asbestos and biomedical waste measures are being prepared.

This led to a decision by the acting Kingdom Representative (on 15 November 2024) to step in for the island executive and make a number of decisions on permitting, supervision and enforcement at Selibon/Lagun.

Dit heeft geleid tot een besluit van de waarnemend Rijksvertegenwoordiger (op 15 november 2024) om indeplaats te treden van het bestuurscollege en daarmee te voorzien in een aantal beslissingen op het gebied van vergunningverlening, toezicht-, en handhaving (VTH) bij Selibon/Lagun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Gabriëls over de faillissementen van steeds meer koplopers in onze circulaire economie

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government what it had done after several Dutch circular plastics recyclers went bankrupt, what caused the failures, and how the government responded to cheap Chinese and virgin plastic. The state secretary answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined market causes and EU trade measures, and set out planned measures including a plastic levy from 2028, a recyclate norm from 2027 and EUR 267 million in subsidies.
The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but can confirm that the Ministry of KGG has had contact with a number of plastic recycling companies to explore options for support.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casus, maar wel bevestigen dat het Ministerie van KGG contact heeft gehad met een aantal plasticrecyclingbedrijven om mogelijkheden voor ondersteuning te bekijken.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Kostić, Wingelaar, Koekkoek, Gabriëls, Bamenga en Van Kent over het RTL Nieuws onderzoek 'Meer ziekmakende stoffen in de lucht bij 125 bedrijven door heel Nederland’

Six MPs asked the state secretary about an RTL Nieuws investigation showing rising emissions of hazardous substances (including PAK) at many industrial firms, and about the effectiveness of the ZZS minimisation duty, reporting errors at Tata Steel and the role of competent authorities. The state secretary answered that enforcement and assessment of emissions data is primarily the responsibility of competent authorities such as the provinces and environmental services, pointed to the Impulsprogramma Chemische Stoffen and the Actieagenda, promised to consult competent authorities and to ask RIVM and the Expertgroep for a reassessment, and declined to act on several requests because they fall under other bodies.
The competent authority may use all means available to it, including filing a criminal complaint; I do not interfere further in this.
Het bevoegde gezag kan gebruik maken van alle middelen die hen ter beschikking staan, waaronder het doen van aangifte, ik meng mij hier verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gabriëls en Stultiens over de uitspraken van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat in het wetgevingsoverleg Water van 18 november 2024

MPs Kröger and Gabriëls asked the government to respond to remarks by the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management that the Valencia floods could not be directly linked to climate change and that climate science is not fully settled, and whether this conflicts with IPCC findings and the collective-government principle. The Minister of Climate and Green Growth answered that climate change increased the rainfall but flood damage depends on several factors, that the minister's remarks are not to be addressed as they were made on behalf of the cabinet, and that the answers were delayed due to a climate summit.
Statements made by ministers are always on behalf of the cabinet, unless explicitly indicated otherwise.
Uitspraken gedaan door bewindspersonen zijn altijd namens het kabinet, tenzij expliciet aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gabriëls over de uitspraken van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat in het wetgevingsoverleg Water van 18 november 2024

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the minister's remarks on the Valencia floods in a November 2024 water committee meeting, which questioned the link to climate change, amounted to climate disinformation and undermined government commitments. The government answered that it does not know the Valencia situation, denies sowing doubt on climate change, affirms support for science, and says it will provide reliable information via independent institutions.
No. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management states that he does not know the situation in Valencia and makes no specific statements about the situation and possible explanations.
Nee. De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geeft aan de situatie in Valencia niet te kennen en doet geen specifieke uitspraken over de situatie en de mogelijke verklaringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over stankoverlast door een kunstmestbedrijf in Amsterdam

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about odour and emission nuisance from fertilizer producer ICL Fertilizers in Amsterdam, including health impacts, outdated norms and monitoring gaps. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (the province of Noord-Holland), noted enforcement steps such as an order under penalty and additional measurements, and pointed to ongoing programmes and studies without committing to new binding measures.
The competent authority oversees this through licensing, supervision and enforcement.
Het bevoegd gezag ziet hierop toe door middel van vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op van de leden Kostić, Van Kent, Gabriëls en Bamenga over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

MPs asked whether LD steel slag is a waste or a by-product usable as building material, citing a critical report from Stichting Natuurlijk Schoon Eerbeek, and asked about contamination risks, enforcement, financial incentives and possible suspension of use. The Minister rejected the report's conclusions, stated that the 2017 legal opinion is not a generic ruling, said use is permissible within regulatory frameworks, and announced a planned nationwide information obligation and review of soil regulation, while declining to suspend use or detail Tata Steel agreements.
As part of the review of soil regulation, I will examine to what extent it is desirable to tighten the regulations further.
In het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving zal ik bezien in hoeverre het wenselijk is de regelgeving nog verder aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht ‘Drijfveren en barrières van de leden van VvE’s bij verduurzamingsopgaven

An MP asked the minister about barriers to sustainability upgrades in homeowners' associations (VvE), including cost-allocation keys in deeds of division. The minister answered that the main barriers are technical, financial and unanimity in decision-making, pointed to the 2023 Versnellingsagenda with planned progress reporting in early 2025, and said deed changes cannot be made free of charge by notaries.
It is of great importance to implement this agenda as quickly as possible.
Het is van groot belang deze agenda zo snel mogelijk tot uitvoering te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over het bericht dat vertraging dreigt voor Tata Steel’s verduurzamingsplannen

MPs asked whether Tata Steel's delayed submission of the environmental impact report (MER) and the health effects report (GER) for its green steel plans could hold up permits, and whether parliament will see these documents before a Joint Letter of Intent is signed. The government says the company intends to submit everything in one go at year-end despite repeated warnings from the environmental service, that the GER methodology is still being developed, that negotiation details cannot be disclosed publicly, and that parliament will be briefed confidentially and may see the MER/GER if finalised before the JLoI.

Given the State's negotiating position and the possible market sensitivity of information on the negotiations, I cannot publicly address the conditions of the possible agreements between TSN and the State.

Gezien de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat en de mogelijke koersgevoeligheid van de informatie over de onderhandelingen, kan ik in het openbaar niet ingaan op de voorwaarden van de mogelijke afspraken tussen TSN en de Staat.
Antwoord op het lid Gabriëls over de certificering van bovengrondse tanks

An MP asked why the certification requirement for above-ground storage tanks was dropped in the Omgevingswet and Bal, and whether this increases environmental risks. The State Secretary replied that RIVM research shows these small tanks pose no external safety risk, that soil-protection rules still apply, and that certification would add no protection, so no reinstatement is planned.
RIVM research has shown that the storage tanks described above do not pose an external safety risk to the surroundings of the activity.
Uit RIVM-onderzoek is gebleken dat de hierboven omschreven opslagtanks geen risico voor externe veiligheid van de omgeving van de activiteit veroorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Gabriëls en Thijssen over het bericht ‘145 euro meer kwijt aan zorg bij zware industrie in de buurt: grote bezorgdheid bij experts’

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether they were concerned that residents near heavy industry face higher healthcare costs, why those costs are high, and what the government will do about health risks from industry. The government acknowledges industry can affect residents' health but says healthcare costs depend on many factors, points to ongoing studies and the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, and declines a new expert group and a large-scale costs study for now.
It is understandable that residents of these areas may be alarmed by this article, but there is a caveat to be made.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de inwoners van deze gebieden kunnen schrikken van dit artikel, maar er is hier ook een opmerking naast te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht ‘Vliegbasis Gilze Rijen en 11 andere Defensieterreinen ernstig verontreinigd met giftig PFAS’

An MP asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about reports that Gilze-Rijen air base and eleven other defence sites are heavily contaminated with PFAS, including why the 2013 data was not shared with parliament and what remediation and health measures follow. The government answered that the authorities were informed in 2020-2021, that no health risks were identified for current site use, and that remediation plans and costs will follow once risks are mapped, with a handreiking expected in autumn 2024.

Defence will periodically keep your House informed of the progress of the remediation programme and the results of any follow-up investigations into PFAS contamination on defence sites via the 'Stand van Defensie'.

Defensie zal uw Kamer via de «Stand van Defensie» periodiek op de hoogte houden van de voortgang van het saneringsprogramma en de resultaten van eventuele vervolgonderzoeken naar PFAS-vervuiling op defensieterreinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gabriëls over het overnemen van de adviezen van de Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond als harde voorwaarde bij de onderhandelingen over de maatwerkafspraken

MPs Thijssen and Gabriëls asked how health of residents and workers is systematically included in the Tata Steel maatwerkafspraak negotiations, and whether the government's commitments go beyond the motion on adopting the Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond advice. The government answers that health is an integral part of the negotiation mandate, that a health paragraph will be included in the Joint Letter of Intent, that the health impact assessment (GER) is delayed and expected in 2025, and that most correspondence cannot be shared because it would harm the state's negotiating position.
Many of the documents and correspondence contain information that could harm the State's negotiating position.
Veel van de documenten en correspondentie bevatten informatie die de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat kunnen benadelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Gabriels over het bericht 'Advies aangescherpt: speel niet in zeeschuim, maar strandganger weet van niets'

Two Green Left-PvdA MPs asked why the government quietly clarified its advice to avoid swallowing sea foam, why no warning signs were placed on beaches, and how PFAS contamination will be addressed. The minister answered that the advice was only clarified, not tightened, that signs are reserved for acute dangers, that economic motives played no role, and that the topic will be raised at the October national bathing water consultation.
This will be discussed at the next national bathing water consultation in October.
Dit zal ter sprake komen in het volgende landelijk zwemwateroverleg in oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Gabriëls over de inzet van innovatieve waterzuiveringstechnieken

MPs Stoffer and Gabriëls asked the minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about innovative water treatment techniques for PFAS, medicine residues and other pollutants, including who should pay and whether reuse can be encouraged. The minister answered that existing measures, a fourth treatment stage and an extended producer responsibility are underway, while the choice of technique and cost recovery largely rest with water managers, and that the effects of future substances cannot be fully anticipated.
It is up to the drinking water companies to assess which treatments of the abstracted water are needed to produce drinking water from it.
Het is aan de drinkwaterbedrijven om te beoordelen welke behandelingen van het ingenomen water nodig zijn om hier drinkwater van te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Gabriëls over het bericht 'Vervuiling Jelsumer Feart komt van vliegbasis Leeuwarden'

Two MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Defence about reports that PFOS contamination in the Jelsumer Feart originates from Leeuwarden air base, including exceedances far above the water-framework norm, spread risks, health risks, remediation timing and other defence sites. The government confirmed the source is on the base, described containment measures, notification of the Public Prosecution Service, a remediation plan to be tendered in Q3 2024 with intent to remediate by year-end, and an ongoing source investigation and programmatic PFAS approach across defence sites.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) has therefore been instructed to remediate the soil at the former fire-training site and the sediment in the watercourses on the air base.
Het RVB heeft daarom opdracht gekregen om de grond op de voormalige oefenbrandweerplek en het baggerslib in de watergangen op de vliegbasis te saneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over de plannen van de Waalse overheid om mijnbouw te vergunnen, vlak over de grens bij Vaals

An MP asked the minister whether Walloon plans to permit mining just across the border near Vaals were known and whether the Netherlands was involved, along with groundwater and environmental impact questions and avenues for Dutch participation. The minister answered that no concrete permit application exists, that the Netherlands asked in 2019 to be involved under the Espoo Convention, and that transboundary EIA and public participation rights apply once a concrete application is filed.
In addition, participation is also possible on a concrete permit application and on the decision of the competent authority thereon.
Daarnaast is ook op een concrete vergunningaanvraag en het besluit van het bevoegd gezag daarop inspraak mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over asfaltcentrales

MP Gabriëls asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about community concerns over asphalt plants, emission measurement frequency, continuous monitoring, covering raw materials, and energy use in public procurement. The State Secretary answered that permitting and enforcement lie with local authorities, that a minimum yearly measurement regime for PAHs and benzene is proposed, that continuous measurement is deemed too costly, and that the Deventer case and enforcement details are for municipalities to decide.
Permitting, supervision and enforcement concerning asphalt plants is the responsibility of the local competent authority.
Vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving rondom asfaltcentrales is aan het lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Gabriëls over het project Maascleanup

An MP asked about the Maascleanup volunteer project, informal arrangements for removing collected litter, and whether Rijkswaterstaat should take responsibility after a 2023 incident where collected waste was left unremoved. The state secretary said Rijkswaterstaat can collect litter under the ZOR scheme if placed at the public road, described the 2023 Grensmaas incident as a coordination failure between land managers, and saw no need for new initiatives.
Since the situation at the Grensmaas is an incident, I currently see no need to take additional initiatives.
Aangezien de situatie aan de Grensmaas een incident betreft, zie ik op dit moment geen noodzaak om aanvullende initiatieven te nemen.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Gabriëls over granuliet

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the current classification of granuliet as soil rests on 2020 parliamentary answers and a 2021 Council of State ruling, and whether granuliet differs from granite sand because of polyacrylamide. The State Secretary confirmed that granuliet meets the Soil Quality Decree definition of soil, upheld by the Council of State, and that polyacrylamide does not change this, but deferred answers to questions 6 onward on timing grounds.
The Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State confirmed on 31 October 2021 that the presence of polyacrylamide is no reason to classify granuliet differently from soil.
De Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State heeft op 31 oktober 2021 bevestigd dat de aanwezigheid van polyacrylamide geen reden is om granuliet anders te classificeren dan grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over afstemming bij de beantwoording van vragen over granuliet en granietzand

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management which departments must be consulted before answering earlier questions on granulite and granite sand, and why ongoing civil lawsuits would require extra coordination. The State Secretary replied that internal departments were consulted, that the lawsuits do not affect the answers, and that the answers will be sent as soon as carefully possible.
The answers to your questions of 28 March 2024 on granulite and granite sand will be sent to you as soon as carefully possible.
De beantwoording van uw vragen van 28 maart 2024 over granuliet en granietzand zal ik u zo spoedig als zorgvuldig mogelijk doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Bromet over de aanwezigheid van hoge concentraties van het verboden gewasbeschermingsmiddel dinoterb in oppervlaktewater in het Natura 2000-gebied het Zwanenwater

MPs Gabriëls and Bromet asked about dinoterb, a banned pesticide, found in surface water in the Natura 2000 area Zwanenwater, including its origin, enforcement capacity, sanctions and whether enforcement should be tightened. The minister said a HHNK investigation into sources is underway, that residues may leach from soil or illegal use is possible, that NVWA found no dinoterb in inspections, and that enforcement was adequate while the ministries explore improving oversight.
I am waiting for the results of the investigation before deciding whether further action is necessary.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek af om te kunnen bepalen of verdere actie noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Koekkoek, Bamenga, Gabriëls en Thijssen over Tata Steel en de HUMAN documentaire STAAL

MPs from PvdD, Volt, D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about the HUMAN documentary STAAL on Tata Steel, including alleged concealment of emissions, the reliability of company emission data, citizen-operated cameras, health ultimatums and the dismissal and rehiring of a critical employee. The state secretary answered that emissions must fall, that the government will seek faster health-focused agreements with Tata Steel, and that enforcement and monitoring lie with the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst, while declining to judge several specific allegations.
Enforcement and supervision of Tata Steel is a task of the competent authority, the province of Noord-Holland.
Handhaving en toezicht op Tata Steel is een taak van het bevoegd gezag, de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over microplastics

An MP asked the state secretary how the EU REACH restriction on intentionally added microplastics is being enforced in the Netherlands, including the lack of enforcement against glitter and small plastic products still on sale. The state secretary said the ILT and NVWA are responsible for supervision, promoted awareness and guidance, opposed a positive list, and said the Commission is preparing a Q&A document.
The ILT starts preparing supervision of compliance with the REACH restriction on loose glitters and microplastics in 2024.
De ILT start in 2024 met de voorbereiding van toezicht op de naleving van de restrictie onder de REACH-verordening op losse glitters en microplastics.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over enkele berichten rondom PFAS

An MP asks the government about PFAS contamination in backyard hen eggs, PFAS in sea foam, and the permit application by Chemours to discharge TFA, and about government's responsibilities and enforcement powers. The government answers that a risk assessment is underway, a broad research programme and EU-wide PFAS restriction are pursued, and that the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority handling the Chemours permit and enforcement.
Depending on the violation, the competent authority has a number of enforcement instruments at its disposal to act against emissions by companies.
Het bevoegd gezag heeft afhankelijk van de overtreding een aantal instrumenten tot zijn beschikking om handhavend op te treden om uitstoot door bedrijven te verminderen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriels over het artikel ´Mercedes muss über hunderttausend Diesel-Auto’s zurückrufen´

Gabriels (GroenLinks/PvdA) asked about the Mercedes diesel recall ordered by Germany's KBA, the emission defeat method, whether other manufacturers are affected, what the government has done since the 2022 EU Court ruling, the number of vehicles and extra nitrogen emissions in the Netherlands, and whether damages can be recovered from industry. The State Secretary answered that the RDW found no unlawful manipulation in its later tests, that the Netherlands supports recalls where defeat devices are found, and that recovering social damage from manufacturers is legally difficult because the State has no direct loss.
I am not aware of models from other manufacturers that are manipulated in a comparable way.
Ik ben niet bekend met modellen van andere fabrikanten die op een vergelijkbare manier worden gemanipuleerd.

qn: Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over belemmeringen voor reddingsboten

An MP asked ministers whether the Wadden Sea planning decision blocks dredging of the channel to the Ameland lifeboat station and whether they would grant an exemption to deepen it quickly. The minister answered that the planning decision does not prevent deepening if limited in scope, and that Rijkswaterstaat asked the lifeboat society to report shoaling locations so necessity can be assessed jointly.
The PKB Waddenzee does not constitute an obstacle to bringing the fairway to the desired depth, provided the deepening is limited in scope.
De PKB Waddenzee vormt geen belemmering om de vaargeul op de gewenste diepte te brengen, mits de verdieping beperkt in omvang is.
Vragen van de leden Roefs (PvdA) en Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minster van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de spoedwet verbreding A27 (ingezonden 1 juni 2010).

MPs Roefs (PvdA) and Van Gent (GroenLinks) asked the transport minister whether the A27 widening plan at Amelisweerd is more intrusive than earlier plans, whether the environmental impact assessment (MER) is adequate given the roughly 40% traffic increase, and whether ecological network (EHS) effects were properly studied. The minister replied that the plan is not more far-reaching than the 2006 startnotitie, that noise and air quality effects were modelled and monitored under the NSL, and that a nature test was conducted instead of a separate EHS study, arguing EHS has no external protective effect.
On the effect determination and weighing of alternatives within the environmental impact assessment, I refer to the answer to question 7.
Ten aanzien van de effectbepaling en de alternatievenafweging in het kader van de milieueffectrapportage verwijs ik naar het antwoord onder 7.
Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het fietspad onder het nieuwe station van Breda (ingezonden 23 september 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the bicycle access to the new Breda station's secured bicycle parking, reached only by a staircase with bicycle gutters from the south, conflicts with cycling policy, and whether a ramp should be built instead. The minister defended the design (staircase used to keep mopeds out and consistent with guidelines), rejected a ramp and wider lane as too costly, and confirmed capacity for 3,500 secured spaces.
For an assessment of the architectural design and a check on the desired functionalities, I consulted the National and Railway Architect.
Voor een beoordeling van het architectonisch ontwerp en een toets op de gewenste functionaliteiten heb ik de Rijks- en Spoorbouwmeester geraadpleegd.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het verkopen en niet accepteren van EU-regiotickets door NS (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Transport about steps taken on cross-border tariff systems, whether NS sells and refuses to accept EU regional tickets, and what means exist to oblige NS to participate. The ministry's reply is only an interim notice saying the answers will take time because consultation with NS is ongoing and answers are expected by end of October.
The answering of the questions from former MP Cramer (CU) about NS's acceptance of the Euregio ticket will take some more time.
De beantwoording van de vragen van het voormalig lid Cramer (CU) over de acceptatie van het Euregioticket door NS vergt nog enige tijd.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Sharpe (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over gevolgen van de zandmotor voor de Delflandse kust (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

PVV MPs De Mos and Sharpe asked the minister of Transport and Water Management whether the Zandmotor pilot should be halted over uncertain effects on currents, rip formation, drowning risk, munitions and sea-level rise. The minister rejected halting the project, citing active monitoring, safety measures and the need for innovative, cost-efficient coastal defence.
Also during and after the construction of the Zandmotor, effects are monitored daily.
Ook tijdens en na de aanleg van de Zandmotor worden effecten dagelijks gemonitord.
Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht dat de ov-reiziger miljoenen euro te duur uit is (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the transport minister about the share of OV-chipkaart trips where travellers forget to check out, the money transport companies earn from incomplete transactions, the number of refund claims, and whether an alert-email application will be built as requested by a motion. The minister answered with per-operator percentages, partial financial data (GVB about 190,000 euro per month, HTM about 45,000 euro per month), said most operators provided no figures, and said the operators consider the email application inopportune for now, though he will press them to reconsider.
I will urge them and TLS to take another careful look at the need for this functionality and to map out its various aspects as quickly as possible.
Ik zal er bij hen en bij TLS op aandringen om de noodzaak van deze functionaliteit nog eens goed te bekijken en de diverse aspecten ervan zo snel mogelijk nader in kaart te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de hoogte van de borg bij het reizen met de OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Transport about the level of the OV-chipkaart deposit (instaptarief of EUR 4) in regional transport, whether incomplete transactions cost travellers much, and whether the deposit should be halved. The minister rejects the criticism, says the deposit is set jointly by regional authorities to prevent unchecked travel, refuses to provide per-month transaction data, and says restitution policy for forgotten check-outs may be tightened later.
The regional authorities and their transport operators have indicated that they are not willing to provide this data.
De decentrale overheden en hun vervoerders hebben aangegeven dat zij niet bereid zijn deze gegevens te verstrekken.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de totstandkoming van grote projecten (ingezonden 9 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked ministers whether knowledge gaps among officials deciding on large infrastructure projects cause cost overruns and whether a national project centre should be created. The minister rejected a causal link, defended the existing Rijksprojectenacademie and inter-agency cooperation, and declined to set up a separate central organisation.
We are still of the opinion that a separate organisation bundling expertise and experience with large projects is not necessary.
We zijn nog steeds van mening dat een aparte organisatie waarin deskundigheid en ervaring met grote projecten wordt gebundeld, niet noodzakelijk is.

Vragen van het lid Aptroot (VVD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over «gesjoemel met veiligheidscertificaten» en het niet optreden van de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat (IVW) (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

Aptroot (VVD) asked whether rail track workers could obtain safety certificates without passing the online test, whether the inspectorate IVW should file criminal complaints, and whether safety procedures should be reviewed. Minister Eurlings acknowledged the inspectorate suspects proof-of-participation was obtained without answering questions, said IVW judged no crime occurred and the Public Prosecution Service agreed, and declined to revise the safety procedures, leaving quality assurance to the companies.
Following the publicity, the IVW nevertheless contacted the Public Prosecution Service to verify whether this decision was correct.
Naar aanleiding van de publiciteit heeft de IVW alsnog contact opgenomen met het Openbaar Ministerie om te toetsen of dit besluit terecht was.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over dubbel in- en uitchecken bij de OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

MP Slob asked the minister of Transport about double check-in and check-out on the OV-chipkaart, including NS's three-minute rule and inconsistent practices at RET and in regional transport. The minister confirmed the rules, explained the reasons for the differences, and said he would ask all carriers to look at a more uniform approach to waiting times.
From the perspective of travellers' interests, I will therefore ask all carriers to consider the possibilities for a more uniform solution for building in a waiting time after check-in and check-out.
Vanuit het reizigersbelang zal ik bij alle vervoerders daarom aandacht vragen voor de mogelijkheden van een meer uniforme oplossing om na een check-in en check-uit een wachttijd in te bouwen.
Vragen van het lid Aptroot (VVD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het uitblijven van de openstelling spitsstroken A12 Woerden-Gouda-Zoetermeer (igezonden 16 september 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Transport why the peak-hour lanes on the A12 between Woerden, Gouda and Zoetermeer were not yet open despite being built, and whether they could open immediately. The minister answered that the systems must still be connected, programmed and tested for safety, that opening is planned for 10 December 2010 and was accelerated from November 2011.
The opening will take place immediately after the testing of all systems has been completed successfully.
De openstelling zal direct plaatsvinden nadat het testen van alle systemen positief is verlopen.

Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over stand van zaken rondom de studie Rotterdam Vooruit en de Nieuwe Westelijke Oeververbinding (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

MP Cramer asked the minister of Transport and Water Management about the Rotterdam Vooruit masterplan, which compares the Blankenburg and Oranje tunnel options using allegedly non-comparable packages, underplays environmental effects, may pre-select the Blankenburg tunnel, and about stakeholder participation and adherence to the Elverding advice. The minister replied that the tunnel choice is not yet made, that both alignments are being compared fully, that the stakeholder meetings were informational and widened, and that the process follows the Elverding spirit while a formal consultation will follow.
Once this information is available for both alignments, an administrative preferred direction can be determined.
Zodra deze informatie voor beide tracés beschikbaar is, kan een bestuurlijke voorkeursrichting worden bepaald.

Vragen van de leden van Nieuwenhuizen en Lodders (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de hinder die luchthaven Schiphol ondervindt van ganzen (ingezonde

MPs Nieuwenhuizen and Lodders asked whether bird strikes with geese at Schiphol had doubled, how Noord-Holland manages goose control, and whether the province should be pressed to tighten policy. The minister answered that only six goose strikes occurred in five years, that preventive measures are necessary and under review, and that any tightening would be discussed in the national bird-strike steering group.
Yes, I share that concern. The preventive measures being taken are all necessary.
Ja, ik deel die zorg. De preventieve maatregelen die genomen worden zijn alle nodig.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over buitenlanders die een Nederlands rijbewijs krijgen (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Transport why some foreigners can exchange foreign driving licences for Dutch ones without testing while others from the same countries cannot, and asked about road safety, eligibility criteria and income or education links. The minister explained the 30% ruling scheme for specialist expatriate workers, stated that a declaration of fitness is still required, and denied any link to income or education.
It is expressly not the case that these people can exchange their foreign driving licence for a Dutch one without testing.
Het is uitdrukkelijk niet zo dat deze mensen zonder toetsing het buitenlandse rijbewijs voor een Nederlands kunnen omwisselen.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over snelheidsverhoging op het spoor (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

MP Slob asks the minister about delays in ERTMS signalling and higher speeds (160 and 200 km/h) on rail lines including Amsterdam–Utrecht, the Hanzelijn and the Zwolle area, plus the use of penalties against suppliers and funds reserved for northern Netherlands. The minister answers that the ERTMS delivery slips to December 2010 with penalties applied, that the 160 km/h option is being pursued with the sector without a fixed date, and that other items such as reisttijd effects and the 200 km/h ICE upgrade were not considered necessary.
At present no new setbacks at the supplier are known and ProRail assumes that delivery will be realised by the end of 2010.
Op dit moment zijn er geen nieuwe tegenvallers bij de leverancier bekend en gaat ProRail ervan uit dat oplevering eind 2010 wordt gerealiseerd.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat de Groningse dijken niet voldoen aan de veiligheidseisen (ingezonden

MPs Van Dekken and Samsom asked whether reports that over a third of Groningen dikes fail safety standards are true, why the 2005 inspections did not reveal this, and whether the priority list of eight weak links must change. The minister explained the six-yearly assessment process culminating in the LRT 2011 report, attributed the expected failures to tougher 2006 hydraulic boundary conditions for Wadden Sea dikes, and stated that new information will not change the priority or sequence of the eight weak links.
The LRT report will contain the assessed test results, and only then will it become clear whether over a third of the Groningen dikes no longer meets the standard.
Het LRT-rapport bevat de beoordeelde toetsresultaten en dan wordt duidelijk of ruim een derde van de Groningse dijken niet meer voldoet aan de norm.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de uitlatingen van de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat dat hij Sea Shepherd de Nederlandse vlag wil ontnemen (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Transport about his plan to strip Sea Shepherd of its Dutch flag, the controversial Zeebrievenwet amendment, and the Dutch position on Japanese whaling and detained activists. The minister replies that a new national-ship-nationality law is being accelerated, that the IVW found Sea Shepherd ships broke collision rules but no criminal investigation occurred, that the Bob Barker received a nationality declaration, and that the Netherlands sees no reason to single out Japan's trial of activists.
This process is being internally accelerated so that it can be submitted to the House of Representatives after the summer recess.
Dit proces wordt intern versneld om zodoende na het zomerreces bij de Tweede Kamer te worden ingediend.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over vertraging bij de realisatie van station Halfweg (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Transport why the Halfweg station is delayed by a year and whether Rijkswaterstaat failed to honour an agreement. The minister replies that Rijkswaterstaat was not a party to the station agreement, that the delay stems from an unresolved safety question on the N200 crossing, and that completion is now expected in mid-2012.
No, because Rijkswaterstaat is not a party to the (station) agreement between the Province, municipalities, ProRail and NS.
Nee, want Rijkswaterstaat is geen partij in de (stations)overeenkomst tussen Provincie, gemeenten, ProRail en NS.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het dragen van een niqaab (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Koopmans asks ministers whether a bus driver who refused a niqab-wearing passenger acted improperly, and what the government is doing about face covering in public transport. The minister says the driver breached company rules, the operator apologised, and that a ban would need a legal basis, so the government will leave further steps to the next cabinet.
The cabinet considers wearing such clothing undesirable.
Het kabinet vindt het dragen van dergelijke kleding onwenselijk.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Justitie over het niet voortvarend aanpakken van de bij de Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart bekende zaken (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

MP Bashir asks whether the Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart should speed up handling of passenger compensation claims after two court rulings clarified EU Regulation 261/2004, and whether the Inspectie can act against airlines or the commission. Minister Eurlings answers that the Sturgeon ruling applies as binding EU law, that the commission must follow the law and is independent, and that the Inspectie can take enforcement action against airlines but not against the commission.
As previously indicated and discussed with your House, passengers can also bring their individual complaints to the Inspectie.
Zoals eerder aangegeven en met uw Kamer is gewisseld kunnen reizigers met hun individuele klacht ook bij de Inspectie terecht.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de verkoop van het spoor bij Velsen (ingezonden 4 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Transport whether he had approved ProRail's request to sell and dismantle the Santpoort Noord–IJmuiden railway line to the municipality of Velsen, and asked about its future potential, reactivation costs and whether the sale could still be prevented. The minister confirmed his consent, said the line has no realistic future for freight or passenger service and was not designated as a main railway, and stated that the sale follows from the 2009 designation decision, against which no objection was lodged and under which the owner Rail Infratrust may sell.
Yes. I have agreed to ProRail's request to proceed with dismantling the Santpoort Noord–IJmuiden railway line and selling the land to the municipality of Velsen.
Ja. Ik heb ingestemd met het verzoek van ProRail om over te gaan tot opbreken van de spoorlijn Santpoort Noord – IJmuiden en het verkopen van de grond aan de gemeente Velsen.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het artikel «Eurlings houdt EU-brief over aswolk achter» (ingezonden 20 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister whether a June 2010 letter from Commissioner Kallas on full compensation for passengers stranded by the volcanic ash cloud was withheld, and asked for a copy. The minister denied knowing any such letter, said nothing was withheld, and pointed to his August 23, 2010 letter to the Chamber on the European approach.
No, I have not withheld any letter.
Nee, ik heb geen brief achtergehouden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht dat de ov-reiziger miljoenen euro te duur uit is (Iigezonden 24 augustus 2010).

MP Van Gent (GroenLinks) asked the minister of Transport about a newspaper report that OV-chipkaart travellers lose millions by forgetting to check out, asking how often this happens, how much transport companies earned from incomplete transactions, how many travellers reclaim money, and whether a warning-notification app was developed as requested by a motion. The minister replied that he does not have the requested data, which has been requested from decentralised authorities, and will forward it once received.
I do not have the data that is asked for. This data has been requested from the decentralised authorities.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens waarnaar gevraagd wordt. Deze zijn uitgevraagd bij de decentrale overheden.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de hoogte van de borg bij het reizen met de OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asks the transport minister about the OV-chipkaart deposit amount, incomplete transactions costing travellers money, monthly data by operator and mode, and whether deposits could be halved to 2 euro in regional transport. The minister replies that he lacks the requested data, which has been requested from regional authorities, and promises to send it to parliament once received.
I do not have the data asked for. This has been requested from the decentralised authorities.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens waarnaar gevraagd wordt. Deze zijn uitgevraagd bij de decentrale overheden.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over dubbel in- en uitchecken bij de OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

MP Slob (ChristenUnie) asks the Minister of Transport about double check-in/check-out errors on the OV-chipkaart, including the three-minute rule at NS and RET, and whether incomplete transactions are counted. The Minister responds that the requested data is not in his possession, has been requested from regional authorities, and will be sent to parliament once received.
I do not have the data that is asked for. This has been requested from the decentralised authorities.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens waarnaar gevraagd wordt. Deze zijn uitgevraagd bij de decentrale overheden.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over financiële tegenvallers bij het programma hoogfrequent spoorvervoer (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Transport and Water Management about budget shortfalls in the high-frequency rail programme (PHS), including the Almere corridor, abandoned four-tracking at Delft-Zuid to Schiedam, and the proposed Schiedam Kethel station. The minister denies that a shortfall is yet established, says alternative solutions are being sought within the budget with a decision by year-end, and states that the Schiedam Kethel station and four-tracking are not needed within PHS before 2020 and will be examined in the NMCA.
By the end of this year I want to reach a decision on this with those involved.
Voor eind van dit jaar wil ik hierover vervolgens met de betrokkenen tot besluitvorming komen.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Taxi’s speciaal vervoer sjoemelen» (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister about reports that most taxi firms, including in special transport, evade the collective labour agreement and social contributions, and asks about public money involved and the minister's responsibility to end it. The minister replies that the Social Fund Taxi imposed about 2.4 million euro in back-payments in 2009, that the ministry has no formal responsibility for CAO enforcement but supports it through general binding declaration and possible referral to the Labour Inspectorate (none requested so far), and points contracting bodies to procurement guidelines that include CAO compliance as a selection criterion.
I have no formal responsibility for monitoring compliance with the Taxi transport CAO, but the central government has a supporting role in enforcement by the collective bargaining parties
Ik heb geen formele verantwoordelijkheid bij de controle op de naleving van de cao Taxivervoer, maar de Rijksoverheid heeft een ondersteunende rol bij de handhaving door cao-partijen
Vragen van het lid De Rouwe (CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de Stichting Friese Stoomtrein Maatschappij. (Ingezonden 25 juni 2010)

An MP asks the minister of Transport and Water Management about rising costs for track adaptations needed for the Friese Stoomtrein, including whether costs can be reduced, pre-financing, the scope of safety requirements, and subsidy for ATB NG on steam locomotives. The minister replies that the design has been reviewed and costs revised downward, that a EUR 500,000 subsidy was granted to the province of Friesland for Sneek track works, and that the operator remains responsible for its rolling stock.
I have understood from ProRail that in the recent period the design was again critically reviewed and the cost estimate has been revised downward.
Ik heb van ProRail begrepen dat in de afgelopen periode het ontwerp nog eens kritisch is doorgelicht en dat de kostenraming naar beneden is bijgesteld.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Taxi’s speciaal vervoer sjoemelen» (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

The MP asks the minister about reports that special-transport taxi firms evade the collective agreement and whether their operating licences should be withdrawn, and about claims that tenders for special transport focus only on price. The minister answers that compliance with the CAO is primarily the responsibility of social partners and the Sociaal Fonds Taxi, that the IVW can suspend or revoke licences only after a civil court judgment finding serious and repeated breaches, and that quality criteria are being promoted in tenders with an annual evaluation to Parliament.
The Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management (IVW) can suspend or withdraw the operating licence. For that a judgment from the civil court is required.
De Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat (IVW) kan de ondernemersvergunning schorsen of intrekken. Daarvoor is een vonnis van de burgerlijke rechter nodig
Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over Europese richtsnoeren staatssteun zeehavens (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the transport minister whether he knows the European Commission has delayed its draft state aid guidelines for seaports and whether he will press for swift adoption in the Transport Council and directly with the Commission. The minister confirmed the delay, said he has repeatedly raised it with the Commissioner and will do so while in office, and announced that officials will brief DG Competition and a joint Dutch-German position is being prepared.
On several occasions I have raised with the Commissioner the failure to produce the guidelines.
Verschillende malen heb ik de Commissaris aangesproken op het uitblijven van de richtsnoeren.

Vragen van de leden Jansen en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de massale ontduiking van de CAO in de taxibranche (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

SP MPs Jansen and Ulenbelt asked the ministers of Transport and Social Affairs about widespread non-compliance with the collective labour agreement in the taxi sector, including fraud with social premiums, its causes, and possible enforcement. The minister replied that the Sociaal Fonds Taxi is responsible for the data, that inspectorates received no prior signals, that social partners agreed a 15% cap on agency staff, and that SFT imposes back-payments with a 10% penalty, while declining a retrospective study and pointing to social partners and existing enforcement for further action.
A study as referred to I consider neither possible nor necessary.
Een onderzoek zoals bedoeld acht ik niet mogelijk en ook niet nodig.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht dat taxichauffeurs jarenlang zijn opgelicht (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether taxi drivers were defrauded by paying around 37 euros for a taxi logbook when comparable versions cost about 3 euros, whether the minister would investigate or order repayment, and whether the annual taximeter inspection could be abolished. The minister answered that Sdu's pricing fell within permitted tariff freedom, that no investigation had been announced, that all approved logbooks meet the requirements, and that the annual taximeter inspection will be kept because consumers cannot verify it themselves.
No investigation into Sdu has been announced by me.
Door mij is geen onderzoek naar Sdu aangekondigd.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over zwemmen in rivieren (ingezonden 30 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Transport and Water Management about drownings and rescues of swimmers in rivers, the rules on where swimming is allowed under the Inland Waterway Police Regulations, the authorities responsible for exemptions, public information, and whether warning signs should be mandatory. The minister answered that no national registration of swimming incidents exists, outlined the legal framework and cooperative information campaigns, and declined to introduce mandatory signage or study its effectiveness, preferring to keep current policy.
In view of the above, I prefer to continue the current policy.
Gelet op het bovenstaande geef ik er de voorkeur aan het huidige beleid voort te zetten.
Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het derde spoor bij Zevenaar (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister about the timing of a third track near Zevenaar, residents' concerns about noise and emissions from the Betuwe line, planned measurements, freight train numbers and noise barriers. The minister answers that construction is expected to start in 2015, that the track will reduce disruption, that the MER evaluation starts in Q4 2010, and gives freight figures and budget assurances.
The evaluation of the MER begins in the fourth quarter of 2010.
De evaluatie van de MER vangt aan in het 4 de kwartaal 2010.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de problemen rondom de AIS-transponders (ingezonden 21 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Transport about privacy concerns over AIS transponders on inland vessels, citing a 2006 convenant limiting broadcast data, whether the system will be made mandatory, whether Rijkswaterstaat's dual enforcement role is problematic, and whether a privacy-intrusive tracking website can be acted upon. The Minister confirms the convenant limits AIS data to ship name and position, states no guarantee against future mandatory use (obligation not before 2013 under CCR agreement), refers the tracking website question to the Data Protection College, and says the dual-role criticism is not accepted while digital data use for enforcement is under review.
I have asked the Minister of Justice to request advice from the Data Protection College on this matter and to inform your House of the outcome of that advice.
Ik heb de Minister van Justitie verzocht het College bescherming persoonsgegevens terzake om advies te vragen en uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het advies te berichten.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Economische Zaken, van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de vogels op

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked several ministers about bird strikes at Schiphol, whether culling, scaring and egg treatment are sustainable, the costs, and whether farmland near the airport should be converted to solar energy or food crops banned there. The government answered that bird strikes are a safety priority, that a Regiegroep Vogelaanvaringen is examining feeding reduction via crop management, that a ban on food crops would be too far-reaching, and that solar panels on farmland are not yet economical or covered by subsidy.
Question 6: Are you willing to introduce a ban on growing food crops in the immediate vicinity of airports?
Vraag 6 Bent u bereid een verbod in te stellen op het verbouwen van voedingsgewassen in de directe nabijheid van luchthavens?
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de toelating van Talent-treinstellen (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Transport about the admission to the Dutch network of Talent train sets (types 643.2 and 644) for a Aachen–Heerlen–Sittard connection, including whether 2005 test runs covered both variants and whether the sandwich configuration could be approved without new test runs. The minister answered that no admission request has been filed, that both variants were admitted in 2004 with the diesel-electric variant's admission later lapsing, that the sandwich set needs practical detection tests coordinated with ProRail, and that the operator must apply to the Inspectorate.
It is a matter for the operator which rolling stock it deploys on a route.
Het is een zaak van de vervoerder welk materieel hij inzet op een traject.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de problemen met de OV-Chipkaart en tariefsverhoging door de NS in verband met de invoering van de OV-Chipkaart (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister of Transport about problems with the OV-chipkaart, NS fare changes including the end of the return ticket, and whether the minister would convene consumer groups and reconsider the system. The minister replied that consumer organisations are already involved through formal consultation, defended the fare restructuring as revenue-neutral for the average traveller, and said the card is well received after first use.
However, such a commitment was made for the introduction within regional concessions.
Wel is een dergelijke toezegging gedaan voor de introductie binnen regionale concessies.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over camera’s langs de wegen (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).
