An SP MP asked the Minister of Transport about reports of drivers braking for new roadside cameras, whether cameras cause accidents or traffic jams, which bodies may place cameras and what they record, whether competing firms duplicate cameras, and what criteria prevent a proliferation of cameras. The Minister answered that no evidence links cameras to accidents or jams, that cameras are placed sparingly under stated purposes with some personal-data safeguards and CBP notifications, and that a joint national camera system is being pursued.
VenW will make efforts toward a single joint camera system for various purposes for public parties.
Daarnaast zal VenW zich inspannen voor één gezamenlijk camerasysteem voor diverse doeleinden voor de publieke partijen.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over een spoorwegongeval bij Maarheeze (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister of Transport about the causes of a train-lorry collision at a level crossing in Maarheeze, the independence and publication of investigations, whether the crossing had been recently rebuilt to legal standards, the permit procedure for exceptional transport, camera surveillance, and technical or grade-separation measures. The minister said the inspectorate's investigation points to the lorry driver failing to clear the crossing in time, with final results expected in December 2010, reports are public, the rebuild and permit procedure are under review, and no intensification of crossing-safety measures is currently warranted.

The Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management (IVW) concludes from on-site investigation that the collision between a train and a lorry at a level crossing in Maarheeze on 22 July 2010 could have occurred because the lorry driver did not clear the crossing in time.

De Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat (IVW) concludeert op grond van onderzoek ter plaatse dat de aanrijding tussen een trein en een vrachtwagen op een overweg bij Maarheeze op 22 juli 2010 heeft kunnen plaatsvinden doordat de bestuurder van de vrachtwagen de overweg niet tijdig heeft vrijgemaakt.
Vragen van lid Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de structurele fileproblematiek rondom Amsterdam (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

MP Sharpe asked the minister of Transport and Water Management about structural traffic congestion around Amsterdam, including whether the Filetop 50 should be prioritised under MIRT as requested by a motion. The minister disputed that the situation is 'schrijnend', listed six Amsterdam bottleneck projects already in progress and pointed to the MIRT projectenboek 2010 for planning and delivery dates.
These projects are described in detail in the MIRT projectenboek 2010, including the delivery schedule.
Deze projecten staan uitvoerig beschreven in het MIRT projectenboek 2010, inclusief planning van de oplevering.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over onderaanbesteding in het regionale OV (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

MP Slob asks the minister of Transport about subcontracting in regional public transport, including coach drivers working under a different CAO, rest times, OV-chipkaart access and a single CAO. The minister replies that subcontracting is permitted under national and EU rules, that labour matters are for employers and employees, that the Wp2000 need not change, and that the concession holder remains liable.
The Stadsregio Amsterdam executive board will not take measures to shape the programme of requirements in new tenders so that subcontracting of transport becomes impossible.

Het Dagelijks Bestuur van de Stadsregio Amsterdam gaat geen maatregelen nemen om bij nieuwe aanbestedingen het programma van eisen zo vorm te geven dat onderaanbesteding van het vervoer onmogelijk wordt gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de kantoorkosten van een aantal waterschappen (ingezonden 22 juli 2010).

MP Schouw asked about media reports on high office construction costs at several water boards and whether a comparison with Zuidas office costs is valid, and asked what measures would follow. The minister replied that the data came from the water boards, that the EIB comparison of pure construction costs is nuanced, and that housing policy is the responsibility of the water boards' executive, accountable to their general boards, with the province as supervisor.
Responsibility for housing policy lies with the daily board of the water boards.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het huisvestingsbeleid ligt bij het dagelijks bestuur van de waterschappen.
Vragen van het lid De Rouwe (CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Treinverkeer Amersfoort stilgelegd na incident» (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

The MP asks why a train incident at Amersfoort led to a broad shutdown of rail traffic, who decided it and for what purpose, and whether parts of the station could have stayed open. The minister explains that ProRail halted traffic at the request of the KLPD and Inspectie for investigation and to untangle stranded trains, and commits to ask ProRail to evaluate and possibly adjust procedures on traffic flow.

I have urged ProRail to thoroughly evaluate and possibly adjust these procedures following this incident, particularly regarding traffic flow, with the other parties involved, and to inform me of the results.

Ik heb er bij ProRail op aangedrongen om deze procedures naar aanleiding van dit incident met name op het aspect «doorstroming» grondig met de andere betrokken partijen te evalueren en eventueel aan te passen, en mij over de resultaten daarvan te informeren.
Vragen van lid Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de structurele fileproblematiek rondom Amsterdam (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

MP Sharpe (PVV) asked the Minister of Transport about structural traffic congestion around Amsterdam, asking whether the situation is unacceptable, which File Top 50 bottlenecks should be prioritised under the MIRT, and when the largest projects will be completed. The minister's reply is only a holding notice stating that more time is needed and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer these questions.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat ik meer tijd nodig heb om deze vragen te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over geluidsmeetpunten rond Schiphol (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

MP Cramer asks the ministers about the reliability of noise monitoring around Schiphol, including NOMOS versus Luistervink measurements, Lden values, flight altitudes, certification data and a request for RIVM funding. The minister largely defends the existing measurement and calculation system, says the measurement-based fines idea is not feasible, and promises only to inform parliament once EU validation results are known.
I draw the conclusion that there is no realistic alternative to the current enforcement system in which Lden values are calculated with a computational model.
Ik verbind hieraan de conclusie dat er geen reëel alternatief is voor de huidige handhavingssystematiek waarbij de Lden-waarden met een rekenmodel worden berekend.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Economische Zaken, van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de vogels op

An MP asks several ministers about rising bird strikes at Schiphol, whether culling and scaring birds are sustainable, whether agricultural land near the airport attracts birds, what the costs are, and whether food crops near airports should be banned. The government only sends a notice that it needs more time and will answer as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer these questions.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat ik meer tijd nodig heb om deze vragen te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de problemen rondom de AIS-transponders (ingezonden 21 juni 2010).

MP Bashir asks the minister of Transport and Water Management about privacy problems with AIS transponders on inland vessels, including the 2006 covenant, costs, expanded uses, a guarantee against mandatory use, a public tracking website, and the dual role of Rijkswaterstaat. The minister's reply only announces that the answers will be delayed because the legal and organisational enforcement aspects take longer than expected.
Answering these questions takes more time because elaborating mainly the legal and organisational aspects of enforcement turns out to require more time than initially expected.
De beantwoording van deze vragen kost meer tijd omdat de uitwerking van met name de juridische en organisatorische aspecten van de handhaving meer tijd blijkt te vergen dan aanvankelijk verwacht.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de situatie van een boorplatform in de Noordzee (ingezonden 25 mei 2010

An MP asks ministers about reports that a Norwegian North Sea production platform was at risk after repeated drilling incidents, whether a Norwegian government report exists, whether the government will press Norway on environmental risks, and whether an emergency plan exists. The government answers that no official Norwegian report exists yet, that Statoil's investigation will be published, that Norway's regulator PSA considers the situation serious but stable, and that Dutch and Norwegian emergency plans exist.
I am willing to send the investigation report once it is available.
Ik ben bereid het onderzoeksrapport toe te zenden op het moment dat het er is.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de stand van zaken MKBA ERTMS in relatie tot het programma hoogfrequent spoorvervoer (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

MP Cramer asks the minister about the delayed MKBA on ERTMS, why it was not sent to parliament, the proven benefits of deferred braking, remaining uncertainties, and why PHS rail corridor plans ignore ERTMS. The minister answers that the MKBA was completed in January 2010 and attached, acknowledges uncertainties about deferred braking and capacity gains, and commits to a sector evaluation in 2013 informing further ERTMS implementation.
I also indicated that the Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management, on the basis of a specific safety file valid only for this route, has granted permission for deferred braking.

Ik heb daarbij ook aangegeven dat de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat op basis van een specifiek veiligheidsdossier, dat alleen geldig is op dit traject, toestemming heeft gegeven om uitgesteld te remmen.

Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de problemen met de OV-Chipkaart en tariefsverhoging door de NS in verband met de invoering van de OV-Chipkaart (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the minister of Transport about problems with the OV-Chipkaart, including rising NS fares, the loss of round-trip discounts, off-peak discount rules, and declining public support, and whether the government will act on passenger demands. The minister's reply only announces that more time is needed to answer and promises answers as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer these questions.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat ik meer tijd nodig heb om deze vragen te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Taxi’s speciaal vervoer sjoemelen» (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Transport whether taxi firms defrauding the collective agreement while transporting vulnerable people deserve to lose their licence, and what is true of the claim that tenders by municipalities and insurers consider price but not quality. The minister replies only that more time is needed and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer these questions.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat ik meer tijd nodig heb om deze vragen te beantwoorden.
Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over Europese richtsnoeren staatssteun zeehavens (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

Two VVD MPs ask the transport minister whether he is aware that the European Commission has been slow to finalise draft state aid guidelines for seaports, and whether he will raise the matter in the Transport Council and with the Commission. The minister only sends a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the deadline and promises a reply as soon as possible.
I am not able to answer these questions within the set deadline.
Het lukt mij niet om deze vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Boelhouwer (PvdA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het mogelijk manipuleren van informatie betreffende Schiphol aan de Tweede Kamer (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether he was aware of reports that he had misled Parliament and citizens about the negative effects of Schiphol's growth, and whether pressure had been put on critical researchers to alter findings. The minister rejected the characterisation, said researchers may be asked to present results more clearly but not to alter outcomes, and stated that all relevant information had been available to Parliament.
You can be assured that all information available on this matter has always been at the disposal of your House.
U kunt ervan verzekerd zijn dat alle over deze kwestie beschikbare informatie steeds tot de beschikking van uw Kamer heeft gestaan.

Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over stand van zaken rondom de studie Rotterdam Vooruit en de Nieuwe Westelijke Oeververbinding (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Minister of Transport about the Rotterdam Vooruit masterplan and the New Western Crossing, questioning the comparability of the Oranjetunnel and Blankenburgtunnel options, the treatment of nature and landscape risks, stakeholder selection, and conformity with the Elverding advisory commission's recommendations. The Minister only replies with an interim notice that more time is needed and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer these questions.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat ik meer tijd nodig heb om deze vragen te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid De Rouwe (CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de Stichting Friese Stoomtrein Maatschappij (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Transport about costs of track adaptation for the Friese Stoomtrein Maatschappij, the financing options, and whether ProRail's costs should fall on the client, and asks for subsidy for ATB NG installation. The minister only replies that more time is needed and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer these questions.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat ik meer tijd nodig heb om deze vragen te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over vertraging bij de realisatie van station Halfweg (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

MP Slob (ChristenUnie) asked the minister of Transport and Water Management whether Rijkswaterstaat failed to honour an agreement in the cooperation agreement on Halfweg station, why ProRail postponed the station by a year, and whether the station can still open in December 2011. The minister's reply is only a notice that more time is needed and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer these questions.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat ik meer tijd nodig heb om deze vragen te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid De Rouwe (CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Treinverkeer Amersfoort stilgelegd na incident» (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

Mr De Rouwe (CDA) asks the Minister of Transport about the decision to halt all train traffic around Amersfoort after an incident on 23 June 2010, asking who decided, why, whether it was for investigation or criminal matters, and why sections could not be kept open. The Minister's reply is only an interim notice that more time is needed and answers will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer these questions.
Hierbij deel ik u mede dat ik meer tijd nodig heb om deze vragen te beantwoorden.

Vragen van de leden Vendrik en Van Gent (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de geluidsoverlast voor de kerkdorpen Hernen en Niftrik in de gemeente Wijchen (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister of Transport about noise nuisance from the A50 motorway in the villages of Hernen and Niftrik, and about conflicting Rijkswaterstaat promises on quieter road surfacing. The minister said some homes may exceed 65 dB, that noise measures will be studied under a programme starting in 2011, that current law does not allow measures for traffic growth, and that quieter asphalt is intended for 2012 at the locations concerned.
I intend to apply ZOAB quieter asphalt at the locations concerned in 2012.
Ik heb de intentie om in 2012 op de betreffende locaties ZOAB aan te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over een energiebesparingsplan voor de spoorsector (ingezonden 29 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Transport and Water Management why ProRail's energy-saving plan for the rail sector was not sent to parliament, whether an integral study with cost-benefit analysis was done, what NS is doing on energy saving and whether to include agreements in the new concession, and about costs, CO2 savings, RouteLint and electrification. The minister declined to send the internal ProRail plan, said the April letter gave sufficient overview, gave substantive but partly undetermined answers on costs and savings, and declined to make further concession agreements with NS.
I consider this sufficient, so in my view it is not necessary to send the integral energy policy plan, which is an internal ProRail document, to the House of Representatives.
Dit acht ik voldoende, zodat het in mijn ogen niet nodig is om het integrale energiebeleidsplan, dat een intern document van ProRail is, aan de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het stopzetten van het project «zonnespoor» (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

MP Van Gent (GroenLinks) asked the minister of Transport and Water Management why ProRail dropped the Zutphen solar-rail pilot and whether the Ecofys report was negative, and proposed resuming it. The minister said ProRail chose solar cells on station roofs and a wind pilot instead, that the Ecofys report was an expert opinion for a prize competition rather than a judgement on the plan, and that he saw no reason to ask ProRail to resume the project.
The assessment of the prize competition is confidential.
De beoordeling van de prijsvraag is vertrouwelijk.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht dat de OV-chipkaart vanaf april 2011 in heel Nederland verplicht zou worden (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

MP Smits (SP) asked the minister whether the national steering group had announced that the strippenkaart would be abolished nationwide in April 2011, and questioned its criteria, pricing, regional pressure and readiness of the OV-chipkaart. The minister answered that the criteria stand, that no pressure was exerted by central government, that the decision to switch off the strippenkaart per region depends on meeting those criteria, and that April 2011 is a realistic target for decentralised authorities.
I assess such a request against the agreed criteria and make a positive decision at the moment the relevant authority meets the criteria.
Ik toets dit verzoek aan de afgesproken criteria en neem een positief besluit op het moment dat de betreffende overheid aan de criteria voldoet.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het besluit van het Directoraat-Generaal voor Gezondheids- en Consumentenbescherming van de Europese Commissie om gedupeerde reizigers min

An SP MP asks the Minister of Transport whether the European Commission's health and consumer directorate was right to inform stranded passengers less prominently about their right to compensation from airlines, and whether the Netherlands will seek reversal. The minister points to existing information links and the airline duty under EU Regulation 261/2004, sees no reason to approach the Commission, and refers back to his answer on information provision.
I therefore see no reason at this time why the European Commission could be called to account on this.
Ik zie derhalve op dit moment geen reden dat de Europese Commissie hierop zou kunnen worden aangesproken.
Vragen van de leden Roefs (PvdA) en Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minster van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de spoedwet verbreding A27 (ingezonden 1 juni 2010).

Two MPs from PvdA and GroenLinks ask the minister of Transport and Water Management about the A27 widening under the emergency road-widening law near Utrecht, covering capacity increase, traffic growth, the environmental impact assessment, and nature (EHS) effects. The minister's reply is only an announcement that the questions cannot be answered within the three-week deadline.
It is not possible to answer the questions within the set period of three weeks.
Het is niet mogelijk de vragen binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het besluit station Lisse niet te realiseren (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asked the transport minister why NS and ProRail decided not to reopen Lisse station for Keukenhof visitors, and whether the variant study and subsidy commitment would be shared or honoured. The minister answered that NS would not guarantee service due to capacity, cost and rolling-stock constraints, that the planning study was dropped, and that the study would be shared, though no aanlegbesluit would be taken without a service guarantee.
I asked NS and the Keukenhof foundation, and they indicated they have no objection to providing this study.
Ik heb NS en de stichting Keukenhof gevraagd en zij hebben aangegeven dat zij geen bezwaar hebben tegen het verstrekken van deze studie.
Vragen van de leden Boelhouwer en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de overlast door trillingen bij HSL-zuid (ingezonden 12 februari 2010).

MPs Boelhouwer and Samsom asked the minister about vibration nuisance from trains on the HSL-Zuid line, including whether speed, the 1994 environmental assessment, SBR standards, temporary rolling stock and mitigation measures were relevant. The minister reported 45 complaints, said speed affects vibration non-linearly, promised ProRail further investigation of vibration levels and rolling stock, and noted that noise measures do not address vibration.
In this context, anticipating the final timetable, I will instruct ProRail to conduct further investigation.
In dit kader zal ik, vooruitlopend op de uiteindelijke dienstregeling, opdracht geven aan ProRail om nader onderzoek te doen.

Vragen van het lid Poppe (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over transport van gevaarlijke stoffen op ferry’s (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

An SP MP asks the transport minister whether inadequate visibility of dangerous goods on ferries, found by the Inspectorate, undermines safe stowage, and what measures will be taken, including mandatory orange markings. The minister says the inspectorate found documentation shortcomings, outlines awareness and stricter enforcement steps, and declines to tighten marking rules because the problem lies in compliance and cargo documentation.
In the second half of 2010 the IVW will place more emphasis on checking documentation during regular inspections and will act more strictly against violations.
In de 2 de helft van 2010 wordt door IVW meer nadruk gelegd op de controle van de documentatie bij de reguliere inspecties en wordt strenger opgetreden tegen overtredingen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de uitlatingen van de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat dat hij Sea Shepherd de Nederlandse vlag wil ontnemen (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

An MP asks the caretaker Minister of Transport about his announced tightening of the Sea Shepherd ship flag rules, whether this respects parliament's declaration that his bill was controversial, and about the Japan whaling and Sea Shepherd activist issues. The minister replies only that answers will take more time due to consultation with other ministries.
Answering the questions will take some time due to consultation with my colleagues of Foreign Affairs and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality.
De beantwoording van de vragen vergt nog enige tijd in verband met afstemming met mijn collega's van Buitenlandse Zaken en Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de keuring van mobiele handbediening voor auto’s (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

An MP asked whether the RDW must test a removable mobile hand-control system for disabled drivers before market admission and why it refuses to develop a test. The minister replied that the RDW has no approval role for such removable systems, that approval would not guarantee safe installation across vehicles, and that enforcement would be difficult, while promising to monitor further developments.
I will therefore closely monitor any further steps in the development.
Ik zal daarom eventuele verdere stappen in de ontwikkeling nauwgezet volgen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent (GroenLinks) en Smits (SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een datalek in de website www.ervaarhetov.nl (ingezonden 20 mei 201

MPs asked whether OV-chipkaart websites should be placed under national responsibility after a data leak exposing 168,000 travellers, and about discount schemes requiring personal cards. The minister said decentralised authorities and carriers are responsible under the Wbp, supported a breach-notification duty, and declined to impose changes on regional tariffs or costs.
Vragen van het lid De Rouwe (CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de kritiek op sluiting van het luchtruim (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

An MP asked the transport minister about criticism that the airspace closure over volcanic ash was unnecessary, whether safety remains paramount, which measurement methods are used, whether LVNL was prevented from operating on 17 May, how European and US models compare, and how to accelerate Single European Sky. The minister answered in detail, defending the closure as based on KNMI maps and a European procedure, describing the new Dutch zoning from 23 May, and outlining steps toward SES including a FABEC coordinator and network coordinator.
On Monday 17 May 2010 no formal airspace closure took place, but LVNL took operational measures due to high concentrations of volcanic ash.
Op maandag 17 mei 2010 heeft geen formele luchtruimsluiting plaatsgevonden, maar zijn er door LVNL operationele maatregelen getroffen

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de situatie van een boorplatform in de Noordzee (ingezonden 25 mei 2010

An MP asked three ministers about reports that a North Sea drilling platform was at risk of collapse, whether a Norwegian report exists and can be shared, whether the platform was evacuated, who supervises its stability, and whether a contingency plan exists for an oil leak like the Gulf of Mexico. The minister only sent an interim notice that answers will follow later because interdepartmental consultation is needed.
Because consultation with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is necessary, the questions cannot be answered within the three-week deadline.

Omdat overleg met het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en met het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken noodzakelijk is, kan de beantwoording van de vragen niet binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken afgerond worden.
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Eski (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over veelvuldige treinstoringen op de lijn Winterswijk–Arnhem (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

MPs Ormel and Eski (CDA) asked the transport minister about repeated train disruptions on the Arnhem–Winterswijk line, including causes, frequency, information for passengers and replacement transport. The minister answered that the faults stemmed from a new axle-counter system interacting with magnetic brakes, that a replacement part is being installed, and that ProRail acknowledged its errors and will draw lessons learned.
ProRail has publicly acknowledged its mistakes and provided me with the data needed to answer the preceding questions.
ProRail heeft haar fouten publiekelijk erkend en mij de gegevens verstrekt voor de beantwoording van de voorgaande vragen.

Vragen van de leden Polderman en Poppe (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het storten van s

Two SP MPs asked ministers about the dumping of steel slag in the Oosterschelde after a Breda court interim ruling urging serious research into effects. The minister said the ruling is considered in the pending objection on an enforcement request, that existing monitoring will report this summer, that only certified materials are used, and that dumping will not be suspended for flood-safety reasons.
In the interest of safety, I am not willing to suspend the work.
In het belang van de veiligheid ben ik niet bereid de werkzaamheden op te schorten.

Vragen van de leden Cramer en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over spoorlijn BredaUtrecht in

MPs Cramer and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked ministers whether the A27 widening plan keeps a future Breda–Utrecht rail line possible, questioning the study method, space reservation, and the Nijpels advice. The minister answers that the A27 widening will not make a future rail line impossible, promises further study in the second MER phase, and defers on the advisory group's critique pending discussion.
In the second MER phase of the A27 Lunetten–Hooipolder planning study I will further give shape to my commitment to the House on keeping the rail line from being made impossible.
Ik zal in de 2 e fase MER bij de planstudie A27 Lunetten–Hooipolder mijn toezegging aan de Tweede Kamer over het «Niet onmogelijk maken» van de spoorlijn nader vorm geven
Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over veerdiensten en de daartoe verleende subsidiegelden (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister about a report on ferry services and whether provinces' subsidy use and lack of follow-up policy warrant a national framework. The minister said decentralised authorities bear responsibility, promised an evaluation by year-end, and declined to change the responsibility split or impose national norms before the results are in.
I consider it too early to give a substantive response to this question. I am waiting for the outcome of the evaluation.
Ik acht het te vroeg om nu een inhoudelijke reactie te geven op deze vraag. Ik wacht hiervoor het resultaat van de evaluatie af.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over een groen geluidsscherm (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether the claimed fine-dust capture of the CleanScreen noise barrier (equivalent to 8000 trucks a day) contradicts the test finding of no significant air-quality gain, and whether a green barrier should be retested in summer. The minister answers that the two studies asked different questions, that the reference screen performed as well as the innovative ones, and sees no reason for further research.
I therefore see no reason to conduct further research.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding nader onderzoek te doen.
Vragen van het lid Roemer (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over ProRail die investeert in stroom voor de weg (ingezonden 10 december 2009).

MP Roemer asked the minister whether ProRail's plan to supply electricity for electric cars on motorways, and whether ProRail funds meant for rail would be used for this, was acceptable. The minister said ProRail has no role in road electrification, will submit a proposal for review, that Rijkswaterstaat is not an electricity supplier, and that ProRail assured no rail funds will be used.
In line with my commitment during the General Consultation of 24 March 2010 on the 2010 management and transport plan, I will inform you by the end of May 2010 at the latest about ProRail's proposal.
In lijn met mijn toezegging tijdens het Algemeen Overleg op 24 maart 2010 inzake het beheer- en vervoerplan 2010 zal ik u uiterlijk eind mei 2010 informeren over het voorstel van ProRail.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bromfietsrijbewijs (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Transport about first experiences with the moped practical exam, its costs, driving school availability, the CBR fee of 95 euro, and effects on moped use. The minister reported 541 candidates in March 2010 with an 84% pass rate, said it was too early to answer the cost and instruction questions, promised an evaluation with results in March 2011 and a road-safety evaluation by 2013, and said the fee is cost-covering and subject to ministerial approval.
I currently think it is still too early to make statements about the aspects of the moped practical exam you mention.
Ik vind het momenteel nog te vroeg om uitspraken te doen over de door u genoemde aspecten van het bromfietspraktijkexamen.
Vragen van het lid Eski (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het artikel «De stalling is vol» (ingezonden 16 februari 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about a newspaper report that bicycle parking at stations is full, whether planned expansion is enough, whether bikes left over three days should be discouraged, and whether bikes removed when no space is available is acceptable. The minister confirmed growing cycling demand, said long-stay limits could be site-specific, accepted removal only where bikes cause hindrance or danger, and promised a letter on medium-term parking plans before summer 2010.
As announced during the General Consultation of 19 November 2009, I will inform you before summer 2010 about how medium-term demand for bicycle parking at stations can be met.

Zoals tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 19 november 2009 aangekondigd, zal ik u voor de zomer 2010 informeren over de wijze waarop op de middellange termijn voldaan kan worden aan de vraag naar fietsparkeervoorzieningen bij stations.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de enorme vertragingen voor luchtvaartpassagiers door de aswolk (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asked the transport minister how Regulation 261/2004 applies to passengers stranded by the Icelandic volcanic ash closures, what airlines must compensate, and whether passenger rights were respected. The minister answered that the ash closure counts as extraordinary circumstances excusing financial compensation but not care and refund duties, that the Inspectorate will assess complaints case by case, and that the total number of affected passengers is unknown.
No complaints have so far been received by the Inspectorate.
Bij de Inspectie zijn tot nu toe nog geen klachten binnengekomen.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over waterschapsheffingen voor winkelbedrijven (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether retail companies pay too much water board levy, whether the RND's complaints about pre-filled returns and the one-month filing deadline are justified, and whether the RND's recommendations will be adopted. The minister answered that pre-filled data may be inaccurate and the issue will be examined together with the water boards and the RND, without committing to specific recommendations.
Together with the Union of Water Boards, the RND will further survey which problems retail businesses encounter and which solutions are possible.
Samen met de Unie van Waterschappen zal met de RND nader worden geïnventariseerd tegen welke problemen de winkelbedrijven aanlopen en welke oplossingen mogelijk zijn.

Vragen van het lid De Rouwe (CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de kritiek op het vliegverbod dat is ingesteld na de uitbarsting van de vulkaan Eyjafjallajökull (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

MP De Rouwe asked the transport minister about criticism of the airspace closure after the Eyjafjallajökull eruption, including who decided, the data used, the precautionary principle, economic damage and the Single European Sky. The minister referred to an earlier letter for most questions, acknowledged personal and economic damage, and said he would stress the Single European Sky to EU colleagues.
See my letter of 3 May 2010 (parliamentary paper 21 501-33, no. 276).
Zie mijn brief van 3 mei 2010 (Kamerstuk 21 501-33, nr. 276 ).
Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over veiligheid in het openbaar vervoer (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An MP asks the ministers about the lack of action against aggression on public transport: whether new safety measures have been implemented, camera coverage on buses, budget for Taskforce recommendations, incident figures, and a national travel ban for offenders. The ministers answer that Taskforce measures will be implemented largely in 2010 with progress reports, that remaining buses lacking cameras are being addressed, that EUR 4 million is available, that incidents are not uniformly registered, and that a national travel ban law amendment will be submitted to parliament as soon as possible.
I will submit this law amendment to the House as soon as possible.
Deze wetswijziging zal ik zo spoedig mogelijk aan de Kamer voorleggen.

Vragen van de leden Roefs en Laaper (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over geld voor sociale veiligheid (ingezonden 24 maart 2010).

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers of Transport and of Home Affairs about rising or stable aggression on regional buses, what provinces are doing, how much central funding exists for social safety, and whether the approach should be uniform in tender requirements. The ministers answered that victimisation is stable, that decentralised authorities have discretion over the broad transport grant, that a taskforce assigns specific measures to provinces, and that decoupling tender procedures is not advisable.
In the accountability for the spending of the BDU, the funds for social safety are not separately identifiable.
In de verantwoording van de besteding van de BDU zijn de middelen voor sociale veiligheid niet separaat herkenbaar.

Vragen van de leden Aptroot , Remkes en Neppérus (allen VVD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat, van Financiën en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het artikel «Ambtenaren willen rij

MPs from the VVD asked ministers whether a covenant between industry and government on favourable tax treatment of green gas for vehicles was being prepared and whether Parliament would be informed before signing. The minister confirmed industry requested the covenant, that ministries are assessing it for cost-effectiveness, and promised to inform Parliament and consult before any covenant is signed.
Before a covenant would be concluded, the cabinet will inform the House and, if desired, consult with you.
Alvorens een convenant zou worden gesloten zal het kabinet de Kamer informeren en indien gewenst met u overleggen.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de mogelijke fusie tussen Transdev en Veolia (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister about a possible Transdev-Veolia merger, market power rules, concession transfers, works council views, and whether the state could buy back Connexxion and tighten bus tendering. The minister answered that merger control rests with the NMa and the European Commission, that market power articles of the Wp2000 never entered into force, and that the market remains competitive with no reason to intervene, while reserving the state's sale-option terms and planned amendments to the PSO rules.
The choice whether or not to merge lies with the private parties themselves.
De keuze om al dan niet te fuseren ligt bij de private partijen zelf.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «CBR-directie vult haar zakken» (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Transport and Water Management whether it is outrageous that the CBR directorate gave itself a pay rise while the organisation was still making mistakes, and whether that is acceptable. The minister replied that the pay was set by the CBR supervisory board, that he finds the fees high for a public body, and that he will cap directors' pay at the public-sector salary norm by amending the CBR statutes.
The remuneration of the directorate is set by the CBR's Supervisory Board under the current articles of association.
De beloning van de directie is op basis van de huidige statuten van het CBR vastgesteld door de Raad van Toezicht.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de invoeringskosten van de OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 30 maart 2010).

MP Smits asks the minister whether reported cost overruns and lower revenues for the OV-chipkaart in Groningen and Drenthe are true, whether other regions face shortfalls, and which costs and revenues differ from estimates. The minister confirms higher system costs and lower expected card sales, attributes them to later introduction and development, and notes that Groningen-Drenthe bears the revenue risk as a decentralised operator.
The OV bureau Groningen Drenthe has informed me that the costs of purchasing hardware and software and of maintaining and managing the system are higher than expected.
Het OV-bureau Groningen Drenthe heeft mij aangegeven dat de kosten voor de aanschaf van de hard- en software en het instandhouden en beheren van het systeem hoger zijn dan verwacht.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het aantal mensen dat vergeet uit te checken met de OV-chipkaart en geld terug vraagt (ingezonden 12 februari 2010).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Transport about reports that many OV-chipkaart travellers forget to check out, how many forgo refunds, and how much money transport operators retain as a result. The minister said the 270,000 weekly figure could not be confirmed because operators count incomplete rides rather than travellers, provided partial regional data and NS figures, and said operators cannot yet quantify retained funds, promising to keep reducing incomplete transactions and consider returning leftover money to travellers.
At present no complete overview is available of the number of incomplete transactions across all areas where the OV-chipkaart has been rolled out.
Op dit moment is er nog geen compleet overzicht beschikbaar van het aantal incomplete transacties van alle gebieden waar de OV-chipkaart is uitgerold.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier, Willemse-van der Ploeg en Mastwijk (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Weten

MPs asked whether school and contract transport vehicles must use winter tyres and whether the government will require safe vehicles for contracted transport of children. The minister replied that no winter-tyre obligation exists, that contracting authorities can set such requirements in tenders, and that a winter-tyre campaign and guidance on tendering will be launched.
I will inform you of the results of these actions.
Ik zal u over het resultaat van deze acties informeren.
Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over duurzaam zoab (ingezonden 15 februari 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Transport about the lifespan, winter frost damage, monitoring, and life-cycle costs of porous asphalt (zoab) road surfaces after a harsh winter. The minister answered in detail, explaining monitoring and maintenance practice, ongoing research, and that the government already uses modified-bitumen zoab+ with contractual bonus/malus incentives and lower life-cycle costs.
Rijkswaterstaat has carried out research into the life-cycle costs of ordinary zoab and of zoab+, which has been applied almost always since 2007.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft onderzoek verricht naar de life cycle-kosten van gewoon zoab en van het sinds 2007 vrijwel altijd toegepaste zoab+.
Vragen van de leden Atsma en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de positie van verkeersregelaars bij evenementen (ingezonden 9 maart 2010).

CDA MPs asked the transport minister about the legal position of traffic marshals at events after a court case in which a driver ignored a marshal's signal and was prosecuted, asking about liability, marshal training, and whether their position needs improvement. The minister answered that drivers must obey marshals and bear responsibility, that the court acquitted the marshals, that event organisers may use trained or volunteer marshals, and that no measures are planned.
I see no reason to make changes in this regard.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hierin wijzigingen aan te brengen.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Roefs (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de beschonken «bob» (ingezonden 9 maart 2010).

MPs Bouwmeester and Roefs asked the ministers of Transport and of Health about a newspaper report that designated drivers ('Bobs') often drink, and about why men might think they can drive above the legal limit. The government disputes the report's methodology, cites its own evaluations showing fewer drivers drinking, explains gender differences in risk perception, and rejects publishing maximum drink guidance while keeping the zero-alcohol message.
I want to stress that the cabinet's position is and remains that alcohol and driving do not mix.
Ik wil benadrukken dat het kabinetsstandpunt is én blijft dat alcohol en verkeer niet samengaan.

Vragen van de leden Samsom en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het door de NS inzetten van eigen personeel om treinen schoon te maken (ingezond

PvdA MPs asked whether NS using its own staff to clean trains during a national cleaners' strike amounts to strike-breaking, and whether NS should be pressed to offer decent contracts. The minister answered that legality is for courts, the Arbeidsinspectie found two breaches of the Waadi ban on supplying labour during conflicts, that voluntary removal of hazardous dirt is not strike-breaking, and that the labour-pay question lies with the cleaning contractor; he would raise concerns with employers via the labour minister.
In two cases it was established that article 10 of the Waadi had been breached.
In twee gevallen is geconstateerd dat artikel 10 van de Waadi is overtreden.
Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstraat over uitchecken met de OV-chipkaart voor een grensovergang (ingezonden 12 maart 2010).

MP Verdonk asked the minister whether Dutch travellers must check out with the OV-chipkaart before a border crossing and how this works on a train without leaving it, and whether the government will fix the problem. The minister answered that the OV-chipkaart is a domestic ticket, international trips still need a paper ticket, and NS is studying how to avoid check-out for annual pass holders before the obligation takes effect.
NS has informed me that it is investigating how to prevent holders of the above-mentioned cards from having to check out at the border on international journeys in the future.
NS heeft mij laten weten dat zij onderzoekt hoe in de toekomst voorkomen kan worden dat houders van bovengenoemde kaarten bij een internationale reis moeten uitchecken voor de grens.
Vragen van het lid Roefs (PvdA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over ruzie tussen Arriva en de NS (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether passengers were fined for using NS discount cards on regional trains after a dispute between Arriva and NS, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister answered that no fines were reported, that the operators resolved the card's validity themselves, and that no further meeting was needed.
No, no reactions about fines have been received at my ministry.
Nee, er zijn bij mijn ministerie geen reacties binnengekomen over boetes.
Vragen van het lid Vendrik (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het onderzoek naar een glazen overkapping voor de A27 (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

MP Vendrik (GroenLinks) asked the transport minister whether the regional authority BRU had approached the ministry about a feasibility study for a glass covering over parts of the A27 in Utrecht, whether a cost-benefit analysis would be commissioned, and how the minister judged the award-winning concept. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is involved in supporting the study, declined a cost-benefit analysis because a Rotterdam study found benefits did not outweigh costs, and said the concept scores poorly on practical and cost-effectiveness grounds.
No. In my letter of 2 March 2010 I indicated that a cost-benefit analysis was carried out in Rotterdam on the glass covering concept.
Nee. In mijn brief van 2 maart 2010 (VenW/DGMo-2010/848) heb ik aangegeven dat er in Rotterdam een MKBA is uitgevoerd naar het concept van de glazen overkapping.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht dat skimmers loeren op ov-opladers (ingezonden 9 maart 2010).

An MP asked the transport minister about reports that skimmers were targeting OV-chipkaart top-up machines, whether paper strippenkaarten should remain available, whether travelers should be told where skimming occurred, and how much public money was spent on OV-chipkaart teething problems. The minister said the problem concerns bank cards nationwide, that the GVB transit operator is investigating measures and will not name locations due to a police probe, and that no public money has been spent on fixing skimming.
Because of an ongoing police investigation, the location where the skimming took place cannot be disclosed.
In verband met een lopend politieonderzoek kan de locatie waar het skimmen heeft plaatsgevonden niet bekend worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over pleegzorg

An MP asked the government about foster care screening after a case of a 10-year-old girl in Vlaardingen, covering the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming certificate, motives of prospective foster parents, periodic screening, Veilig Thuis procedures, and whether children are interviewed privately. The State Secretary answered each question in detail, describing existing procedures and periodic checks while committing to no new measures.
Ensuring safety is fundamental when placing a foster child in a (new) foster family.
Het borgen van de veiligheid is fundamenteel bij het plaatsen van een pleegkind in een (nieuw) pleeggezin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulp aan jongeren en volwassenen met eetstoornissen

An MP (Westerveld, GroenLinks-PvdA) asks what concrete steps have been taken since 2021 to improve care for people with eating disorders, including the effects of the 2021 €50m acute youth mental health funding, the status of regional expertise networks and Gezondheidsraad recommendations, and rising waiting times. The state secretary answers that K-EET networks, information tools and funding were developed, that national figures on treatment capacity are not kept, that waiting times rose due to structural shortages and a broad approach is needed, and points to a 2026 subsidy and other initiatives, without quantified targets or new monitoring commitments.
These figures are not kept at national level.
Deze cijfers worden niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Eén op twintig ouderen wordt mishandeld: We zien het topje van de ijsberg’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that one in twenty elderly people are abused, the taboo and low reporting to Veilig Thuis, campaigns, the information box on financial abuse, police and prosecution data, and bank and notary cooperation. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging the problem and taboo, citing the 2018 prevalence study, describing campaigns and alliances, and committing to explore a new prevalence study and an updated information box, while saying some data (police, prosecution, professional misconduct) is not registered.
At national level, Veilig Thuis has no insight into who reports which form of domestic violence.
Op landelijk niveau is er bij Veilig Thuis geen zicht op wie welke vorm van huiselijk geweld meldt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘In Gambia dreigt genitale verminking weer legaal te worden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the government would act against a Gambian bill that would legalise female genital mutilation, including aid, diplomatic contacts and prevention in the Netherlands. The government answered that it opposes FGM, has raised the issue with the Gambian government and works through EU projects and campaigns, but has no direct Dutch programmes on FGM in Gambia.
Our ambassador in Dakar has repeatedly discussed the Dutch position on the bill to legalise female genital mutilation with representatives of the Gambian government.

Onze ambassadeur in Dakar heeft de Nederlandse positie met betrekking tot het wetsvoorstel betreffende legalisering van vrouwelijke genitale verminking meermaals met vertegenwoordigers van de Gambiaanse regering besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Instanties waren jaren op de hoogte van misstanden op zorgboerderij Wekerom'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how authorities could have ignored reports of abuse and exploitation of children at a care farm in Wekerom, including the role of the Leger des Heils as guardian, and what would be done to strengthen supervision of youth care. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate (IGJ) is assessing nine signals, that individual cases cannot be discussed for privacy reasons, that an independent investigation is not needed for now, and that the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit will gain supervisory tasks under a pending bill.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de rechtsbescherming van ouders en kinderen bij spoedverzoeken aan de kinderrechter

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about inadequate legal protection of parents and children in urgent court applications for out-of-home placement, citing an article on procedural shortcomings and ECHR Articles 6 and 8. The minister acknowledged the need for improvement, pointed to a forthcoming bill (contours to Parliament in autumn 2024), an ongoing legal aid pilot to 31 December 2024, and ongoing fact-finding work, but declined to commit to immediate measures.
The contours of the bill will be communicated to the House in the autumn of this year.
Over de contouren van het wetsvoorstel wordt uw Kamer in het najaar van dit jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Voor miljarden aan zorgfraude gepleegd, maar pakkans nihil: ’En zorgpremies stijgen steeds meer’

The MP Dobbe asks the minister how the government will tackle healthcare fraud, whether market organisation of care and open-house constructions make fraud easier, and whether budget cuts combined with billions lost to fraud is consistent. The minister answers that fraud will be addressed through the Wbsrz, the Wibz bill and extended licensing, rejects the claim that cuts double-hit care, and says the Wibz bill and a study on open-house models are underway, while rejecting a ban on profit distribution and the claim that abolishing market forces would reduce fraud.
I find it reprehensible that public healthcare funds are being abused and that patients are the victims.
Ik vind het verwerpelijk dat er misbruik wordt gemaakt van publieke zorggelden en dat patiënten daar de dupe van worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over correspondentie tussen IGJ en een huisarts

An FVD MP asked for the full email correspondence between the health inspectorate (IGJ) and a GP, and any correspondence with Twitter about the GP's account, referenced in a February 2021 ministry email as 'this man'. The minister answered that the IGJ had no correspondence with the person referred to as 'this man' and no correspondence with Twitter about the GP's account.
After inventory, it turned out that the IGJ had no correspondence with the person referred to as 'this man'.
Na inventarisatie is gebleken dat de IGJ geen correspondentie heeft gehad met de persoon waarnaar werd gerefereerd als «deze man».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Zwaargewond pleegmeisje (10) vertelde op school dat ze werd mishandeld, toch moest ze terug naar huis'

The MP Crijns asks how local authorities, foster care organisations, the school, Veilig Thuis and the police could ignore repeated abuse warnings about a 10-year-old foster child, and what will be done to prevent recurrence and inform biological parents. The State Secretary answers that joint inspectorate research is underway, which must be awaited before conclusions, while pointing to the meldcode, complaint routes for parents, and existing child-listening initiatives.
This investigation is being carried out jointly by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) and the Inspectorate of Justice and Security (IJV), with involvement of the Inspectorate of Education.
Dit onderzoek gebeurt in gezamenlijkheid door de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) en Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (IJV) met betrokkenheid van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Nieuw beeld van daders seksuele uitbuiting: bijna 90 procent heeft migratieachtergrond en ze vallen na straf terug in oud gedrag’

MPs Tielen and Brekelmans asked about a report on perpetrators of sexual exploitation (predominantly with migration background, reoffending after sentence), including attention to people with mild intellectual disability, the effects of the LVB policy study, attachment problems in youth care, and further research. The state secretary points to the LVB-proof criminal justice agenda, existing youth care guidelines, planned research and the forthcoming reinforced anti-trafficking action plan, without committing to a new specific measure.
Your House was informed by letter of 23 April about, among other things, the recent research of the National Rapporteur
Uw Kamer is per brief van 23 april jl. geïnformeerd over onder meer het recentelijk onderzoek van de Nationaal Rapporteur
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Vapes van Nederlandse kinderen in lab onderzocht: bomvol gif, lood en te veel nicotine'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health about lab findings that illegal vapes used by Dutch children contain toxins, lead and excess nicotine, and asked what the NVWA is doing against their sale on social media. The State Secretary confirmed enforcement at importers, distributors, shops and online platforms (3.6 million vapes withdrawn, over 1,000 posts removed) and pointed to youth prevention campaigns.
Since January the NVWA has had over 1,000 advertisements and posts offering vapes removed from social media and platforms.
De NVWA heeft sinds januari ruim 1.000 advertenties en posts waarin vapes worden aangeboden van social media en platformen laten verwijderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat er in vapes van Nederlandse kinderen giftige metalen, kankerverwekkende stoffen en veel meer nicotine zit dan wettelijk is toegestaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health how the government will address vapes containing toxic metals, carcinogens and excess nicotine, and how sales to minors and the industry will be controlled. The State Secretary answered that these products are unacceptable, that the NVWA has removed 3.6 million vapes from the market, that enforcement powers and fines will be increased, and that a neutral packaging requirement and a list of banned additives are coming.
The NVWA is the supervisory authority under the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act, which covers vapes.
De NVWA is de toezichthouder op de Tabaks-en rookwarenwet, waar de vapes onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Tielen over de bijschrijfplicht in de horeca

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Tielen asked about the mandatory listing (bijschrijfplicht) of day managers in hospitality licences, including its purpose, costs, screening tools and municipal practice. The Minister answered that the requirement is kept for hospitality businesses under the Alcohol Act, that the Bibob and good-conduct checks justify it, and that the government is still consulting municipalities and KHN on administrative burden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de financiële problemen in de jeugdhulp steeds erger worden

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport how the government will respond to reports from the Jeugdautoriteit that financial problems in youth care are worsening, and whether planned cuts should be reconsidered. The state secretary answered that the report is nuanced, pointed to existing continuity arrangements, a subsidy scheme and a transition fund, and said the 2025 cut was not carried forward while the 2026 measure is for the next cabinet to decide, with a expert commission advising in 2025 and 2028.
I will of course continue to monitor this closely.
Ik blijf dit uiteraard nauwgezet monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Bromet over de geplande lelieteelt naast OBS De Singelier, gemeente Westerveld

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Bromet asked about a planned lily farm next to a primary school in Westerveld, where pesticide exposure concerns arise, and what advice parents and schools can get. The State Secretary answered that GGD advice is available, that a RIVM study on pesticides and residents is underway, that a motion on spray-free zones is being considered, and that the Omgevingswet allows municipalities to apply the precautionary principle.
Since a lot of crop protection agents are used in lily cultivation, the Minister of LNV will start an investigation into how the expansion of the lily acreage can be limited.
Aangezien in de lelieteelt veel gewasbeschermingsmiddelen worden gebruikt, gaat de Minister van LNV een onderzoek starten naar hoe de uitbreiding van het areaal in de lelieteelt beperkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat het aantal mensen in Nederland met gonorroe flink doorstijgt

MP Paulusma asked the ministers about the rise in gonorrhoea and falling condom use among young people, and about access to STI care, prevention campaigns, municipal funding and sexual health education. The State Secretary answered that the trends are worrying but not yet calling for acute action, that further research and policy decisions on sexual health care are pending for a next cabinet, and that no measures were accelerated.
Decision-making on the system and financing of (supplementary) sexual health care, however, is left to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming over het stelsel en financiering van de (aanvullende) seksuele gezondheidszorg is echter aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de aanpak van zorgfraude in Tilburg

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the minister how the government responds to reports that Tilburg's fraud enforcement against care providers was arbitrary, whether providers can defend themselves, and whether national bodies should take over care fraud oversight from municipalities. The minister says legal remedies (objection, appeal, ombudsman, civil claims) exist, points to joint measures and pilot projects, and rejects a centralised approach, while noting that excessive profit distribution will be tackled through a bill.
If there is a decision as referred to in the General Administrative Law Act, legal remedies such as objection and (higher) appeal are open within the administrative law framework.
Indien sprake is van een besluit als bedoeld in de Awb, dan staan er binnen de bestuursrechtelijke kaders rechtsmiddelen open zoals bezwaar en (hoger) beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Hermans over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about a report that at least 172 people died from taking suicide powder Middel X, and about prevention, registration and legal options. The minister says the research shows diverse victims, keeps the current access-limiting code rather than tightening it, and promises further study, a Wtl evaluation and changes to forensic autopsy powers.
I do not intend to further tighten the threshold-raising policy.
Gelet hierop ben ik niet voornemens om het drempelverhogend beleid verder aan te scherpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Mohandis over het bericht dat geïnstalleerde trapliften vaak nog steeds niet voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit en dit tegenstrijdig is met valpreventie beleid

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Mohandis asked whether stairlifts installed via the Wmo often fail Bouwbesluit safety minimums, whether the ministry's guidance is being used, and whether compliance can be a GALA funding condition, among nine questions. The minister said no signals of widespread non-compliance were received, that enforcement and compliance are municipal responsibilities under the decentralised Wmo and Woningwet, and that the guidance is voluntary and not a GALA condition, while committing to ensure the VNG repromotes the guidance.
Under the Wmo 2015, the municipality (as client and owner) must ensure that the stairlift complies with all regulations, including the Bouwbesluit.
Op grond van de Wmo 2015 moet de gemeente (zijnde opdrachtgever en eigenaar) zich verzekeren dat de traplift voldoet aan alle regelgeving waaronder het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Mila woont met haar pasgeboren baby in een auto in Noord, urgentieverklaring afgewezen'

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked the ministers how they view Amsterdam refusing an urgency declaration for a mother and newborn living in a car, and whether they would act against such policy. The minister answered that municipalities hold discretion over urgency criteria, that Amsterdam says it tried to prevent the situation, and that he will not discuss the case specifically for privacy reasons.
It is up to the municipal council to set criteria for determining which housing seekers qualify for urgency.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om criteria vast te stellen aan de hand waarvan kan worden bepaald welke woningzoekenden in aanmerking komen voor urgentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over verspreiding van medische misinformatie op sociale media

An MP asks the government how it responds to the spread of medical misinformation on social media, its effects on trust in vaccination, contraception and maternity care, and whether platforms and regulators under the DSA should act. The government answers that it relies on platform responsibilities under the DSA, the Commission's enforcement, prebunking, trusted doctors' initiatives and public information, and declines to regulate content or require BIG registration for information-sharers.
It is still too early to assess whether very large online platforms and search engines are taking sufficient measures to mitigate that risk.
Het is nu nog te vroeg om te kunnen beoordelen of zeer grote online platforms en zoekmachines voldoende maatregelen nemen om dat risico te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het onder verscherpt toezicht stellen van de ZIKOS-afdelingen Harreveld en Zetten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Inspectorate's decision to place two closed youth care (ZIKOS) departments under heightened supervision, and about unlawful restraint, suicidal youths, transfers and Woodbrookers. The State Secretary answered that heightened supervision runs six months with extra visits, that the Inspectorate is reflecting on its own supervision and that no further measures to strengthen it are planned.
The Inspectorate decided on its own initiative to reflect on its supervision of the ZIKOS departments.
De IGJ heeft op eigen initiatief besloten te reflecteren op haar toezicht op de ZIKOS-afdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de vergoeding van medische hulpmiddelen die nodig zijn om onderwijs te kunnen volgen

An MP asked whether necessary medical aids for pupils to follow education should be reimbursed, how reimbursement works across schools, insurers and municipalities, and how to reduce bureaucracy and costs for parents. The minister answered that children can obtain aids via the Zvw, Wmo and UWV school provisions, that parents may face co-payments under the Zvw, that the UWV provided 5,168 education provisions worth 30 million euros in 2023, and that insurers are working on uniform rules from 2025.
It is undesirable that parties point at each other and parents thus do not receive reimbursement for (medical) aids.
Het is onwenselijk dat partijen naar elkaar wijzen en ouders zo geen (medische) hulpmiddelen vergoed krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Honderden miljoenen aan WMO-fraude: 'Zorgcrimineel heeft vrij spel''

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van den Hil asked about a report claiming hundreds of millions in Wmo care fraud, how municipalities supervise providers and pgb spending, screening, Bibob checks, RIEC cooperation, data sharing and Wmo supervision quality. The State Secretary disputes the amounts, says fraud cannot be reliably measured, outlines municipal responsibilities and tools, and points to forthcoming legislation (Wbsrz, Wmo amendment) and a stimulation programme.

I am currently preparing an amendment to the Wmo that sets out further frameworks for the organisation of Wmo supervision, the independent functioning of the supervisor and transparency in supervision, such as publication of supervisory reports.

Momenteel bereid ik een wijziging van de Wmo voor waarin nadere kaders worden gesteld voor de inrichting van het Wmo-toezicht, het onafhankelijk functioneren van de toezichthouder en transparantie in het toezicht, zoals de openbaarmaking van toezichtrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Hoeff en Crijns over het bericht 'Zorgen bij kinderombudsman: Steeds meer kinderen gaan niet naar school'

MPs Van der Hoeff and Crijns asked the minister about a report that more children are staying out of school and the implications for the child ombudsman's concerns, including links to youth care waiting lists and the closure of secure youth care. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites causes such as waiting lists, teacher shortages and Long COVID, and lists measures like digital schooling and a truancy bill, without confirming a link to secure youth care closures.
Together with schools, collaborative partnerships, municipalities and care organisations, we are working to ensure that no child stays at home unnecessarily any longer.
Samen met scholen, samenwerkingsverbanden en gemeenten en zorgorganisaties zetten we ons in om ervoor te zorgen dat geen kind meer onnodig thuiszit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over nieuwe misstanden en toezicht bij zorgboerderijen

MP Westerveld asks the minister about abuses at care farms (Aurora Borealis, Zonnehoeve, United Souls), inspection capacity, PGB-financed care, support for victims and financial transparency of care providers. The minister answers that inspection has been expanded, recounts how the GGD and IGJ handled Zonnehoeve, and announces measures on PGB wooninitiatieven and integrity of financial management while noting that some answers defer to other bodies.
The IGJ is currently investigating the content of these reports and will determine any follow-up actions based on its investigation.
De IGJ onderzoekt op dit moment de inhoud van deze meldingen. Zij zal op basis van haar onderzoek eventuele vervolgacties bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat ouders alarm slaan over demonenuitdrijvingen en mishandelingen bij kinderen met autisme op een zorgboerderij in Wekerom

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of demon-exorcism and abuse of children with autism at a care farm in Wekerom, including questions on oversight, profit and ANBI status. The government said the IGJ is investigating five recent reports, that religious freedom limits banning prayer healing, and that ANBI status is assessed neutrally, while committing to no new investigations beyond existing inspections.
The IGJ is currently examining the content of these reports and will determine any follow-up actions based on its investigation.
De IGJ onderzoekt op dit moment de inhoud van deze meldingen. Zij zal op basis van haar onderzoek eventuele vervolgacties bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Martens-America over het hoofdstuk 'Zo krijg je geld terug van DUO' in het boek DRUKS 2

MPs Van Eijk and Martens-America asked whether DUO's prestatiebeurs (performance grant) facilities are widely misunderstood, whether a generic 'structural functional limitation' note suffices, whether late claims are allowed, and whether a book promoting ways to get money back from DUO is undesirable. The minister answered that DUO staff know the rules, that medical claims require a signed medical form and a causal link, that late claims are possible with justification and a five-year coulance term, and that free public information is not objectionable.
However, I see the task of ensuring that (former) students are informed through our own channels so well that no external explanation or help is needed.
Wel zie ik de taak om ervoor te zorgen dat (oud-) studenten via onze eigen kanalen zo geïnformeerd worden dat er verder geen externe toelichting of hulp nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Friese gemeenten miljoenen tekortkomen op jeugdzorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that Frisian municipalities face multi-million shortfalls in youth care budgets, asking about causes, effects on young people, and whether the planned 511 million euro cut should be scrapped. The State Secretary said municipalities are responsible for their own finances, pointed to the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd and a planned 2025 expert review, declined to give a list of municipalities with shortfalls, and referred to the Voorjaarsnota for the cut.
I do not have an overview of which municipalities have a shortfall in youth care.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van welke gemeenten een tekort op jeugdzorg hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over dat Appelsientje de frisdrankentaks ontwijkt door koemelk aan een product toe te voegen

An MP asked why fruit juice producer Appelsientje can avoid the soft drinks excise by adding a small amount of milk fat, and whether the government will close this loophole and reconsider the dairy exemption. The state secretary answered that the dairy exemption has existed since 1993 and is currently lawful, that a contour letter sets out options for a differentiated sugar-based levy and for changing the dairy exemption, and that any change would need 12 to 24 months of preparation by Customs.
The attached contour letter sets out the options for a differentiated consumption tax.
In bijgaande contourenbrief zijn de opties voor een gedifferentieerde verbruiksbelasting uiteengezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Krul over dat in New Towns als Almere “het sociale cement het stenen cement nauwelijks kan bijbenen”

CDA MPs asked the government to respond to a report on social resilience in Almere and to reflect on how New Town problems such as debt, loneliness, teacher shortages and youth crime relate to rapid growth and national financing, and what action is needed. The minister replied that the report was commissioned by Almere and that the government points to existing programmes (NPLV, GALA, IZA, regional deals) and will await a broader WijkWijzer study before reflecting further.
For a reflection on the problems in the New Towns, the results of that study will be awaited.
Voor een reflectie op de problematiek in de New Towns, worden de resultaten van dat onderzoek afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Crijns en Maeijer over het bericht dat 400.000 kinderen nooit buitenspelen

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that 400,000 children never play outside and whether safe play spaces and social safety are declining. The state secretary acknowledged the problem as complex, said data on play spaces is incomplete, and promised a study and further consultation with Jantje Beton, but committed to no binding measures.
The lack of (complete) data overviews makes it difficult to properly investigate, evaluate or monitor policy on and the availability of sports and play spaces in Dutch municipalities.
Het gebrek aan (volledige) data-overzichten maakt het lastig om het beleid over en de beschikbaarheid van sport- en speelplekken in Nederlandse gemeenten goed te onderzoeken, evalueren of monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt- Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs asked the health minister about top salaries of healthcare executives, including interim managers exceeding WNT pay norms, unenforced expense-disclosure rules in the Governancecode Zorg, and whether a statutory duty or lobbying-register reform should apply.
