The minister said the WNT norms rightly apply by status rather than appointment form, that she prefers talks with sector bodies before legislating on expense transparency, and that a lobbying-register letter is forthcoming.
I will first talk with the BoZ, NVZ, NVZD and NVTZ to see how transparency around declarations can be promoted.
Ik ga eerst met de BoZ, NVZ, NVZD en NVTZ in gesprek om te kijken hoe transparantie rondom declaraties bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Daniëlle Jansen en Krul over het evenement ‘Navigating Nicotine Regulation: Insights from Sweden’

Two MPs asked the ministers about a Business Sweden event in Parliament on nicotine regulation, with speakers linked to the tobacco and nicotine industry, and whether it breaches FCTC Article 5.3. The State Secretary opposed the event, said Dutch snus and nicotine pouch policy will be maintained, but stated that the House itself is responsible for its contacts with the tobacco industry.
I trust that members of the House will hold each other to account when there is contact with the tobacco industry.
Ik vertrouw erop dat Kamerleden elkaar aanspreken wanneer sprake is van contact met de tabaksindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het bericht 'Mostafa is ongedocumenteerd, op leeftijd en nergens welkom – behalve in de Pauluskerk in Rotterdam'

An MP asked about homeless elderly people without residence permits, their eligibility for care under the coupling rules, and whether gemeenten should provide care. The government said homelessness monitoring does not capture this group, that medically necessary care is guaranteed under the regeling onverzekerbare vreemdelingen, and that it sees no need for new talks with municipalities.
Existing methods for monitoring the number of homeless people in the Netherlands do not specifically capture the group of homeless elderly people without a residence permit.
Bestaande methoden die het aantal dakloze mensen in Nederland monitoren, brengen niet specifiek de groep dakloze ouderen zonder verblijfsvergunning in beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het grote verschil tussen de Duitse en de Nederlandse Schijf van Vijf

An MP asked the state secretaries of Health and Agriculture about the gap between the revised German and the Dutch food guidelines (Schijf van Vijf), including the 60/40 plant-animal protein target and whether sustainability should be weighed. The government confirmed the 50/50 target for 2030, said the Gezondheidsraad advice is being followed, and explained the differences in method and scope, while leaving updates of the Schijf van Vijf to the Voedingscentrum and new ambitions to a new cabinet.
Formulating new ambitions or policy goals is up to a new cabinet.
Het formuleren van nieuwe ambities of beleidsdoelen is aan een nieuw kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de (toegang tot) zorg voor ongedocumenteerde personen op Aruba, Sint-Maarten en Curaçao

An MP asked the government which Caribbean organisations were consulted under the Simons motion on refugee assistance, how child and health protection for undocumented people is addressed, whether Curaçao's reports can be shared, and how civil society input and HIV medication access are handled. The government answered that migration and healthcare for undocumented people are the responsibility of the autonomous countries, withheld the reports until Curaçao publishes them, and pointed to ongoing working-group cooperation.

However, the fact remains that migration policy, including access to healthcare and protection of undocumented minors, is a matter for the countries, and the countries within the Kingdom are primarily responsible for it themselves.

Feit blijft echter dat migratiebeleid inclusief de toegang tot de gezondheidszorg en bescherming van minderjarige ongedocumenteerden een landsaangelegenheid is, en de Landen binnen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden hier zelf primair voor verantwoordelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de dalende vaccinatiegraad onder jonge kinderen

An MP asked the state secretary about the falling childhood vaccination rate, its risks, and whether government information and campaigns can reverse it. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to ten planned actions and a promised update before the summer recess, and stressed the role of doctors and local tailoring.
I will inform the House before the summer about progress on the ten actions initiated.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor de zomer over de voortgang op de tien ingezette acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over noodkreet van gemeenten over doorontwikkeling verwijsindex februari 2024

MP Van der Plas asked whether the government will abolish the Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (VIR) without a replacement, given its role in early contact between professionals, and whether youths support it. The State Secretary confirms the plan to remove the statutory basis following a motion and evaluations showing limited use, support and nationwide coverage, while pointing to other youth-care initiatives and a phased wind-down with a handbook and regional alternatives.
It is correct that I intend to implement the motion and thereby remove the legal basis for the Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (VIR) from the Youth Act.
Het klopt dat ik voornemens ben om de motie uit te voeren en zodoende de grondslag voor de Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (hierna: VIR) te schrappen uit de Jeugdwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de berichten 'Recordaantal meldingen van personen met verward gedrag in 2023' en 'Duizenden kwetsbaren wachten op plek beschermd wonen'

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of health and justice about rising reports of people with confused behaviour reaching police and about waiting lists for protected housing, asking whether ggz shortages and funding cuts cause these trends. The minister answered all 14 questions in substance, rejecting a causal link to ggz capacity and maximum waiting times, while acknowledging long waits and listing existing programmes.

I do not have data on how many homeless people who come into contact with the police over confused behaviour are on a waiting list for protected housing or have previously been admitted to a ggz institution.

Ik beschik niet over gegevens over hoeveel mensen die dakloos zijn en in aanraking komen met politie vanwege verward gedrag, op een wachtlijst voor beschermd wonen staan of eerder opgenomen zijn geweest in een ggz-instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht "Maartje Kraamzorg trekt de stekker eruit, kraamzorg in Twente moet hulp zoeken voor 160 gezinnen"

An SP MP asked the minister about the closure of Maartje Kraamzorg in Twente, which leaves about 160 families needing other midwifery care, and about low insurer tariffs, workforce shortages and future guarantees of kraamzorg. The minister says insurers and providers are responsible, that the NZa and IGJ had no prior signals, that the preferred insurer is working with other providers to place clients, and that a follow-up to the sector convenant is being negotiated.
I made inquiries with the NZa and IGJ. They indicate that they had not previously received signals about the discontinuation of Maartje Kraamzorg.
Ik heb navraag gedaan bij de NZa en IGJ. Zij geven aan dat zij niet eerder signalen hebben ontvangen over het wegvallen van Maartje Kraamzorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over miljarden euro’s aan junkfoodadvertenties

An MP asked the state secretary for health about billions of euros spent on junk food advertising despite preventive accord targets, whether voluntary industry agreements work, whether a total advertising ban is needed, and what further steps will reduce overweight. The state secretary acknowledged the conflict with the accord, pointed to a planned ban on junk food marketing aimed at children and a food environment law, a sugar-based drinks levy and other prevention programmes, while rejecting a full advertising ban for now.
This is one of the reasons why I am preparing legislation that prohibits marketing of unhealthy food aimed at children.
Dit is een van de redenen waarom ik wetgeving voorbereid die marketing van ongezonde voeding gericht op kinderen verbiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het afwijzen van sociale huurwoningen aan woningzoekenden met een verleden als cliënt in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the state secretary and minister whether housing corporations refusing social rental homes to former youth-care clients is acceptable, and what will be done to prevent exclusion. The minister says the case was resolved, that a new urgency rule for youth-care leavers is planned via the Wetsvoorstel versterking regie volkshuisvesting, and that programme progress will be reported, while declining to find a violation of equal-treatment law.
With the Housing Governance Strengthening Act I want to ensure the government takes back control to steer how much, where and for whom housing is built now and in the future.
Met de Wet versterking regie op de volkshuisvesting wil ik regelen dat de overheid de regie herneemt om nu en in de toekomst te sturen hoeveel, waar en voor wie er gebouwd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het rapport ‘Eenzaam gesloten’ van Jason Bhugwandass

An MP asked the Minister and State Secretary about the 'Eenzaam gesloten' report on ZIKOS units in closed youth care, rights violations, the Woodbrookers reopening under a new name, and whether closed youth care should be phased out by 2030. The State Secretary answered that closed youth care is being transformed toward small-scale care, that former justice buildings will be divested by agreement with municipalities, that the Inspectorate's supervision is ongoing, and that closed placements remain necessary for a limited group of youths.
Until the inspection reports are published, the IGJ cannot go further into the findings and the supervision.
Tot de openbaarmaking van de inspectierapporten kan de IGJ niet verder ingaan op de bevindingen en het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de brief ‘Reactie op verzoek om informatie voorafgaand aan het WGO jeugd 29-01-2024 over de invulling van de taakstelling 511 mln op jeugd (36410-XVI-110)’

Tielen (VVD) asks whether a fuller letter with analyses of measures to fill the 511 million euro youth-care savings will follow, why financial clarity is delayed, what varieties of co-payments were examined, and how treatment duration is being addressed. The Staatssecretaris answers that a co-payment is needed, options depend on future political choices by a new cabinet, the savings are a Rijk responsibility not blocking reforms, several co-payment variants were modelled, and a regional study on treatment duration will be shared around summer.
With a co-payment, various design variants are possible to (partly) fill the 511 million euro savings.
Bij een eigen bijdrage zijn verschillende varianten qua vormgeving mogelijk om de besparing van € 511 mln (deels) in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Gezinshuiszorg faalt: kwetsbare kinderen onvoldoende beschermd'

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the state secretary and minister about a news report that vulnerable children in family-home youth care were insufficiently protected, questioning the IGJ's oversight, the lack of a reliable count of family homes, the case for a profit ban, and measures against abuses. The state secretary acknowledged the failures, explained risk-based inspection and the planned bills and measures, but rejected a general profit ban.
That is why it is also essential that municipalities set quality requirements during contracting, as laid down in the Quality Criteria for Family Homes.
Daarom is het ook essentieel dat bij de contractering gemeenten kwaliteitseisen stellen zoals neergelegd in de Kwaliteitscriteria Gezinshuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de huisvesting van de YMCA-vakantiekampen

An MP asked the State Secretaries for Health and Interior whether they would act on the YMCA holiday camps' lost lease in Leusden, including mediating with the province and Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and seeking alternative premises. The State Secretary answered that the matter is local and regional, that the government will not take a role, and pointed to the municipality's stated willingness to help find a location.
It is therefore up to the locally and regionally involved parties to seek a solution.
Het ligt daarom op de weg van de lokaal en regionaal betrokken partijen om een oplossing te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Minder vrouwen laten zich testen op baarmoederhalskanker

An MP asks the minister about falling participation in the cervical cancer screening programme and whether the government will act on it, including self-sampling and reminders. The minister acknowledges the concern, explains the reasons for non-participation and the steps taken, such as a self-sampling kit, information changes, and research due at year end.
The declining participation as such is a worrying development.
De dalende deelname als zodanig vind ik een zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked about high executive pay in healthcare, including a UMC Maastricht board chair above the WNT pay cap, interim manager exemptions, and municipal leverage over pay. The minister defended the exemption mechanism, said data on sector-wide pay totals and jeugdzorg management costs are not kept, and noted only seven exemptions were granted in healthcare.
Antwoord van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Supermarkteigenaren verplaatsen tabaksverkoop naar eigen speciaalzaken in aanloop naar verbod

An MP asks whether supermarket owners are opening tobacco shops next to their stores to keep selling tobacco before the supermarket ban, whether the number of outlets is tracked, and what measures could curb new outlets. The state secretary answers that outlets are expected to fall to about 4,400 by 2024, that a registration duty is in preparation, that no additional measures against supermarkets are considered necessary, and that no further talks are planned.
In the field of discouraging tobacco use and combating gambling addiction, the cabinet has taken various measures that can count on broad public support.
Op het terrein van tabaksontmoediging en het tegengaan van kansspelverslaving heeft het kabinet verschillende maatregelen genomen die op breed maatschappelijk draagvlak kunnen rekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de Kamerleden Vondeling en Crijns over het bericht dat uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen stilzwijgend worden verlengd

MPs Vondeling and Crijns asked whether child out-of-home placements and supervision orders are extended without a court hearing via the 'meldbrief' procedure, and whether this is extra-legal. The minister acknowledged roughly 4,000 yearly extensions decided without a hearing (under 30%), said the meldbrief procedure is problematic, and promised the LOVF is seeking an alternative, while maintaining the judge decides whether to hold a hearing.
The National Consultation on Family and Youth Law has indicated, in consultation with my ministry, that it gives high priority to finding an alternative to the current meldbrief procedure.

Het Landelijk Overleg Vakinhoud Familie- en jeugdrecht (LOVF) heeft in overleg met mijn ministerie aangegeven hoge prioriteit te geven aan het zoeken naar een alternatief voor de huidige procedure met de meldbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Utrecht bezuinigt miljoenen op zorg en ondersteuning: 'De financiële situatie is ernstig''

Party MP Dobbe asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport how the government reacts to news that Utrecht is cutting millions from care and support, and whether central funding lags behind rising care demand, including the 2026 funding cliff. The state secretary replies that municipalities are financially autonomous and responsible for balanced budgets, points to ongoing talks on municipal finances, the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, the reintroduction of income-dependent Wmo contributions from 2026 and a houdbaarheidsonderzoek of the Wmo 2015, but gives no municipal-level figures.
I do not have an overview of municipalities that intend to cut spending in the social domain.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van gemeenten die voornemens zijn om te bezuinigen op het sociaal domein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Grote zorgen bij medewerkers GGD Noord- en Oost-Gelderland: ‘Ik heb zoiets nog nooit eerder meegemaakt’'

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about reports of severe staffing and morale problems at GGD Noord- en Oost-Gelderland, including whether similar signals exist elsewhere, staff turnover, municipal funding, and structural solutions. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate has monitored the infectious disease unit since 2022 with improvements noted, that GGDs are primarily accountable to municipalities, and that broader public health reform will be discussed with a next cabinet.
Given the chosen division of responsibilities in the system, VWS sees no role for itself in carrying out such an investigation.
Vanwege de gekozen verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling in het stelstel ziet VWS geen rol voor zichzelf om dergelijk onderzoek op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de tekortkomingen in de geboortezorg voor asielzoekers

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the government about a study showing higher perinatal loss among pregnant asylum seekers, interpreter use, relocation of pregnant women, and communication problems between care providers. The State Secretary replied that the data are already known and regretted, that existing measures and the care chain working group address them, that access to care is adequately arranged, and that relocation of pregnant women is restricted but not fully avoidable.
Yes. Access to maternity care is also well arranged for asylum seekers in the Netherlands.
Ja. De toegang tot de geboortezorg is ook voor asielzoeksters in Nederland goed geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Meer jonge vrouwen op eerste hulp na zelfverwonding of suïcidepoging'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the reported 50 percent rise in young women treated at emergency departments for self-harm or suicide attempts, along with ongoing research, prevention measures, aftercare, and mental health care contracting and insurer waiting lists. The Minister attributed the trend to multiple societal causes, described existing prevention programmes and research, and answered that insurer contracting is improving with an evaluation planned for spring 2024.
Your House will be informed about the outcomes of this evaluation.
Uw Kamer wordt over de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Geen plek meer in daklozenopvang in Utrecht en Amersfoort: 'Mensen slapen noodgedwongen op straat'

MP Kat asks how landlords select tenants, whether they may run credit checks and BKR queries, and whether people under protective administration (beschermingsbewind) are wrongly refused housing and how this is protected. The minister answers that landlords must follow the Wet goed verhuurderschap and anti-discrimination law, that protective administration is not a protected characteristic and is not a valid reason for refusal per sector bodies, and that no legal change is needed.
Having a protective administrator is moreover not discrimination. It is not a legally protected personal characteristic.
Het hebben van een beschermingsbewindvoerder is bovendien geen discriminatie. Het betreft geen persoonskenmerk dat wettelijk is beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht 'Geldproblemen door chronisch ziek kind: ik voel me een schooier'

An MP asked whether parents of chronically ill children are forced to move because the Wmo 2015 does not fully fund home adaptations, and what the government will do about the financial strain. The State Secretary answered that the Wmo appeal route exists, that moving can be an option when adaptations are not feasible, that municipalities are responsible for suitable support, and that cliëntondersteuning and a Wmo allowance for extra costs are available, without committing to new action.
I have no data on how often parents of chronically ill children have to move because home adaptations are not reimbursed under the Wmo 2015.
Ik heb geen gegevens over hoe vaak het voorkomt dat ouders van chronisch zieke kinderen moeten verhuizen omdat de aanpassingen aan hun woning niet vergoed worden vanuit de Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Synhaeve over het bericht ''Red flags' bij bijna 50 procent van de jeugdhulpinstellingen’ en Onderzoek niet-integere bedrijfsvoering jeugdhulp

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the current supervision structure allows youth care providers to act improperly, whether quality can be assessed beforehand through licensing, whether a joint supervisory structure will be stimulated, how the private equity findings will be used, and when the integrity bill (Wibz) will be submitted. The state secretary answered that improper conduct has no place in youth care, pointed to the Wvbjz and Wibz bills giving the NZa supervisory tasks, committed to exploring licensing with VNG and providers, and gave a timeline of Raad van State advice in the first quarter of 2024.
The bill 'Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid jeugdzorg (Wvbjz)' contains obligations regarding, among other things, the governance structure and financial management of youth care providers.

In het wetsvoorstel «Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid jeugdzorg (Wvbjz)» zijn verplichtingen opgenomen ten aanzien van o.a. de bestuursstructuur en de financiële bedrijfsvoering van jeugdhulpaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'Grote jeugdzorgorganisatie investeert miljoenen in bedrijven van eigen adviseur, ondanks megaverlies'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a press report on a large youth care organisation investing millions in companies of its own adviser despite heavy losses, and about poor inspection findings at its Zetten secure youth facility, including use of restraint measures, staff shortages, safety and complaints, and governance conflicts of interest. The government answers that it shares concern, that no unlawfulness can be established from the article, that the inspectorate and accountant had no direct reason to intervene, that Zetten is improving under the inspectorate's watch, and points to the Wibz bill to strengthen external oversight of integrity.
The IGJ cannot give information about ongoing supervision.
Over een lopend toezicht kan de IGJ geen informatie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het smaakjesverbod voor e-sigaretten

An MP asked the state secretary about the flavour ban on e-cigarettes, including whether opzetbare flavour filters that circumvent it are prohibited and how enforcement, fines and neutral packaging are progressing. The government confirms that such filters are banned under the Tabaks- en rookwarenbesluit, admits enforcement and the planned fine increases will take one to two years, and promises research results on neutral e-cigarette design by March.
I can be brief about this: these attachable flavour filters are indeed prohibited.
Ik kan hier kort over zijn: deze opzetbare smaakjesfilters zijn inderdaad verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht dat eén op de vijf jongeren slachtoffer is van huiselijk geweld, geen toename door Corona

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that one in five young people has been a victim of domestic violence, the long waiting times at Veilig Thuis, and how many perpetrators are removed from the home. The State Secretary answered with prevalence figures, a list of prevention initiatives (meldcode, campaigns, guidelines, integrated approach), regional figures on temporary home bans, and an explanation of the causes of Veilig Thuis waiting times.
Statistics Netherlands (CBS) publishes half-yearly figures on the approach to domestic violence and child abuse, including the number of temporary home bans requested and imposed.

Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) publiceert halfjaarlijks cijfers over de aanpak van huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling, waaronder het aantal aangevraagde en opgelegde tijdelijke huisverboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Zeeuwse GGD wil actie van gemeenten tegen lage vaccinatiegraad kinderen’

MP Tielen asks the State Secretary about the low childhood vaccination rates in Zeeland and nationally, the rise in whooping cough, the 'Vol vertrouwen in vaccinaties' approach, the national dialogue scope, municipal responsibility under the revised Public Health Act, and funding flows to GGDs. The State Secretary answers that the rates are concerning but not a sudden collapse, that RIVM research and the SocioVax programme are underway, that municipalities hold primary responsibility, and that VWS holds no overview of municipal spending on vaccination and youth health care.

Given the division of responsibilities between central government and municipalities, VWS has no overview of how the funds municipalities receive via the Municipal Fund are allocated to youth health care organisations.

VWS heeft gelet op de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling tussen Rijk en gemeenten geen overzicht van de verdeling van middelen, die gemeenten via het Gemeentefonds beschikbaar stellen aan JGZ-organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over dehandhaving van het online verkoopverbod op vapes

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health how enforcement of the online sales ban on vapes is failing after an RTL investigation found it easy to order them online. The State Secretary acknowledges a group of deliberate offenders, adds two inspectors now expanding to five, and plans legislative changes to raise fines and broaden enforcement powers.
I am working on a legislative amendment so that the NVWA also receives more enforcement instruments to enforce compliance.
Ik werk aan een wetswijziging zodat de NVWA ook meer handhavingsinstrumenten beschikbaar krijgt om de naleving af te dwingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Faillissementen dreigen door nieuwe cao'

An MP asked whether youth care institutions risk bankruptcy if a new collective labour agreement raises wages and municipalities do not compensate them, and what measures are needed. The minister said there is no central overview of providers' finances, pointed to municipalities' continuity duty, the Youth Authority's monitoring, transition funding and the continuity subsidy scheme, and noted ongoing consultation.
There is no central insight into the current financial position of youth care institutions to assess this claim.
Er is geen centraal inzicht in de actuele financiële positie van jeugdzorginstellingen om deze stelling te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het 'eindrapport onderzoek regeldruk bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen'

An MP from the CDA asks the government why its acknowledgement that red tape for volunteer organisations is a serious problem has not led to concrete measures, how the Beleidskompas ensures volunteer organisations are consulted, whether the AVG obligations and the volunteer allowance should be changed, and what a further volunteer allowance increase would cost. The government replies that it is working on a plan of action with the sector, that the Beleidskompas will be evaluated before any changes, that banks have adopted a new sector standard reducing checks on non-profits, that AVG obligations will not be reduced, and that raising the volunteer allowance by 500 euro would cost about 3 million euro a year, while promising a further policy response in December 2023.
We are therefore holding talks with various departments, the sector and other relevant stakeholders to arrive at concrete and serious measures to counter the red tape.
Wij zijn daarom met verschillende departementen, de sector en andere relevante betrokkenen gesprekken aan het voeren om tot concrete en serieuze maatregelen te komen om de regeldruk tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'EU-Burgers zonder (t)huis: De Aanpak van Dakloosheid en de Staat van EU-burgerschap in Nederland'

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about an academic article criticising the government's plan for homeless EU citizens, including its treatment of residence rights and the three-group categorisation. The state secretary largely rejected the critique, defended the plan as a clarification of EU-citizen rights, and committed to a rights tool and pilot projects while declining to seek an independent advisory opinion.

To achieve this, it was decided in consultation with municipalities to develop a practical rights tool to help municipalities better assess entitlements to shelter (under the Wmo 2015) of individual EU citizens.

Om dit te bewerkstelligen is in overleg met gemeenten besloten om een praktische rechtentool te ontwikkelen waarmee gemeenten beter in staat zouden moeten zijn om rechten op opvang (in het kader van de Wmo 2015) van individuele EU-burgers te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht 'Drugscrimineel was de baas van zorguitzendbureau dat personeel levert aan Jeugdhulp Friesland'

MP Mohandis asked about a report that a drug criminal headed a care staffing agency supplying Jeugdhulp Friesland, and about oversight of Woodbrookers and fraud prevention. The government answered that the IGJ moved its planned supervision forward, Jeugdhulp Friesland will stop closed youth care in its current form by July 2024, and fraud measures (Bibob, Wbsrz, pilots) and a sector working group on flex staffing are underway.
Such an investigation commissioned by the IGJ is in principle never made public.
Een dergelijk onderzoek in opdracht van de IGJ wordt in beginsel nooit openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het schrijnende bericht van een jeugdzorginstelling

MP Van der Plas asked the State Secretary for Health about a confidential report exposing serious abuses at youth institution Woodbrookers, including pain stimuli, safety, and unreported incidents. The State Secretary answered that the report was commissioned by the IGJ, was published only in anonymised form after a court ruling, led to an improvement plan and the institution's decision to end closed youth care by July 2024, and that pain stimuli are not permitted.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de misstanden bij Woodbrookers

An MP asks the state secretary for health about serious abuses at the youth care institution Woodbrookers, including a confidential report, painful restraint techniques, missed incident reporting and possible rights violations of youths. The government answers that Jeugdhulp Friesland has an improvement plan under IGJ monitoring, that the institution will stop closed youth care in its current form by July 2024, and that the inspectorate has brought forward its supervision.
Such an investigation commissioned by the IGJ is in principle never made public.
Een dergelijk onderzoek in opdracht van de IGJ wordt in beginsel nooit openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de HPV-vaccinatie bij mensen ouder dan 27 jaar

An MP asked the state secretary about HPV vaccination effectiveness for people over 27, whether they can get vaccinated, how they are informed, vaccine waste and possible alternative uses for surplus vaccines. The state secretary answered that evidence for over-27s is very limited, that they can be vaccinated at their own expense, that no active outreach occurs, and that surplus vaccines are being considered for alternative uses.

Data on vaccinations given outside the national vaccination programme, for example via the GGD, gynaecologist, urologist or GP, are in most cases not provided to the RIVM, so there is very limited insight into these numbers.

Gegevens over vaccinaties gegeven buiten het Rijksvaccinatieprogramma om, bijvoorbeeld via de GGD («Vaccinaties op maat»), de gynaecoloog, de uroloog of de huisarts, worden in de meeste gevallen niet aan het RIVM verstrekt en om die reden is er maar zeer beperkt inzicht in deze aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Woude over het artikel ‘Exorcisten ’De Laatste Reformatie’ onder vuur: duiveluitdrijvingen bij kinderen en wegbidden autisme’

MPs Becker and Van der Woude asked about reports of exorcisms of children and prayer to cure autism by the group De Laatste Reformatie, covering child protection, reporting routes, foreign contacts, visas and a promised law on informal education. The government condemned such practices, pointed to Veilig Thuis, the police and existing child protection tools, declined a new investigation or legal measures against the group citing religious freedom, and said it had no knowledge of a promised study on the scale of exorcisms.
I do not intend to investigate this further.
Ik ben niet voornemens dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Omtzigt over feitenonderzoek in de jeugdbescherming

MPs Kwint and Omtzigt asked why the action plan to improve fact-finding in youth protection (feitenonderzoek jeugdbescherming) produced few real improvements, what the government will do, and whether children were wrongly placed out of the home. The Minister replied that the evaluation found many actions were taken but only partly implemented, that further improvements are planned, and that no evidence of wrongful out-of-home placements due to poor fact-finding has been found.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de effectiviteit van het afschaffen van de btw op groente en fruit in landen waar dit al is toegepast

An MP asked the government about the effectiveness of abolishing VAT on fruit and vegetables in countries where this was done, including health and purchasing-power effects, and whether the OECD should study it. The government answered that no decision has been taken, that information on other countries' measures is limited, and that the decision is for a next cabinet.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het 'eindrapport onderzoek regeldruk bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen'

An MP from the CDA asks the government to respond to the final report on administrative burden for volunteer organisations and philanthropic institutions, including whether the AVG and Wwft obligations should be relaxed for small organisations and how departments coordinate. The State Secretary answers that burden is a serious problem, points to ongoing talks with the sector, and declines to exempt small organisations from the AVG while promising a fuller response in December.

The cabinet considers it very important to reduce the administrative burden on volunteer organisations and philanthropic institutions given the important social value of these organisations in our society.

Het kabinet vindt het erg belangrijk om de regeldruklasten bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen te verminderen gezien de belangrijke maatschappelijke waarde in onze samenleving van deze organisaties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het (on)vermogen van minderjarigen om de gevolgen van genderbehandelingen onder ogen te zien en de noodzaak om als overheid in actie te komen

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Omtzigt asked the minister whether medical treatment of gender incongruence in minors meets the definition of regular medical care, whether the state should take responsibility for a broader societal debate, and how other countries have changed their approach. The minister replied that care is governed by professional and quality standards set by the field, that treatment of minors requires careful evaluation and informed consent, that the government does not intervene in clinical matters, and that a broad societal approach and an ongoing evaluation of the quality standard are underway.
The government does not interfere in how care providers deliver care, insofar as it concerns medical-substantive considerations.
De overheid bemoeit zich niet met de manier waarop zorgverleners zorg verlenen, voor zover het medisch-inhoudelijke overwegingen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Jongeren en hun smartphones een wereldwijde geestelijke giframp'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a press article claiming youth mental health is being driven by smartphones, and about the link to youth care, age limits for social media, and Dutch trends since 2012. The minister answered that the causal link between phone use and youth care is not established, outlined existing research and policy measures, said age verification is being developed, and found no 2012 break in Dutch youth care use.
Nevertheless, it is difficult to demonstrate whether a causal relationship exists between phone use and use of youth care.
Toch is het lastig aan te tonen of een causale relatie bestaat tussen het gebruik van een telefoon en jeugdzorg gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Hagen over het bericht dat kinderen soms langer dan een jaar wachten op logopedie

MPs Sahla and Hagen asked about reports that children sometimes wait over a year for speech therapy, including waiting-list data, the Treek norm, therapist numbers, tariffs, insurer duties and measures to reduce waits. The minister reported that over half of first-line practices had waits exceeding one year in 2022, that insurers must ensure access and mediate, and that he will consult the NZa on more intensive supervision, while stating that tariff adequacy cannot yet be judged.
I will consult with the NZa on whether it is possible to exercise more intensive supervision of speech therapy.
Ik ga met de NZa overleggen, of het mogelijk is om intensiever toezicht op de logopedie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de parlementaire BBQ

An MP asked ministers about the parliamentary BBQ, renamed NLvoedt, and whether its meat, fish and dairy industry organisers, including a sitting senator, give disproportionate lobbying influence, and whether ministers should attend. The government replied that lobbying is a legitimate part of democracy, that the event's partners are publicly listed, that attendance is a matter for individual politicians, and that it sees no ground to exclude such events, while committing to an evaluation of agenda and lobby-paragraph transparency tools.
To improve transparency and accountability, the guideline on transparency of ministers' agendas has been tightened in line with the Van Baarle-Dassen motion.
Om transparantie en verantwoording te verbeteren is de «Uitvoeringsrichtlijn transparantie agenda’s bewindslieden» aangescherpt in lijn met de motie Van Baarle-Dassen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de dalende vaccinatiegraad

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the declining vaccination rate, including measles coverage among infants, and proposed mobile vaccination points, twijfeltelefoon access, and an accelerated HPV campaign evaluation. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, noted that a national outbreak risk is not yet present, referred to pending RIVM research and planned follow-up letters, and said no extra funds beyond existing ones are available.
Beyond these already initiated actions and measures, there are currently no additional funds available for extra efforts to raise the vaccination rate.
Boven op deze al ingezette acties en maatregelen zijn er op dit moment geen extra middelen beschikbaar voor extra inzet om de vaccinatiegraad te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Paul over het bericht ‘Kinderen wachten soms langer dan jaar op logopedie: Gevolgen worden onderschat’

MPs Tielen and Paul asked the health and education ministers about reported long waiting lists for speech therapy for children, their causes, administrative burden, the link with school advice, and digital options. Minister Kuipers reported rising waiting lists (half of first-line practices with waits over a year in 2022), said data cannot yet be split further, promised to discuss more intensive supervision with the NZa, and pointed to existing initiatives while giving no firm new measures.
I will consult with the NZa on whether it is possible to exercise more intensive supervision over speech therapy.
Ik ga met de NZa overleggen, of het mogelijk is om intensiever toezicht op de logopedie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over gezondheidsdoelen in de wet opnemen

An MP asks the minister why the government refuses to anchor collective health targets in law despite calls from medical, advisory and civil-society bodies and a Parliamentary motion. The minister answers that a legal basis is not a logical next step, that targets exist in the Prevention Accord and GALA, and that political debate on measures is the proper route.
I am therefore not convinced that legally anchoring health targets would give me a better starting position for a more binding preventive health policy.
Ik ben er daarom niet van overtuigd dat het wettelijk verankeren van gezondheidsdoelen mij een betere uitgangspositie geeft voor een dwingender preventief gezondheidsbeleid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over de berichten 'Jongeren stellen eigen diagnoses via TikTok: ‘Als je dit herkent heb je ADHD’' en 'De TikTok psycholoog is in opkomst: ‘Als je deze vie

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about news reports on young people self-diagnosing mental health conditions via TikTok and on unreliable 'TikTok psychologist' advice, asking for research on consultations, action against medical misinformation and clearer mental health information for youth. The State Secretary said no data are kept on such consultations and that collecting it would burden professionals, pointed to Digital Services Act obligations on platforms, and announced a study this autumn into a more coherent, findable mental health information offer.
In the RTL Nieuws article, the vice-chair of the NIP states that it is not recorded whether young people more often report to the GP as a result of such videos.
In het artikel van RTL nieuws geeft de vicevoorzitter van het NIP aan dat niet wordt bijgehouden of jongeren zich vaker melden bij de huisarts als gevolg van dergelijke video’s.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Ine zit al acht weken zonder huishoudelijke hulp: 'Let niet op de stank'' en de antwoorden op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Tilburg bezuinigt flink op Wmo

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports of personnel shortages and waiting lists for Wmo domestic help, and whether national intervention or supervision of municipalities is warranted. The government answered that no national figures exist, attributed shortages to the tight labour market and the abonnementstarief, pointed to the TAZ programme and dialogue with municipalities, and explained that interbestuurlijk toezicht is used sparingly and only under the intervention ladder.
There are no figures available at national level showing the extent of the personnel shortage for the domestic help provided under the Wmo 2015.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar die op landelijk niveau inzichtelijk maken wat de omvang van het personeelstekort is voor de huishoudelijke hulp die op basis van de Wmo 2015 geleverd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Doorstart kinderdagcentrum Uithuizen mislukt op laatste moment, ouders zijn ten einde raad'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the failed rescue of a children's day centre in Uithuizen, asking about adequate provision, acceptable distance, national responsibility, and whether such centres should be protected from bankruptcy. The State Secretary agreed that enough centres should exist, said municipalities are legally responsible for adequate youth care, pointed to planned legislation and the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, and said the IGJ supervises quality, while declining to say bankruptcies must be prevented.
Municipalities can be held to account by the national government for failing to meet those responsibilities through inter-governmental supervision.
Gemeenten kunnen door het Rijk worden aangesproken bij het niet nakomen van die verantwoordelijkheden via het interbestuurlijk toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de politie-inzet bij uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen

An MP from PVV asked the government about police involvement in roughly 550 annual child removals from their homes and whether this was justified. The minister answered that police assist only when safety requires it, under an internal guideline agreed with the Public Prosecution Service and Jeugdzorg NL that emphasises de-escalation.
The starting point is that the police only assist when this is necessary to safeguard safety and the circumstances require it.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de politie alleen assisteert als dit nodig is ter waarborging van de veiligheid en als de omstandigheden daarom vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het Advies van de Gezondheidsraad ‘Vaccinatie van ouderen tegen pneumokokken (2023)’

An MP asked whether people aged 80 or older in 2020 (born before 1941) who want pneumococcal vaccination should get priority, in line with COVID-19 policy, and whether COVID-19 and pneumococcal vaccination of vulnerable elderly could be combined this year. The state secretary said he will consider the Health Council advice, needs more time for a financial feasibility study, and explained the current age-cohort rollout while stating COVID-19 vaccination cannot be combined with the others this year.
As soon as I have more clarity on this, I will inform the House as soon as possible.
Zodra ik hier meer duidelijkheid over heb, zal ik de Kamer zo spoedig als mogelijk is informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Nieuwe strategie tabaksfabrikanten: investeren in medicijnen voor rokers’

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports that tobacco companies are investing in medicines for smokers, the 'sjoemelsigaret' (cheat cigarettes) and whether the government will act against them. The state secretary condemned the investments, said legal limits prevent a different measurement method in national rules, and said a College van Beroep ruling is awaited, with the RIVM results to be shared with the European Commission.
As promised, in my letter of 4 July I also informed you of the outcome of external legal research into the possibility of stricter national rules or a different measurement method.
Zoals toegezegd heb ik u in mijn brief van 4 juli jl. tevens op de hoogte gesteld van de uitkomst van extern juridisch onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de toename van obesitas onder jongeren

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary and Minister of Health about rising obesity among young people, the cost of overweight, lapsed prevention targets from the 2018 Prevention Agreement, sports affordability, and healthy food in institutions. The government answers that obesity is a complex problem requiring many measures, that the 2040 targets have not yet been declared failed, and that it is continuing and extending prevention policy with extra funds, though several specific measures have not been implemented yet.
The cabinet continues the goals of the Prevention Agreement and has made extra funds available to intensify the effort on overweight and obesity.
Het kabinet zet de doelen van het NPA voort en heeft extra middelen beschikbaar gesteld om de inzet op overgewicht en obesitas te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht 'Sportkantine drooggelegd: kabinet sleutelt aan nieuwe anti-drankplannen'

An MP from the PVV asks whether the government plans a 50% alcohol excise increase, a ban on selling wine and beer in supermarkets, and a ban on all alcoholic drinks in sports canteens, and why adults should not decide for themselves. The state secretary denies a cabinet decision exists, says the aim is no alcohol served during youth matches and no sales to under-18s at clubs, and says the RIVM inventory of measures is available.
There is no cabinet decision, nor a political wish list.
Er is geen sprake van een Kabinetsbesluit, ook niet van een politiek wensenlijstje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de oproep van gemeenten om handvatten voor het verminderen van het aantal tabaksverkooppunten

An MP asked the state secretary for health whether municipalities will get tools quickly to reduce tobacco outlets, and about shop-in-shop constructions and Utrecht's temporary ban on new tobacco shops. The state secretary answered that reducing outlets is a key goal, that a shop-in-shop loophole is not allowed under the planned supermarket ban, that municipalities decide locally, and promised to inform parliament before the November 2023 committee meeting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over signalen van gebedsgenezers die autisme claimen te kunnen genezen door uitdrijving van demonen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports of faith healers claiming to cure autism through demon exorcism, including reactions to a Rotterdam event, whether the government would investigate, supervise or revoke ANBI status, and privacy safeguards for filmed participants. The State Secretary answered that these gatherings are religious rather than treatment under youth or care law, that no investigation or enhanced supervision is planned, that ANBI status cannot be refused on this basis, and that the Dutch DPA is being alerted about the filming.
In view of the answers above, I do not intend to conduct research.
Gelet op de antwoorden hierboven ben ik niet voornemens om onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Paul en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Ouders eisen verbod op autismebehandeling voor kinderen'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about reports that parents demand a ban on ABA-based autism treatment for children, including the number of providers, complaints, safety oversight and the evidence base. The government answered that ABA covers many varying treatments, that complaints to the IGJ are limited, that it will commission research into effects on young people, but that it does not support a ban.
I will therefore have research carried out into the impact of ABA and treatments containing ABA elements on young people.
Ik ga daarom onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van ABA en behandelingen waar elementen van ABA in zitten op jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Mindervaliden wachten soms maanden op reparatie rolstoel: ‘Al 2,5 jaar bezig’’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of disabled people waiting months or years for wheelchair repairs and supply, and about enforcement of the national framework standards. The State Secretary regretted the delays, called a 2.5-year wait unacceptable, and said the municipality, as contracting party, has required an improvement plan from the supplier, with contract-based consequences left to the municipality.
Timeframes outlined by Hart van Nederland are, however, unacceptable and also not in line with the framework standards.
Termijnen die worden geschetst door Hart van Nederland zijn echter onacceptabel en ook niet in lijn met het normenkader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Miljoenen voor actieplan dakloosheid dreigen niet juist te worden uitgegeven: ‘Schandalig’

MPs Van den Hil and Verkuijlen asked the state secretary about a report that municipalities plan to spend the national homelessness action plan funds mainly on prevention rather than housing and financial security, and about youth transition between the Youth Act and Wmo. The state secretary disputed that the report proves misuse, noted that other funding streams and the housing ministry are involved, cited a dashboard and existing policy on youth transition, and committed to ongoing dialogue without a concrete new measure.
Care is needed when drawing conclusions about how municipalities spend the funds and whether this is in line with the National Action Plan on Homelessness or not.
Er is zorgvuldigheid geboden bij het trekken van conclusies over hoe gemeenten de middelen besteden en of dat wel of niet in lijn is met het Nationaal Actieplan Dakloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Akerboom over de gezondheidskosten van het eten van vlees

MPs Van Esch and Akerboom asked the government about health costs of meat consumption, true pricing, and a meat levy. The government acknowledged the health costs, said it is studying true pricing and a sugar-based beverage tax review, but declined to commit to a meat levy given parliament's prior rejection of one.
Setting prices in supermarkets is the responsibility of the supermarkets themselves.
Het stellen van prijzen in de supermarkten is de verantwoordelijkheid van de supermarkten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over geweld tegen jeugdzorgmedewerkers

An MP asked the government about rising aggression against youth care workers, the causes, complaint follow-up, prevention measures and information on incidents. The State Secretary answered that employers are primarily responsible, that no systematic data on incidents or sick leave is kept, and pointed to existing measures and planned regional meetings.
I do not know how many youth care workers drop out as a result of aggression in the work situation.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel jeugdzorgmedewerkers uitvallen als gevolg van agressie tijdens de werksituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Deze drie 14-jarigen moeten voor hun moeder zorgen: ‘Soms ben ik er wel klaar mee’

An MP asked the state secretary about news reports of 14-year-olds caring for their mother and whether young carers are recognised by municipalities, schools and care providers, and what research exists. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the mantelzorgagenda, SCP data and a support toolkit, and committed to raising the issue with the VNG.
In my discussions with the VNG I will point municipalities to this.
In mijn gesprekken met de VNG ga ik gemeenten hierop wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de toename van het aantal jonge mensen dat een beroerte krijgt, mogelijk veroorzaakt door drugsgebruik

An MP asked the state secretary whether rising strokes among young adults may be linked to drug use and what policy and research follow. The government says the cause is unknown, sees no need for new research specifically on drugs and strokes, and declines to add drug use to a stroke-prevention study with ZonMw.
I see no need to commission new research into the link between drugs and strokes.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om een nieuw onderzoek naar het verband tussen drugs en beroertes uit te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Nog geen 20 procent van jongeren haalde gratis hpv-prik: ‘Kan veel ellende voorkomen’

An MP asked why fewer than 20 percent of young adults invited for the free HPV vaccine had been vaccinated after five months, and what the government would do to raise uptake and avoid wasting vaccines near expiry. The State Secretary answered that uptake is not fully controllable, that the campaign and mobile vaccination points are being expanded, and that the vaccines will be used optimally or donated abroad, while declining to extend eligibility beyond the Health Council's advised age group.
I am therefore not dissatisfied with the provisional uptake; of course I would like to see even more young adults get the HPV vaccination.
Ik ben dan ook niet ontevreden over de voorlopige opkomst; uiteraard zou ik graag zien dat nog meer jongvolwassenen de vaccinatie tegen HPV nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Werner over de uitzending ‘Leven na een amputatie’

MPs Van den Berg and Werner (CDA) asked the Minister of Health about a broadcast on life after amputation, raising gaps in municipal Wmo provision, prosthesis software locks, wheelchair and prosthesis funding, client support, insurer reimbursement and stoma data sharing. The minister answered largely by pointing to municipal discretion, insurers and industry contracting, and promised only general steps such as agreements with the VNG and Movisie on client support.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wmo 2015 and have policy discretion within the legal framework for that implementation.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015, waarbij zij binnen het wettelijke kader beleidsvrijheid hebben t.a.v. deze uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Tilburg bezuinigt flink op Wmo, inwoners krijgen minder huishoudelijke hulp: 'Klachten blijven binnenkomen’'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the national government supervises municipalities' implementation of the Wmo 2015 after reports of cuts to home help in Tilburg, and whether shortfalls exist elsewhere. The State Secretary answered that municipalities implement the Wmo on their own authority, that the national government can consider intervention if structural signals arise, that citizens have legal remedies, and that a sustainability study of the Wmo is planned with the VNG.
Municipalities implement the Wmo 2015 on their own legal authority.
Gemeenten voeren de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 (hierna: Wmo 2015) op eigen juridisch gezag uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over drugsgebruik in gevangenissen

Member Kuik (CDA) asked the Justice and Health ministers about suspected widespread Spice use in Ter Apel prison, its health risks and detectability, sanctions for smuggling, addiction care, and measures to stop smuggling. Minister Weerwind answered that smuggling and use are punishable, detection is difficult and under study with new technology, no confirmed Spice deaths are known, and DJI is expanding information and reviewing foreign approaches, though no additional mortality testing is planned.
In addition, DJI also focuses on prevention of use and information provision.
Daarnaast zet DJI ook in op preventie van gebruik en voorlichting.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Raemakers over het artikel 'Het gebrek aan zorg voor psychiatrische patiënten met een verslaving drijft ouders tot wanhoop: ‘Wij zijn gevangen in de zorg voor hem’

D66 MPs Kat and Raemakers asked the state secretary and minister about a newspaper report on people with psychiatric problems and addiction who fall between care providers, lose housing and end up in severe cases. The government acknowledges the problem, points to existing dual-diagnosis standards, the Integraal zorgakkoord and regional escalation models, says care providers do not record referrals, and promises to pass the Querido pilot to municipalities and to inform itself via the national addiction rapporteur.
Care providers do not keep data on referrals to other care providers, so there is no national picture of how large this group is.
Zorginstanties houden geen gegevens bij over het doorverwijzen naar andere zorginstanties, dus er is geen landelijk beeld hoe groot deze groep is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Van den Hil, Van der Plas en Stoffer over het bericht dat Meander opvanglocaties voor schipperskinderen sluit in Maasbracht, Nieuwegein, Lemmer en Terneuzen

MPs asked whether the government will prevent the closure of four boarding houses for bargee children run by Stichting Meander and whether the economic claim right on the buildings blocks relocation. The State Secretary answered that closures are a business decision for the boarding houses, that talks are ongoing and the KPMG study will be shared before summer, and that Meander is not blocked from moving to smaller locations.
The Ministry of VWS is currently in talks with the Meander bargee boarding house, so we cannot agree with the term 'stuck in the Ministry of Health's procedures'.

Het Ministerie van VWS is momenteel in gesprek met schippersinternaat Meander, dus in de term «vastlopen in de procedures van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport » kunnen wij ons niet vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over de berichtgeving over jongvolwassenen met psychische problemen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Education about reports of high levels of psychological complaints among young adults, including why girls are more affected, the role of social pressures, social media, and youth care demand. The government answered that mental health concerns are long-standing and worsened by COVID-19, pointed to existing research and the cross-ministerial mental health programme, and said it is in dialogue with youth, parents and professionals while it does not identify causal links to foreign ideologies.
To learn more about the causes of and solutions for these feelings of anxiety, uncertainty and stress, on 25 April I held a conversation with young people, parents, care workers and administrators.

Om meer te weten te komen over de oorzaken van en oplossingen voor deze gevoelens van angst, onzekerheid en stress, ben ik 25 april jl. in gesprek gegaan met jongeren, ouders, hulpverleners en bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Kuik en Van den Berg over het bericht 'The jury is still out'

CDA MPs asked the state secretaries about a report linking smartphone and social media use to worsening mental health among teenage girls, including Dutch data on depression, suicide and self-harm. The government answered that Dutch data are limited, that a causal link between social media and depression is not established, and listed prevention measures, platform engagement and a forthcoming child-protection policy letter.
There is no data available on self-harm among young people in the Netherlands.
Er is geen data beschikbaar over automutilatie onder jongeren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Hil en Ellian over het bericht ‘Geef crisisdienst direct toegang tot hoger beveiligde bedden’

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government will give crisis services direct access to high-security psychiatric beds, how many such beds exist per province, and what it will do about shortages. The minister rejected direct access, citing the need for proper assessment and placement, reported 1737 secured beds in 2022 and pointed to a dashboard, a coordination point, regional inventories and a joint evaluation as measures.
We do not consider it desirable to give crisis services direct access to high-security care.
We vinden het niet wenselijk om crisisdiensten direct toegang te geven tot de (hoog) beveiligde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Witte Huis noemt 'zombie drug' ernstige bedreiging voor de volksgezondheid'

An MP asked the health minister about reports of the 'zombie drug' xylazine, its veterinary use, online sales to private buyers, and enforcement against illegal trade. The minister answered that fentanyl-xylazine combinations are not known in the Netherlands, that online sale of prescription veterinary medicines to private persons is prohibited, and that NVWA, IGJ and customs supervise trade, with no need for additional measures at this time.
There is currently no reason for additional measures regarding the veterinary medicine xylazine.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende maatregelen ten aanzien van het diergeneesmiddel xylazine.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de Nutri-Score

An MP from the PvdD asks the State Secretary for Health about the Nutri-Score food logo, citing inconsistencies with the Dutch dietary guidelines, consumer confusion, and possible health-washing of products. The State Secretary agrees with the Health Council's findings, commits to pursuing its recommendations, and confirms the introduction of Nutri-Score on 1 January 2024 without delay.
I have decided to introduce Nutri-Score with a start date of 1 January 2024 and shared this with you in my letter to the House of 25 April 2023.
Ik heb besloten tot invoering van Nutri-Score met een startdatum van 1 januari 2024 en heb dit met u gedeeld in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 25 april 2023.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Westerveld (GroenLinks) over gesloten jeugdinstellingen

An MP asked the state secretary for health about youth in closed youth care institutions, including involving young people in decisions, outdated facilities, staffing, education, internship discrimination and preparation for age 18. The state secretary answered that he talks with youth during visits, will continue this, will raise facilities and education issues with institutions and municipalities, and will work on education and internship measures.
That is why I always do that when I visit an institution.
Daarom doe ik dat altijd als ik op bezoek kom bij een instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de gemeente Rotterdam medische gegevens opvraagt bij de huisarts om te bepalen of mensen recht hebben op warmtetoeslag

MP Hijink asked the minister about reports that Rotterdam requests medical records from GPs to decide on heating allowance claims, questioning the relevance, storage, privacy and proportionality of such requests. The minister answers that the Participatiewet and AVG permit requesting medical information for individual special assistance, that the SMA doctor alone has access and requests are rare (about 3% of cases), and that the government sees no reason to intervene with Rotterdam.
As long as work is done according to current laws and regulations, such as the Participatiewet, AVG and KNMG guidelines, I see no reason to enter into discussion with a municipality.
Zolang er gewerkt wordt volgens vigerende wet- en regelgeving, zoals de Participatiewet, AVG en KNMG-richtlijnen zie ik geen aanleiding om in gesprek te gaan met een gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van der Laan over berichten over schermtijd

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Van der Laan asked the State Secretaries for Health and for the Interior about reports on rising screen time among babies and young children, its effects, and what government will do to inform parents and address tech companies' role. The government answered that screen time has both benefits and harms, outlined existing youth health-care guidance, a planned public campaign, reliance on the EU Digital Services Act and talks with platforms, and declined to adopt France's age-15 social media rule because Dutch GDPR implementation already protects children under 16.

At the commission of the Alliance for a Digital Society, the Trimbos Institute is surveying the extent to which existing research can show the relationship between mental, social and physical health and screen time.

Het Trimbos-instituut inventariseert in opdracht van de Alliantie Digitaal Samenleven in welke mate bestaande onderzoeken beeld kunnen geven van de relatie tussen mentale, sociale en fysieke gezondheid en schermtijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de oproep van de KNMG om lange termijn gezondheidsdoelen wettelijk te verankeren

MPs Van Esch asked whether the government would legally anchor long-term health goals after a KNMG open letter, and whether it would send a proposal on this to parliament. The state secretary answered that legal anchoring is not the logical next step now, citing shared responsibility and the Gezond en Actief Leven Akkoord, and that it may be considered later depending on implementation.
I am not convinced that legally anchoring health goals gives me a good starting position for more binding preventive health policy.
Ik ben er niet van overtuigd dat het wettelijk verankeren van gezondheidsdoelen mij een goede uitgangspositie geeft voor een dwingender preventief gezondheidsbeleid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het door gemeenten in de Duin- en Bollenstreek vervangen van definities in hun Wmo-verordeningen die afwijken van de definities, zoals die door de wetgever in de Wmo 2015 zijn v

An MP asked the State Secretary about four Duin- en Bollenstreek municipalities replacing the statutory Wmo 2015 definitions of 'beschermd wonen' and 'opvang' in their local ordinances, and what this means for residents' protection. The State Secretary answered that the definitions broadly follow the statute but that the element 'begeleiding' is missing from the opvang definition, which is undesirable, and promised to ask VNG to promote clarity and to alert the municipalities to the omission without further specific steps.
It is my intention to ask the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) to promote that no uncertainty arises for residents regarding the mentioned facilities.
Het is mijn voornemen de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) te vragen te bevorderen dat voor de inwoners geen onduidelijkheid ontstaat over de genoemde voorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Drost, Stoffer, Pouw-Verweij en Palland over de beeldvorming van leven met downsyndroom

MPs from five parties asked the government about a biology textbook passage on Down syndrome, its implications for inclusion, prenatal counselling and support for people with disabilities. The minister said the publisher withdrew the passage, that schools must promote democratic basic values, and described existing policy on inclusion, counselling and support, but declined to evaluate the effects of the prenatal screening funding change.
I am always open to societal signals following funding changes, but an investigation is not appropriate.
Ik sta altijd open voor maatschappelijke signalen naar aanleiding van bekostigingswijzigingen, maar een onderzoek ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Kuik over het bericht ‘Social Media is a Major Cause of the Mental Illness Epidemic in Teen Girls. Here’s the Evidence'

MPs Slootweg and Kuik asked whether Dutch longitudinal studies exist on social media use and teen mental health, and how the government views the claim that social media is a major cause of depression and anxiety in teen girls. The government answered that no simple direct causal link has been established, listed Dutch longitudinal studies, outlined prevention and regulatory measures, and promised a broader policy letter.
As stated above, we do not yet see a scientific consensus on a simple and direct causal relationship between social media use and the development of depression and anxiety.
Zoals boven gesteld zien wij nog geen wetenschappelijke consensus over een eenvoudige en directe causale relatie tussen sociale mediagebruik en de ontwikkeling van depressie en angsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de open brief ‘Voorop voor gelijke gezondheid’ van artsenfederatie KNMG en ruim 70 organisaties

MP Hijink (SP) asked the government how it responds to an open letter from the KNMG and about 70 organisations on health inequality, cost barriers to care, and calls to legally anchor health goals and address poverty. The State Secretary answers by pointing to GALA funding, Welzijn Op Recept, the poverty and debt approach, an SER advisory request, and rejects legally anchoring health goals while promising further consultation and a proposal on health-promotion competences.
Legally anchoring health goals and target values in the law does not do justice to the shared responsibility of all parties that is needed.
Het wettelijk vastleggen van gezondheidsdoelen en streefwaarden in de wet doet geen recht aan de gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid van alle partijen, die nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Kathmann over de brief van artsenfederatie KNMG over het effect van armoede op ziekte

MPs Bushoff and Kathmann asked the government how it will respond to the KNMG's warning that poverty drives illness, including whether it will reduce health inequalities, target prevention where needed, and act on the KNMG's four recommendations. The state secretaries answered that health gaps are being addressed through existing agreements and programmes, that the KNMG recommendations are under discussion, and that legally anchoring health targets was rejected in a vote, leaving the response largely to policy programmes.
The cabinet is currently holding talks with the KNMG about these recommendations.
Het kabinet voert op dit moment gesprekken met de KNMG over deze aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Jeugdzorgmanagers verdienen bij met handeltje in zzp’ers bij hun eigen werkgever'

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about reports that youth care managers profited from placing freelancers at their own employer, asking about sector revenues, flex work, dual shifts, iHUB's requests for extra funding, IGJ investigation and reporting of fraud. The state secretary gave detailed answers, acknowledged the need for more measures and an upcoming letter on private equity, but declined to judge the iHUB case or confirm whether a criminal complaint would be filed, referring to ongoing investigations and other bodies.
iHUB has indicated that it is currently still investigating the signals referred to in the article.
iHUB heeft laten weten dat zij momenteel de signalen nog onderzoeken waarin in het artikel naar gerefereerd wordt
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Middel X vaker gebruikt na onthulling werkzame stof’

MPs Tielen and Bevers asked the Minister of Health about a report that use of Middel X rose after the active substance was publicised, and about the effectiveness of the industry code on restricting private sales. The Minister answered that a causal link cannot be established, that legal bans are ineffective and risky, that talks with stakeholders continue, and that the code will be evaluated at end 2023.
The Ministry of VWS continues to talk with field partners to explore whether, and if so which, additional options exist to prevent use of these substances for suicide.
Het Ministerie van VWS blijft wel in gesprek met veldpartijen om te verkennen of en zo ja, welke aanvullende mogelijkheden er zijn om het gebruik van deze stoffen voor suïcide te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Van Strien over het artikel 'Bevrijdingsfestival Utrecht gaat voor het eerst in 30 jaar niet door'

MPs Chris Simons and Van Strien asked the State Secretaries about the cancellation of the Utrecht Liberation Festival, the value of commemorating liberation, and financial support for liberation festivals. The government answered that the festivals are decentrally organised, that it sees no central role, that it advised talks with provinces and municipalities, and that talks with the National Committee and the VFonds on solutions are still ongoing.
Since the liberation festivals are organised decentrally, I see no role for central government in finding a solution.
Aangezien de bevrijdingsfestivals decentraal georganiseerd worden, zie ik geen rol vanuit het Rijk weggelegd om tot een oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat meer bevrijdingsfestivals niet door dreigen te gaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether the government would guarantee funding so that liberation festivals stay free and nationwide, and whether it would reconvene with the National Committee 4 and 5 May. The government answered that all festivals go ahead this year, that the festivals are decentralised and funded mainly by provinces and municipalities, that it sees no federal role, and that it will keep monitoring talks between the festivals and the National Committee.
Since the Liberation Festivals are organised at decentralised level, I see no role for central government in finding a solution.
Aangezien de Bevrijdingsfestivals decentraal worden georganiseerd, zie ik geen rol vanuit het Rijk weggelegd om tot een oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch, Vestering en Van Raan over het bericht 'Havermelk duurder door 'limonadebelasting''

Three PvdD MPs asked whether the planned increase in the beverage consumption tax, which exempts dairy drinks but taxes most plant-based milk drinks, is consistent with health and protein policy, and whether the exemption for sugary dairy drinks will be removed. The government confirmed the budget-driven increase, defended the dairy exemption on nutritional grounds, and said a study on sugar taxation is ongoing with results due in 2023, without committing to specific changes.
It is correct that the consumption tax on non-alcoholic drinks (hereinafter: consumption tax) is being increased.
Het klopt dat de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken (hierna: verbruiksbelasting) wordt verhoogd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de koppeling van persoonsgegevens van uithuisgeplaatste kinderen en onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsingen en het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal, waar de Kamer al in 202

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Legal Protection and state secretaries about linking personal data of children placed out of home, independent research into out-of-home placements and the childcare benefits scandal, and why the bill on temporary data exchange did not include an independent-research objective as the 2021 motion requested. The government answered that independent research now exists via a Hamer commission, a CBS study found no group-level link to child protection measures, and the Inspectorate's second study is ongoing, while several answers note data handling and procedural constraints.
I sent the House a memorandum of amendment to the bill Temporary Law on Exchange of Personal Data UHP KOT on 16 March 2023.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 16 maart 2023 een nota van wijziging op het wetsvoorstel Tijdelijke wet uitwisseling persoonsgegevens UHP KOT toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij en Mutluer over het bericht 'Zorgen om online gokken in de klas: ‘Ze denken snel geld te verdienen’'

MPs from four parties asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health how minors gain access to online gambling accounts, whether gambling operators take age checks seriously, and when a ban on gambling advertising takes effect, including whether a two-strikes model should apply. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the Kansspelautoriteit has received no signals of circumvention, promises awareness activities and a ban on untargeted gambling ads by 1 July 2023, but rejects a two-strikes model as not fitting proportionate enforcement.
