That is why I am doing everything I can to bring the ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling into effect as soon as possible.
Daarom stel ik alles in het werk om het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen zo snel mogelijk in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van Kwint over de gevolgen van gemeentelijke aanbestedingen voor kinderen in Maastricht

Kwint (SP) asked the state secretary about the consequences of Maastricht's youth care tender for children with complex needs at Bibihuis, which was not contracted, and about continuity of care and freedom of choice. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for continuity, that non-contracted providers must transfer care by 31 December 2023, that choice is offered as far as possible, and that the Rijk supervises continuity.
For children receiving care from non-contracted parties, such as Bibihuis, ongoing arrangements will where possible be completed in 2023 by the existing care provider.
Voor kinderen in zorg bij niet gecontracteerde partijen, zoals Bibihuis, geldt dat lopende arrangementen waar mogelijk in 2023 worden afgerond door de bestaande zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Ellian en Chris Simons over het artikel ‘Claims Conference reageert op kritiek’

MPs Van den Hil, Ellian and Simons asked the state secretary about a Nieuw Israëlitisch Weekblad article on Claims Conference criticism, concerning declining Holocaust knowledge and support for the annual Nationale Kinderherdenking in Madurodam. The state secretary agreed the trends are worrying, said he is in talks with organisations including the Kinderherdenking and is funding a pilot, but ruled out structural subsidy for the Kinderherdenking for now.
However, I have indicated that structural subsidisation of the Nationale Kinderherdenking by the Ministry of VWS is not on the table for now.
Wel heb ik aangeven dat structurele subsidiering van de Nationale Kinderherdenking vanuit het Ministerie van VWS voor nu niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over huishoudelijke hulp

An MP asks the minister about shortages and waiting lists for domestic help (huishoudelijke hulp), the failure to meet the six-week decision norm, and what is being done about the shortages and the planned personal contribution. The minister answers that the number of clients rose about 30% to 2021, that no national waiting-list picture exists, that the planned contribution is expected to reduce demand by about 30,000 clients, and that municipalities are responsible for local measures.
There is no national picture of waiting lists for domestic help.
Er bestaat geen landelijk beeld van wachtlijsten voor huishoudelijke hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Vaak dakloos na verlaten jeugdzorg'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary how youths leaving youth care are supported to avoid homelessness at 18, whether data exist on youth becoming homeless, how they are prepared for independence and the transition to the Wmo, how they are informed of options, and whether eligibility for extended youth care can be harmonised with municipalities. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to the Big Five planning approach, the national homelessness action plan and a pending housing bill, said no figures exist for youth homeless at 18, promised a policy-information study due around summer and talks with the VNG.
No figures are available on the number of young people who become homeless or without a permanent home on their eighteenth birthday.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat dak- of thuisloos wordt op hun achttiende verjaardag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat er toch weer jeugddelinquenten geplaatst worden in Cadier en Keer

An MP asked whether juvenile offenders are being placed in closed youth care facilities (Cadier en Keer) alongside vulnerable youths, and why the small-scale juvenile justice facilities (KVJJ) are under-used. The Minister replies that the reported sequence is incorrect since closed youth care placement always requires a separate civil court authorisation, and defends the mixed-group approach while announcing a review of KVJJ placement criteria with results expected by June 2023.
Placement in closed youth care always requires a separate (civil law) authorisation from the children's judge.
Voor de plaatsing in de gesloten jeugdhulp is altijd een afzonderlijke (civielrechtelijke) machtiging van de kinderrechter vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over samenwerking tussen retailers en de tabaksindustrie om extra tabakswinkels te openen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about retailers and the tobacco industry opening tobacco shops next to supermarkets, which could offset the planned supermarket sales ban, and asks about monitoring and licensing. The State Secretary says the ban will reduce outlets sharply (SEO estimates from about 10,000 in 2021 to under 2,000 by 2032), announces a registration obligation requiring a law change so it cannot start in 2023, and rejects a licensing system with time-limited permits as too costly and inflexible.
I am working hard to have this law change in force in 2024, but given this lengthy process, 2023 is unfortunately not possible.
Ik werk er hard aan deze wetswijziging in 2024 van kracht te laten zijn, maar 2023 is, gezien dit langdurige proces, helaas niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het gebrek aan hulp aan gestrafte jongeren

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about reports that half of court-ordered help for young offenders is not provided or provided too late, and whether this raises reoffending. The government says such non-delivery is not registered, accepts that specialist help is needed and that it may contribute to reoffending, and points to ongoing procurement reforms and an exploration of youth-justice help without committing to central national arrangement.
I am working with the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport and the Association of Dutch Municipalities on the bill 'Act improving the availability of care for young people'.

Ik werk samen met de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) aan het wetvoorstel «Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid zorg voor jeugdigen»
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Westerveld over het schrappen van honderden banen van jeugdhulpverleners in Limburg

An MP asked the state secretary about Xonar's financial trouble, job cuts among youth care workers in Limburg, when the ministry knew, and how care continuity and oversight are ensured. The state secretary answered that Xonar is at escalation level 3 of the continuity protocol, that a recovery plan is being drafted, that municipalities hold the legal responsibility for adequate youth care, and that several questions cannot be answered further because the process is ongoing.
Because the process is ongoing, I cannot go further into this specific case.
Omwille van het lopende proces kan ik niet verder op deze specifieke casus ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de eetstoornis ARFID

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about ARFID, an eating disorder: prevalence, treatment capacity, professional training, GP and youth-care knowledge, parent information, and whether free school meals account for it. The State Secretary answered that prevalence and treatment numbers are not known, outlined existing training, guidelines and information websites, and said school meals would be voluntary with school-level arrangements for individual pupils.
It is not known how many children and adults currently receive treatment for ARFID or are on a waiting list specifically for ARFID treatment.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel kinderen en volwassenen momenteel een behandeling voor ARFID krijgen of op een wachtlijst staan specifiek voor een behandeling van ARFID.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Thijs Zonneveld: "Alleen een topsporter voor de klas is niet genoeg"’

An MP asked the minister whether the 'Sporthelden op School' business case and pilot linking top athletes, sports clubs, municipalities and schools is known, and whether it can inform new pilots and the athlete stipend scheme. The minister confirms awareness, agrees that school-sport links can help vulnerable children, but defers concrete decisions on the pilots to an exploration starting in early 2023 and proposes linking the EUR 200,000 stipend amendment funds to top athletes working in schools in 2023.
I cannot yet say anything about that because we are starting the exploration of the further design of these pilots in early 2023.
Daar kan ik nog geen uitspraken over doen omdat we met de verkenning over de nadere invulling van deze pilots in het begin van 2023 starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel ‘Illegale sigarettenfabriek ontdekt in Heerlen, 23 aanhoudingen’

An MP asks the government about an illegal cigarette factory in Heerlen, seizure figures, lost excise revenue, social costs, the link between excise increases and smuggling, and EU cooperation against tobacco smuggling. The state secretary gives detailed seizure data, estimates roughly 50 million euros per year lost to illegal trade, cites studies on excise and smuggling, and says current EU cooperation needs no intensification for now.
The cabinet will inform the House about this with the BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer hierover informeren met het BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht in Trouw over het gebrek aan landelijk overzicht van de wachttijden in de jeugdzorg

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about the lack of a national overview of youth care waiting times, which a Trouw report highlighted, and what has been done to create one since the Youth Act of 2015. The state secretary answered that no national overview or regional average waiting times exist, that municipalities are responsible, that the Aanpak Wachttijden with a learning network and a national picture is under way, and that the Rijnmond follow-up continues.
It is not known what the current average waiting time per region is for the most common forms of youth care.
Het is niet bekend wat op dit moment de gemiddelde wachttijd per regio is voor de meest voorkomende vormen van jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het ‘Rapport Wmo-toezicht 2021’

An MP asked the state secretary about the IGJ report showing persistently low quality of municipal Wmo oversight and the Court of Audit's warnings, including why municipalities have not improved, unreported incidents, annual reports and timelines. The secretary acknowledged the problems, announced a joint policy framework with statutory reinforcement of municipal oversight (independence, mandatory oversight policy, public reports, possible duty to follow recommendations), and promised a letter by end of Q1 2023, while declining to quantify lost funds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smolders over de schrikbarende stijging van het aantal daklozen, met name onder jongeren

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the sharp rise in homelessness, especially among young people, whether true numbers are higher, and why the National Homelessness Action Plan runs to 2030, and also raises asylum reception policy and migrant worker homelessness. The State Secretary acknowledges the concern, says monitoring is incomplete and pilot counts are planned, defends the 2030 target and the Housing First approach, and rejects the link between asylum inflow and housing shortage.
On the basis of the results of this pilot, I want to take concrete follow-up steps.
Ik wil op basis van de resultaten van deze pilot concrete vervolgstappen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van den Hil en Paulusma over een gesprek met de Eilandsraad van Sint Eustatius

MPs asked about referral arrangements in a pilot for Sint Eustatius health care, including whether patients are sent only to Sint Maarten, lost medical records, reported deaths, inspectorate complaints and dialysis availability. The minister answered that referrals go to Sint Maarten Medical Center, referrals elsewhere remain specialist-initiated, records-sharing is being studied, the inspectorate received 13 reports over five years, and peritoneal dialysis talks are ongoing.
To improve digital data exchange, I am examining the possibilities for a (regional) electronic patient record.
Ter verbetering van de digitale gegevensuitwisseling onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden van een (regionaal) elektronisch patiënten dossier
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Nederlanders hebben minder vertrouwen in vaccinaties’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a European survey showing lower Dutch trust in vaccines, and about vaccination rates, youth-group differences, and campaigns. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to a planned trust monitor and a RIVM pulse survey, and said it is too early to judge the effect on vaccination uptake.
I attach great importance to vaccinations and to achieving the highest possible vaccination rate.
Ik hecht zeer aan het belang van vaccinaties en het behalen van een zo hoog mogelijke vaccinatiegraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Kwint en Van Nispen over de inzet van voorspellende algoritmes met betrekking tot kinderen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether the police would keep using the ProKid Plus algorithm to predict violent crime among children, and about oversight, data, safeguards and links to youth care and the Top400 approach. The minister answered that ProKid Plus was used only once in a 2016 Amsterdam trial, is no longer used, that a new police alerting system (ProKid 23-) is still under legal and ethical assessment, and described existing legal safeguards and oversight, while committing to no new structural rule changes.

The experiences with ProKid Plus underline the importance of good safeguards for the use of algorithms, to which the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, is giving extra attention.

De ervaringen met ProKid Plus onderstrepen het belang van goede waarborgen voor het gebruik van algoritmen, waar de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties in samenwerking met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming extra aandacht voor heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over toenemend drugsgebruik onder studenten

An MP asked the state secretaries of health and education about rising drug use among students, the effects of COVID measures on student wellbeing, and planned action. The government answered that it is running prevention programmes and a mental health approach, but declined to give cost-benefit or risk analyses, citing unclear trends and data limits.
For this reason, among others, I cannot provide a risk analysis of the consequences of health problems from drug use for society and the labour market as a whole.
Mede om deze reden kan ik geen risicoanalyse geven voor de gevolgen van gezondheidsproblemen door drugsgebruik op de maatschappij en de arbeidsmarkt als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga inzake de adviesbrief van de SER met betrekking tot advies Jeugdzorg met spoed omzetten in tastbaar beleid

Van Haga asks the State Secretary for Health about the SER's letter urging concrete follow-up to its 2021 youth care advice, why earlier recommendations remain unimplemented, and when a concrete action plan will come. The State Secretary acknowledges the urgency, points to a joint Reform Agenda with municipalities, and cites measures such as standardisation, local teams and a planned bill on specialist care, but declines to appoint a coordinating minister and gives no firm timetable.
I share the urgency with the SER.
Ik deel de urgentie met de SER.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het bericht ‘GGD trekt stekker uit digitaal jeugddossier ondanks investering van miljoenen’

MPs Hijink and Leijten asked why three GGDs stopped developing a digital youth health dossier after millions in investment, and about alternatives, data safety and oversight. The State Secretary answered that the decision belongs to the GGD boards, that no data-safety problem exists, that alternatives will be bought from the market, and that national information standards and municipal responsibility apply.
It is not for me to respond.
Het is niet aan mij om met een reactie te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Mohandis en Bikker over het uitgesteld betalen bij het online afrekenen van alcoholische dranken

MPs Kuik, Mohandis and Bikker asked whether online alcohol shops offering buy-now-pay-later payment undermine the Alcohol Act and encourage overconsumption, and whether the state will stop or ban it. The state secretary agrees with the concerns, notes that the Alcohol Act still applies, says some shops are already exploring alternatives, and will examine legal measures if shops do not stop.
If the liquor stores do not stop, I am willing to examine legal measures and discuss this with my colleagues in the cabinet.
Als slijterijen niet stoppen, dan ben ik bereid om wettelijke maatregelen te onderzoeken en hierover in gesprek te gaan met mijn collega’s binnen het kabinet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened. The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over jeugdbescherming

An SP MP asked the Minister about reports that children were placed out of home without a judge's involvement, and about inequality in child protection measures by income, education and migration background. The Minister explains that voluntary placements require parental consent and can be revisited, notes there is no reliable data on their number, and says the government will work on monitoring, clearer distinction between voluntary and coercive routes, and reducing unequal chances of child protection measures.
There is no reliable, meaningful data available on the number of voluntary out-of-home placements.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare, betekenisvolle gegevens over het aantal vrijwillige uithuisplaatsingen beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onderwijs en zorg

An MP asked the education and health ministers about children with support needs who do not receive suitable education for financial reasons, the tension with inclusive education ambitions, funding of municipalities and specialist providers, and reserves in schools. The minister responded that the government will pursue inclusive education, promised further letters and action plans, and acknowledged that excessive school reserves are undesirable but described them as temporary.
At national level it is not tracked how many children use support hours to follow education, or how many hours this concerns.
Op landelijk niveau wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel kinderen gebruik maken van ondersteuningsuren om onderwijs te volgen, of om hoeveel uren dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over  problemen rondom de zorg aan onverzekerden

The SP MP Hijink asked the Minister of Health about problems in providing care to uninsured people, including rising uninsured numbers, registration and address rules, administrative burden for GPs, and refusals of care. The Minister acknowledged concern, described the existing reimbursement schemes and recent digitalisation and legal-basis fixes, and promised to restore the notification route via a Wmo amendment, though he did not commit to a faster timeline or to new measures beyond that.
Underlying medical data of uninsured persons are not known on an individual basis, not even at the CAK, so I cannot answer this question.
Achterliggende medisch gegevens van onverzekerde personen zijn niet -ook niet bij het CAK- op individuele basis bekend, deze vraag kan ik daarom niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Richardson, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Tientallen klachten van misbruik en mishandeling in Gelders jeugddorp’

MPs asked the state secretary about reports of abuse and mistreatment at the Glind youth village, including whether inspectors had prior signals and what is being done about the care provider and former foster children. The government answered that the IGJ received several signals and reports since 2018 and will handle them, that Pluryn set up a helpline and is commissioning research, and that existing complaint channels exist, while declining to disclose details of individual reports citing confidentiality and privacy.
The IGJ never makes statements about the precise content of reports and how they are handled.
Over de precieze inhoud van meldingen en de afhandeling doet de IGJ nooit mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over criminelen die schoolkinderen ronselen met snus

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked the Justice Minister and the Health State Secretary about criminals recruiting schoolchildren with snus, including police handling, enforcement against snus sales and planned awareness campaigns. The minister acknowledged the concern, cited a broad youth crime prevention programme, said no police figures on the phenomenon exist, and pointed to ongoing NVWA enforcement and a forthcoming decision on a snus ban.
The police registrations contain no concrete indications of criminals recruiting schoolchildren with snus.
In de registraties van de politie zijn geen concrete aanwijzingen gevonden voor criminelen die schoolkinderen ronselen met snus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de misstanden bij de Glind en de Tijdelijke regeling financiële tegemoetkoming voor slachtoffers van geweld in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the State Secretary and Minister about abuse at Jeugddorp De Glind, whether investigations are independent, where victims can report, whether perpetrators still work in youth care, criminal prosecution, safety measures, and whether the compensation scheme should be extended beyond 31 December 2022. The government answers that Pluryn will conduct its own investigation, points to existing reporting channels and the IGJ, notes that the scheme ends in December 2022 and that it sees no reason to extend it, and reports 18,955 applications with long processing delays.
I agree that thorough and independent research must be carried out.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat grondig en onafhankelijk onderzoek gedaan moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Richardson over het bericht ‘GGD trekt stekker uit digitaal jeugddossier ondanks investering van miljoenen’

MP Richardson asked the state secretary about the GGD halting its digital youth record project despite millions invested, including the quality criteria, the leverage of the supplier, and how lessons would be shared. The state secretary answered that the decision and its handling rest with the GGD boards and municipalities, that evaluations are underway in each region, and that VWS is not responsible for the project's termination.
The decision to stop the GGiD was taken by the three GGD general boards themselves.
Het besluit om te stoppen met het GGiD is een besluit dat genomen is door de drie GGD (algemeen) besturen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de documentaire ‘Taken – Kinderen van de Staat’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about the documentary on child protection, the IGJ findings on unjustified out-of-home placements, decentralised youth care, financing, workforce shortages and compensation. The government acknowledged serious problems, promised a reform agenda and a plan to improve legal protection, but rejected re-auditing all placements and any compensation scheme.
In all cases examined, multiple problems existed in the family, such as addiction, debt, domestic violence or parenting problems.
In alle onderzochte zaken speelden meerdere problemen in het gezin, zoals verslaving, schulden, huiselijk geweld of opvoedproblemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het feit dat geïnstalleerde trapliften vaak niet voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit

An MP asked the state secretary whether stairlifts often fail the Building Decree and whether municipalities enforce it, including questions on contractor self-inspection, liability, and minimum standards. The government says municipalities are responsible as competent authority and as Wmo commissioner, promises an information sheet with the Minister for housing and VNG, and plans to report progress in early 2023 while judging a certification body unnecessary.
I will consult with municipalities and draft an information sheet to prevent unsafe stairlifts and staircases.
Ik ga in overleg met gemeenten en stel een informatieblad op ter voorkoming van onveilige trapliften en trappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'Hoe nu verder?' vragen gezondheidsorganisaties zich af nu Staatssecretaris Van Ooijen overleg over alcoholpreventie staakt

An MP from D66 asks the state secretary for Health about the impact of ending the alcohol table (alcoholtafel) under the National Prevention Agreement, and about future cooperation with parties including the alcohol industry. The state secretary answers that the table did not yield effective measures, that commitment to the 2040 targets remains, that the tobacco and overweight tables continue, and that he will keep talking with parties in specific situations and will share his approach before year end.
Before the end of the year I will share with your House the approach with which I will contribute to the NPA targets.
Voor het eind van het jaar deel ik mijn inzet waarmee ik ga bijdragen aan de NPA-doelen met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld n Bikker  over de aanpak van zelfbenoemde ‘afvalcoaches” en pro-ana websites

MPs Westerveld and Bikker asked the government about self-declared 'afvalcoaches' and pro-ana websites exploiting vulnerable minors, including the lack of progress on an online investigation strategy, capacity, prior warnings, and blocking sites. The Minister answered that a multi-track approach is in place, the police exploration of an online investigation strategy is ongoing with results expected early 2023, individual cases cannot be discussed, and a blanket ban on pro-ana sites is not deemed opportune.
Unfortunately, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Helaas kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Van der Molen over het artikel ‘Bestuurder scootmobiel raakt te water in Stadskanaal’

CDA MPs asked about rising scooter-mobility accidents, the SWOV safety recommendations, the relation between the Wegenverkeerswet and the Wmo, and mandatory training. The minister says reliable injury data are lacking, cites CBS fatality counts, says a new framework for mobility vehicles is being developed with SWOV and RDW input, and declines to make training mandatory.
There are no recent, reliable data available on the number of (seriously) injured traffic casualties among scooter-mobility users.
Er zijn geen recente, betrouwbare gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal (ernstig) verkeersgewonden onder scootmobielrijders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Duizenden doden na valincidenten'

An MP asked about reports that fatal fall incidents have doubled in ten years, the timing of a fall-prevention programme plan, how municipal funds for fall prevention will be ensured to go to effective measures, and whether municipalities are preparing. The minister acknowledged the concern, linked the rise to an ageing population, said the programme plan would be sent to the House before Christmas, and described a specific grant and national support being prepared.
The House will be informed about this before Christmas.
De Kamer wordt hierover voor de kerst geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over stappen naar betere jeugdhulp

An MP asks the state secretary about the care and protection available to child and adult victims of sexual abuse, exploitation and violence, and about specialist national care and the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd. The secretary acknowledges gaps and points to ongoing studies, a national action plan, a reform agenda due this autumn, and consultation of care providers, without committing to a dedicated treatment title or a new national research project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over de berichten dat het aantal jongeren met suïcidale gedachten ook na corona hoog is en dat er een toename van zelfdodingen onder jongvolwassenen is

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that youth suicidal thoughts and young-adult suicides remain high after COVID, and what the government will do. The secretary acknowledged the concerning data, cited huisarts visit increases of 39%, and listed mental-health prevention measures, including the national mental health approach, loneliness policy and suicide prevention agenda.
Yes, I am aware of the reports.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'NVDI en STAP: samenstelling Alcoholtafel van het Nationaal Preventieakkoord leidt niet tot het gewenste resultaat'

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government will take further measures against problem alcohol use after the NVDI and STAP withdrew from the alcohol table of the National Prevention Agreement over conflicting interests. The state secretary said he supports the agreement's goals, has ended the table as ineffective, and will share his approach with parliament before year-end, while committing to evidence-based measures.
I no longer consider the consultation table appropriate for the challenges we face.
Ik acht de overlegtafel niet meer passend voor de uitdagingen waar we voor staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met Wmo-voorzieningen bij een verhuizing

An SP MP asked why people moving between municipalities may be left without Wmo support, and whether the new municipality must take over existing indications and whether the Wmo should be changed. The state secretary said no such signals are known, that temporary takeover of indications is good practice, that a 2021 moving covenant exists for hulpmiddelen, and that no amendment to the Wmo is needed after a court ruling.
Following this ruling and parliamentary questions, I contacted the VNG. The VNG has committed to bring the ruling to the attention of all municipalities.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak en Kamervragen contact opgenomen met de VNG. De VNG heeft mij toegezegd de uitspraak onder de aandacht te brengen van alle gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het rapport ‘Meedoen zonder beperkingen’ van de Nationale ombudsman

Christian Union MP Ceder asked the government to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on young people with disabilities and the Participation Act, including whether expectations of self-reliance are realistic and whether the law should be changed. Minister Schouten answered that a reply to the report will follow, cited measures such as the Breed Offensief bill, the planned raise of earnings thresholds and a 10% minimum wage increase, but rejected a structural system change for this group.
This cabinet's coalition agreement does not provide for a systemic change of the kind referred to in question 6.
In het Coalitieakkoord van dit kabinet is niet voorzien in een stelselverandering zoals bedoeld in vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Omtzigt over een laag tarief op verse groente en fruit, dat al in een aantal EU-lidstaten wordt toegepast en dus ook in Nederland mogelijk zou moeten zijn.

MPs Van Esch and Omtzigt asked why the Netherlands cannot apply a reduced VAT rate on fresh fruit and vegetables as Italy, Latvia and Spain do. The government answered that it is studying the legal and practical delimitation with SEO, expects results in early 2023, and that a zero rate could take effect on 1 January 2024 at the earliest.
The cabinet emphasises that it is wise to await the conclusions of this study before proceeding to any introduction of a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables.
Het kabinet benadrukt dat het verstandig is om de conclusies van dit onderzoek af te wachten voordat tot eventuele invoering van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Knops over het bericht 'Gezondheid uit een flesje: smoothies van dit Venlose bedrijf verhogen de weerstand'

MPs Van den Berg and Knops asked the State Secretary for Health about a study claiming a Venlo company's smoothies boost immunity, and whether it affects advice and prevention policy. The State Secretary answered that the study is unpublished, does not warrant changing dietary advice or prevention policy, and that the health claim is not currently permitted under EU rules.
The study gives no reason to change the dietary guidelines, so the Nutrition Centre will not adjust its consumer information in response to these research results.
Het onderzoek geeft geen aanleiding om de voedingsrichtlijnen te wijzigen, het Voedingscentrum zal de consumentenvoorlichting dan ook niet aanpassen naar aanleiding van deze onderzoeksresultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het artikel 'Voor altijd een piep in je oor'

An MP asked the state secretary for health about rising hearing damage among young people, including structural hearing screening, a legally binding decibel limit and legislation. The state secretary pointed to the existing convention, screening studies and a pending Health Council advice, and promised to inform parliament after that advice.
After the Health Council's advice has been published, I will inform you about possible additional measures.
Na het verschijnen van het advies van de Gezondheidsraad zal ik u informeren over mogelijk aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bikker over wettelijke maatregelen om de kans op gehoorschade te beperken

Two MPs asked the state secretary for health about legal measures to limit hearing damage, including whether the voluntary prevention convenant should become a statutory duty of care and how to enforce volume limiters on earpods. The state secretary declined to pre-empt the Health Council's advice, said the convenant will be extended by a year and that more sectors should join, and said the NVWA will further investigate earpod risks.
I have asked the Health Council to advise on possible further measures that could be taken in the context of preventing hearing damage.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om te adviseren over mogelijke verdere maatregelen die genomen kunnen worden in het kader van de preventie van gehoorschade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Paulusma over de uitspraak van de advocaat-generaal aan de Hoge Raad ten aanzien van verplichte anticonceptie in de gesloten jeugdzorg

MPs Raemakers and Paulusma asked the State Secretary for Health about the Advocate-General's opinion that compulsory contraception under the Wvggz may breach the ECHR, and whether it is also imposed in closed youth care. The State Secretary declined to anticipate the Supreme Court ruling, said closed youth care falls under the Youth Act rather than the Wvggz, and argued that compulsory contraception there should be exceptional and rare.
I await the Supreme Court's ruling with interest.
Ik wacht de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad met belangstelling af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Stoffer over het bericht 'Vulva maakt nummer over abortus genaamd 'Kill The Baby' en over misbruikers genaamd 'Abusers''

MPs Bikker and Stoffer asked the minister how a song and release party about abortus ('Kill The Baby') relate to the Wet afbreking zwangerschap, to government abortion policy, and whether authorities can intervene. The minister answered that the song is protected artistic expression, that intervention is undesirable, that public broadcasters decide their own content, and that prior content supervision is constitutionally impermissible.
Ik acht ingrijpen dan ook ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over Het beroep op vrijstelling wegens richtingbezwaren

MP Bisschop asked the government whether a Zuid-Holland Zuid truancy region's practice of asking parents for their specific religion or belief when claiming exemption on grounds of objection to a school's denomination is lawful, whether it breaches GDPR and due-care principles, and whether it wrongly involves youth health care and Veilig Thuis. Minister Wiersma answered that asking for the specific belief is necessary and lawful under the Supreme Court's case law and the GDPR, that the municipality rather than the minister is responsible for enforcement, that a well-argued exemption alone is not grounds for a Veilig Thuis report, and that the regional policy document has been adjusted on that point.
Enforcement of compulsory education is first and foremost a matter for the municipal authorities concerned.
De handhaving van de leerplicht is op de eerste plaats een zaak van de betrokken gemeentebesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het toezicht op gezinshuizen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about supervision of family-style foster care homes (gezinshuizen) in youth care: rent costs, use of interns, quality criteria, profit-making, metatoezicht, powers of the inspectorate and advocates, and handling of upheld complaints. The State Secretary answers that cost elements and quality criteria guide pricing and oversight, that the inspectorate can issue binding orders but not close homes indefinitely, and that a metatoezicht pilot runs until mid-2023 before any decision.
The definitive use of metatoezicht will only happen once the IGJ has confidence in these parties.
Het definitief inzetten van metatoezicht zal pas gebeuren als de IGJ vertrouwen heeft in deze partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de problemen bij jeugdzorgaanbieder Partners voor Jeugd

An MP asks the state secretary how Partners voor Jeugd fell so far behind that complex-care children cannot be helped on time, why it was not caught earlier, and what is being done about regional waiting lists and decentralised youth care. The government acknowledges serious problems, points to primary municipal responsibility with inspectorates and the Jeugdautoriteit providing oversight, and promises reform measures and a letter on short-term relief.
In our decentralised youth care system, municipalities are primarily responsible for providing a qualitatively and quantitatively adequate supply of child protection, youth probation and youth care.

In ons decentrale jeugdzorgstelsel zijn de gemeenten primair verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van een kwalitatief en kwantitatief toereikend aanbod voor jeugdbescherming, jeugdreclassering en jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Tegen ongezond eten kunnen gemeenten vrijwel niets doen'

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the reported lack of municipal tools to limit unhealthy fast-food outlets, especially in poorer areas, and about links to the Omgevingswet, Warenwet, NS stations and food-chain policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the link between unhealthy food supply and health inequality, said the legal options for a healthier food environment are still being explored and will be reported to parliament in autumn, and pointed to the National Product Improvement Approach and NS's own retail ambitions.
This autumn I will inform the House in more detail about this, in my letter on nutrition and overweight.
Dit najaar zal ik de Kamer, in mijn brief over voeding en overgewicht, nader informeren hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Neef over het advies van de Gezondheidsraad inzake eetstoornissen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Health about the Health Council's advice on eating disorders, including the reported four-year average wait for help, the need for a national early-detection approach, and what the K-EET chain approach has achieved. The State Secretary answered that delays are partly inherent to the illness, pointed to capacity expansion, regional coordination, the K-EET hotline and website, and a letter with the policy response, but gave no firm new wait-time targets.
I support municipalities and providers in their regional responsibility for tackling waiting times.
Ik ondersteun gemeenten en aanbieders in hun regionale verantwoordelijkheid voor de aanpak van wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulphonden

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked about the coverage of assistance dogs under the Zvw and Wmo, the evidence for dogs for mental health conditions such as PTSS, and the costs, regulation and oversight of dog training schools. Minister Helder answered that only blind-guide, signal and ADL dogs are covered by the basic health insurance, that therapy and PTSS dogs lack sufficient proven effectiveness, that municipalities have discretion under the Wmo, and that regulation of trainers relies on private standards and a pending European norm.
The Zorginstituut will then consider whether these results give reason to carry out an assessment within the framework of the 'state of science and practice'.
Het Zorginstituut zal dan bekijken of deze resultaten aanleiding zijn om een beoordeling te doen in het kader van de «stand van de wetenschap en praktijk».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Mutluer over het bericht Prijsexplosie GHB vanwege oorlog in Oekraïne, verslaafden stoppen met de drug

MPs Bikker and Mutluer asked whether the government will expand outreach and addiction care for GHB users after reports of a price spike that could push users to stop abruptly or switch to other drugs. The State Secretary answered that substitution is undesirable, pointed to existing addiction-care initiatives, online information and monitoring, and to the government's drug-prevention and organised-crime policy, without committing to new concrete steps.
Given the concern raised by Novadic-Kentron, we remain alert to signals that give cause for intervention.
Gelet op de vrees van Novadic-Kentron blijven we alert op signalen die aanleiding geven tot ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over jonge mantelzorgers

The MP asks the State Secretary about young carers, their visibility, numbers, difficulties, support and awareness-raising, and whether a letter will be sent before Prinsjesdag. The State Secretary answers that awareness and practical support are key, describes existing local and national support and the school pilot, and promises a vision letter before the budget debate.
Before the VWS budget debate I will send the House a letter setting out the cabinet's vision on informal care and its efforts to improve it for the coming cabinet period.
Ik zal voor de begrotingsbehandeling van VWS een brief naar de Kamer sturen met daarin de visie van het kabinet op mantelzorg en de inzet voor verbetering voor de komende kabinetsperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het artikel 'Klokkenluiders slaan alarm

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reported abuses at a youth family home (Villa Maria) and how complaints can be safely reported and handled. The state secretary explained the complaint channels (LMZ, IGJ meldpunt, Jeugdwet complaint committees, AKJ) and said the inspectorate is investigating, but declined to detail individual complaints citing confidentiality and privacy.
Due to the confidentiality of the information and the privacy of those involved in the submitted reports and signals, the individual reports or signals cannot be addressed.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van de informatie en de privacy van betrokkenen bij de afgegeven meldingen en signalen, kan niet op de individuele meldingen of signalen worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over onzorgvuldige uithuisplaatsingen kinderen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Inspectorate's finding that child out-of-home placement investigations are often careless, why less drastic measures are not tried first, why parents are denied information, and about youth care reform and profit-driven providers. The State Secretary acknowledged improvement is needed, promised a plan of action on parents' legal protection in autumn 2022, and gave a limited response on providers' profits and compensation.
As indicated in our letter on the IGJ investigation of 27 June 2022, the Minister for Legal Protection and I will jointly take this up and report back to your House in autumn 2022.
Zoals aangegeven in onze brief over het IGJ-onderzoek van 27 juni 2022, zullen de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en ik dit gezamenlijk oppakken en in het najaar van 2022 aan uw Kamer terugkoppelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Als studenten zelf alarm slaan over hun cocaïnegebruik, dan is er wat aan de hand’

MPs Slootweg and Van der Molen asked the government about reports of rising hard drug use among students since COVID, the 12.5% lifetime cocaine use figure, trends, prevention in student houses, public campaigns and cooperation with student associations. The state secretary answered that monitors show no excessive rise, outlined existing prevention programmes, said mass public campaigns risk backfiring, and promised continued contact with student associations.

Because the signal from the student association is worrying, I have had periodic consultations with the National Chamber of Associations, the national student association cooperative, and will continue this contact to keep a finger on the pulse.

Omdat het signaal van de studentenvereniging verontrustend is, heb ik periodiek overleg gehad met de Landelijke Kamer van Verenigingen, het landelijke samenwerkingsverband van studentenverenigingen, en zal dit contact voortzetten om een vinger aan de pols te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Omtzigt over het nieuwsbericht 'Faillissement door verkoopverbod tabak? Lobby klopte cijfers op'

MPs Dassen and Omtzigt asked about a news report that a tobacco-sales-ban impact study commissioned by the government, by SEO Economisch Onderzoek, overstated bankruptcy risk under lobby pressure, and asked how commissioned research is checked for representativeness, objectivity, lobbying influence and Framework Convention compliance. The State Secretary answers that existing codes (ARVODI, ALLEA, GIR) provide sufficient safeguards, that the research design was approved by VWS and adjusted after supermarkets refused cooperation, that the government does not deem Article 5.3 FCTC breached, and that a lobby register and a new ministers' code will be pursued.
The cabinet will ask a professor with expertise in interest representation and political decision-making for advice on a lobby register, and report on it in autumn 2022.
Het kabinet zal een hoogleraar met expertise op het gebied van belangenbehartiging en politieke besluitvorming vragen om advies over een lobbyregister, en hierover najaar 2022 nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de gezinshuizen in de jeugdzorg

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary about the rapid growth of family homes in youth care, their for-profit BV structures, tariff differences between municipalities, and whether WNT pay caps and quality supervision apply. The state secretary confirmed the growth, said legislation permits various organisational forms including BVs, referred tariff setting to municipalities and providers with supporting guidelines, said WNT does not cover partnerships (vof), and pointed to planned Wibz legislation and IGJ supervision.
This bill was recently explained in more detail by the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport in her letter of 29 June regarding tackling non-integrous care providers.
Dit wetsvoorstel heeft de Minister voor Langdurige zorg en Sport onlangs nader toegelicht in de brief van 29 juni jongstleden met betrekking tot de aanpak van niet-integere zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het risico op een overval op tabaksspeciaalzaken

An MP asks the government about a robbery at a tobacco shop, whether NVWA rules force shopkeepers to cover windows, and whether this endangers small retailers given the high robbery risk. The State Secretary answers that NVWA does not require covering windows, only that tobacco products not be visible from outside, that the choice of measures is up to the shop, and that the Centre for Crime Prevention will advise shops on compliance with visibility.
The NVWA does not require shopkeepers to fully cover their windows and front door.
De NVWA eist niet van winkeliers dat zij hun ramen en voordeur volledig afplakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Palland, Peters en Bikker over het artikel 'Investeer in preventie en die begint al bij de kinderwens'

MPs from CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about preconception care such as the Nu Niet Zwanger programme, its reach, and whether it should be part of the Kansrijke Start programme and municipal prenatal advice duties. The state secretary answered that Nu Niet Zwanger is already part of Kansrijke Start, available in 172 municipalities, that 272 municipalities have a local Kansrijke Start coalition, and that structural funding and possible anchoring will be explored.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het gebrek aan vegetarische en veganistische maaltijden in zorginstellingen

An MP asks the state secretary about the lack of vegetarian and vegan meals in care institutions, citing a petition and hospital nutrition figures, and whether extra steps and agreements will follow. The state secretary says hospitals are improving, that extra steps are not considered necessary now because food offerings are the responsibility of the institutions themselves, and that the concern is passed on to the Goede Zorg Proef Je project.
Food offerings are part of the quality of care and fall under the responsibility of the care institution itself.
Het voedingsaanbod is onderdeel van de kwaliteit van zorg en valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorginstelling zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verkuijlen en De Neef over het artikel ‘Noodkreet kinderrechters: veroordeelde jongeren krijgen niet de hulp die ze nodig hebben’

MPs Verkuijlen and De Neef asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about reports that convicted youths do not receive timely specialised youth care ordered by juvenile judges, including waiting lists, municipal budget constraints, lighter treatment advice from the Child Protection Council, and priority for these youths. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said regional procurement obligations and a support programme are being pursued, but gave no national figures on waiting lists and stated there is no plan to give these youths priority.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care, including youth care for young people in the criminal law context.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp, waaronder jeugdhulp voor jongeren in het strafrechtelijk kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de uitvoering van het jeugdstrafrecht en het (op tijd) ontbreken van de juiste hulp voor jongeren

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about long waiting times for court-ordered youth treatment and whether this increases reoffending and pretrial detention. The minister acknowledged the problem, said no data exist on youths waiting in detention, found no link to recidivism, attributed waits to municipal procurement gaps, and pointed to a planned law and a support programme.
No figures are available on the number of young people held in detention waiting for treatment.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat in detentie wacht op een behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Fastfood rondom scholen neemt sterk toe.’

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that fast-food outlets near schools, especially in deprived areas, are increasing, and what measures will be taken on food environments, including municipal powers and product reformulation. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, promises a letter after the summer on the prevention approach and possible legal measures, and says a legal exploration of municipal instruments is underway.
I am currently exploring legal measures to achieve a healthier food environment.
Ik verken op dit moment wettelijke maatregelen om tot een gezonde(re) voedselomgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Romke de Jong over een suikertaks

MPs Van der Laan and Romke de Jong asked whether the coalition's sugar tax, which raises the existing beverage excise, would also make bottled water more expensive and whether this fits prevention goals. The government confirmed that mineral water is temporarily included, plans to exempt it from 1 January 2024, and will study tariff differentiation by sugar content.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Westerveld over het bericht 'Hoe ‘pro-anacoaches’ kwetsbare meisjes misbruiken' en de uitvoering van de motie Van der Graaf c.s. (Kamerstuk 31015-197)

MPs Bikker and Westerveld asked about reports of 'pro-ana coaches' sexually exploiting girls with eating disorders, and the implementation of a motion on online investigation strategy and criminalising pro-ana content. The Minister outlines a range of prevention, support and criminal-justice measures already underway, but declines a blanket ban on pro-ana sites and says an online investigation strategy is still being developed, with details promised before summer.
In addition, I have committed to discuss with the police the development of an online investigation strategy.
Daarnaast heb ik toegezegd met de politie in gesprek te gaan over het ontwikkelen van een online opsporingsstrategie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht ‘Peuk peperduur; kabinet: prijsverhoging sigaretten tot 47 euro in 2040’

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary for Health whether a planned large increase in cigarette excise up to 47 euro per pack by 2040 is justified, and whether it will push smokers abroad and fuel smuggling. The state secretary answers that excise increases are an effective prevention tool toward a smoke-free generation by 2040, cites RIVM evidence that cross-border buying rose only modestly, and points to EU traceability rules and the WHO protocol against illicit trade.
A further excise increase after 2024 is one of the measures I am including in my exploration because it is scientifically regarded as a very important measure to reduce the number of smokers.

Een verdergaande accijnsverhoging na 2024 is één van de maatregelen die ik meeneem in mijn verkenning omdat dit wetenschappelijk wordt gezien als een zeer belangrijke maatregel om het aantal rokers terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het memorandum van het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei

An MP asked the state secretary about the National Committee 4 and 5 May memorandum's reference to Dutch and Indonesian victims of the colonial war in Indonesia, and whether this is painful for Indo-Dutch communities who see perpetrators honoured. The state secretary answered that the commemoration covers all war victims, that the committee decides independently, that feelings of anger are understood, and that the Indies history is part of Dutch history, without committing to changes.
The NC is an independent organisation that decides autonomously on how the 4 May commemoration is shaped.
Het NC is een onafhankelijke organisatie die zelfstandig besluit over de wijze waarop de herdenking op 4 mei wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Westerveld over seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de jeugdzorg

MPs Ceder and Westerveld asked the State Secretary and Minister about sexual boundary violations in youth care, including 414 reports reported by the Inspectorate, the role of victim protection, supervision and prosecution. The government acknowledges the problem as shocking, describes measures following the De Winter report, the AKJ advocacy system and IGJ supervision, and says it sees no structural gap in prosecution while admitting it cannot count prosecuted cases in youth care.

In addition, extra investment has been made in advocacy work (AKJ) to offer young people a listening ear; they will also more often explicitly ask about experiences of violence during their visits to institutions.
Daarnaast is extra geïnvesteerd in vertrouwenswerk (AKJ) om jongeren een luisterend oor te bieden; zij gaan tevens vaker expliciet vragen naar ervaringen van geweld bij hun bezoeken aan instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Kuiken over het artikel 'Vaccinatie kleine kinderen tegen rotavirus opnieuw niet vergoed

MPs Van der Laan and Kuiken asked why the rotavirus vaccine was not reimbursed for infants despite a positive Health Council advice, and about cost-effectiveness criteria. The State Secretary said no structural funding is available, the vaccine's cost-effectiveness depends on tender prices, and he will not instruct RIVM to start a tender, while promising a broader review of the basic-package test later in the year.
As I wrote to your House in my letter of 23 May, no financial coverage is available for rotavirus vaccination.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 23 mei j.l. aan uw Kamer heb geschreven is er geen financiële dekking beschikbaar voor rotavirusvaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de veiligheid van trapliften

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Wmo-funded stairlifts in several municipalities do not meet Bouwbesluit safety requirements, whether municipalities might choose cheaper unsafe lifts, and about an income-dependent co-payment. The secretary acknowledged the concern, said municipalities bear responsibility via procurement and checks, declined to commission further investigation, and noted the trade-offs of a separate co-payment.
I am of the view that unsafe situations can thereby be prevented by the responsible parties and that additional research has no added value.
Ik ben van mening dat zodoende onveilige situaties door de verantwoordelijke partijen voorkomen kunnen worden en dat aanvullend onderzoek geen toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg en Bikker over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars investeren in fastfoodketens

MPs asked whether health insurers' investments in fast-food chains are a wrong signal given the obesity problem, and whether fast food should be an exclusion category. The minister replied that insurers decide their own investment policy, that the holdings are small (about 8 million euros), that dialogue with chains like McDonald's has produced commitments, and that prevention talks and an upcoming letter will follow.
As private parties, health insurers themselves decide on their investment policy.
Als private partijen gaan zorgverzekeraars zelf over hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Het papieren meisje'

An MP asks the State Secretary about a news report on a young girl lacking specialised youth care, court-ordered treatment not delivered, waiting lists, runaway incidents and closed-youth-care failings. The State Secretary acknowledges the shortcomings, says waiting-time data is not kept nationally, promises regional dashboards and mandatory regional procurement of specialised care, but gives limited data and does not answer one question in time.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care. Information on waiting times is therefore not kept nationally.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp. Informatie over wachttijden wordt daarom niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'GGD-GHOR laat onverzekerde burgers stikken'

An SP MP asked the health minister how the GGD-GHOR could stop processing notifications about uninsured people, why the GDPR was cited, what the consequences are, and whether the registration rules excluding homeless people from health insurance will be changed. The minister answered that no legal basis exists for processing these notifications, that care remains financed via the subsidy scheme, that a legislative change is being prepared, and that talks with GGD GHOR continue.
I will examine which legislative procedure this amendment can accompany, so that it can take effect as quickly as possible.
Ik zal bezien met welk wetstraject deze wijziging mee kan lopen, zodat deze zo snel mogelijk in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Paulusma over de artikelen 'Het ene Nederland is het andere niet' en 'Er vallen doden door slechte zorg Sint Eustatius'

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretaries about press articles reporting deaths from poor healthcare on Sint Eustatius, including referral problems and the role of Zorg en Jeugd Caribisch Nederland. The government acknowledged the problems, described steps taken and planned (a referral pilot, protocol review, talks with providers), but declined to commission a specific investigation, pointing to the IGJ calamity inquiry already under way.
I am willing to enter into discussion with care providers about their concerns.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met zorgverleners over hun zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Kamminga over de berichten ‘Er vallen doden door slechte gezondheidszorg Sint Eustatius’ en ‘Het ene Nederland is het andere niet’

MPs Van den Hil and Kamminga asked the State Secretaries about reports of deaths from poor healthcare on Sint Eustatius, including the hospitainer's equipment, staffing, appointment of a hospital director and stakeholder involvement. The government denied the hospitainer was inadequate or unstaffed, said no new director was appointed but a temporary CMO was added, and committed to a study of healthcare in Caribbean Netherlands and to a letter for the budget debate.
I will send your House a letter before the 2022 budget debate in response to question 9.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de begrotingsbehandeling 2022 als antwoord op vraag 9 een brief sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ceder over het aantal doorplaatsingen van uit huis geplaatste kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Ceder asked about the frequency of re-placements of children taken out of their homes, what concrete steps followed the Het Vergeten Kind report and the StroomOp action plan, and whether targets were met. The State Secretary answered that re-placements are not registered nationally, that some targets such as the under-5% overplacement goal were not met though numbers fell, and that a plan for the future of closed youth care will be sent before summer.
The number of re-placements is not registered nationally.
Het aantal doorplaatsingen wordt niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Westerveld over het zo snel mogelijk naar het nultarief brengen van de btw op groente en fruit vanwege steeds duurdere boodschappen

MPs Van Esch and Westerveld asked why the VAT on fruit and vegetables cannot be cut to zero sooner, given rising grocery prices, and whether this could happen by 1 July 2022. The government answers that defining unprocessed produce raises complexity and fiscal-neutrality issues, so it cannot be done by 1 July 2022, and promises a plan of action with a study to the House by summer.
It is therefore not possible to arrange this by 1 July 2022.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om dit voor 1 juli 2022 te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de problemen bij de woonlocatie Oosterparkheem Groningen

MP Hijink (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about the problems at the Oosterparkheem care location in Groningen after the bankruptcy of MartiniZorg, including why elderly residents and former addicts were housed together, and whether La Hacienda's high past profits made it a suitable successor. The government answered that the municipality and health insurer are responsible for continuity of care, that most residents have been relocated, that IGJ intervened against MartiniZorg, and that a bill on conditions for profit distribution is being prepared.
For the Wlz, profit distribution is currently prohibited for intramural care and permitted for extramural care.
Voor de Wlz geldt op dit moment dat winstuitkering verboden is voor intramurale zorg en toegestaan voor extramurale zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de ggz in het eerste kwartaal al een miljoenenverlies lijdt

MP Hijink asked the minister about reports that mental health care (ggz) providers face multi-million euro losses in Q1 2022, why major providers still lack contracts with insurers, what will prevent recurrence, and whether no client will be left without care. The minister answered that contracting is the responsibility of insurers and providers, that the NZa and IGJ supervise continuity of care, that monitoring will be reported before summer, and that the NZa will be asked to examine recent treatment cutbacks for structural problems.

Because the recently announced adjustments to treatment offerings are happening in a short period, I have asked the NZa to examine the cases more closely and inform me of any common underlying factors.

Omdat de recent aangekondigde aanpassingen van behandelaanbod in korte tijd plaatsvinden heb ik de NZa gevraagd om de casuïstiek nader te bezien en mij over eventuele gemeenschappelijke onderliggende factoren te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Verkoopverbod of niet: jongeren kopen massaal snus'

MPs Heerema and Rajkowski asked why snus and nicotine pouches above 0.035 mg remain widely available despite the Dutch sales ban, and what the NVWA is doing about online and social media sales. The State Secretary replied that the NVWA targets importers and websites, has seized stock and pressed importers to stop sales, uses notice-and-take-down on social media, and is intensifying enforcement while awaiting the Digital Services Act.
I am in discussion with the NVWA about how enforcement can be intensified.
Ik ben met de NVWA in gesprek over hoe de handhaving geïntensiveerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Kabinet wil minder fastfoodwinkels in de stad’

MPs Heerema and Rahimi asked whether the government will restrict fast-food outlets, how this fits EU and national rules on freedom of enterprise, and what the preventive agreements and industry commitments achieve. The State Secretary answered that legal options for municipalities to shape the food environment are being explored, subject to EU Services Directive justification, and that industry product-improvement steps are underway.
I am having the options explored to give municipalities more legal tools in this area.
Ik laat de mogelijkheden verkennen om gemeenten op dit vlak daarom meer juridische handvatten te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het nieuws dat overgewicht, roken en drinken in drie jaar nauwelijks gedaald zijn

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary for Health about news that obesity, smoking and drinking had barely declined over three years, and whether the national prevention goals for 2040 are at risk. The state secretary acknowledged the gap with the goals, said a sugar tax and VAT cut on fruit and vegetables are being prepared, promised to intensify measures and inform parliament around summer, but declined to anchor prevention goals in law, citing shared responsibility and personal choice.
A statutory anchoring of these prevention goals is, in my view, not needed at this time.
Een wettelijke verankering van deze preventiedoelen is wat mij betreft dan nu ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat nicotinezakjes op middelbare scholen en zelfs op basisscholen verhandeld worden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that nicotine pouches are sold in secondary and even primary schools in Hoorn, and about enforcement, the motion to bring them under the Tobacco Act, and planned measures. The State Secretary agreed the products are undesirable, said the NVWA is acting against pouches above 0.035 mg nicotine as unsafe food, will issue a policy rule by 1 May 2022, and promised a further letter before summer.
I find it very undesirable that young people use and sell nicotine pouches.
Ik vind het zeer ongewenst dat jongeren nicotinezakjes gebruiken en verhandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden en Kuiken over de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015 voor patiënten met ALS

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Kuiken asked about municipal delays and inconsistency in Wmo 2015 provision of aids and support to ALS patients, including whether municipalities can be called to account and their view of the ALS protocol. The State Secretary acknowledged distressing cases and deferred to municipalities, pointing to existing agreements, a pending study and a commitment to talk with municipalities and the VNG where problems are signalled.
I am aware that distressing situations arise in individual cases, for example of ALS patients, where it takes a long time to organise support, and that is undesirable.
Ik ben ermee bekend dat zich schrijnende situaties voordoen in individuele situaties van bijvoorbeeld ALS-patiënten, waarin het lang duurt om de ondersteuning te organiseren en dat is onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Chaos in jeugdzorg is een goudmijn voor adviesbureaus'

MP Westerveld asked the State Secretary of Health about a Follow the Money report that youth care reform has generated large spending on external consultancies, advisers and programmes, and about how effective this spending has been. The State Secretary acknowledged concern, explained that external research and consultation are used for reform, referred to existing procurement and tariff rules, and said the Youth Reform Agenda will be sent to parliament before summer 2022.
Parliament will be informed before summer 2022 about the Youth Reform Agenda and the outcomes of the consultation with the VNG.
De Kamer wordt vóór de zomer van 2022 geïnformeerd over de Hervormingsagenda Jeugd en de uitkomsten van het overleg met de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over het op straat zetten van alleenstaande gezinnen

An MP asked the state secretary about single-parent families being left homeless due to municipal housing allocation policies and whether child-protection measures are used as pressure. The government answered that housing allocation is decentralised, housing shortages are the underlying cause, child-protection measures cannot be based on housing problems alone, and a study on urgency allocation by housing corporations is underway.
This is not known. This is not registered as such.
Dit is niet bekend. Dit wordt niet als zodanig geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen
