MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uithuisgeplaatste kinderen en het toeslagenschandaal

An MP asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, including reunification prospects, complaint procedures at the youth care inspectorate and certified institutions, the scope of the inspectorates' investigation, and legal protection for parents and children. The minister answered at length, often stating that the inspectorates lack competence to handle individual complaints, declined to name the investigators, and said the requested two-week deadline could not be met.
I am not willing to give you the names of the staff (officials) of the inspectorates who carry out the investigation.
Ik ben niet bereid u de namen te geven van de medewerkers (ambtenaren) van de inspecties die het onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de zorgwekkende frisdrankconsumptie van jongeren

An MP asked the state secretary for health about youth soft-drink consumption, the need for national research, school measures, Nutri-Score, sugar tax and advertising limits. The state secretary answered that existing RIVM surveys suffice, outlined school and product-reformulation measures, and promised further measures and a sugar drinks tax in the Belastingplan 2023.
I hope to inform the House before the summer about the additional measures.
Ik hoop uw Kamer voor de zomer te informeren over de aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Luchtvaartonderzoek houdt vliegherrie buiten beeld, waarschuwt GGD’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked why the aviation cost-benefit guidance (MKBA werkwijzer) treats aircraft noise in ways that allegedly favour the aviation sector and diverge from WHO noise guidelines, and whether this undermines trust of residents. The minister replied that the guidance is an adequate first version, that noise valuation will be improved through a research agenda, that the ministry did not influence the noise norms, and that no 'rekentrucs' (calculation tricks) occurred.
It is indeed important that noise nuisance is taken into account properly in cost-benefit analyses.
Het is inderdaad van belang dat geluidhinder op goede wijze wordt meegenomen in MKBA's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Westerveld over terugplaatsingen na uithuisplaatsingen

MPs Ceder and Westerveld asked the ministers how to reduce long out-of-home placements of children, what the government knows about returns home, and whether returns will be registered. The minister answers that reunification is a goal, lists measures and a WODC study, and says registration of returns will be explored with partners, but no reliable national figures on returns currently exist.
I am willing to improve registration on this point.
Ik ben bereid de registratie op dit punt te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het onderzoek 'Gesloten jeugdzorg beschadigt 86% van de kinderen'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Het Vergeten Kind study claiming closed youth care harms 86% of children, including isolation cells and restraint. The State Secretary acknowledged harm and abuse risks, cited reduced placements and isolation cell phase-out, and promised a plan to end closed youth care in its current form, with alternatives to be developed with municipalities, providers and youths.
That is why it is good that in recent years the number of children placed in closed youth care has decreased sharply.
Het is daarom goed dat de afgelopen jaren het aantal kinderen dat in de gesloten jeugdhulp geplaatst wordt sterk verminderd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Mantelzorgers en professionals moeten het samen zien te rooien, ‘maar overheid moet dan ook iets bieden’

An MP asked whether a Maastricht hospital's 'Mantelzorgacademie' training patients and carers to perform medical tasks such as IV antibiotics, and whether carers face pressure to take over care, and who bears legal responsibility. The state secretary replied that training is voluntary, case-by-case, supervised by professionals, that carers performing such tasks are not acting professionally under the BIG Act, and that the government will keep working on formal-informal care cooperation.
If someone performs reserved acts non-professionally, the BIG Act does not apply to them.
Als iemand niet beroepsmatig voorbehouden handelingen uitvoert dan is de Wet BIG niet op hem van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Paulusma over de inzet van tolken in de jeugdzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about children interpreting for parents in youth care, the funding gap for interpreters under the Jeugdwet compared with mental health care, and risks to fact-finding in child protection cases. The State Secretary acknowledged that child interpreting is undesirable in serious cases, said no signals of children being refused or parents being excluded are known, and announced a study on interpreter funding due before summer.
No extensive investigation has been carried out in response to the questions you ask in questions 6 to 9.
Er is geen uitgebreid onderzoek gedaan naar aanleiding van de vragen die u stelt in de vragen 6 tot en met 9.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat ieder jaar 3 miljard euro zorggeld verdwijnt in de zakken van mensen die mensen leveren die zorg leveren

An SP MP asked the government about a newspaper report that 3 billion euros of care funds yearly go to intermediary, recruitment and staffing agencies, and whether agency margins and wage-cost ratios were excessive. The minister answered that most of this sum pays wages and employer charges of agency staff, that margins are roughly 10 to 20 percent, and listed measures to reduce reliance on intermediaries.
The picture that paying costs for non-employed staff results in an annual profit of 3 billion euros for agencies is in any case incorrect.
Het beeld dat de betaling van kosten voor personeel niet in loondienst voor de bemiddelings- en uitzendbureaus resulteert in een jaarlijkse winst van € 3 miljard, is in ieder geval onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Werner over het bericht 'PGB-houders krijgen opeens minder uren'

An MP asks the State Secretary about reports that PGB holders receive fewer hours after insurers overrule district nurses' indications, and about rising complaints to the SKGZ. The minister answers that insurers may review indications but should consult the nurse first, that complaints in 2021 were not higher than 2020, and that no further investigation is planned for now.
As the answer to question 3 shows, the number of new complaints did not rise in 2021.
Zoals uit het antwoord op vraag 3 naar voren komt, is het aantal nieuwe klachten in 2021 niet gestegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘Meer verkeersongelukken in 2021, politie maakt zich zorgen’

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked about police concern over rising traffic accidents in 2021, including risky behaviour, nitrous oxide use in traffic, and the road safety targets and funding for dangerous N-roads. The minister outlined prevention and enforcement measures, said the nitrous oxide ban cannot take effect by 1 July 2022 due to procedure, and committed to a road safety target and prioritisation of N-road investments.
The cabinet is committed to reducing traffic participation under the influence of all drugs, and specifically nitrous oxide.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om verkeersdeelname onder invloed van alle drugs, en ook specifiek van lachgas, terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Werner, De Neef en Tellegen over het toezicht van de gemeenten op de zorg

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the state secretary about municipal supervision of care after reports that municipal oversight under the Wmo 2015 is failing, including staffing, coordination with national inspectorates, handling of reports, staff qualifications and fraud. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, said municipalities have wide discretion and that a study on Wmo supervision is underway with a follow-up letter promised before 1 June 2022, while several answers referred to existing cooperation arrangements and noted that national data was unavailable.
That is why my predecessor decided to commission a study into the functioning of Wmo supervision.
Daarom heeft mijn ambtsvoorganger besloten een onderzoek in te stellen naar het functioneren van het Wmo-toezicht
